jobs.title: Business Planning & Operations Partner - 11955
jobs.excerpt: Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small.
jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Support and Education leaders to run their business reviews: prepare thedata, agree the actions, and write their section of the quarterly Health Pack
  • Build Support capacity plans with Support leaders, and work with FP&A and HR on Support and Education inputs to the AOP and to capacity and headcount planning
  • Analyze Support and Education performance and learning adoption with their teams, and turn the results into recommendations leaders can act on
  • Work with Support, Education, and Customer Success teams to define and test the signals that point to customer risk, and feed them into the cross-VS customer health view
  • Work with Business Intelligence: say what leaders need to see, validate what gets built, and contribute Support and Education definitions to the KPI dictionary
  • Align Support and Education metrics and plans with Professional Services and Customer Success operations so cross-VS views match
  • Work with leaders and the Tech Product Manager to write business cases for technology and AI requests, each with a named outcome and measure, and track the results
  • Present findings alongside leaders to the CCO team, and mentor less experienced analysts

What You Will Bring to Coupa

    • Bachelor's degree and 8+ years (or a Master's degree and 6+ years) in business planning, operations analytics, customer analytics, or BI in a SaaS or technology company; background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or strategic FP&A looking to move into a business partner role is highly welcome; support, education, or enablement data experience strongly preferred

    • Experience building capacity or workforce planning models

    • Advanced SQL, strong Excel/Sheets, and a BI tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)

    • Skill with scoring, segmentation, and trend analysis, and a track record of getting leaders to act on your analysis

    • A collaborative style: you build agreement across teams with different priorities, and you work independently with minimal direction

    • Clear communication and presentation skills with directors and senior leaders; uses AI tools such as Claude to automate analysis and reporting, with human review
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:

  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREFounded in 2012, 3iQ is one of the world's leading alternative digital asset managers, pioneering institutional-grade investments.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Founded in 2012, 3iQ is one of the world's leading alternative digital asset managers, pioneering institutional-grade investments. 3iQ launched the world’s first Digital Assets Managed Account Platform (QMAP), a hedge fund investment solution, offering innovative risk-managed investment solutions to gain exposure to digital assets. 3iQ was also the first to launch a Bitcoin and Ethereum ETP listed on a major global stock exchange, integrate staking into its Ethereum and Solana ETPs boosting investor returns, and offering other regulated ETPs. In 2024, Monex Group, a leading Japanese financial group, took a majority stake in 3iQ. Since 2012, 3iQ has been at the forefront of innovation in digital asset investment management. To learn more about 3iQ, visit 3iq.io.

W:
L:
X:

OUR CULTURE

At our company, we lead with Kyōdō — putting “we before me” and winning as a team. We stay humble, curious, and always learning, lifting each other up and celebrating shared success. We move fast, adapt boldly, and focus on what’s possible rather than what’s familiar. We speak with honesty and care, practicing radical candor to help each other grow. And when we commit, we follow through — with accountability, integrity, and real ownership. If you thrive in a supportive, ambitious, growth-minded culture, you’ll belong here!

THE ROLE

The Senior Software Engineer sits at the intersection of exchange connectivity, execution and market data for 3iQ’s trading technology team. You will own the trading core, including order and execution management, exchange integrations and market data pipelines, which risk, the ledger and our client apps all build on. You will be a hands-on builder and an owner: designing, building, deploying and operating what you ship, sharing in the on-call rotation for systems that trade 24/7, and helping set the technical standard for how we build as we scale.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

  • Design and evolve the core trading architecture for throughput, latency and failure isolation
  • Build and maintain venue gateways over REST, WebSocket and FIX: order entry, cancels, amendments and drop copy
  • Own order and execution management: one order per client, client order IDs aligned with the venue, no missed or hidden trades
  • Run market data ingestion and normalization across 10,000+ instruments, with redundancy and failover between feeds and gateways
  • Automate the instrument lifecycle: listing, delisting, expiries and option rotations
  • Onboard new venues and instrument types, and absorb their quirks so clients never see them
  • Be the technical reference for the engineers building risk, ledger and client apps on top of the core
  • Lead incident response on the trading path, and write the runbooks so others can too

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • 7+ years building production backend systems, with at least 3 in trading, market infrastructure or exchange connectivity
  • Deep experience with exchange or broker APIs (REST, WebSocket, FIX), order lifecycles and market data
  • Strong command of a systems or backend language used in production trading, such as C++, Rust, Java or Go
  • Solid distributed systems fundamentals: concurrency, idempotency, back-pressure, failover and consistency
  • Experience designing for high message rates (tens of thousands per second and up) at millisecond latency
  • A track record of owning a production system end to end, including on-call for a 24/7 market
  • Clear written and spoken English

NICE TO HAVE

  • Crypto derivatives: perpetuals, funding, options lifecycle, margin and liquidation on Binance, Deribit or similar
  • OMS/EMS or smart order routing experience
  • Functional programming or JVM experience (Clojure, Scala, Kotlin)
  • Experience leading architecture decisions across several teams

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • Competitive compensation including discretionary bonus
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of an innovative, fast-growing industry
  • Remote-first team with a flexible work environment focused on results
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with a strong execution mindset
  • Annual company offsites to connect, collaborate, and recharge
  • Birthdays off to celebrate your day your way!
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Supportive parental leave policy designed to prioritize family and well-being

jobs.title: Staff Customer Reliability Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise.
jobs.description:
At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.
We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.
Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.
If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.

What you will do

  • Act as the senior technical owner for the most complex, high-severity, and strategically important customer issues.
  • Diagnose difficult problems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, identity and access management, observability, integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Establish and improve standards for troubleshooting, escalation quality, incident readiness, case ownership, and technical documentation.
  • Build automation, diagnostics, runbooks, and other operational mechanisms that reduce repeat escalations and improve time to resolution.
  • Coach and mentor CREs through complex case reviews, incident retrospectives, technical training, and day-to-day technical guidance.
  • Develop reusable technical content and enablement that increases the independence and effectiveness of the broader CRE and Support organizations.
  • Work closely with Escalation Management and account teams on high-touch customers and customer-impacting reliability risks.
  • Participate in the CRE on-call rotation and provide technical leadership during critical incidents.
  • Communicate clearly with engineers, executives, customer technical teams, and other stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to the audience.

What you will bring with you

  • 7+ years experience in technical support, customer reliability engineering, site reliability engineering, solutions architecture, or a related production engineering discipline.
  • Expert-level experience with Kubernetes and Linux in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting and operating workloads across one or more major public cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of using automation to improve operational outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex incidents, technical escalations, problem management, or post-incident improvement efforts.
  • A track record of converting individual customer problems into scalable improvements, such as product changes, automation, standards, or enablement.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers in complex, hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud, regulated, or highly integrated environments.
  • Ability to balance urgent customer needs with durable technical solutions and long-term reliability goals.

What we look for

  • Work with a technically strong team focused on delivering measurable value to customers.
  • Help shape how a growing cloud security company operates at enterprise scale.
  • Collaborate with globally distributed teams across Customer Reliability, Support, Product, Engineering, and SRE.
  • Contribute to open source technologies that are widely used by cloud-native teams.
  • Work in an environment that values diverse perspectives, open dialogue, and continuous learning.

When you join Sysdig, you can expect

  • Extra days off to prioritize your well-being
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match
  • Maternity and Parental Leave
  • Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app
  • Full health benefits package for you and your family
The U.S. annual salary range for this full-time position is between 125,000 and 156,200 USD/year. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job-related experience and education.
We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different.

jobs.description:
Looking for an extra opportunity next to your current career?

Business Development Manager/ Account Executive (m/f/d)

location: Remote (Europe-based)

Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Hours: Flexible

Compensation: High-Tier Uncapped Commission + Recurring Placement Share(Commission only role)

About Us

We are a specialized recruitment agency driving international expansion across Europe. With historic staff shortages impacting the healthcare sector, we partner with hospitals, private clinics, and medical care centers across Belgium to secure top-tier medical talent through direct hire placement.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial, consultative Freelance Business Development Manager (BDM) / Account executive to spearhead our market growth, secure strategic healthcare partnerships, and close service agreements across Belgium.

The Role & Opportunity

We want a high-performing door-opener who can hunt for new client accounts in the healthcare sector, consult with executive leaders, and close commercial deals. If desired, there is also full flexibility and room to handle full-cycle recruitment alongside your sales pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Market Penetration: Formulate and execute a proactive B2B sales strategy targeting key executive decision-makers (such as Hospital CEOs, HR Directors, Managing Directors, and Chief Medical Officers) across Belgium.
  • End-to-End Deal Closing: Own the entire sales cycle—from multi-channel cold outreach and network prospecting to pitching our solutions and negotiating commercial terms.
  • Framework Agreements: Secure, negotiate, and finalize exclusive and semi-exclusive master service agreements on a performance-based (contingency / no-win, no-fee) structure.
  • Account Leadership & Full-Cycle Option: Act as the main commercial contact for new accounts. Collaborate with our internal delivery team to fulfill placements, with full opportunity to run full-cycle recruitment if you prefer managing candidate sourcing yourself.
  • Pipeline & CRM Ownership: Autonomously build, forecast, and manage a robust B2B pipeline of healthcare clients across your target regions.

Requirements

  • Language Skills: Professional English for internal team alignment.
  • Proven Sales Track Record: 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or business development, preferably selling services or corporate solutions into the Belgian market.
  • Industry Alignment: Deep commercial understanding of the medical/healthcare sector or experience in recruitment services sales is strongly preferred.
  • Executive Gravitas: Excellent communication skills with the corporate presence needed to pitch, consult, and negotiate directly with clinical executives and hospital directors.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Self-motivated to work as an independent contractor using your own sales methodologies to drive revenue.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote & Autonomous: Work from anywhere with complete control over your schedule. Scale this as your main freelance activity or run it alongside an existing client portfolio.
  • Premium Commission Architecture:
  • Milestone payout upon successfully closing and onboarding a verified new client agreement.
  • A high-percentage, uncapped recurring commission split for every successful medical placement made within your accounts.
  • High Revenue Potential: Due to severe medical shortages, average placement fees are high-value (€20,000 to €35,000+ per placement), yielding significant commission per deal.
  • Operational & Sourcing Support: Access to our CRM, tailored healthcare marketing collateral, and a dedicated candidate delivery team ready to fulfill your client job orders.

How to Apply

If you are a driven sales professional who wants to capitalize on the high demand in healthcare recruitment, apply today by submitting your resume or LinkedIn profile.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare?
jobs.description:
Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare?

Sound like you? Keep reading.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:
Impact - We do work that matters.
Collaboration - We are in it together.
Human touch - We care deeply.

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and FR (with occasional travel to our London or Paris offices) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

The Platform team exists to make the whole engineering organisation more effective. We’re guided by one core question: how do we help our colleagues reduce cognitive load and get more done? We’re looking for a Platform Product Manager to own the shared layer that internal engineering teams build on, and to lead our push into agentic development on top of that foundation. You’ll treat internal product engineering teams as your customers, build a platform strategy, and success will be evaluated on how much faster and more reliably other teams can ship.

What you will be doing

  • Platform as a Product: Co-own the platform strategy and roadmap with our Head of Platform.
    - Define and communicate the vision for our internal developer platform and agentic development harness. Prioritise investments based on adoption impact, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make the trade-offs between near-term and long-term value clear. Connect platform investment to company objectives.
    - Treat internal teams as customers. Proactively conduct research with other teams to surface implicit platform needs and turn cross-cutting requirements into platform priorities before they become blockers.
    - Conduct user research with engineers, observing development workflows and combining qualitative feedback with usage data to identify friction, unmet needs and opportunities for self-service.
    - Build the shared layer other teams reuse. Work with the engineering team to convert one-off solutions into shared, easy-to-use services, establishing the platform standards, interfaces, and reusable components that let teams stop rebuilding the same thing.
    - Enable agentic development on the platform. Own the capabilities that let internal teams build, deploy, and operate AI agents safely and at scale.
    - Establish agent governance and assurance. Define product requirements for the guardrails that make agentic capabilities trustworthy in production. Own the evaluation framework that measures agent task completion, failure recovery, output quality, and human override rates, and use it to catch regressions before they reach other teams.
    - Drive scalability and reliability. Partner with engineering on the non-functional requirements that make shared services trustworthy at scale: reliability, performance, security, observability, and graceful behaviour under load. Understand what breaks when a service others depend on runs unattended.
    - Use data to decide. Define adoption, reliability, and developer-experience metrics for the platform and agent-specific metrics like time to value, task completion rate, and human override rate. Pull and interpret data yourself, form a point of view, and use it to prioritise.

What we are looking for

This is a senior, high-trust role: you’ll champion a platform-as-a-product vision and represent the Platform team’s priorities in cross-functional conversations, all while keeping empathy for the end-user at the centre of what you build.

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in product management, with meaningful time on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing tooling, or backend/API products
    -Technical fluency: you’re credible with senior engineers, can reason about distributed systems and architecture trade-offs, and are comfortable where the non-functional requirements *are* the product
    - A track record of owning a platform or internal tool end-to-end, setting direction and shipping without someone else defining the “what”
    - Experience shipping agentic workflows and tooling into production
    - Ability to connect platform work to concrete business value and team outcomes
    - Strong written and verbal communication; you can articulate the value of complex platform topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
    - Ownership and autonomy: you grab problems without being asked and drive outcomes without waiting for direction


    Nice-to-haves

    - Hands-on ability to prototype, even if you’re not shipping it
    - Exposure to regulated, enterprise, or security-sensitive environments
    - Background contributing to internal developer platforms, DevEx initiatives, or open-source ecosystems
    - Experience with API gateways, identity/access management, or service-to-service communication patterns
    - Experience designing agent governance capabilities: explainability, audit trails, tool permissions, or approval/escalation workflows
  • An active practitioner of agent frameworks who follows developments in open-source harnesses, coding agents, and orchestration tools
    - Experience in the HealthTech or healthcare industry

- Proficiency in the French language


How we’ll know you’re succeeding

- Faster time-to-integrate for teams adopting shared services and agentic capabilities
- Rising adoption of platform components over one-off, team-built alternatives
- Reliability and performance of shared services and agents meeting agreed SLOs, with strong task completion and low override rates
- Internal teams citing the platform as an accelerant rather than a bottleneck

What you’ll get in return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!
    - From a £75k+ package (based on your experience and the value you can bring)
    - Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
    - 36 days off: 25 holidays +bank holidays +3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) - that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
    - Comprehensive health & wellbeing support – including private health insurance, mental health support and free therapy sessions through Oli.
    - Hybrid & flexible work environment – work from anywhere in the UK/FR, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.
    - Get the tech you need - You will get the latest MacBook and take your pick from a wide range of equipment to set up your home office ergonomically.
    - Work alongside an inspiring team – our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
    - Fantastic office space in Central London/Paris - with a roof terrace, weekly animations, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
    - The usual free bits that come with nice offices (barista coffee, tea, fruit, happy hours and activities...).
Salary: from GBP 75,000

jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

We are adding a new role to our Sales organization to support our customer growth and focus on data and product expansion. The Bluesight Customer Data Engineer owns data integration with our customers, ensuring they get value from Bluesight's platform quickly and seamlessly. You'll work directly with hospital customers to understand their data environments, guide them through Bluesight's requirements, and lead the technical work of getting the hospital customer into the platform. You'll also contribute to the internal tooling that makes the next implementation faster and to the product work that accelerates time-to-value.

About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

SHI’s Solution Marketers are storytellers who simplify complex concepts, craft compelling narratives, and highlight customer outcomes to drive go-to-market success.

The Solution Marketing Manager, Software & Cloud drives the positioning and go-to-market activation of SHI’s software and cloud portfolio. This role translates complex licensing, cloud platform, professional services, managed services, and partner capabilities into compelling customer outcomes, differentiated narratives, and sales-ready solutions that accelerate pipeline growth, adoption, and revenue.

This role partners with Software & Cloud business leaders, hyperscaler and strategic software teams, technical experts, sales, and cross-functional marketing teams to develop solution offerings. The Solution Marketing Manager shapes market-facing messaging, activates launches, and uses customer and market insights to keep SHI’s portfolio relevant, competitive, and aligned with buyer needs.

The role requires demonstrated experience marketing hyperscaler solutions and services, particularly Microsoft, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Role Description


Go-to-Market Leadership

  • Translate executive business goals, including pipeline, growth, customer acquisition, adoption, renewal, and expansion, into performance-focused go-to-market plans.
  • Develop marketing strategies for business and technical decision-makers, including CIOs, CTOs, cloud leaders, IT operations, application and data leaders, procurement, finance, architects, and partner sellers.
  • Partner with Software & Cloud leadership stakeholders to understand portfolio strategy, roadmaps, partner priorities, funding and co-sell motions, and market opportunities.
  • Own capability mapping, offering development support, solution positioning, and first-level strategy alignment for the pillar.
  • Coordinate the Software & Cloud pillar pod, connecting solution marketing, hyperscaler partner marketing, campaigns, content, events, creative, sales enablement, and business stakeholders around shared priorities and measurable outcomes.

Positioning and Messaging

  • Define clear, customer-friendly narratives across the strategic software advisory and hyperscaler portfolio, including licensing, professional services, and managed services.
  • Differentiate SHI by developing a unified software and cloud customer story focused on business value that resonates with target audiences.
  • Create targeted solution playbooks and persona-specific content for economic buyers, technical buyers, procurement leaders, partner sellers, and SHI sales and overlay teams.
  • Translate hyperscaler and software partner priorities and funding opportunities into consistent SHI positioning while maintaining SHI’s differentiated point of view.

Portfolio and Solution Development

  • Partner with practice and technical teams to map capabilities, identify portfolio gaps, prioritize repeatable offerings, and support solution packaging and lifecycle management.
  • Turn approved solution descriptions into market-ready foundations, including catalog listings, one-pagers, overview presentations, marketplace and co-sell content, and internal launch communications.
  • Clarify the customer problem, outcomes, target audience, differentiation, proof points, delivery approach, and partner alignment for each prioritized offering.
  • Support cross-platform and multi-cloud stories spanning Azure, AWS, and GCP while accurately reflecting internally delivered, managed, and partner-delivered capabilities.
  • Maintain alignment between SHI’s internal solution catalog and external hyperscaler marketplaces or co-sell listings, where applicable.

Market Analysis

  • Conduct market, competitive, partner, and customer research to monitor cloud adoption, software buying models, hyperscaler developments, AI and data platform shifts, marketplaces, consumption, commitments, renewals, and emerging customer needs.
  • Translate market insights and analyst information into actionable recommendations for portfolio development, messaging, campaigns, sales readiness, and partner activation.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to inform solution packaging, partner strategy, roadmap priorities, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Monitor competitor positioning and ecosystem changes to identify whitespace and sharpen SHI’s differentiation.

Sales Enablement, Solution Launches, and Adoption

  • Work with creative and content teams to develop high-impact marketing and sales assets, including messaging frameworks, customer journey maps, ROI stories, solution briefs, overview decks, battlecards, marketplace copy, and partner-facing materials.
  • Equip SHI sales, specialist and overlay teams, pre-sales resources, and partner sellers with messaging, use cases, plays, and customer conversation guides.
  • Support solution and service launches with clear handoffs, internal communications, catalog readiness, campaign inputs, partner activation, and success measurement.
  • Support advocacy programs through case studies, customer success stories, win narratives, references, and proof points that demonstrate adoption and measurable value.
  • Help sellers connect licensing and cloud transactions to advisory, professional, managed, and optimization services that expand customer outcomes and lifetime value.

Content and Demand Generation

  • Help achieve demand generation goals by shaping integrated campaigns that create qualified pipeline for priority software, cloud, and hyperscaler solutions.
  • Partner with hyperscaler marketing, campaign, content, editorial, field, and event teams to translate pillar priorities into coordinated activation across SHI-owned and partner channels.
  • Develop content that resonates with IT, cloud, data, application, procurement, finance, and business leaders and guides them through the buying journey.
  • Leverage major ecosystem moments, including Microsoft Ignite, AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next, executive briefings, webinars, and partner field programs, to amplify differentiated SHI stories and accelerate opportunity creation.

Thought Leadership and Analyst Relations

  • Support software and cloud thought leadership through owned and earned media initiatives that establish SHI as a practical, outcome-focused guide across complex partner ecosystems.
  • Support analyst relations and market education that strengthen SHI’s software, cloud, and hyperscaler credibility.
  • Identify opportunities to connect cloud, AI, security, data, modern workplace, and spend optimization narratives into a cohesive SHI point of view.

Performance Metrics

  • Define and track KPIs for positioning, content, campaigns, launches, partner activation, pipeline influence, adoption, marketplace engagement, and sales readiness.
  • Use performance data, customer feedback, partner insights, and field input to continuously optimize strategies and investment priorities.
  • Provide concise updates to senior leadership on key initiatives, dependencies, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking: Synthesizes complex market, portfolio, customer, partner, and performance data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Business Acumen: Connects marketing strategy to revenue growth, pipeline, adoption, renewals, customer value, and partner objectives.
  • Communication: Simplifies software, licensing, cloud, and technical concepts for diverse internal, customer, and partner audiences.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Uses customer needs, buying dynamics, and feedback to guide positioning, packaging, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Develops and executes integrated initiatives across multiple platforms, stakeholders, and routes to market.
  • Collaboration: Builds alignment across business leaders, technical experts, sales, partner teams, and marketing functions to drive decisions and action.
  • Project and Goal Focus: Manages multiple priorities, dependencies, and launches with clear ownership and disciplined follow-through.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: Maintains fluency in rapidly evolving hyperscaler platforms, partner programs, AI, cloud economics, and software buying models.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Excellent copywriting and messaging ability – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to understand audiences and adapt communications for executive, technical, sales, customer, and partner stakeholders – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to create compelling messages that differentiate SHI across software, cloud, and services – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to build go-to-market plans, messaging frameworks, solution briefs, presentations, playbooks, and campaign inputs – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft, AWS, and GCP ecosystems, partner motions, marketplaces, and cloud services – Intermediate.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft 365 suite – Intermediate.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, project management, time management, and organizational skills – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume role and multiple concurrent initiatives in a large, distributed organization – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Strong technical literacy, particularly in cloud and AI, with the ability to simplify complex concepts without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Metrics-driven approach with the ability to connect marketing activity to incremental business results.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and navigate changing priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder needs.
  • Natural curiosity and empathy for customers, sellers, technical teams, and partners.

Other Requirements

  • Completed bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required.
  • 3–5 years of product, services, or solutions marketing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience marketing solutions or services aligned with hyperscalers such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Familiarity with strategic software partners and adjacent platforms such as ServiceNow, Adobe, data platforms, or cloud management technologies.
  • Experience translating cloud platforms, licensing and consumption models, marketplaces, commitments, renewals, partner funding, and co-sell motions into customer and seller value propositions.
  • Proven ability to develop comprehensive go-to-market plans and execute launches that drive awareness, partner engagement, sales readiness, and qualified pipeline.
  • Position may require up to 25% travel.

Preferred

  • Product, services, or solutions marketing experience within B2B technology, IT services, consulting, or solution provider environments.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $100,000 - $130,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

Your Role and Impact:

  • Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.

  • Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.

  • Value Articulation: Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.

  • Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.

  • Technical Credibility: Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.

  • Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.

  • Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

This Role is a Fit for You If:

  • Proven Post-Sales Experience: You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.

  • Technical Credibility: You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources.

  • Stakeholder Range: You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.

  • Structured and Proactive: You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.

  • Commercial Awareness: You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

Bonus Points For:

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale.

  • Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector -- where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.

  • Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.

  • Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

  • Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

  • Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

  • Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

  • Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

  • Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

  • Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

  • Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

  • Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

  • Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

  • Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

  • Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About TechSkills & MyComputerCareer:

TechSkills is the B2B workforce training division of MyComputerCareer (MyCC), focused on helping organizations and technology professionals build the skills needed to succeed in a rapidly changing digital landscape. Through instructor-led training, digital learning, certification programs, and customized workforce solutions, TechSkills partners with businesses to strengthen capabilities across areas including AI, cloud, cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, and other high-demand technical disciplines.

While TechSkills operates as a distinct customer-facing brand, our team members are part of MyComputerCareer and share in the same commitment to Love, Customer First, Excellence, and Ethics. At MyCC, we're focused on transforming lives and organizations through technology education and creating meaningful opportunities for the people we serve.

Location:Remote

Compensation Range:$60-75K Annually

Candidates can reside in one of the following states: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, MO, MS, NC, NV, OH, OK, SC, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, and WI.

PURPOSE OF POSITION

The Marketing Coordinator plays a key role in building demand, strengthening the TechSkills brand, and supporting pipeline growth across our B2B training business.

Working closely with the Director of Marketing and Sales, this role helps execute integrated marketing campaigns across email, social media, webinars, events, and sales enablement channels. The Marketing Coordinator will translate TechSkills' products and solutions into clear, compelling messaging while developing the campaigns and content needed to engage prospects and move opportunities through the sales funnel.

This is a hands-on role for a marketer who is equally comfortable developing content, coordinating campaigns, managing webinars and events, analyzing performance, and partnering closely with Sales.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Support the development and execution of integrated B2B marketing campaigns designed to generate qualified leads, increase engagement, and support revenue growth.

  • Build and execute multi-touch email and messaging sequences, including modified Agoge-style outreach and nurture campaigns.

  • Coordinate campaign activities across email, digital, social media, webinars, events, and sales outreach.

  • Partner closely with Sales to align campaign strategy, messaging, lead follow-up, and pipeline objectives.

  • Support lead nurturing and marketing automation workflows that move prospects from initial engagement to sales conversations.

Demand Generation & Events

  • Coordinate the development, promotion, execution, and follow-up of TechSkills webinars and virtual events.

  • Support trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, and other demand-generation events.

  • Develop pre-event and post-event campaigns designed to maximize attendance, engagement, lead capture, and follow-up.

  • Partner with internal subject matter experts to develop relevant webinar and event content.

Content & Sales Enablement

  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales collateral, including one-pagers, brochures, presentations, case studies, email content, and campaign materials.

  • Translate TechSkills products, services, and technical training solutions into clear and compelling customer-facing messaging.

  • Support Sales with content and tools that strengthen prospect conversations and communicate the TechSkills value proposition.

  • Maintain consistent product and brand messaging across marketing and sales channels.

Social Media & Digital Presence

  • Develop and execute social media content across platforms including LinkedIn and YouTube.

  • Create content that builds brand awareness, demonstrates TechSkills expertise, promotes programs and events, and generates engagement.

  • Coordinate content calendars and campaign schedules across digital channels.

  • Support ongoing improvements to TechSkills' digital presence and customer journey.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance, engagement, lead activity, and conversion metrics.

  • Analyze results to identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, sequencing, and campaign effectiveness.

  • Provide regular reporting on marketing activities and their contribution to lead generation and sales pipeline.

  • Test and refine campaign approaches based on performance data.

KEY COMPETENCIES

B2B Marketing: Understanding of B2B buyer journeys, demand generation, lead nurturing, and sales pipeline development.

Campaign Execution: Ability to coordinate multiple campaign components across email, social, digital, webinars, events, and sales outreach.

Content Development: Strong writing and communication skills with the ability to turn complex products and technical concepts into compelling customer-facing content.

Sales Partnership: Ability to collaborate closely with Sales and understand how marketing activities support pipeline development and revenue goals.

Project & Time Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously.

Analytical Thinking: Comfortable reviewing marketing performance data and using insights to improve campaign effectiveness.

Initiative: Self-directed and proactive, with the ability to identify needs, recommend solutions, and move projects forward in a fast-paced environment.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • 2–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, or a related role.

  • Experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns.

  • Experience with email marketing, lead nurturing, marketing automation, and CRM platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to create professional marketing and sales collateral.

  • Experience coordinating webinars, virtual events, trade shows, or other demand-generation activities.

  • Strong written communication and copywriting skills.

  • Experience using marketing performance data to evaluate and optimize campaigns.

  • Proficiency with CRM and marketing automation platforms; experience with Microsoft Dynamics and Mailjet is a plus.

  • Experience with webinar platforms such as Zoom and social media management tools.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in IT, SaaS, software, technology training, or professional education.

  • Experience marketing B2B workforce development, training, or certification solutions.

  • Familiarity with direct-response marketing and multi-touch prospecting/nurture sequences.

  • Experience supporting sales enablement initiatives.

  • Experience marketing through LinkedIn and YouTube.

  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, or technology certification markets.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means:

  • Consistent execution of high-quality campaigns that generate engagement and support pipeline growth.

  • Strong alignment between Marketing and Sales.

  • Clear and compelling TechSkills messaging across digital, sales, and customer-facing channels.

  • Well-executed webinars and events that generate qualified opportunities.

  • Effective marketing workflows and nurture campaigns supported by CRM and automation systems.

  • A recognizable and trusted TechSkills brand within the IT training and workforce development market.

PHYSICAL AND COGNITIVE DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may:

  • Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer.

  • Frequently operate a computer, phone, and other standard office equipment.

  • Communicate and exchange accurate information with employees, customers, prospects, vendors, and business partners.

  • Occasionally move about office spaces, training venues, conferences, or event locations.

  • Occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds.

  • Maintain the cognitive ability to manage multiple priorities, analyze information, solve problems, and work effectively in an environment with changing priorities and frequent interruptions.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Employees will follow other instructions and perform other duties as assigned by their manager.

WHY JOIN US?

Joining the TechSkills team means helping organizations and technology professionals build the capabilities they need for what's next. You'll have the opportunity to help grow a dynamic B2B technology-training brand while being part of the broader MyComputerCareer organization and culture.

COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS THAT SUPPORT YOU AT EVERY STAGE

We believe taking care of our people is just as important as taking care of the customers and students we serve. Eligible full-time employees enjoy a well-rounded benefits package designed to support health, financial security, and overall well-being.

Our benefits include:

  • Multiple medical plan options, including HSA plans with employer contributions

  • Dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and holidays

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for confidential personal support

  • Optional coverage such as accident, critical illness, and pet insurance

We're committed to helping our employees stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain balance both at work and at home.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.

We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.

We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity

The Event Project Manager is responsible for managing AV production projects for mid to large-sized corporate events for a variety of our largest clients. Clients hire us to provide audiovisual production equipment and technical teams for their events across the country and you would manage the oversight of each project.

This person will work with clients across tech, finance, pharma, and non-profit industries, serving as the face of Meeting Tomorrow throughout the event execution process. You'll be the client's main point of contact and the person accountable for how each event turns out. You'll get to know each client's goals, spot gaps in the plan, recommend the right path, and keep clients, vendors, and our internal teams on track from first call to final invoice. This role is highly detailed, task-oriented, and requires the confidence to guide senior client stakeholders throughout the whole process, ultimately ensuring the clients' vision for AV production and creative design becomes reality.

This role requires frequent to moderate onsite travel (approximately 20-30%, or 4-5 days per month).

What You'll Own

  • Audiovisual Event Project Planning: You’ll lead numerous events throughout the year, managing project scope, timelines, and budgets. You’ll guide clients through the project lifecycle, coaching them on AV Production best practices for in-person and hybrid events to ensure the execution exceeds their vision.
  • Communication & Decision Making: You are the client’s main point of contact and MT representative. You’ll lead the information flow between internal teams (fulfillment, creative, etc.), venues, vendors, and the client, while expertly preparing onsite staff for successful execution.
  • Client Relationship Building: You don’t just manage events but you build genuine connections. You’ll get to know our clients on a personal level (interests, family, life events) and bring a level of enthusiasm that drives credibility and repeat business.
  • Creative Deliverables Management: You’ll act as the bridge between clients and creative teams (designers, editors). You’ll manage logistics with vendors (decor, print, custom fabrication), maintain asset trackers, manage POs, and negotiate terms to be a true steward of the client’s budget.
  • On-Site Leadership: You’ll travel (approx. 20-30%) to be the face of MT, preparing onsite staff in partnership with Production Managers to execute flawlessly while maintaining high energy in fast-paced event environments.

What We Need

  • 4+ Years of Event Experience: You’ve been a part of leading events whether at an agency or other high-touch client setting.
  • Organization & Speed: You’re used to a high volume of work, a fast-paced multitasker who is accountable to deadlines, and finds joy in the details.
  • Clear Communicator. You’re able to confidently set expectations, speak up early, and follow through.
  • Relationship Builder. You’re able to build relationships and cater your approach depending on the person you’re talking to. You’re experienced in working with different personalities and professional levels.
  • Technical & Creative Curiosity: You’re ready to dive into AV production and creative service logistics.
  • Adaptability. You can confidently work and make decisions in gray, unpredictable spaces with shifting priorities. When faced with unforeseen challenges, you adjust to keep the project (and everybody) on track.
  • Values Alignment: You demonstrate kindness, commitment, and humility in everything you do.

The Impact

Within 1 month, you’ll:

  • Learn about MT’s services - the value we offer, the types of events that we service and our customer-service mentality.
    Have opportunities for training to expand your exposure and understanding of how we manage events at Meeting Tomorrow
  • Meet with current members of the Project Management, Production, Creative, and Sales teams to understand best practices for supporting our clients and their diverse needs.

Within 3 months, you’ll:

  • Build strong and lasting relationships with clients and internal team members, ensuring a strong client retention rate.
  • Begin to create your own processes for working with your clients and identify opportunities for efficiency/improvement.
  • Become proficient in our CRM, Netsuite and Project Planning tool, Backstage.
  • Work with members of our internal support teams to effectively manage a large-scale event or event series for premier clients. These clients include Fortune-5000 companies in many sectors including pharmaceutical, wealth management, and production service agencies.

Within 6 months you’ll:

  • Have proficiency in the role and be managing accounts with autonomy.
  • Complete projects to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
  • Demonstrate an aptitude for problem solving and contingency planning; striving to consistently exceed client expectations.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options
  • Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access
  • 401k with employer matching up to 4%
  • 16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays
  • Annual profit-sharing bonus
  • 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
  • $50 Monthly fitness reimbursement
  • Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell
  • Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)
  • Regular social events and learning opportunities

At Meeting Tomorrow, our mission is to foster a culture of respect and affection. We embrace our differences and are committed to having a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in second chances and strongly encourages BIPOC, women, LGBTQIA, veterans, persons with disabilities, formerly incarcerated and all other individuals to apply.

What makes Meeting Tomorrow’s culture so special is the people, and we look for candidates who are a match for our company’s core values: commitment, kindness and humility. If those words describe you and you see yourself in this posting, you’re ready to apply!

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Legal Content Researcher & Editor

Location: Remote - India

About the Role

We are seeking a highly capable Senior Legal Content Researcher & Editor to join a UK based research and communications firm working with clients across the legal, tax, accounting and wider professional services sectors.

This is a hands-on writing, research and editing role for someone who is fast, highly organised, detail-oriented and comfortable producing a substantial volume of high-quality content.

You will research and write articles, blogs, guides, thought-leadership pieces, research papers, website content and other editorial material across a wide range of legal, regulatory, tax, commercial and professional services topics.

Initially, the role will be focused heavily on personally researching, writing and editing content. As the content function grows, the successful candidate will help recruit, train and manage additional writers and develop into the day-to-day lead for the content team.

We are looking for someone with excellent editorial judgement, strong research ability and the ability to maintain both quality and output in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research legal, regulatory, tax, commercial and industry topics using reliable and authoritative sources.
  • Write high-quality articles, blogs, legal guides, thought-leadership pieces, research content and website copy.
  • Produce content consistently against clear deadlines and output targets.
  • Understand unfamiliar subjects quickly and turn complex information into clear, engaging and professional writing.
  • Review, edit and proofread content for accuracy, structure, tone, grammar and readability.
  • Check legal references, facts, statistics, dates and other important claims.
  • Maintain strong research and source standards.
  • Adapt writing style and tone across different clients, brands, audiences and subject areas.
  • Update existing content when laws, regulations or industry developments change.
  • Support content publishing and formatting across WordPress or other content management systems.
  • Help establish editorial guidelines, research standards, writing templates and quality-control processes.
  • As the team grows, help recruit and assess new writers.
  • Train and support writers, review their work and provide clear editorial feedback.
  • Help manage workloads, deadlines, production targets and overall content quality.
  • Work closely with the wider team to ensure content is delivered accurately and efficiently.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Journalism, English, Political Science, Communications or another relevant field.
  • Excellent written English.
  • Strong professional writing, editing and proofreading ability.
  • Strong legal and general research skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify reliable and authoritative sources.
  • Ability to understand complex topics and explain them clearly.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Able to produce high-quality work at pace.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.
  • Confident taking ownership of work and making sound editorial decisions.
  • Genuine interest in law, regulation, tax, business, current affairs and professional services.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage:

  • Journalism.
  • Legal writing or legal research.
  • Editing or digital publishing.
  • Professional content writing.
  • Business, tax or financial writing.
  • Law firm or professional-services content.
  • Academic or policy research.
  • SEO-focused content writing.
  • Keyword research and search intent.
  • WordPress or another CMS.
  • Reviewing or mentoring other writers.

Previous formal management experience is helpful but not essential. We are open to a strong senior writer or editor who is ready to take on greater responsibility and grow into a team leadership role.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is a strong and confident writer.
  • Researches quickly and thoroughly.
  • Has an excellent eye for detail.
  • Is naturally productive and output-focused.
  • Can manage a large and changing workload.
  • Works well with clear targets and deadlines.
  • Can move efficiently between different clients, subject areas and types of content.
  • Produces clean, accurate drafts that require minimal correction.
  • Takes ownership and does not require constant supervision.
  • Responds well to feedback and applies it consistently.
  • Is capable of maintaining high standards while working at pace.
  • Is interested in helping build and eventually lead a high-performing content team.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote role for candidates based in India.
  • Opportunity to work with an international research and communications firm serving clients across the legal and professional services sectors.
  • A role centred around research, writing and editorial quality.
  • Exposure to a broad range of legal practice areas, regulatory matters, tax, accounting and professional services.
  • Opportunity to help build the content function from an early stage.
  • Clear progression into managing and leading additional writers as the team grows.
  • Training, feedback and professional development.
  • Exposure to digital publishing and SEO.
  • Long-term career growth for strong performers.

Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Staff Software Engineer, Backend to the Engineering team.
You'll join the Publishing team, which delivers millions of social messages to networks like Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok and is used by 75% of all Sprout customers every month.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?

With collaborative cross-functional teams that span mobile, front-end, back-end and site reliability engineering—the Sprout Engineering team is a place to sharpen your craft and solve hard problems with the smartest people in the industry. On a daily basis, we process tens of billions of requests and tens of billions of asynchronous events. We also ingest billions of social messages every day, and ship more than 1,000 production deployments every month. You’ll get to work on a “tech-giant” scale with smaller, supportive teams where every engineer has the chance to make an impact on our company, and our customers. The best part? In our industry, you often have to switch jobs or even companies to learn a new part of a tech stack or business. But at Sprout, our product is a suite, so you just need to move teams. You’re able to diversify your skills, which not only benefits your team—but also your career.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure service excellence and maintain robust, scalable technical foundations, leveraging technologies such as Java, Python, MySQL, NSQ, AWS, OpenSearch and Redis.

If you love solving hard problems, delivering and sustaining high-quality software, and confidently guiding your peers to learn from and teach each other, we’d love to talk with you!

Additionally, these are the preferred qualifications that would indicate a particularly strong candidate:

How you’ll grow
