jobs.excerpt: About PharmaEssentia: It’s not often you get the chance to make a real impact on the lives of others, while expanding your own possibilities.
jobs.description:
About PharmaEssentia:
It’s not often you get the chance to make a real impact on the lives of others, while expanding your own possibilities. You’ll find that rare opportunity at PharmaEssentia. Join us, and let’s transform lives, together.
PharmaEssentia Corporation is a rapidly growing biopharmaceutical innovator. We are leveraging deep expertise and proven scientific principles to deliver effective new biologics for challenging diseases in the areas of hematology and oncology, with one product approved and a diversifying pipeline. We believe in the potential to improve both health and quality of life for patients with limited options today through the combination of rigorous research and innovative thinking. Founded in 2003 by a team of Taiwanese-American executives and renowned scientists from U.S. biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, today we are listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE: 6446) and are expanding our global presence with operations in the U.S., Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and China, along with a world-class biologics production facility in Taichung.

Position Summary
The Scientific Content & Publications Manager serves as a key Medical Affairs partner responsible for developing scientific content, educational resources, and scientific communications while coordinating publication planning and execution across the organization. Working under scientific leadership oversight, this role supports Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), Medical Affairs leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders by creating, maintaining, and disseminating high-quality scientific materials that support training, scientific exchange, congress activities, publications, and evidence communication.
This position plays an important role in ensuring that scientific resources remain current, accurate, compliant, and aligned with Medical Affairs objectives. The Scientific Content & Publications Manager will also provide backup support for Medical Information activities using approved resources and established escalation procedures.

Business Need
As the Medical Affairs organization continues to expand, the volume of scientific data, educational resources, publications, and congress-related content continues to grow. Dedicated scientific content support is needed to maintain high-quality materials while enabling Medical Affairs leadership to focus on strategic activities such as MSL development, onboarding, coaching, monthly assessments, and semi-annual competency evaluations.
This role will support the development and maintenance of scientific resources across the organization, ensuring timely updates to reflect emerging data, competitor intelligence, publications, and evolving treatment landscapes.
In addition, increasing congress, sponsorship, and scientific engagement activities require dedicated content development support to prepare educational and field-facing materials. This role will work closely with Medical Affairs leadership and stakeholders to support content development and maintenance while coordinating Medical Review Committee (MRC) submissions through established processes.

Key Responsibilities
Scientific Content Development & Medical Affairs Communications

  • Develop and maintain scientific training materials covering internal research, external publications, competitor data, emerging evidence, and evolving treatment paradigms.
  • Create educational resources and training presentations for Medical Affairs personnel and Medical Science Liaisons.
  • Develop pre-conference training materials supporting major scientific congresses, including ASH, SOHO, EHA, MPN International, ASCO, MPN Asia, and other relevant meetings.
  • Prepare scientific content related to company-sponsored research, publications, congress presentations, and educational initiatives.
  • Create and maintain external-facing MSL presentations and scientific slide decks to support interactions with healthcare professionals and key opinion leaders.
  • Develop and update scientific communication materials, including presentations, training resources, meeting materials, congress resources, and educational content.
  • Monitor emerging scientific literature, congress presentations, publications, and competitive developments to ensure resources remain current and scientifically accurate.
  • Support scientific review of presentations, slide decks, and educational materials to ensure scientific accuracy, balance, and compliance.
  • Coordinate Medical Review Committee submissions and revisions in collaboration with appropriate stakeholders.
Publications Planning & Management
  • Support publication planning and execution across abstracts, posters, oral presentations, manuscripts, and other scientific communications.
  • Coordinate publication timelines, milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage publication development activities, including author coordination, documentation, disclosures, approvals, and submission processes.
  • Maintain publication tracking systems, records, metrics, and status reporting.
  • Coordinate activities among internal stakeholders, external authors, publication vendors, and medical writing partners.
  • Monitor publication project risks, timelines, budgets, and dependencies while recommending solutions to maintain project execution.
  • Ensure publication activities adhere to company policies, Good Publication Practice (GPP), ICMJE recommendations, and applicable industry standards.
Medical Information Support
  • Provide backup Medical Information support utilizing approved content, Standard Response Letters (SRLs), product dossiers, and established Medical Information procedures.
  • Support accurate, balanced, and compliant responses to medical inquiries within approved parameters.
  • Escalate inquiries that require additional review or are outside approved content according to established procedures.
  • Assist in maintaining Medical Information resources and identifying opportunities for content updates.
  • Support Medical Information operational activities as needed, including vendor coordination, documentation, tracking, and reconciliation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner closely with Medical Affairs leadership to identify content needs, training priorities, and educational opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Medical Science Liaisons to support field medical training and scientific resource development.
  • Work cross-functionally with Clinical Development, HEOR, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and Medical Information teams.
  • Manage interactions with external medical writing, publication, and scientific communication vendors.
  • Communicate project status, timelines, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, healthcare, life sciences, communications, or related discipline required.
  • Advanced degree (MS, MPH, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Medical Affairs, medical communications, scientific content development, publications, Medical Information, or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, audience-appropriate educational and communication materials.
  • Experience developing scientific presentations, training materials, congress resources, or publication-related deliverables.
  • Understanding of publication processes and industry standards, including GPP and ICMJE recommendations.
  • Familiarity with medical review and promotional/non-promotional content review processes preferred.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and publication or project-management systems.

Core Competencies
  • Scientific content development
  • Medical communications
  • Publication planning and coordination
  • Scientific writing and presentation development
  • MSL training support
  • Congress and scientific meeting preparation
  • Stakeholder and vendor management
  • Project management and execution
  • Scientific accuracy and attention to detail
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Compliance and process adherence

Location: Remote, up to 30% travel

The expected base salary range for this position is $117,000 - 139,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education and geographical location. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, successful candidates are eligible for short-term and long-term incentives.

Benefits of working with our team:
PharmaEssentia USA strives every day to improve the lives of patients as well as our employees. As a valued member of PharmaEssentia USA, you will enjoy the following benefits:
  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Generous paid time-off
  • 401(k) retirement plan with competitive company match
  • Medical & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account
  • Up to $150 monthly cell phone reimbursement
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Free parking

At PharmaEssentia USA, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. PharmaEssentia USA believes that diversity and inclusion among our team are critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

PharmaEssentia does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Staffing agencies should not send resumes to our HR team or to any PharmaEssentia employees. PharmaEssentia is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies.

At PharmaEssentia, our goal is to treat as many people with cancer as possible. That means challenging the status quo with better science that leads to better lives. jobs.description:
Turnitin is seeking a forward-thinking global HR executive to lead People Operations and its continued transformation. Reporting to the Chief People Experience Officer, this role oversees Global People Shared Services, Benefits, HR Systems and Analytics, and Employee Relations operations, including our external ER partnership. The role will also lead the planned integration of global Payroll operations from Finance.

We are looking for a leader who can design organizations, build capability and create leverage through effective structures, systems, technology and people. This includes challenging legacy ways of working, testing hypotheses, making fact-based investment decisions and using AI and automation to simplify work and improve productivity.

Our environment is global, remote-first and evolving. Success requires someone who can lead through ambiguity, constructively challenge assumptions, make decisions with imperfect information and translate complex problems into practical solutions.

This leader must bring deep operational expertise, sound employee relations judgment, proven HR technology transformation experience and the ability to develop a strong leadership bench. The expectation is not simply to maintain operations, but to build a more scalable, resilient and accountable People Experience function. This leader will also serve as a trusted adviser to the CPXO and senior leadership, bringing independent judgment, sound business acumen and practical solutions to complex operational, organizational and employee matters. They will anticipate risks, offer constructive challenge and help translate business priorities into effective People practices.

What You Will Do

Global People Shared Services & Operational Excellence

  • Lead global People Shared Services across employee lifecycle operations, onboarding, offboarding, leaves, immigration coordination and employee support.
  • Lead the design and continuous improvement of the People Shared Services (PSS) delivery model, establishing clear ownership, decision rights, escalation protocols and accountability within PSS, while partnering with PBPs, COEs and external providers to ensure effective handoffs, coordination and service delivery.
  • Evaluate organizational structure, staffing, spans of control and work allocation to improve service effectiveness, productivity and management capacity.
  • Build scalable operations through standardization, self-service, documented procedures, cross-training and succession coverage.
  • Establish performance measures that identify service gaps, recurring issues, operational risk and opportunities to redirect work to more effective delivery channels.

Employee Relations, Governance & Risk

  • Lead the global Employee Relations operating model, including governance, quality and performance of external ER partners.
  • Bring strong judgment and practical expertise to complex employee matters, including investigations, performance, restructuring, separations and employment risk.
  • Establish clear decision rights, case ownership, service standards and escalation protocols in partnership with Legal and People Business Partners.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and economics of the ER delivery model, building internal expertise and alternatives to external providers where appropriate.
  • Anticipate emerging employee risks and operational vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate intervention before matters escalate unnecessarily.
  • Establish effective ER case management, tracking and reporting, including case volumes, themes, resolution timelines, outcomes and recurring risks to inform continuous improvement.
  • Strengthen the operational management of employee separations and HR offboarding, ensuring clear ownership, timely coordination, consistent documentation and effective partnership across PSS, PBPs, Legal and external providers.

HR Technology, AI & Digital Transformation

  • Lead HRIS modernization, including strategy, selection, implementation, integration, adoption and ongoing optimization.
  • Reimagine the People service model using AI, automation and integrated systems to reduce administrative work, improve self-service and create capacity for higher-value activities.
  • Expand AI-enabled employee and manager support, knowledge management, case routing, workflow automation and workforce analytics.
  • Establish reliable People data, reporting and governance, including appropriate security, privacy and responsible AI controls.
  • Develop fact-based business cases, test hypotheses through pilots and measure productivity, adoption, service improvements and return on investment.
  • Challenge technology investments that automate inefficient processes without first addressing underlying organizational or workflow issues.

Global Benefits & Payroll Transformation

  • Lead global Benefits operations, including administration, enrollment, vendor performance, financial stewardship and employee experience.
  • Design and implement an integration plan for global Payroll operations from Finance, including organizational structure, resourcing, systems, controls and transition readiness.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal and IT to strengthen Payroll governance, compliance, accuracy and integration with People systems.
  • Evaluate opportunities to standardize, simplify and automate Benefits and Payroll processes while protecting service continuity and financial controls.
  • Build sustainable functional leadership and operational coverage across both areas.

People Leadership, Organizational Design & Enterprise Partnership

  • Assess capabilities and capacity against future operating requirements, making evidence-based recommendations to build, buy, automate, or redesign work.
  • Lead effectively in a Remote-First environment, establishing strong operating rhythms, communication, collaboration and accountability across countries and time zones.
  • Partner with the CPXO, PXLT, Finance, Legal and IT on business-critical decisions, operational risks and transformation priorities.
  • Bring forward well-supported recommendations, welcome constructive challenge and adapt plans when new evidence warrants a different approach.
  • Maintain operational performance while implementing organizational change, balancing speed, employee experience, risk and financial discipline.
  • 15+ years of progressive global HR leadership experience, including senior accountability for HR Operations, Shared Services or organizational transformation.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required. Advanced degree or relevant HR or Employment Legal qualification / JD preferred.
  • Strong understanding of global Benefits, Payroll operations, HR compliance and employee lifecycle services.
  • Trusted advisor to C-suite (including Chief People Experience Officer) and senior business leaders, demonstrating strong business acumen and balancing of business objectives and priorities.
  • Demonstrated organizational design expertise, including restructuring teams, developing management capacity, establishing decision rights and improving spans of control and operational leverage.
  • Deep Employee Relations expertise, with sound judgment in complex matters, employment risk, external provider oversight and development of internal ER capability.
  • Proven leadership of significant HRIS implementations or transformations, including systems integration, process redesign, automation and adoption.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI, automation or intelligent technologies to improve employee self-service, knowledge management, case management, workflow execution, analytics or operational productivity.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including building fact-based business cases, testing assumptions, evaluating service delivery alternatives and demonstrating measurable returns.
  • Proven ability to build strong leadership teams, develop successors, address capability gaps and reduce operational dependency on individual employees or external providers.
  • Experience leading global, multidisciplinary teams in Remote-First, distributed or complex matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated resilience through organizational change, competing priorities and constructive challenge, with the ability to maintain delivery while improving how work gets done.
  • Strong executive communication, sound judgment and the ability to influence stakeholders while remaining open to alternative perspectives.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is: $245,402/year to $283,445/year. This position is bonus eligible / commission-based.

Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job-related factors. Internal equity, market and organizational factors are also considered.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You enjoy working at high velocity:
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the Role
The Executive Assistant is a high-ownership hybrid role combining executive support, operational coordination, and task management.
This position works directly with the Principal, who operates at a fast pace and generates deals, ideas, and commitments quickly. The primary responsibility of this role is to be the system behind leadership: capturing commitments, managing calendars, triaging communication, and keeping day-to-day operations moving smoothly without letting details fall through the cracks.
This is not a traditional administrative position focused solely on completing assigned tasks. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver who thinks independently, exercises sound judgment, identifies what needs to happen next, and takes full ownership of getting it done.

Executive Support & Calendar
  • Manage and protect executive calendars, meetings, and daily schedules, ensuring proper buffer times and priorities are maintained.
  • Prepare leadership for meetings by providing key context, summary notes, and relevant documentation.
  • Triage incoming communications, email, and messages daily, drafting responses and flagging priority items (targeting daily Inbox Zero).
  • Translate voice memos, phone calls, and verbal commitments into written follow-ups, action items, and clear records on the same day.
Operations & Project Follow-Through
  • Maintain a centralized system to track open commitments, deadlines, and action items across internal teams and external parties.
  • Proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure tasks and projects are completed on time.
  • Pre-read long documents, reports, and contracts to provide concise summaries and recommendations.
  • Support administrative coordination across residential and commercial property management, vendor communication, and invoice tracking.

Communication & Logistics

Technology & Systems

You’ll also contribute to preventative measures as our environment grows, investigate threats and drive remediation to closure, and collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to strengthen our overall security posture. jobs.description:
Oracle Cloud Senior Project Manager – ERP/SCM Background

Job Summary

Argano is seeking a Project Manager to lead Oracle Cloud implementations for our clients. Depending on client needs, you may manage several smaller engagements at the same time, such as single-module deployments, phased rollouts, or optimization projects. You may also serve as the dedicated project manager on one larger, multi-pillar implementation spanning ERP/SCM, HCM, EPM, and/or CX. We're looking for someone who is comfortable in both roles and can shift between them as client needs change.

Our ideal candidate has a strong track record delivering Oracle Cloud ERP and Supply Chain projects and a solid understanding of how Financials and Supply Chain connect with the rest of the Oracle Cloud suite. We also value experience leading HCM, EPM, or CX implementations, and we welcome candidates who can bring that range to multi-pillar programs.

You'll be accountable for planning, executing, and closing each engagement on time, within scope, and within budget, while serving as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders and Argano leadership.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead Oracle Cloud implementation projects from initiation through go-live, hypercare, and closure, either managing multiple smaller engagements at once or serving as the dedicated project manager on a larger, multi-pillar program.
  • When managing multiple engagements, balance priorities, resources, and client commitments so each project stays on schedule and within budget.
  • When leading a multi-pillar program, coordinate parallel workstreams (for example Financials, Procurement, Supply Chain, HCM, EPM, and CX), managing sequencing, integration points, and shared milestones.
  • Define scope, goals, and deliverables based on the Statement of Work (SOW), and build project plans covering timelines, resource allocation, and key dependencies.
  • Plan and run key implementation activities, including design workshops, testing (SIT, UAT, and parallel financial close or reconciliation where applicable), data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
  • Apply Oracle Cloud implementation methodology and scale it to the size and complexity of each engagement.

Team and Resource Management

  • Work with Center of Excellence (COE) Leads to staff each engagement and adjust staffing as projects move through their phases.
  • Lead and coordinate functional and technical consultants, workstream leads, integration and data teams, and client counterparts.
  • Assign tasks, manage resources, and encourage collaboration and clear communication across teams.
  • Direct the QA Lead to make sure deliverables meet Argano's quality standards and client expectations.

Governance, Risk, and Financial Management

  • Set up governance suited to each engagement, from lightweight status cadences on smaller projects to steering committees and workstream governance on larger programs.
  • Manage risks, actions, issues, and decisions (RAID), including cross-project and cross-pillar dependencies, and drive them to resolution.
  • Develop and carry out risk mitigation plans throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain a Project Budget Tracker/Burn Sheet for each engagement, and manage change requests against the SOW.
  • Follow appropriate internal and external escalation processes, keeping Argano leadership and client stakeholders informed.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client sponsors and project leadership.
  • Prepare and present status reports to senior management and stakeholders, highlighting milestones, issues, risks, and decisions needed.
  • Manage expectations across business functions such as Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain and Operations, HR, and Sales/Service, including their competing priorities.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • MBA or relevant master's degree preferred.
  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification preferred.
  • Oracle Cloud implementation certifications are a plus.

Experience

  • 8+ years of project management experience, including at least 5 years managing Oracle Cloud implementations.
  • Full lifecycle, hands-on project management of Oracle Cloud implementations, including managing multiple concurrent engagements and/or leading a larger, multi-pillar program.
  • Strong experience leading Oracle Cloud ERP and Supply Chain projects, with a solid understanding of modules such as General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Procurement, Project Portfolio Management, Inventory, Order Management, Manufacturing, Cost Management, and Supply Chain Planning, along with the challenges clients and implementation teams commonly face.
  • Experience managing Oracle Cloud HCM (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Talent), EPM (Planning, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation), or CX (Sales, Service, Marketing) projects is highly valued.
  • Experience managing delivery across multiple workstreams or projects, including shared resources, integrations, data conversion, and competing timelines.
  • Background in software implementation consulting, ideally with a systems integrator or Oracle partner.
  • Proven experience with risk assessment and mitigation, quality reviews, and corrective actions.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or Trello.
  • Self-motivated, with a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and keeping up with Oracle Cloud releases and industry trends.

Skill Requirements

  • Project and Program Management: Strong command of project management methodologies and best practices, with the ability to scale them from small engagements to multi-workstream programs.
  • Prioritization and Adaptability: Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple engagements and adjust smoothly when assignments shift between a portfolio of projects and a single larger program.
  • Leadership: Strong ability to guide consultants, workstream leads, and cross-functional teams toward successful delivery.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting status, risks, and decisions clearly to executive audiences.
  • Stakeholder Management: Skill in managing expectations and balancing competing priorities across business functions.
  • Integration Mindset: Ability to see how decisions in one area affect others, such as how chart of accounts design affects EPM reporting or how Supply Chain setup affects cost accounting in Financials.
  • Financial Management: Strong discipline in budget tracking, forecasting, and change control.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations while directing the QA Lead.
  • Problem-Solving and Conflict Resolution: Address project issues with practical solutions and resolve disputes within teams or with stakeholders.
  • Escalation Management: Manage internal communication with Argano leadership and follow appropriate escalation processes.

jobs.excerpt: Principal Analytics Engineer - Global Reporting & Analytics About the TeamThe Global Reporting and Analytics team sits within the Clinical Solutions Platform organization.
jobs.description:
Principal Analytics Engineer - Global Reporting & Analytics


About the Team

The Global Reporting and Analytics team sits within the Clinical Solutions Platform organization. We turn client data and usage into validated, reusable, enterprise-grade reporting — building the capabilities the business needs to deliver customer value and growth. We go beyond usage dashboards, running impact and outcomes analyses that connect product usage to real value for clinicians, and we work problem-first, partnering closely with product, marketing, and account management teams to give our people the data-driven insights they need to create better experiences for our customers, faster.


About the Role

As Principal Analytics Engineer, you'll be the technical lead within the Global Reporting and Analytics team, reporting to the Director of Global Reporting and Analytics, and owning technical execution from discovery to production. You'll work closely with both our analytics team and our engineering/development partners, providing the technical depth and context each side needs from the other.

You bring strong software engineering depth, deep comfort with SQL and Snowflake, and a genuine affinity for analytics — with the curiosity to build real fluency in our analytics domain over time, to the point where you can represent it confidently and independently in technical conversations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between the analytics team and engineering/development partners — translating analytics needs into clear requirements, specifications, and development tickets.
  • Provide hands-on technical depth for the team: deep Snowflake fluency (data engineering experience a plus), excellent SQL, and code review across SQL, Python, and JavaScript (Highcharts), contributing code directly where useful.
  • Coach and mentor analysts on technical concepts and coding, building technical fluency and elevating capability across the team over time.
  • Champion opportunities to bring more coding, automation, and AI tooling into the analytics team's work — prototyping new approaches and driving innovation in how the team operates.
  • Explore how AI could shape the next generation of our reporting — new kinds of insights and experiences we could offer customers and stakeholders.
  • Act as a technical thought partner as new products, features, and initiatives are planned across the business — helping ensure analytics needs are considered from the start.
  • Contribute to the technical design of our reporting and analytics platform — data model choices, performance trade-offs, and level of detail — and help determine how reporting and AI-enabled work should integrate with broader enterprise systems, partnering with engineering on execution.
  • Contribute to improving data quality, alerting for potential issues, and regression testing to catch problems before they reach production.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise non-negotiables: security, compliance, data governance, data residency, PHI/PII handling, and central technology infrastructure standards.

Requirements

  • Engineering experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with experience in data engineering or building analytics data pipelines.
  • Education: BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; advanced degree preferred.
  • Snowflake: Deep, hands-on experience with Snowflake; data engineering experience with Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Languages: Excellent SQL, strong Python, strong comfort with JSON, and working knowledge of JavaScript.
  • Data modeling: Strong grounding in data modeling concepts, comfortable making and explaining recommendations on structure, performance trade-offs, and level of detail in reporting.
  • BI platforms: Working familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau — enough to engage confidently in analytics discussions and help identify opportunities to move calculations and data manipulation upstream, out of the BI layer. Hands-on Tableau experience is a plus.
  • AI & tooling: Comfortable using AI to accelerate coding and everyday work. Experience creating reusable tools or workflows that help scale technical knowledge across a team is a plus.
  • AI / LLM familiarity: Working knowledge of concepts like LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented approaches — enough to lead a project in this space, representing the analytics needs and collaborating with architecture and engineering partners on design and implementation.
  • Communication & mentoring: Exceptional at explaining technical concepts to audiences with a wide range of technical backgrounds, and comfortable coaching less technical colleagues with patience and care — a distinguishing strength for this role.
  • Leadership and delivery management: Plans and sequences work, manages scope, dependencies, and priorities, removes blockers, and drives delivery to keep innovation and reporting modernization moving.

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


Working Pattern
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


About the Business
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world

Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.If performed in any following locations: Home Based - Ireland, Ireland - Limerick (Red Church), the base pay range is €71,700 - €119,500.

Job Description:

About:

ITW Construction Offsite Europe is the leading end‑to‑end metalwork solutions partner in the UK and Ireland, delivering engineered metalwork systems and design software that support the full construction lifecycle. Through our trusted brands, Cullen, Gang‑Nail and Alpine, and over 50 years of combined expertise, we provide compliant, innovative solutions and a bespoke customer experience for the offsite timber frame sector.

We are a division of the Illinois Tool Works family, innovating, designing and manufacturing advanced industrial technology. We are industry influencers and market leaders in our fields with five high-quality brands at the front of technology and enterprise.

At all levels in our organisation, we are encouraged to embrace our inner entrepreneur to drive actions, focus on what matters and share ideas so that every individual can have an impact on the business.

In return we are rewarded, supported in our development and given the opportunities to grow within a large multinational organisation.


Position Summary:

The Offsite Marketing Officer will be responsible for coordinating and delivering marketing activities across ITW Offsite Europe’s brands. The role will focus on executing effective marketing campaigns, communications and content that promote our products and services, strengthen brand positioning and support sustainable business growth.

A core responsibility will be translating customer insights, market opportunities and business priorities into targeted marketing plans and campaigns that support Offsite Europe’s Customer Back Innovation (CBI) and Strategic Sales Excellence (SSE) objectives. Working collaboratively with Product, Engineering, Sales and other customer-facing teams, the successful candidate will develop and deliver customer-focused communications, sales enablement materials, product launches and Joint Investment Fund (JIF) initiatives that strengthen customer relationships, communicate clear value propositions and drive commercial growth.

A key responsibility will be coordinating day-to-day marketing activities, including campaign execution, content creation, digital marketing and internal communications. Working closely with the Graphic Designer, the Offsite Marketing Officer will ensure the timely delivery of compelling, high-quality marketing materials that communicate clear customer value propositions and maintain a consistent, distinctive brand presence.

Success in this role will require strong project management, commercial awareness and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. The individual will be expected to evaluate marketing performance, identify opportunities for continuous improvement and ensure activities remain aligned with strategic objectives, customer needs and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support product launches, innovation projects and commercial growth initiatives.
  • Create targeted value propositions and marketing campaigns for key customer segments and decision makers.
  • Develop engaging marketing materials, sales tools, technical content and training resources.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Software Development and Commercial teams to translate complex technical information into clear, accurate and engaging content.
  • Monitor competitor activity and develop content that strengthens product differentiation and supports sales.
  • Drive & support marketing projects from planning to delivery, managing priorities, resources and deadlines.
  • Work closely with the Graphic Designer and external agencies to deliver high-quality marketing materials.
  • Work with Sales and customers to identify market opportunities and support Joint Investment Fund (JIF) initiatives.
  • Manage Offsite Europe's website, social media and digital marketing channels.
  • Maintain consistent brand identity and messaging across all marketing activities.
  • Develop relationships with external suppliers, managing costs, quality and delivery.
  • Monitor marketing performance and identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and commercial impact.
  • Ensure all activities comply with company health and safety requirements.
  • Demonstrate ITW's core values of Integrity, Simplicity, Trust, Respect and Shared Risk.

The Person:

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in marketing, communications or related role, ideally within a B2B or agency environment.
  • Understanding of customer segmentation and the ability to develop targeted value propositions for different decision makers and stakeholders.
  • Passion for creating engaging marketing content, with an understanding of current digital, social media and design trends.
  • Strong project management, organisational and time management skills, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
  • Ability to understand different customer needs and communicate effectively across the construction supply chain.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with confidence in leading cross-functional projects.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to manage competing priorities in line with business objectives.
  • Good problem-solving skills, with the confidence to work independently and seek support when required.
  • Experience with website management, email marketing and GDPR requirements would be advantageous.
  • Familiarity with design tools such as Canva, WordPress, ActiveCampaign and social media channels would be beneficial.

Other relevant information:

  • Prepared to travel domestically as required
  • Flexibility with working hours as required
  • Full UK driving licence and valid passport.

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Arbor Energy & Resources Corporation ("Arbor Energy"), we’re creating technology to power our lives while protecting the planet that sustains them.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Arbor Energy & Resources Corporation ("Arbor Energy"), we’re creating technology to power our lives while protecting the planet that sustains them. Our advanced power systems deliver clean, reliable baseload electricity with zero operating emissions—modular, fuel-flexible, and engineered for the realities of today’s energy demand. At the core is a supercritical CO₂ turbine with integrated carbon capture, designed to bring carbon-neutral power online quickly at meaningful scale.

Our team includes aerospace engineers, combustion experts, and systems thinkers with a shared goal: to build technology worthy of the world we want to live in. While many of us began our journeys looking to the stars, we’re applying that expertise here at home to deliver dependable, emission-free baseload power and a future of lasting abundance.

If you share our values and are drawn to rigorous work with lasting impact, we’d love to learn more about you. Come build what the future will run on.

Steward our planet: We build for tomorrow, ensuring every bolt we tighten and every hand we lend leaves our environment stronger than we found it.

Lead with Love: We champion the success of our people, partners, and planet, nurturing excellence through camaraderie and rigor.

Explore the Uncharted: We embrace the unknown with curiosity, using courage and discipline to transform uncertainty into opportunity.

Role Overview

The Head of Policy and Public Affairs will shape the policy, regulatory, stakeholder, and public environment necessary to deploy next-generation power infrastructure with carbon capture at scale.

Responsibilities

Strategic Policy Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the executive team, and cross-functional leadership on policy, regulatory, stakeholder, and market-shaping issues.
  • Develop and execute Arbor’s federal and state policy strategy in support of commercial deployment objectives.
  • Monitor emerging legislation, regulations, and agency actions impacting carbon capture, power generation, grid infrastructure, energy markets, and industrial decarbonization.
  • Represent Arbor in industry associations, working groups, coalitions, and policy forums.
  • Provide strategic recommendations that help position Arbor for long-term growth and market leadership.

Public Affairs and Strategic Engagement

  • Develop and lead Arbor’s public affairs strategy and stakeholder engagement approach.
  • Help shape the external narrative around Arbor’s technology, market opportunity, and role in addressing growing electricity demand.
  • Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to establish Arbor as a trusted participant in public policy discussions.
  • Develop coalitions and advocacy strategies that support Arbor’s long-term business objectives and market development efforts.
  • Support executive communications, thought leadership, and external engagement efforts.

Permitting and Deployment Enablement

  • Develop strategies that help accelerate permitting and regulatory pathways necessary for commercialization.
  • Support efforts to improve and accelerate project-enabling processes, including grid interconnection and Class VI permitting where relevant.
  • Build relationships with federal, state, and regional agencies that influence deployment timelines.
  • Identify policy and regulatory barriers to deployment and develop mitigation strategies.

Government Funding and Strategic Partnerships

  • Identify, pursue, and help secure non-dilutive funding opportunities across federal, state, and regional programs.
  • Coordinate with technical, commercial, and finance teams to support grant applications and funding strategies.
  • Develop relationships with agencies, policymakers, and funding organizations that can accelerate Arbor’s growth.

Requirements

  • Proven track record of at least 10+ years' experience in energy policy, public affairs, government affairs, infrastructure development, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated success influencing policy, regulatory, legislative, or stakeholder outcomes.
  • Experience in carbon capture, power generation, grid infrastructure, natural gas, industrial decarbonization, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of energy markets, infrastructure development, permitting processes, or industrial project deployment.
  • Familiarity with Class VI permitting, EPA programs, DOE funding mechanisms, and energy infrastructure development.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior policymakers, regulators, industry leaders, and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree.

jobs.description:
Title:Senior Agentic Engineer
Location: Remote (UTC+0 - UTC+3)
Brahma AI operates at the intersection of enterprise Media Asset Management (MAM) and cutting-edge generative media. We build and scale industry-leading generative AI models, including hyper-realistic digital humans (ATMAN) and multilingual voice synthesis (VAANI), for world-class enterprise clients in entertainment, sports, healthcare, and retail.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Agentic Engineer to build, ship, and run the components of our internal agentic setup: gateway and routing features, tool connectors, and governed agent workflows that let engineers across Brahma use AI agents safely. Much of this work happens in our sovereign agent gateway for model routing, MCP tool hosting, and multi-agent orchestration.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You will build to designs set by the Architect for Agentic AI, own well-scoped components end to end from prototype to production, and contribute to design reviews and architecture decision records (ADRs). You keep up with new agent tooling and patterns, trial the ones that hold up, and make them production-ready for enterprise use. You also share what you learn, within the team and with other Brahma teams.

As a senior individual contributor, you will own components end-to-end from initial prototype to production. Working to technical designs set by our Architect for Agentic AI, you will contribute actively to architecture decision records (ADRs) and design reviews, vet emerging agent frameworks, and harden the most effective patterns for enterprise scale.You won’t have to carry the entire stack alone. You’ll be embedded in a dedicated, high-caliber unit:

  • Lead Engineer for Agentic AI: Team lead driving operational delivery and SLOs.
  • Architect for Agentic AI: Sets high-level architecture and strategic technical direction.
  • Product Management:Directs priorities and feature roadmaps.
  • ML Engineers: Own underlying models, evaluation frameworks, and context techniques.
  • Security Engineer for Agentic AI: Defines governance standards and security controls.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps:Maintains the foundational cloud platforms while you manage agent runtimes.
We assemble our setup from open protocols, open-source components, and our own services, so we stay in control of security, cost, and vendor choice. You build what is missing and maintain what you run, including upgrades, patches, and incident response.

Key Responsibilities

1. Platform & Integration Engineering
  • Gateway & Routing Features: Build and maintain features such as provider fallbacks, budget enforcement, usage attribution, and access policies.
  • MCP Servers & Connectors: Build and operate MCP servers and connectors to Git, CI/CD, work tracking, and documentation, so agent output arrives as reviewable, traceable change.
  • Deployment & Runtime: Own CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure-as-code for agentic AI services, on the cloud platform run by Infrastructure & DevOps.
2. Agent Workflows & Context
  • Governed Workflows & Multi-Agent Patterns: Implement agent workflows with structured inputs and outputs and human approval gates, and multi-agent patterns (A2A, supervisor/worker) with loop, budget, and failure controls.
  • Context Engineering & Memory: Build and run memory and context services (session and long-term memory, context compaction, retrieval, progressive tool disclosure) to the architecture set by the Architect, using techniques evaluated by the ML Engineers.
  • Production Ownership: Run the components you ship after launch: monitoring, alerting, rollbacks, cost, and incident response, and keep them current with upgrades.
3. Quality, Observability & Security
  • Tests & Evals in CI: Write unit and integration tests, and regression evals for agents, tools, and routing using the evaluation framework owned by the ML Engineers, and run them in CI.
  • Observability Pipeline: Own the tracing and usage-reporting pipeline across model, tool, and agent calls, so the Security Engineer can detect threats, ML Engineers can monitor quality, and the Lead can track SLOs and spend.
  • Secure by Default: Build to the security standards and controls owned by the Security Engineer for Agentic AI, and fix security findings in the components you own.
4. Operations & Adoption
  • Maintain What You Run: Keep services and open-source dependencies patched, diagnose failures to root cause, and take part in incident response and any future on-call rotation.
  • Developer Surfaces & Catalog: Build and maintain the ways engineers use the setup: the CLI, chat integrations, coding-agent harness configuration, and the shared catalogue of agents and skills.
  • Coding Agent Adoption: Help teams across Brahma adopt coding agents through documentation, working examples, and pairing.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Document what you build, and share patterns and lessons within the team and with other Brahma teams through demos, guides and pairing.

Must Haves

  • Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, with primary expertise in server-side Python development.

We are looking for an innovative engineer for the GTM Product Team to strengthen the technology beneath OPSWAT's marketing operations. Marketing runs on HubSpot today, and it works hard for us: 1.1 million contacts, 817 active workflows, and the integrations that connect it to SugarCRM, Salesloft, My OPSWAT, websites and our data master. Your first job is to make that foundation more reliable — keeping the integrations healthy, resolving the sync and data-quality issues that slow the team down, and giving Marketing Operations a technical partner who understands their platform from the inside.

From there, you will help us build the next generation of that capability in house. The four functions HubSpot performs for us are the roadmap: marketing automation and email; lead capture from web, portal, events and webinars; lead management, meaning scoring, lifecycle and routing; contact data governance and consent and tight integration with our OPSWAT Data Master (ODM). Along the way you will bring AI into the product to enable smarter lead qualification, routing and scoring and more automated campaign managements.

What You Will Be Doing

Build the Platform

  • Build one governed front door for every lead, whatever the source — web forms, My OPSWAT, webinars, field events, partner and list imports — so each lead is validated, de-duplicated, consented and enriched once, at the gate, and nothing reaches the CRM or the data spine any other way.
  • Build AI-native lead qualification: a model that reads fit and engagement across every signal we hold — product usage in My OPSWAT, Academy progress, web behavior, intent, firmographics — ranks the whole database with real resolution, explains every score in plain language, and learns from what SDRs actually convert.
  • Build intelligent lead routing: the right lead to the right rep at the right moment, with territory, capacity, availability and priority held as data that Marketing Operations can shape and preview themselves, and a decision record behind every assignment so anyone can see why a lead went where it did.
  • Make every hand-off dependable: each lead tracked from capture to first touch, stalls surfaced automatically, every priority tier followed up, and nothing lost between systems.
  • Give Marketing Operations a self-service campaign layer: per-campaign behavior — routing, priority, nurture — configured in minutes with a preview of what it would have done to yesterday's leads, so new campaigns stop requiring new workflows and old overrides expire on their own.
  • Build the platform AI-native from day one: expose its data and actions through an MCP server so OPSWAT's internal agents and assistants can look up a lead, explain a routing decision, or trigger a campaign action in natural language — and design every capability so an agent can use it as readily as a person can.
  • Make consent and suppression a single source of truth, enforced at the gate and impossible to bypass, and stream every signal and every decision into OPSWAT Data Master so marketing, product and sales data finally join in one place.
  • Build the seams to SugarCRM, the email service provider, visitor identification, enrichment and My OPSWAT so that a failure in any one of them is contained, retried and visible — never silent, never lossy.
  • Leveraging OPSWAT Agentic SDLC — use the Platform team's agentic coding platform as your primary means of production, own the quality and security of what ships, and document the system as you go so it stays knowable.

Keep HubSpot Running Through the Transition

  • Own the health of HubSpot's existing integrations until each one is retired: the SugarCRM sync through the Sugar Data Tool, Salesloft, the My OPSWAT feed (portal and Academy), 6sense enrichment, web forms and the Forms API.
  • Triage and resolve integration incidents across HubSpot and its neighbors — root-cause them, fix them permanently, and write down what happened.
  • Make safe, minimal changes in HubSpot when the business needs them, and hold the line against new workflow and list sediment that the migration would only have to unwind.
  • Build the Forms Gateway pull-forward so website capture decouples from HubSpot early, and run the interim enrollment connector that keeps Salesloft working through cutover.
  • Reconcile HubSpot and platform data continuously during the parallel run so drift is caught long before a cutover gate.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 6+ years building and operating production backend systems, with at least 3 in Python
  • Demonstrated, recent, daily practice building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode, Codex or similar). You can show us the workflow, the review and test loop, and something real that shipped through it.
  • Production support of a marketing automation platform's integrations — HubSpot strongly preferred; Marketo or Pardot considered — including its APIs, its data model, and its sync to a CRM. You have kept one of these healthy while other things changed around it.
  • Production experience with event-driven and durable-execution patterns: message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, replay. Temporal or a comparable workflow engine strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on integration engineering against real vendor APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries — built and operated, not configured through a wizard.
  • PostgreSQL to a strong level: schema design, JSONB, partitioning, migrations with Alembic, and query performance work you can describe.
  • Cloud deployment on Azure or AWS: containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, secrets management, observability.
  • Experience shipping LLM features into a product: structured outputs, evaluation discipline, confidence thresholds, fallbacks and guardrails — consuming a provided model gateway rather than building the infrastructure.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the skill to explain a technical trade-off to a marketing operations lead in their terms.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • SugarCRM logic hooks and REST API, or another CRM's server-side extension model; Salesforce Apex or triggers transferable.
  • Marketing technology domain knowledge: lead scoring and routing, consent and suppression, deliverability and ESP warm-up, campaign attribution.

  • Minimum 3 years managing a team of at least 4 individuals.

  • Expert-level proficiency in program/project management methodologies and tools (e.g., Confluence/JIRA). PMP certification is a plus.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and align diverse cross-functional teams.
  • Highly analytical with a strong ability to identify problems, analyze data, and develop effective solutions in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Experience working with global manufacturing partners and supply chains. Willingness to travel internationally as required (up to 20%).
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to operational excellence.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Model Performance
jobs.excerpt: Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end.
jobs.description:
Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end. Our Sonic Inference Engine has served more than 20 billion requests for over 1 million developers and 500 million end users, with 400,000+ models behind a single integration, at up to 10x lower cost per token than traditional providers.

We are now building the AI Factory that runs it. The Sonic Inference Pod packs 1 MW of custom-designed compute into a 20-foot container with closed-loop, water-free cooling, sited wherever power exists. Pods are live in the US and Europe, and we are scaling to dozens of pods and tens of thousands of GPUs, all operated as one distributed fabric that reroutes traffic the moment a pod goes offline (announcement).

Every request that hits that fleet, whether it is an image, a video, a voice or a token stream, has to come back faster and cheaper than anyone else can serve it. Model performance is what makes that true. That is the job.

The role

As Principal Engineer, Model Performance, you will own how fast and how cheaply every model on Runware runs: diffusion and video generation, speech, 3D and LLMs, across 400,000+ models and tens of thousands of GPUs. You will set the performance roadmap, build the hardest pieces with your own hands, and build and lead the Model Performance team as it grows around you.

This is a principal-level role for someone who has led inference performance work at the frontier and still writes the kernel. You will decide where the next 2x comes from on a given model and hardware generation, whether that is a fused attention kernel, a better quantization recipe, speculative decoding, a smarter batching policy or a different parallelism layout, and then make it land in production on real traffic. You will work directly with the Sonic Inference Engine team, the infrastructure and hardware teams, and with NVIDIA and the open-source engine communities, and you will hire, mentor and lead the engineers who do this work alongside you.

Success means Runware serves a new open model at the Pareto frontier of latency and cost within days of its weights being released, our cost per request keeps falling with every hardware generation, and the team you have built can do this without you in the loop.

What you'll do

  • Own inference performance end to end for the fleet: the kernels, the serving engines, the model-level optimizations and the benchmarks that prove them, across image, video, audio, 3D and LLM workloads on every GPU generation we run.
  • Set the model performance roadmap. Decide which models, hardware and techniques get the team's attention and in what order, based on real traffic, real cost and what the next generation of pods will run.
  • Do the hardest work yourself: write and tune CUDA kernels, fuse attention and MLP paths, bring up new quantization formats (FP8, FP4, INT4) with quality held, and get new parallelism and batching strategies working on multi-GPU nodes.
  • Make new models fast on day one. Build the pipeline that takes a newly released open model from weights to a production-grade, optimized deployment in days, and keep closing that gap.
  • Choose and shape the serving stack: TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, custom diffusion and video pipelines, and the Sonic Inference Engine's own runtime. Decide what we adopt, what we fork and what we write ourselves, and contribute upstream where it pays.
  • Own the benchmarking and performance regression system: reproducible, hardware-aware measurement of throughput, latency, cost and quality for every model we serve, wired into CI so that a regression never reaches a pod.
  • Partner with infrastructure and hardware engineering on GPU memory, storage and network bottlenecks that show up as inference latency, and feed what you learn back into the next generation of servers and pods.
  • Build and lead the team. Hire principal and senior engineers, set the bar for technical rigour, mentor the people on the team, and run it so that a very small group delivers performance across a very large model catalogue.
  • Use AI to accelerate the work: automated kernel search and tuning, benchmark generation, profiling triage and documentation with LLM-based agents, so that the team's output grows faster than its headcount.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years in GPU, HPC or deep learning systems engineering, with several of those optimizing inference performance for models in production at a company that runs them at scale.
  • A track record of shipping performance, not just measuring it. You have taken a state-of-the-art model from a reference implementation to the Pareto frontier of latency and cost on real hardware, and you know what breaks between the two.
  • Deep, current, hands-on CUDA and GPU architecture expertise: kernel design, memory hierarchy and occupancy, Tensor Cores, fused kernels, CUDA Graphs, NCCL, and the profilers (Nsight Systems and Compute) that show exactly where a microsecond goes.
  • Real production experience with at least one major inference engine (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang or similar) and with the techniques that define modern serving: continuous batching, paged KV cache, speculative decoding, prefill/decode disaggregation, quantization and tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism.
  • Fluent in Python and C++, comfortable in PyTorch internals, torch.compile and Triton, and happy to write the benchmark, the kernel and the CI job yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.
  • Experience leading engineers: you have built or run a performance team, hired for it, set its technical direction and stayed hands-on while doing so.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own output every day, for kernel search, profiling analysis, benchmarking, documentation and code review, and you have a clear view of how a small team armed with these tools should operate differently.
  • Comfortable owning outcomes in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment, making decisions with incomplete information and being accountable for latency, cost and quality across hundreds of thousands of models.

Nice to have

  • Diffusion and video generation performance: DiT and UNet pipelines, attention at long sequence lengths, step distillation, caching across denoising steps, LoRA hot-swapping, and the loaders and samplers in ComfyUI, Diffusers or custom engines.
  • Contributions to TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, FlashAttention, CUTLASS, Triton, Dynamo or similar open-source inference projects, or an open-source project of your own that people run.
  • Experience with Blackwell-generation hardware (B200, GB200/GB300 NVL72), NVLink and NVSwitch topologies, and multi-node inference over InfiniBand or RoCE.
  • Mixture-of-experts serving: expert parallelism, expert placement and load balancing, and the memory and communication trade-offs that come with them.
  • Accuracy evaluation for optimized models: the harnesses, datasets and statistical discipline to prove a quantized or distilled model is as good as the original.
  • Experience with non-NVIDIA accelerators (AMD, TPU or custom silicon) and with porting an inference stack across them.
  • Speech and audio model serving: streaming ASR and TTS with tight latency budgets.
  • Published work, patents or talks on inference performance.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A rare mandate: own inference performance for one of the largest model catalogues in the world, on hardware the company designs and operates itself, at a business whose margin is your work, with the GPU budget and backing to match.
  • Meaningful stock options.
  • We're a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm and celebrate wins. We keep core hours for collaboration and calls; outside those, you set your own schedule.
  • Our release cycles are fast and intense, and they're followed by real downtime. We expect you to take it.
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick days and public holidays.
  • Paid maternity, paternity and caregiver leave.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats in inspiring locations.

🚀 Our Story

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly.

🖍️ This role

Head of Platform is responsible for building and leading the team that provides Partly’s foundation for shipping and operating software: the internal platform, infrastructure foundations, reliability practices, and security-by-default capabilities that let product teams move fast without breaking things. This now extends in two directions: the specialised infrastructure behind Partly's foundational ML/AI capabilities (GPU compute, model training and serving, inference cost), and a platform that natively supports agentic development so regionally-embedded product engineers (including forward-deployed engineers) can move exceptionally fast. You’ll treat platform as an internal product - setting strategy, driving adoption, and partnering closely with engineering and the business to improve delivery speed, uptime, and cost efficiency as we scale.

💻 What will you do

  • Platform Strategy & Team Leadership: Build and lead the Platform function (SRE, DevEx, Infrastructure, Security enablement as appropriate). Set a clear roadmap, establish ways of working, hire and grow the team, and manage prioritisation/trade-offs.

  • Developer Experience : Create the default path for engineers to build, test, deploy, and operate services (service templates, CI/CD, environment provisioning, secrets/config, deployment patterns, feature flags). Focus on adoption and measurable improvements in developer productivity.

  • Reliability & Operational Excellence: Own or drive (depending on org boundaries) our reliability foundations: observability (metrics/logs/traces), alerting standards, incident response, postmortems, SLO/error budget practices, rollout/rollback patterns, backups/DR, and reducing on-call toil.

  • Infrastructure Foundations: Ensure our cloud and Kubernetes foundations are scalable, secure, and maintainable. Use Infrastructure-as-Code and automation (Terraform for GCP, GitOps with ArgoCD, Python/Bash tooling, etc.) to run repeatable, auditable infrastructure.

  • ML & Foundation-Model Infrastructure: Build the platform beneath Partly's foundational models — accelerator (GPU/TPU) provisioning, scheduling and utilisation, training/fine-tuning orchestration, and scalable, low-latency model serving. Own the ML deployment lifecycle (model registry, experiment tracking, evaluation/observability) and treat inference economics as a first-class cost driver, since inference — not training — typically dominates AI infrastructure spend at scale.

  • Agentic & Forward-Deployed Enablement: Make the platform natively support agentic development. Design golden paths that are self-service and machine-consumable (discoverable, executable, safe) so AI coding agents and engineers alike can go from generated code to production without the platform team as a bottleneck — with isolated execution environments, guardrails, and observability built in. Ensure regional and forward-deployed engineers can move at maximum speed on a robust but extensible foundation.

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications. As a part of this strategy, the FAM will provide on-going education to accounts regarding the Patient Services program, the regional payer landscape, and pharmacy channel access. The FAM is also responsible for partnering with internal and external stakeholders to optimize access to the product for patients.
