  • Coordinate utilization of the patient service platform to seamlessly support the customer and patient when office chooses the HUB or SP as their ideal path to approved therapy.
  • Coordinate annual pharmacy reauthorizations at designated accounts to ensure timely reauthorization and continuation of therapy is maintained.

The FAM will help identify and address time sensitive market development and implementation efforts to remove access barriers to the product for appropriate patients, while optimizing adherence.

jobs.description:
About L & E Research, Inc.

At L&E Research, we connect brands with people to make conversations happen. Since 1984, we've been a trusted partner in qualitative research recruitment across healthcare, consumer goods, B2B, and beyond. We're growing our team and looking for a Recruitment Strategist who thrives on solving hard problems and building relationships.

Director of Recruitment and Panel Development

Full-Time | US Remote | EST or MST

This is not a corporate recruiting or HR Role. You'll lead how L&E finds and engages the people who take part in market research studies (consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, and business decision-makers).

Examples of backgrounds we are looking for:

market research or panel management,

clinical trial patient recruitment,

digital or paid acquisition marketing,

CRM or database marketing,

membership or community growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, the Director of Recruitment & Panel Development is responsible for the performance of Recruitment Operations and for the health, growth, and development of L&E's panel member database (leopinions.com). You'll independently lead the Recruitment and Panel division and partner across the business to move it forward.

You'll work closely with the Director of Operations and the Technology Product Manager to implement new systems and automations, and alongside the Project Management, Account Management, Sales, Marketing, and Technology teams. The Recruitment Operations Manager and the Social Media Coordinator report directly to this role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Recruitment Operations & Targeted Panel Builds

  • Oversee Recruitment Operations and directly supervise the Recruitment Operations Manager.
  • Plan and oversee market- and client-specific panel builds, including spend approval, budget tracking, and FMP study group set-up, in coordination with the Recruitment Strategist and Project Management teams.
  • Work directly with clients on recruitment, including creative when needed.
  • Develop recruitment plans of action for niche and rare populations, such as clinical trial patients and B2B decision-makers, and build team capability around these specialized skill sets.
  • Lead the operational adoption of Recruiting Workflow Automation.
  • Identify and vet new recruitment tools, then lead their training and integration within Recruitment Operations.

Panel Database Stewardship & Health

  • Own the L&E panel member database and its health, accuracy, integrity, and project-readiness, with health metrics and regular reporting to leadership on growth, attrition, hygiene, and engagement.
  • Lead database hygiene, including deduplication, data validation, suppression management, and compliance with privacy standards, partnering with the Technology database team on execution.
  • Grow the panel by identifying gaps by market, demographic, and specialty (including hard-to-reach populations), partnering with Marketing to recruit new consumer and healthcare professional members, and running active and inactive member re-engagement campaigns as new member platforms launch.
  • Own member-facing wording across confirmation letters, thank-you letters, and the Universal Participant Consent & Confidentiality Agreement, and route member inquiries to the right team.

Social Media & Paid Recruitment Channels

  • Oversee social media postings and directly supervise the Social Media Coordinator.
  • Set link tracking and source attribution standards across flyers, paid ads, and organic posts, and share posting guidance with Operations.
  • Evaluate and stand up new paid recruitment channels, partnering with Technology and IT on account setup and site tracking.

Bid Feasibility & Sales Support

  • Provide and consult on feasibility for escalated or complex requests, as requested.
  • Review and collaborate on RFIs requesting additional panel or community engagement details.

Systems Implementation & Process Enablement

  • Partner with the Technology Product Manager to define operational requirements for new systems and automations for panel and recruiting work.
  • Conduct operational user acceptance testing and confirm new systems work for the teams that will use them before rollout.
  • Lead implementation across Operations with the Director of Operations, including training materials, rollout communication, and adoption tracking.
  • Keep operational documentation and processes accurate, current, and consistently followed.

Team Leadership

  • Manage your direct reports, the Recruitment Operations Manager and Social Media Coordinator, including hiring, reviews, and staffing proposals.
  • Take on other special projects as needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in panel management, recruiting operations, project management, market research operations, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience isolating and recruiting niche or rare populations, such as clinical trial or B2B audiences, including developing plans of action and building teams around these skill sets.
  • Social media and/or digital marketing experience, including paid advertising channels and campaign tracking (required).
  • Experience writing SOPs and training materials and implementing new systems or processes across teams.
  • Prior management experience overseeing a department or team, with demonstrated success in staffing, training, and performance management (preferred).

Knowledge & Skills

  • Proven ability to work independently and manage priorities for yourself and your team, while knowing when to collaborate and escalate.
  • Deep understanding of panel database structure, segmentation, hygiene, and member-engagement best practices.
  • Working knowledge of recruiting operations, paid recruitment channels, and the L&E FMP environment.
  • Knowledge of sourcing channels, screening approaches, and recruitment strategies for niche and rare populations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret database health, recruiting, and quality metrics and turn them into action.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint), database, CRM, and panel-management platforms, and social media and paid advertising platforms.
  • Adaptability and a strong aptitude for learning and using new technologies, including emerging AI tools, to improve efficiency and insight.

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS

A Windows-based PC will be provided to all full-time employees. You'll also need:

  • Reliable high-speed internet/broadband connection.
  • Consistent and dependable phone service.

WHO YOU ARE

Beyond the technical skills, the right person for this role brings these qualities to the work every day:

  • Owns the work. You take ownership of the day-to-day work of the role and the team, set priorities with confidence, and keep leadership informed and engaged on key decisions.
  • Leads and develops people. You set clear expectations for your direct reports, create accountability across the functions you oversee, and drive the team toward the company's vision.
  • Thinks strategically. You connect daily panel and recruiting work to broader business goals and spot opportunities to scale, including for niche and rare populations.
  • Communicates clearly. You communicate well, verbally and in writing, with leadership, cross-functional partners, direct reports, and external vendors.
  • Keeps projects moving. You manage multiple workstreams, implementations, and recruiting needs at once while meeting deadlines.
  • Lets data guide decisions. You use data to inform decisions, prioritize investments, and measure the impact of database and recruiting initiatives.
  • Works well across teams. You collaborate effectively with Operations, Marketing, Sales, Technology, and Product.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Lead team L10s and attend Operations Leadership L10s, monthly management staff meetings, yearly management retreats, and other onsite meetings or events as needed.
  • Minimal travel required (quarterly)
  • Adhere to the ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 20252 standards.

HOW TO APPLY

We read every application, and we want to know you read this post all the way through.

Key Phrase - Recruitment.

This job summary outlines primary responsibilities but is not intended to be all-inclusive. Duties may be modified or expanded to reflect business needs and the natural progression of the role.

L&E Research, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Help establish Kentro-hosted platform environments in AWS or other approved cloud environments, coordinating with infrastructure, security, and IT teams.

  • Design and build demonstrations, prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, and reusable technical accelerators that support customer solutions and internal capability development.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
QA Automation Engineer (AI-First)

Location: Bengaluru, India (remote), with daily overlap with our UK team

Engagement Type: Full-time contract, 3 months then ongoing

Experience: 2–4 years

Reports to: Technical Project Manager

Compensation: India-based, aligned to experience and location

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We ship fast. AI helps our engineers write code quicker than ever, and we’re about to launch two major web platforms used by thousands of educators. Speed only counts if what reaches teachers works beautifully, every time.

We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer who wants to own that quality. You’ll learn our products inside out, help us move from manual checks to smart, AI-assisted automated testing, and become the person the team trusts to say “this is ready.”

You’ll work directly with our technical project manager and engineers, get hands-on with the latest AI testing and agent tools, and have room to grow into a broader engineering role as you prove yourself.

Key Responsibilities

Quality and testing

  • Test new features end to end across our web platforms and mobile apps, thinking like a teacher, a director and an admin, and catch issues before they reach customers.
  • Write clear test cases and acceptance criteria, using AI to generate and expand them quickly.
  • Build and maintain automated regression suites (e.g. Playwright, Cypress or similar) so every release is checked consistently without repetitive manual work.
  • Evaluate and pilot new AI-forward QA testing platforms (self-healing, agent-driven and visual AI testing tools), measure what actually saves time, and help us adopt the ones that work.
  • Verify that reports, dashboards and data exports reflect real user activity accurately.
  • Test user journeys that span systems, such as course completion, certificates and automated customer emails.
  • Log bugs clearly in Jira, reproduce them reliably, and work with engineers until they’re fixed and verified.

Release and production support

  • Run pre-release and post-release checks, and help verify hotfixes quickly when something needs attention.
  • Be the first technical line for product questions from our customer-facing team: investigate, resolve what you can, and route the rest with the right detail.
  • Turn recurring questions into simple guides and self-serve answers, so the team can find solutions without waiting.

AI and automation

  • Work alongside our automation specialist to test and refine the AI agents and workflows we’re rolling out across the company.
  • Document how our products work, building shared knowledge that helps the whole team and our AI tools.

What We’re Looking For

  • A degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering field (B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA or equivalent), or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in QA, test automation or software development on web applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing mobile apps on iOS, Android and Amazon (Fire OS) devices, including app store builds and testing across devices and screen sizes.
  • Experience building automated tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred) and comfort reading code.
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Copilot daily, and you’re curious about AI agents and AI testing tools.
  • Openness to new AI-forward QA testing platforms (e.g. Mabl, Testim, testRigor, Applitools, or AI agents working with Playwright), and the curiosity to try them, compare them and bring the best into our workflow.
  • A sharp eye for detail: you notice when a number, a layout or a flow isn’t quite right, and you can explain exactly why.
  • Clear, structured bug reporting and documentation.
  • Comfort with web fundamentals: browser dev tools, APIs and testing across devices and screen sizes.
  • Ownership and follow-through: you see an issue through to resolution and speak up early when something is off.
  • Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working with technical and non-technical colleagues in the UK time zone.

Bonus points

  • Jira or Asana experience in an agile sprint setup.
  • Exposure to a headless CMS (e.g. Strapi), SQL, or tools like Postman.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) or AWS.
  • Experience with no-code automation tools (Zapier, n8n, Make) or email platforms like Customer.io.
  • An ISTQB Foundation certification or similar.
  • Interest in education, ed-tech or early childhood learning.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • First 30 days: learn our products and users, take on release checks, and log your first well-documented bugs.
  • By 60 days: own testing for a product area and ship your first automated regression tests.
  • By 90 days: run release QA independently, with automated coverage on our key user journeys and a recommendation on which AI testing tools we should adopt.

What to Be Ready to Demonstrate

Be ready to walk us through test automation you’ve built: what you chose to automate, how you structured it, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a short, paid practical exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information.

What We Offer

  • Experience with a growing international education company, working closely with our UK-based team.
  • Real ownership: what you test and automate goes straight to thousands of educators.
  • Daily exposure to AI agents, AI testing tools and modern engineering practices.
  • Mentorship and a clear path to grow into a broader engineering role.
  • Compensation benchmarked to the Bengaluru/India market, based on your experience and location.
  • Remote working, plus 15 days paid annual leave and Indian public holidays.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven team at the intersection of education, media and technology.

Why Join Us

If you’re curious about AI and want your work to matter, this is the role. You’ll help shape how a growing global education company builds and tests its products in the AI era, and grow your skills faster than you would almost anywhere else.

Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire an Account Executive, Large Enterprise to the Sales & Customer Experience team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Prospect, develop and close sales opportunities with both new logos and existing customers in the large enterprise segment.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals (prospecting and meetings completed) to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota retirement.
  • Establish deep relationships within your book of business through multi-threading, achieving both executive or VP level and end user engagement.

What you’ll bring

Sprout Social is looking for a highly driven and tech-savvy Account Executive with strong business acumen to join our expanding Large Enterprise sales team. Ideally, you will be equally driven by a customer-centric mentality as well as a desire to find and close new business.

These are the minimum qualifications that our hiring team is looking for in this role:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in B2B sales
  • Proven success selling/cross-selling to large enterprise organizations (5,000+ global employees)
  • Ability to manage a large number of prospective accounts and identify problems, opportunities and consultatively provide solutions for each of them

Additionally, these are the preferred qualifications that would indicate a particularly strong candidate:

  • Experience building relationships, presenting and selling to senior level decision makers across multiple functions
  • Experience working with internal partners and cross-functional stakeholders to increase deal momentum and exceed both prospects and customers expectations

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Partner with the Director of Enterprise to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.
  • Meet with current members of the Enterprise Sales team individually to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gather learnings to implement into your role.
  • Shadow Account Executives on calls live or through Gong to learn sales strategies and positioning.
  • Dive right into our platform to learn about what makes our platform unique, how our solution impacts business objectives and why customers love our solutions.
  • Learn Sprout’s go-to-market messaging, key differentiators, develop and personalize segment-specific value propositions.
  • Learn the relevant customer stories and case studies to justify your value propositions with real ROI examples from the field.
  • Complete a demo and written certification to ensure comprehension.
  • Learn Sprout’s existing customer sales process by shadowing your peers.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Meet with all your existing customers within the book of business and begin the process of building relationships with key strategic stakeholders.
  • Identifying the top 20-25% of new logo opportunities within your book of business to create focus and execution in your weekly prospecting activities.
  • Understand the language of all your customers and where we can expand our offerings by expansion into new business units or increasing utilization of our platform with existing customers.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota attainment after ramp.
  • Co-build account & territory plans with your BDR, Professional Services, Solutions Engineers & Customer Success teammates.
  • Regularly meet with your BDR to define a relationship that ensures seamless communication and coordination on all net new business generation and expansion opportunities.
  • Conduct active research leveraging all available tools and data sources to understand your customers’ brand, culture, KPIs, partners, and success metrics so you can add value throughout your interactions and become a trusted advisor.
  • Gain a solid understanding of your customer’s internal transitions and mitigate the risk of customer churn.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Have built solid relationships at the C-Level with existing customers within your “book of business".
  • Have built strong internal relationships with your peers, customer success, professional services, solutions engineering, our legal partners and others who will take part in your deal cycles. You will have a deep understanding of each team’s partnership expectations and service level agreement.
  • Have built 4X your monthly quota target of net new logo pipeline.
  • Travel locally or out of state to meet with high potential prospects and critical customers on a quarterly basis to speed up your deal cycles and increase win rates.
  • Become a Sprout Social and social media expert to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to help our customers realize their full potential and accomplish their goals.
  • Consistently achieve your monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Mentor and develop your BDR to become best in class at their respective functions and further advance their skill sets and career trajectory.
  • Step up as a peer leader to share best practices across the organization and help others grow from your experiences.
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly activity, pipeline and new business metrics.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: $208,000 – $260,000 OTE annually. OTE is governed by an incentive plan. It is the sum of a fixed base salary plus incentives at target performance. Incentive compensation will vary based on performance. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

We have two geographic pay zones in the United States:

Zone 1 (New York, California, Washington): $228,800 – $343,200

Zone 2 (All other US states): $208,000 – $312,000

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

Sprout Social is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on identity- race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including sexual identity), age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged or sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. Because Sprout Social is a federal contractor, we affirmatively recruit individuals with a disability and protected veterans. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion in our latest DEI Report.

If you require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the interview process or to submit your application, please email us at . For more information about our commitment to equal employment opportunity, please click here (1) Equal Opportunity Employment Poster and (2) Sprout Social's Affirmative Action Statement.

jobs.excerpt: Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you?
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

Senior Data & AI Engineer - Managed Services 

Responsibilities 

  • Lead a collaborative effort supporting multiple clients’ Azure Data platform, Databricks, and/or Fabric / PowerBI environments, ensuring prompt responses to any escalations while analyzing and resolving incidents
  • Manage, advise, and delegate all aspects of assigned client’s in-scope services (e.g. alerting & monitoring, platform governance, ETL, Data Warehousing, Reporting, AI/MLops, etc.)
  • Architect, implement, monitor, and support enhancements to clients’ Microsoft Azure and/or Fabric tool stacks for Data & AI (ADF, SQL DW, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering, Microsoft Power BI)
  • Understand and advise customers on licensing involving Microsoft data and AI solutions, and understand the limits/advantages of each licensing platform
  • Support comprehensive solutions for customers including importing data from multiple sources, transforming via metadata-driven ETL architectures, storing across the stages of medallion data lake architecture, and serving performant star schema data models for Enterprise Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence and AI/ ML applications
  • Research new and custom solutions where appropriate; learn, apply, and refine skills around data engineering and data analytics
  • Interact with clients to identify issues, troubleshoot expediently, and follow up on issues within contracted SLAs
  • Regularly and proactively communicate ticket status information to all associated parties, handle escalations from more junior team members as appropriate
  • Attend regularly cadenced client meetings and serve as lead engineer for technical questions and support tickets
  • Communicate technical issues and solutions to clients in business terms with an eye toward supporting strategic business outcomes
  • Configure, administer, tune and develop client’s data environment based on governance and security best practices and well-architected frameworks
  • Create and maintain updated documentation for each client’s environment
  • Promote best practices for clients and internally to enhance and improve organizational processes
  • Mentor/coach onshore and offshore engineers on assigned clients – coordinate technical work sessions for gap areas and refine client communications
  • Collaborate with team members and client stakeholders to ensure solutions align to our client’s needs and best practices, and to identify opportunities for growth in a client engagement
  • Advise clients on their technical journey while mentoring and supporting engineers across the team

Requirements 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent certification
  • Experience working in a support role and understanding standard support processes (i.e. ITIL)
  • 5+ yearsarchitecting, implementing, and supporting solutions on the Microsoft Azure and Fabric tool stacks for Data & AI (ADF, SQL DW, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Power BI)
  • Strong proficiency in Enterprise Data Warehousing, Semantic Models, Data Lake Architecture, and Metadata-driven ETL processes is required
  • Experience with DevOps/ DataOps, for example experience delivering work using git-based source control and automated deployment pipelines is required
  • Experience implementing and/or supporting Agentic AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and/or LLM use cases on the Microsoft tool stack for Data & AI is preferred
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • A passion for problem solving and learning new technologies
  • Client relationship skills and experience managing vendors
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Strong desire for personal development and learning, including commitment to continuously upgrading your technical skills as the data landscape change
  • Work remote, but not alone – with a team filled top to bottom with data analytics professionals

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.excerpt: IntroductionJoin us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!
jobs.description:
Introduction

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction. 

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT.  Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us! 

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

The Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate Finance will partner with Operations, Global Account Management, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Treasury and other stakeholders to identify, analyze and address process inefficiencies that impact billing, collections, vendor payments and overall customer experience. This role will leverage financial expertise, freight forwarding operational knowledge, and large-scale data analysis to identify trends, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that improve performance and efficiency. The successful candidate will support cross-functional initiatives by developing reporting, analytics, and process controls that proactively identify issues, reduce errors, minimize manual effort, and enhance operational effectiveness. This individual will serve as a key resource in driving continuous improvement through data-driven insights, process optimization, and collaboration across Finance and Operations teams.

Responsibilities

  • • Partner with Global Account Management, Operations, Billing, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Payable teams to analyze operational and financial data, identify process gaps impacting billing accuracy, invoice delivery, and collections performance, and provide recommendations to improve efficiency and customer experience (15%)• Lead projects sponsored by AR, AP leadership and the Senior Manager, Corporate Finance, supporting process improvements, operational efficiencies, and strategic initiatives (10%)• Review and analyze aged receivables for key global customers to identify root causes of collection delays and recommend corrective actions (8%)• Collaborate with Global Account Management and Global Billing teams to analyze billing disputes, invoice delivery challenges, and collection barriers, providing data-driven insights and recommendations (7%)• Develop and maintain reporting tools and dashboards to identify billing, collection, and operational issues before invoices become aged or uncollectible (15%)• Analyze shipment-level, operational, and financial data to identify process inefficiencies, root causes, and opportunities to improve billing, collections, and payables performance. (20%)• Partner with Accounts Receivable teams to evaluate collection challenges and develop analytical tools that improve the efficiency of issue identification and resolution. (5%)• Develop and utilize Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools to validate billing accuracy against customer rates, tariffs, contracts, and automated rating systems. (5%)• Support Accounts Payable leadership by analyzing vendor billing trends, identifying processing inefficiencies, and recommending solutions that improve automation and workflow effectiveness. (4%)• Perform root cause analysis on recurring vendor and internal process issues and support initiatives designed to enhance automation, efficiency, and controls. (4%)• Support Accounts Payable process improvement initiatives that strengthen operational effectiveness, compliance, and fraud prevention controls. (2%)• Support ad hoc analyses, reporting requests, and financial projects while ensuring alignment between operational activity and financial reporting. (2%)• Monitor recurring operational and financial issues, identify trends, and recommend long-term solutions to eliminate repeat exceptions. (3%)• Disclaimer: The responsibilities and duties described above are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and priorities may change at any time based on business needs, operational requirements, and organizational objectives. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
  • The wage range for this position is $92,700.00-$139,060.00 and may vary based on geography as well as relative knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience.

Qualifications

Education Qualifications• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience Experience Qualifications• 7-10 years of experience in transportation, logistics, freight forwarding, or related operational finance functions.• Demonstrated experience supporting billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, operational finance, or process improvement initiatives.• Experience working with cross-functional teams including Operations, Billing, Customer Service, Sales, and Finance. Skills and Abilities• Strong knowledge of freight forwarding operations and the shipment lifecycle.• Ability to identify operational and financial process gaps, perform root cause analysis, and develop reporting and analytical solutions that improve efficiency, billing accuracy, collections performance, and stakeholder decision-making.• Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to enhance data analysis, reporting, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives• Experience developing reports, dashboards, and analytics tools using Excel, Power BI, or similar technologies.• Ability to analyze and interpret large, complex datasets to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.• Ability to facilitate discussions among stakeholders and assist in resolving process-related challenges through fact-based analysis.• Experience communicating findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership.• Experience with transportation management systems (TMS), including but not limited to WorldPort (AS400) and CargoWise.• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, lookups, and data analysis.• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.• High attention to detail and accuracy.

What AIT Can Offer You

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services.

AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630-766-8300 ext 5218.

Job Description: Art Buying and Photography Representation Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – Worldwide

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Art Buying and Photography Representation Experts to evaluate creative briefs, cost estimates, artist selection, and image licensing arrangements. This role is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in art buying, photo buying, creative production, photography representation, or licensing management.

You will assess artist suitability, review project budgets, evaluate usage rights, and identify potential contractual or logistical issues while providing clear written explanations for your decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review creative briefs and recommend suitable photographers or visual artists based on project requirements.
  2. Evaluate cost estimates and identify missing, excessive, or unreasonable charges.
  3. Assess image licensing terms, including media, territory, duration, and exclusivity, to ensure they align with client requirements and agreed budgets.
  4. Identify potential gaps in contracts, model or property releases, insurance, and project logistics.
  5. Evaluate artist selection, pricing, and licensing arrangements based on industry standards and project objectives.
  6. Provide concise written explanations supporting evaluations and recommendations.

Required Qualifications

  1. Professional experience as an Art Buyer, Photo Buyer, Creative Producer, Agency Producer, Photography Agent, Artist Representative, or Licensing Manager.
  2. Hands-on experience managing professional projects involving creative briefs, cost estimates, negotiations, contracts, and final delivery.
  3. Working knowledge of image licensing, usage rights, and commercial terms.
  4. Strong understanding of artist selection, project budgeting, and photography commissioning.
  5. Ability to evaluate pricing and licensing arrangements and clearly explain professional decisions.
  6. Strong written English communication skills.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Submit your resume and a short professional profile.
  2. Art Buying and Licensing Interview: Complete a brief conversation about your experience with artist representation, photography commissioning, pricing, and image licensing. No preparation or written assignment is required.
  3. Experience Review: Your qualifications will be assessed against the project requirements.
  4. Onboarding and Initial Task: Selected candidates will receive project guidelines and complete an initial task for review before proceeding.

jobs.description:
About Fello:

Fello is a profitable, hyper-growth, VC-backed B2B SaaS company building the agentic real estate platform of the future.

Our platform combines data intelligence, marketing automation, and conversational AI to help real estate teams engage smarter and scale faster. At the center of it is Felix, our AI teammate, which takes real work off a team's plate — running follow-up across calls, texts, and emails today, with more of the team's day-to-day work coming next.

We're not another tool in the stack. We're the system that powers it — learning, adapting, and executing in real time so teams can focus on growth, not guesswork.

If you're excited about building an AI product that's changing how an entire industry works, you'll fit right in.

About You:

As an Account Manager at Fello, you will own expansion revenue across a book of existing customers, helping top residential real estate teams and brokerages get more from Fello and grow their partnership with us. You know the real estate industry and its players well, and you have managed relationships with the top Mega and Large teams before.

You are a seller at heart. You spot expansion opportunities early, build the business case with the customer's leadership, and close. You have a proven track record of performance against quota, and you are a trusted partner to the teams you serve: consultative, credible, and relentless about driving results for them and for Fello.

This is a remote role, offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the US.

You Will:

  • Own expansion revenue for an assigned book of existing accounts, with a focus on growing relationships with Mega and Large real estate teams
  • Identify expansion opportunities across your book and build account plans that turn them into closed business
  • Lead strategic conversations with team leaders, operations directors, and marketing managers about how Fello can support their growth, including expanding Felix and additional seats
  • Run the expansion sales cycle from first conversation through close, including virtual demos, ROI modeling, and negotiation
  • Use customer insights, usage data, and success stories to build compelling cases for expansion
  • Manage your pipeline and forecast accurately against your monthly expansion quota
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to align on account health, adoption, and the right timing for expansion
  • Share insights from your customer conversations with Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership to help shape the company's direction and improve customer outcomes

You Have:

  • A proven track record of surpassing quota in a quota-carrying account management, expansion, or sales role
  • Deep knowledge of the real estate industry and its players
  • Experience managing relationships with top Mega and Large real estate teams
  • A history of closing expansion or upsell deals with real estate teams, brokerages, or a closely related vertical
  • Demonstrated executive presence and negotiation skills
  • Client-focused orientation with a strong sense of urgency and timely follow-ups
  • Receptiveness to coaching and mentoring, and a willingness to experiment with new ideas
  • High attention to detail with robust technical execution and organizational skills
  • Proficiency with Google Suite and Hubspot preferred

Our Benefits:

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Fully remote work with flexible hours to promote work-life balance.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO and paid holidays to recharge and relax.
  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive team environment that values innovation and collaboration.
  • Equity Options: Opportunity to own a part of Fello and share in our success.
  • Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative products that leverage AI and advanced technologies.

jobs.title: Lead Specialist, Internal Audit, Controls, Compliance and Risk
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewPearson Virtual Schools operates audited platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students, in which audit readiness and a defensible control environment are not optional.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Pearson Virtual Schools operates audited platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students, in which audit readiness and a defensible control environment are not optional. This role is the dedicated owner of audit response and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) for our platforms.

As Staff, Governance, Risk & Compliance, you own the response across the internal audit lifecycle, SOC 2 (Types 1 and 2), the risk register, and the business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) program. You set evidence and attestation standards across service owners, translate findings into tracked remediation, and partner with internal audit, cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and legal.

This is a senior individual contributor role. It sits independently of the operational security team; it assures that the team operates the controls, and you independently verify and attest to them. You also have a dotted-line relationship to the Lead, Service Operations & Cyber Risk for day-to-day coordination.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Audit & SOC 2 Leadership

  • Lead the response across the audit lifecycle, including planning, fieldwork coordination, and reviewing draft observations, root causes, and risks.

  • Challenge observation and management action plan ownership, wording, and feasibility, and draft and submit audit-closure proposals with stakeholder alignment.

  • Own SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2) coordination, including planning and bringing additional platforms into scope. Review evidence and send weak submissions back for rework.

  • Work with partner teams to ensure resources are assigned and aligned, and continually work with them on gaps and help them close them.

Controls, Evidence & Remediation

  • Set standards for evidence, attestation, and documentation across services.

  • Translate findings into structured remediation plans with owners, due dates, and evidence requirements, tracked to closure.

  • Maintain the audit-action tracker and hold action owners accountable, challenging weak ownership and unrealistic timelines.

  • Coordinate audit actions owned by other teams across the organization and keep them visible to closure.

  • Govern the configuration management database (CMDB, the inventory of services and their dependencies) for audit scope, keeping ownership and classification accurate. Solution Architecture operates and maintains it.

Risk & Resilience Governance

  • Own the risk register, including quality, owners, clear write-ups, closure, and escalation of risks beyond tolerance.

  • Turn access-review and vulnerability gaps into formal risks or audit actions where appropriate.

  • Govern the business continuity and disaster recovery program, including impact analyses, coverage and gaps, vendor continuity, annual reviews, and tabletop exercises, and executive attestation.

Cross-Functional Influence & Reporting

  • Partner with internal audit, cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and legal to close findings and prevent repeat observations.

  • Prepare audit and GRC status updates for monthly operations reviews, covering open actions, overdue items, blockers, and risks.

  • Advise service owners and coach peers on governance expectations, acting as an objective assurance partner.

What You Will Bring

  • 5 or more years in internal audit, controls, compliance, or risk (IT audit or GRC strongly preferred)

  • Hands-on coordination of SOC 2 (or SOX) programs, including evidence and attestation management

  • Demonstrated ownership of a risk register and the risk-management lifecycle

  • Experience governing or supporting business continuity and disaster recovery (impact analyses, plans, tabletops, attestation)

  • A professional qualification is expected or strongly preferred (CISA, CIA, CRISC, ACA/ACCA, or CISSP)

  • Proven ability to challenge peers and leaders and to represent the organization to external auditors

  • Experience in EdTech, SaaS, regulated, or highly distributed environments is a plus; familiarity with NIST CSF or ISO 22301 is a plus

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; advanced degree a plus

Key Behaviors & Attributes

Independent & Objective: You bring professional skepticism and integrity, and you hold the line on audit-readiness.

Business-Enabling: You approach assurance as a means of enabling the business, not policing it, while staying objective.

Influence Without Authority: You push peers and leaders to own and close actions, challenging weak ownership and unrealistic timelines.

Continuous Improvement: You bring proven GRC frameworks and improve governance without slowing delivery.

Collaborative: You partner across security, engineering, privacy, legal, and internal audit to build a consistent control environment.

Direct Reports: None. This is a senior individual contributor role.

JOB SUMMARY

B-Stock is searching for an experienced B2B Buyer Development Director with a track record of over-performance and demonstrated success leading and developing sales talent. This person will own a portfolio of high-value buyer accounts while directly managing a team of Buyer Account Managers and driving both individual and team performance in large-scale liquidation inventory sales.

As a member of the Buyer Account Management Team, the Director, Buyer Account Management will accelerate GMV growth by bringing in new high-value buyers, expanding strategic buyer relationships, and coaching team members to qualify, onboard, retain, and scale large B2B liquidation buyers. The Director is accountable for clear team goals, consistent execution, buyer experience, performance management, and employee development. The ideal candidate combines advanced B2B sales expertise and buyer relationships with a hands-on, supportive management approach that builds accountability and a strong leadership bench.

This person applies AI throughout their own and their team’s sales motions, from prospecting and buyer research to pipeline management, and develops repeatable, increasingly automated workflows that improve team productivity and precision. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Buyer Account Management, this individual contributes to long-term buyer growth, team capability, and revenue targets.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • IDENTIFY
  • Generate new big buyer leads through cold outreach, trade shows, inbound marketing follow-up, and other buyer marketing initiatives.
  • Build AI-enabled prospecting and account-research workflows to find, qualify, and prioritize high-value buyers at scale.
  • Leverage a professional network to connect with key decision-makers; coach the team on prospecting and account targeting.
  • Prospect into target seller accounts for more inventory.
  • Maintain accurate Salesforce activity and pipeline records; establish consistent reporting and pipeline hygiene expectations for direct reports.
  • ENGAGE
  • Create, position, and sell the full value of B-Stock solutions to high-value buyers.
  • Deliver concise, effective sales pitches tailored to each prospect; coach direct reports in discovery, negotiation, and relationship management.
  • Partner closely with Account Management, Client Operations, Customer Service, Logistics, and other teams to execute transactions and resolve buyer obstacles.
  • Step into complex escalations and help team members create practical solutions across programs, inventory, shipping, and operational constraints.
  • CLOSE
  • Achieve quarterly individual and team GMV and sales objectives by maintaining healthy pipelines and consistent execution.
  • Build and grow a book of large buyers purchasing more than $500,000 annually, while helping direct reports increase buyer spend, retention, and account value.
  • Increase transaction volume, buyer purchase frequency, and value delivered on the B-Stock platform.
  • Use AI-driven automation within Salesforce and buyer data sources to surface expansion signals, improve forecasting, and tailor recommendations to buyer buying patterns; scale effective practices across the team.
  • LEAD, COACH & DEVELOP PEOPLE
  • Directly manage assigned Buyer Account Managers, setting clear responsibilities, measurable performance expectations, and priorities aligned with GMV, retention, buyer growth, and company goals.
  • Hold consistent 1:1 meetings, team meetings, pipeline reviews, and performance check-ins; provide timely, specific coaching, constructive feedback, recognition, and support to remove obstacles.
  • Evaluate performance fairly using results, behaviors, and role-specific competency tracks; identify performance gaps early, document expectations, and drive improvement plans in partnership with People leadership as appropriate.
  • Partner with each direct report to create and maintain an Individual Development Plan and actionable Grow development areas, informed by personal strengths, career aspirations, competency expectations, and business needs. Review and update growth milestones and goals at least monthly.
  • Identify stretch assignments, cross-functional projects, mentoring, peer learning, and training opportunities to build account management, negotiation, analytical, operational, and leadership capabilities.
  • Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, reinforce strong operating practices and CRM discipline, and share effective sales plays and AI workflows across the team.
  • Foster an inclusive, trusting, high-accountability team environment where employees feel comfortable raising issues, collaborating, giving feedback, and taking ownership of results and career development.
  • Recognize high potential talent and build succession readiness by preparing strong team members for larger accounts, expanded responsibilities, and future leadership opportunities.
  • Translate leadership priorities into clear team plans and capacity decisions, communicate progress and risks, and take accountability for both team wins and gaps.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

  • 8+ years of experience in quota-carrying, enterprise B2B transactions with a proven history of exceeding goals.
  • Experience in marketplace business models, buyer account management, and re-commerce sales.
  • Ability to develop and execute strategic and tactical account plans and translate business objectives into clear team goals.
  • Professional network of C-level or VP-level buyer contacts.
  • Hands-on experience building AI automations or agentic processes for prospect research, outreach, pipeline analysis, and sales productivity, and ability to coach adoption across a team.
  • Strong judgment, creativity, conflict resolution, and ability to manage difficult conversations and complex cross-functional problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, coaching, prioritization, and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency with MS Office, Salesforce.com, and other CRM tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, entrepreneurship, or related field.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with structured development practices, competency rubrics, Individual Development Plans, and career growth tools.
  • Knowledge of eCommerce, supply chain, ERP, or logistics software solutions.
  • Experience in SaaS selling and a start-up-like environment.
  • Experience building custom assistants, projects, or agents on AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok to support buyer workflows and team coaching.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including direct-report management, coaching, performance evaluation, and employee development.
  • Experience leading a sales or account management team to measurable growth and performance outcomes.

The pay rate for this role will range between $150,000 to $180,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)
  • Support for continuing education
  • Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

Find Strength In Numbers

jobs.title: Penetration Tester - Hardware (Canada)
jobs.excerpt: Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing.
jobs.description:
Packetlabs is a cybersecurity consulting firm specializing in advanced Penetration Testing. We exist to eliminate the false sense of security that comes from shallow testing and checkbox-driven assessments. Our slogan, "Ready for more than a VA scan?", reflects a simple standard: real security work should be rigorous, manual, and built to uncover what automated approaches miss. Our clients span government, technology, law enforcement, retail, healthcare, and financial services, and they rely on us because credibility matters when the stakes are high.

Packetlabs is looking for an Penetration Tester - Hardware to lead security assessments of embedded and IoT devices, the physical products where a vulnerability lives in silicon, firmware, and board layout, rather than in a web request. The Ethical Hacker - Hardware is a specialized technical role focused on assessing embedded systems across all industries, from consumer IoT to industrial and connected devices. This role involves getting hands-on with a device, opening it up, and proving what an attacker with physical or local access can really do.

This role requires the rare combination of offensive security instinct and genuine hardware fundamentals. You will work directly with clients to understand their devices and deliver findings that improve security posture.

Who we are looking for

  • No egos, ever. Egos don't belong at Packetlabs. The more you learn, the less you know. You stay humble, ask questions, and work to help clients improve their security.
  • Customer-first mentality. You are an excellent communicator with clients, project managers, and teammates. You are responsive, reliable, and professional throughout every engagement.
  • You deliver work that you take pride in. Your work is an autograph of your excellence. You hold yourself to a high standard, and it shows in what you produce.
  • Digs deeper into every finding. You don't stop until impact is proven, while understanding that restraint is the right call in sensitive OT environments where high-risk activity is not appropriate.
  • Comfortable being uncomfortable. You move toward obstacles, not away from them. Consulting is not a typical job and requires adapting to rapidly changing environments.
  • Always learning. Cybersecurity changes every day, and you keep up because you want to. You are deeply aware of your skillset and committed to improving it.
  • Self-motivated and dependable. You take ownership of your work and your outcomes without needing to be managed into them.

What you’ll be doing

  • Hardware Penetration Testing
    • Plan and execute end-to-end hardware penetration tests on embedded and IoT devices, against a defined scope and rules of engagement
    • Identify, access, and exploit on-board debug interfaces: JTAG, SWD, UART, and similar, to gain code execution or memory access
    • Extract firmware via debug ports, in-circuit flash reads (SPI / I2C / NAND), or chip-off when required, and analyze it for vulnerabilities
    • Intercept and analyze data on common embedded buses (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB) using logic analyzers and protocol decoders
    • Where in scope, perform side-channel analysis and fault injection (power analysis, voltage/clock glitching) to bypass secure boot, readout protection, or authentication
  • Firmware Analysis & Reverse Engineering
    • Reverse engineer firmware and embedded binaries (Ghidra, IDA, Binwalk, etc.) to find logic flaws, hardcoded secrets, and exploitable conditions
    • Assess physical attack surface, tamper resistance, and key/secret storage
    • Distinguish between theoretical and operationally relevant risk to keep findings actionable
  • Client Advisory & Remediation
    • Write high-quality technical reports and present findings to client stakeholders, both technical and non-technical
    • Advise on practical, prioritized remediation that clients can act on
    • Build client confidence through credibility, clear communication, and proven impact
  • Methodology, Research & Continuous Improvement
    • Build and maintain lab tooling, test rigs, and internal methodology
    • Contribute to research, responsible disclosure, and internal knowledge-sharing
    • Stay current on hardware attack techniques, embedded architectures, and defensive controls
    • Help raise the standard of hardware security work across the firm

What success looks like

  • Clients gain a clear, accurate understanding of their hardware risk, backed by proven, reproducible impact
  • Findings are credible, actionable, and land for both technical and leadership audiences
  • Engagements are delivered to a consistently high standard with strong client confidence
  • Scope and rules of engagement are managed well as engagements evolve, with risk surfaced early and clearly
  • Packetlabs' hardware testing methodology and lab capability continue to mature through your contribution
  • Clients trust Packetlabs as the partner that can break their hardware before someone else does

Education and Experience

  • A graduate of an Information Security, Computer Science, or Computer/Electrical Engineering degree program (or equivalent hands-on experience)
  • Strong electronics fundamentals. Able to read schematics and datasheets and reason about a board from them
  • Hands-on soldering ability, including surface-mount (SMD) rework and basic chip removal
  • Demonstrated experience accessing debug interfaces (JTAG, SWD, UART) and extracting firmware from real devices
  • Comfort with core bench instruments: logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and multimeter
  • Firmware reverse-engineering skills and scripting proficiency in Python, plus enough C to read embedded code
  • Familiarity with common embedded architectures (ARM/Cortex-M, MIPS, AVR, RISC-V) and RTOS/bare-metal concepts
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Nice to have (one or more would be an asset):
    • Side-channel / fault-injection experience (e.g., ChipWhisperer)
    • RF and wireless work: SDR, BLE, sub-GHz, Wi-Fi
    • Knowledge of secure boot chains, TEEs, secure elements, and HSMs
    • PCB design familiarity (KiCad / Altium) for understanding target boards
    • Published CVEs, conference talks, CTF placements, or open-source tooling
    • Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP for breadth, or hardware-focused training)

Why us?

  • The opportunity to work on high-stakes hardware engagements where your judgment and bench skills genuinely matter
  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Play a key role in shaping the growth, direction, and methodology of Packetlabs' expanding hardware practice
  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
  • Flexible work environment that empowers employees to do their best work
  • Fully remote within Canada

You’ll spend about your time growing revenue with existing customers. The role is collaborative as you’ll work with Solutions Engineers, SDRs, Account Managers, Professional Services, Product Management, Legal, and Sales Ops to find opportunities, shape and validate solutions, and close new revenue. You’ll partner most closely with Account Managers because they know the current customers day to day, and together you’ll plan how to reach new teams and grow each account.

Who are you?

You have the ability to talk to Analysts, Data Engineers, and C-Suite with comfort. You won’t be building the product, but you can explain how it works in plain terms. You sell on value as opposed to features. You know how to ask the right questions to get the information you need in a deal. You are comfortable with using AI to keep organized, iterate solutions, and finalize proposals, but you still have an opinion and intuition. You are entrepreneurial, but you may not have ever been an entrepreneur. You have great relationships and are comfortable bringing them professionally when there’s a win-win. You advocate for yourself, the company, and your client with fair balance. Prior to sales, you may have worked as or in a Solutions role (consultant, architect, or engineer), Technical Account Manager, Business Transformation, or Management Consulting.

What are the key responsibilities?

Relationship and Program Management 

  • Build strong relationships across users, champions, program owners, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and executive sponsors. 

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for customer initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and internal teams. 

  • Establish clear objectives, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and follow-up actions. 

  • Maintain momentum between meetings and hold internal and external stakeholders accountable for commitments. 

  • Act as the voice of the customer and share actionable feedback with Product, Engineering, Support, Education, and leadership. 

Technical and Product Fluency 

  • Develop a proficient working knowledge of Quid’s platform, product configuration, data sources, workflows, integrations, and AI capabilities. 

  • Translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for business stakeholders. 

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and customer technical teams to document requirements, validate technical capabilities, and position solutions to customers and prospects. 

  • Be able to see opportunities to resell a given package or offering to other customers and industries.

Contract Execution 

  • Own sales strategy and execution for expansion. Collaborate with Account Managers to create opportunities and complete deals.

  • Manage deals through pricing, proposal development, contract preparation, procurement, legal, security and AI reviews, negotiation, signature, and internal handoff. 

  • Maintain accurate expansion forecasts, clearly documenting risk, expected outcomes, last steps, next steps, and required support. 

Growth Planning 

  • Identify expansion opportunities based on customer outcomes, emerging business needs, additional use cases, and opportunities across departments or business units. 

  • Multi-thread customer relationships to reduce reliance on a single contact and strengthen the overall partnership. 

  • Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with the appropriate internal stakeholders. 

  • Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, contract, and activity information in Quid’s systems of record. 

How will success be measured? 

  • Quarterly expansion targets

  • Timely and successful contract execution 

  • Product comfort and adoption

jobs.excerpt: At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence.
jobs.description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

Research Scientist — Audio Source Separation


Description

The goal of our team is to develop novel AI-powered audio processing algorithms. The twist is that our algorithms must run in real time, on physical devices, for applications such as dynamic awareness, hearing augmentation, agentic perception, voice pickup, content enhancement, and ones we haven’t even thought of yet. You will work with experts in ML, DSP, software engineering, and psychoacoustics to prototype and implement new algorithms.

You will develop next-generation algorithms that isolate, extract, or suppress individual sound sources from microphone recordings, sometimes augmented by other sensor signals. Applications include voice pickup, hearing augmentation, and new audio experiences that must ultimately run in real time on physical devices.

Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting-edge audio technology. We are looking for people passionate about machine learning and audio to help shape what comes next.


Responsibilities

  • Research, prototype, train, and evaluate novel source separation and extraction algorithms for speech and other real-world sounds.
  • Develop approaches for single- and multi-microphone recordings, including spatial cues and optional auxiliary sensors.
  • Investigate robust separation in challenging conditions such as overlapping talkers, noise, reverberation, and motion.
  • Evaluate perceptual quality, separation performance, generalization, latency, memory, and computational requirements.
  • Collaborate with DSP and embedded software teams to deploy models in real-time demonstrations and product platforms; contribute to patents and conference papers.

Education

Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.


Skills

  • Deep hands-on experience in audio source separation, target sound extraction, speech enhancement, or related neural audio processing.
  • Comfortable tackling complex, open-ended problems where you have to experiment with and discard many ideas before finding the right solution.
  • Strong knowledge of audio DSP, time-frequency methods, and microphone array or spatial signal processing.
  • Experience training and evaluating audio models in PyTorch; proficiency in Python and familiarity with C/C++ is a plus.
  • Understanding of objective and perceptual evaluation methods and the tradeoffs involved in real-time low-power inference.
  • Experience with multimodal or sensor-conditioned separation, ONNX/TFLite, or embedded deployment is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills; publications at conferences such as ICASSP, Interspeech, NeurIPS, or similar are welcome but not required.

We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. A Pagaleve é uma empresa do setor de"Buy Now Pay Later", uma startup fintech inovadora e uma das primeiras empresas a oferecer pagamento parcelado no PIX, sem juros, e sem a necessidade de usar cartão de crédito. Temos como objetivo oferecer a lojistas um novo método de pagamento, para aumentar suas vendas de um jeito simples, descomplicado e ágil, mas também temos como objetivo oferecer às pessoas a oportunidade de comprar aquilo que desejam, sem se comprometerem com os altos juros do cartão de crédito.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa curiosa, hands-on e apaixonada por resolver problemas reais com dados e machine learning. Na Pagaleve, Ciência de Dados está no centro do negócio: nossos modelos impactam diretamente decisões de crédito, fraude, pricing, collections e experiência do usuário.

Trabalhamos com alto volume de dados, problemas complexos e espaço real para experimentação. A posição terá forte interação com Produto, Engenharia, Riscos e Operações, participando desde análises exploratórias e experimentos até desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de modelos em produção.

Encorajamos a experimentação com o estado-da-arte em IA e Machine Learning, incluindo o uso de Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) para aprimoramento de sistemas de risco e a exploração de LLMs para problemas de negócio. ● Desenvolver, testar e evoluir modelos de machine learning aplicados a crédito, fraude, risco e comportamento do usuário.
