● Participar do ciclo de vida completo (end-to-end) dos modelos, incluindo design, implementação e manutenção de pipelines de dados e ML em produção, garantindo estabilidade e performance.

● Trabalhar próximo de Engenharia, Produto e Riscos para transformar problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas e modelos escaláveis.

● Realizar análises exploratórias, testes, experimentos e avaliações de performance de modelos.

● Acompanhar métricas de negócio e performance dos modelos, ajudando a identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

● Contribuir para boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e qualidade técnica do time.

O que buscamos

● Experiência prévia com Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning ou Analytics.

● Boa base em estatística, modelagem preditiva e análise de dados.

● Experiência com Python e bibliotecas de machine learning.

● Familiaridade com modelos supervisionados, feature engineering e avaliação de modelos.

● Experiência com SQL e grandes volumes de dados.

● Curiosidade para explorar novas abordagens e vontade de aprender constantemente.

● Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.

Diferenciais

● Experiência em fintechs, crédito, fraude, risco ou pagamentos.

● Familiaridade com gradient boosting, redes neurais, Graph Neural Networks ou LLMs.

● Experiência com Foundational Models e Embbedings.

● Experiência com ambiente de Cloud.

Por que a Pagaleve?

● Problemas complexos e reais desde o primeiro dia.

● Espaço para experimentação, aprendizado rápido e impacto direto no negócio.

● Ambiente altamente colaborativo, com proximidade entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.

● Autonomia para testar ideias, construir soluções e participar ativamente da evolução dos modelos e produtos da empresa.

jobs.description:
RedSeal, a pioneer in preemptive exposure management and winner of the SC Award for Best CTEM Solution, helps organizations see, understand, and secure their hybrid digital environments across IT (on-prem, cloud, and remote workers), OT, and IoT. By dynamically modeling the entire environment, RedSeal uncovers hidden assets, misconfigurations, and lateral attack paths, prioritizes exposures based on business-critical impact with Risk Radius™, and continuously validates compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Trusted by hundreds of Fortune 1000 companies and more than 75 U.S. government agencies, including all five branches of the U.S. military, RedSeal strengthens resilience, streamlines operations, and reduces business risk. Learn more at www.redseal.net.

Overview
As a Sales Engineer, you will establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with customers as you communicate to understand their hybrid environment, security architecture, and operations, and help them define their exposure management objectives while mapping them to RedSeal capabilities. This role requires hands-on leadership to resolution of technical/integration problems effectively escalating critical issues of both technical and operational natures. You will provide standard and customized training on the RedSeal platform while providing accurate, complete and timely written documentation for all project phases. You must have demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with customer representatives at all levels of the organization, from highly technical to senior management.


Performance Objectives
A RedSeal Sales Engineer performs a wide variety of technical sales activities including:
  • Partnering with Sales Directors to plan and execute technical sales strategies for each account, including briefings, demonstrations, proposals, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and technical issue resolution.
  • Establishing and proactively maintaining value-added relationships with customers and partners.
  • Conducting technical discovery to identify customer requirements, use cases, success criteria, and potential obstacles to a successful evaluation.
  • Assessing the customer's IT, OT, IoT, cloud, and hybrid environments, including their security architecture, existing technologies, and operational processes.
  • Understanding the customer's cybersecurity and exposure management objectives and mapping them to RedSeal capabilities and measurable business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Platform teams to maintain development, staging, and production environments.

  • Store and manage Databricks secrets, tokens, and configuration securely within Azure Key Vault and DevOps variable groups.
  • Understand and apply DevOps practices in a data platform context.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

jobs.description:
stellenausschreibung

Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.de stehen wir für maßgefertigte Möbel „Made in Germany“. In unserer eigenen Produktion fertigen wir in Losgröße 1 und begeistern Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa – überwiegend über unsere digitalen Kanäle.
Unser Marketing bauen wir gerade neu auf. Ein zentraler Hebel für unser Wachstum ist eine konsequent getestete Customer Experience – vom ersten Besuch über die Planung im Konfigurator bis zur Bestellung. Dafür suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland – eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d).

das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest die Conversion-Optimierung unserer Online-Shops und baust ein systematisches Testprogramm auf, in dem dauerhaft Tests laufen.
  • Du entwickelst Hypothesen aus Daten, Nutzerverhalten, Kundenfeedback und Wettbewerbsvergleichen und priorisierst sie in einem transparenten Backlog.
  • Du konzipierst A/B-Tests, setzt Varianten KI-gestützt um – etwa Mockups, Texte und Layouts – und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.
  • Du optimierst unseren Online-Konfigurator, Produktseiten, Checkout und Landingpages und reduzierst gezielt Hürden und Abbrüche im Planungs- und Kaufprozess.
  • Wo der Traffic für A/B-Tests nicht reicht, arbeitest du mit qualitativen Methoden wie Session-Analysen, Heatmaps und Nutzerbefragungen.
  • Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse und Learnings in einem Testlog und stellst sie regelmäßig im Management und im Team vor.
  • Du baust agentische Workflows für Analyse, Variantenentwicklung und Reporting auf.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content, Design und unserer Webentwicklung zusammen.

das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung, idealerweise im E-Commerce, mit einer großen Zahl selbst verantworteter Tests
  • Ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Änderungen wirklich verkaufen – und nicht nur, was gut aussieht
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Testmethodik und Statistik, z. B. Signifikanz, Laufzeiten und Stichprobengrößen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Analyse- und Testing-Tools wie GA4, Microsoft Clarity oder gängigen A/B-Testing-Plattformen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes UX-Verständnis; Webdesign-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich
  • Eine starke KI-Affinität und Erfahrung darin, Mockups, Varianten und Analysen mit KI-Tools zu erstellen
  • Durchsetzungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse auch auf Management-Ebene überzeugend zu vertreten
  • Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Niederländisch ist ein Plus
  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise; ein Wohnort im Raum Köln/Bonn ist ein Plus

das bieten wir dir

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres Testprogramms – inklusive der Freiheit, es mit KI-Agenten zu skalieren – und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer fairen, leistungsgerechten Vergütung in einem wachstumsstarken, innovativen Unternehmen
  • Moderne Tools und eine eigene KI-Infrastruktur für das Marketing
  • 30 Urlaubstage und eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Eine offene Kommunikationskultur, flache Hierarchien und ein familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld
  • Eine gezielte Einarbeitung sowie Weiterbildung und Förderung deiner Entwicklung
  • Rabatte auf unsere Möbel, „Family and Friends“-Angebote und weitere Mitarbeitervorteile
  • Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland und regelmäßige Mitarbeiter-Events vor Ort

die nächsten schritte

Du willst unsere Shops messbar besser machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit zwei bis drei Beispielen aus deinen bisherigen Tests (Hypothese, Ergebnis, Learning), deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – per E-Mail an

Microsoft AI and Automation

Digital Marketing Account Manager – Google Business Profile & Local SEO | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a hands-on Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage and optimize digital marketing performance across a portfolio of approximately 15–20 client accounts.

This role is heavily focused on Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization and local SEO, particularly for businesses in the storage, parking, and local-service industries.

This is not a strategy-only account management position. You’ll personally execute optimizations, analyze local search performance, prepare reports, lead monthly client conversations, and identify opportunities to improve both client retention and account growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong digital marketing execution skills with the confidence to independently manage client relationships and communicate performance clearly.

What You’ll Own

Google Business Profile & Local SEO

  • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles to improve local visibility and search rankings
  • Execute local SEO strategies across client accounts
  • Optimize key local ranking factors, including:
    • Citations
    • NAP consistency
    • Reviews
    • Local search visibility
  • Monitor local search performance and identify opportunities for ongoing optimization
  • Personally implement improvements rather than simply providing strategic recommendations
  • Continuously evaluate account performance and adjust optimization efforts accordingly

Client Account Management

  • Independently manage approximately 15–20 client accounts
  • Own accounts from marketing execution through reporting and client communication
  • Maintain consistent communication and follow-up with clients
  • Lead monthly client meetings to review performance, insights, and recommendations
  • Build strong client relationships while maintaining accountability for marketing results
  • Keep client priorities, deliverables, and next steps organized

Reporting & Performance Analysis

  • Prepare clear and concise monthly marketing performance reports
  • Analyze campaign and local search data to identify trends and opportunities
  • Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for clients
  • Pull and compile data from internal platforms and marketing tools
  • Track account performance over time
  • Identify potential risks and opportunities related to retention and account growth

Marketing Tools & Technology

  • Select and manage the digital marketing tools needed to execute and optimize client accounts
  • Evaluate tools based on performance, efficiency, and client requirements
  • Research and recommend new platforms when appropriate
  • Quickly learn unfamiliar software and marketing platforms
  • Extract and interpret relevant performance data across different systems

Client Retention & Account Growth

  • Identify opportunities to improve client satisfaction and retention
  • Recognize appropriate upsell opportunities within existing accounts
  • Use marketing performance insights to strengthen client relationships
  • Proactively address potential account concerns
  • Support long-term account growth through consistent execution and communication

Internal Collaboration

  • Coordinate with internal account teams to provide a seamless client experience
  • Support white-glove ALO accounts with marketing execution and performance reporting
  • Provide marketing data and insights to the COO for client reporting when required
  • Keep internal stakeholders informed about account performance, risks, and opportunities

Requirements

  • Approximately 5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, with a strong focus on execution
  • Proven experience optimizing Google Business Profiles
  • Strong understanding of local SEO, including:
    • Local ranking factors
    • Citations
    • NAP consistency
    • Review strategies
    • Local search performance
  • Experience independently managing multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Previous client-facing or account management experience
  • Strong ability to select, operate, and evaluate digital marketing tools
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing performance data
  • Ability to quickly learn new software platforms and extract relevant performance information
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Self-directed and comfortable working without micromanagement
  • Professional spoken English suitable for client-facing communication
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a digital marketing agency or white-label environment
  • Experience with storage, parking, local-service, or other location-based businesses
  • Experience presenting monthly marketing reports directly to clients
  • Experience identifying upsell and client retention opportunities
  • Experience working with Google Business Profile, local SEO, reporting, and analytics tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a hands-on marketer who enjoys executing and optimizing, not just creating strategies
  • Have strong practical knowledge of Google Business Profile and local SEO
  • Can independently manage 15–20 client accounts without losing attention to detail
  • Are comfortable being accountable for marketing performance
  • Can turn performance data into clear, actionable improvements
  • Confidently present results and recommendations directly to clients
  • Proactively identify opportunities instead of waiting for instructions
  • Learn new platforms and marketing tools quickly
  • Can balance execution, reporting, client communication, and account growth

What Success Looks Like

  • Improved Google Business Profile and local search performance across client accounts
  • Consistent execution of local SEO optimizations
  • Accurate and useful monthly client reporting
  • Strong client communication and relationship management
  • Organized management of approximately 15–20 accounts
  • Proactive identification of performance improvement opportunities
  • Strong client retention and satisfaction
  • Identification of appropriate upsell and account growth opportunities

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing local search performance across client accounts, optimizing Google Business Profiles, addressing citation or NAP consistency issues, and analyzing opportunities to improve rankings.

You may then prepare performance reports, lead a monthly client meeting, pull data from internal platforms, coordinate with internal account teams, or identify an opportunity to improve retention or expand an account.

In short: you own both the hands-on marketing execution and the client relationship needed to drive measurable results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application / Screening with Pavago
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have strong hands-on experience with Google Business Profile, local SEO, digital marketing execution, and client account management, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help clients improve their local visibility, marketing performance, and long-term growth.

Associate Managing Editor

Job Purpose

The Associate Managing Editor is responsible for the end-to-end management and development of assigned journals, ensuring timely publication, operational excellence, and strong stakeholder engagement. The role works closely with editors, authors, reviewers, societies, and internal teams to support journal growth, publication quality, indexing objectives, and overall portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

Journal & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the end-to-end publication process for assigned journals, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of issues.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for journal-related operational matters and escalations.

  • Coordinate closely with editors, editorial boards, authors, reviewers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient journal operations.

  • Ensure a seamless transition of newly acquired journals from the acquisitions stage to editorial management.

  • Monitor publishing schedules and proactively address delays to maintain publication timelines.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with journal editors, authors, reviewers, society partners, and internal teams.

  • Liaise regularly with Sage India, UK, and US colleagues to address editorial, production, and operational requirements.

  • Provide high-quality service and support to editors, societies, and contributors.

Journal Development & Performance

  • Identify opportunities to enhance journal performance, visibility, and impact.

  • Work closely with editors on manuscript flow, turnaround times, editorial planning, and publication strategies.

  • Drive initiatives related to journal indexing, abstracting, Impact Factor acquisition, and overall portfolio growth.

  • Educate and guide editors on indexing criteria, citation performance, and Impact Factor improvement strategies.

  • Identify and implement journal-specific development plans to improve performance and reach.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop and execute journal-specific promotional activities, including:

    • Call for Papers campaigns

    • Impact Factor announcements

    • Special Issue promotions

    • Article-level marketing initiatives

    • Conference and event promotional support

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and present journal performance reports and publisher reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

  • Maintain accurate journal records, reports, and portfolio documentation.

  • Prepare personal performance reports aligned with departmental objectives.

Contract & Business Management

  • Support drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing journal contract renewals and addenda.

  • Develop an understanding of publishing business models and contractual frameworks.

  • Support onboarding, maintenance, and renewal of new publishing products and content solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on industry developments, publishing trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

  • Work independently to achieve departmental objectives while escalating issues appropriately when required.

Key Accountabilities

  • Effective management of assigned journal portfolios.

  • Delivery of publication schedules and service-level commitments.

  • Enhanced journal visibility through indexing and abstracting achievements.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction and relationship management.

  • Accurate reporting and performance tracking.

  • Successful implementation of journal development initiatives.

  • Compliance with publishing standards, contracts, and internal policies.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Publishing, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 2-3 years of experience in scholarly journal publishing within an editorial or journal management environment.

  • Experience managing journals throughout the publication lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience with journal development activities, indexing applications, and editorial workflows.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Scholarly publishing processes

    • Peer review management

    • Journal management and development

    • Publishing contracts and business models

    • Abstracting and Indexing (A&I) databases

    • Impact Factor and journal performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly:

    • Excel

    • PowerPoint

    • Outlook

    • Teams

    • SharePoint

  • Experience with peer review management systems is preferred.

Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced publishing environment.

Success Measures

  • Timely publication of assigned journals.

  • Improved journal performance and indexing outcomes.

  • High editor, author, reviewer, and society satisfaction.

  • Achievement of departmental and individual KPIs.

  • Effective management of journal portfolios and stakeholder relationships.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

jobs.description:
Who we are.

Arbor Biotechnologies, a clinical stage, next-generation gene editing company based in Cambridge, MA, is advancing a portfolio of first-in-class genomic medicines addressing serious diseases for which there are no existing functional cures, with a CNS pipeline initially prioritizing multiple ALS targets and a co-developed, clinical program, ABO-101, for the treatment of primary hyperoxaluria type 1. The company’s unique breadth of gene editing technologies goes beyond the limitations of early editing approaches to unlock access to new gene targets and expand the therapeutic reach of genomic medicines. For more information, please visit: .

Who you are.

You're driven by purpose and curious by nature. You take ownership, speak up, and stay steady when things get hard. You'd rather the team win than get the credit. If that sounds like you, keep reading.

About the role.

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager will lead day-to-day clinical trial operations for assigned early-phase studies of our gene-editing therapeutics in rare genetic diseases. Reporting to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, this role will be responsible for study execution from start-up through close-out, including site oversight, CRO and vendor management, trial documentation, timelines, budgets, and operational issue resolution.

In our lean biotech environment, this role requires a hands-on clinical operations leader who can manage multiple aspects of trial execution while partnering closely with internal teams, investigative sites, CROs, laboratories, and external vendors.

What you'll do.

  • Lead day-to-day clinical trial operations across assigned studies, sites, CROs, laboratories, and vendors.
  • Manage study start-up, site activation, monitoring oversight, and close-out activities.
  • Own and manage study timelines, budgets, invoices, vendor deliverables, and key milestones.
  • Oversee study documentation and trial master file quality to support inspection readiness.
  • Review and provide operational leadership on clinical documents, including protocols, ICFs, CRFs, SAPs, CSRs, study plans, and related materials.
  • Partner with cross-functional study teams to drive study execution, resolve operational issues, and support achievement of study milestones.
  • Manage clinical sample logistics between patients, sites, and laboratory vendors.
  • Drive timelines and logistics for Safety Review Boards, Data Monitoring Committees, data cuts, and related study activities.
  • Lead or support vendor review, selection, contracting, onboarding, and performance oversight.
  • Build and manage effective relationships with investigative sites, CROs, vendors, clinical experts, and internal stakeholders, including planning investigator meetings.
  • Identify, escalate, and resolve study risks and operational issues.
  • Represent the company externally with study partners and investigative sites.
  • Travel domestically and internationally to investigative sites or study-related meetings as needed.

What you bring.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related, or related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive clinical operations experience in the pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry, including experience managing clinical trial execution from start-up through close-out.
  • Experience managing early-phase clinical studies; rare disease or CNS experience preferred.
  • Experience managing U.S. and global clinical trials across CROs, vendors, laboratories, and study sites.
  • Familiarity with ethics committee and regulatory submissions, such as pre-IND, IND, Scientific Advice, CTA, or similar filings.
  • Strong knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, clinical research regulations, and the drug development process.
  • Experience with vendor oversight, budgets, contracts, invoices, and change orders.
  • Strong clinical operations leadership, project coordination, planning, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with Smartsheet, Microsoft Office, or similar project and study tracking tools.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of mRNA, RNAi, gene therapy, or gene-editing therapeutics; familiarity with LNP or AAV-based development preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on mindset and willingness to work across multiple areas of clinical operations in a startup environment.

·Fully remote role

Compensation and benefits.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $165,000–$185,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including relevant experience, skills, education, training, internal equity and other job-related factors. All employees are eligible for bonus, new hire equity, comprehensive health coverage, and discretionary paid time off.

Arbor is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to a hiring process and a workplace free of bias and discrimination, and we welcome candidates of every background.

jobs.title: Director of Customer Success
jobs.excerpt: The Director of Customer Success owns the strategy, relationship health, retention, and growth of one highly complex, strategic enterprise healthcare account for Vatica + Cozeva.
jobs.description:
The Director of Customer Success owns the strategy, relationship health, retention, and growth of one highly complex, strategic enterprise healthcare account for Vatica + Cozeva. This role serves as the primary client leader and trusted advisor, connecting risk adjustment and quality solutions to the client’s business priorities and measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on role with approximately 80% of time dedicated to direct account ownership and execution and 20% to people leadership. The Director leads one Customer Success Manager and personally drives client strategy, executive engagement, problem solving, and follow-through. Success requires the judgment to navigate a complex organization independently and the ability to work closely with Product, Engineering, IT, and operational teams in a healthcare SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Client Leadership
  • Own the account strategy and success plan, aligning client priorities, contractual commitments, stakeholder needs, and growth opportunities.
  • Build trusted relationships across executive, business, clinical, and technical stakeholders; navigate organizational complexity and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Lead executive governance meetings and quarterly business reviews, personally preparing insights, recommendations, and action plans that demonstrate value and advance the partnership.
  • Anticipate account risks and lead escalations through resolution, maintaining clear ownership, timely communication, and accountability for commitments.
  • Client Outcomes and Growth
  • Drive revenue attainment, retention, and expansion for the assigned account. Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with Sales and Product.
  • Track risk adjustment and quality program outcomes, solution adoption, financial impact, and account health; translate performance data into actionable client recommendations.
  • Own improvement plans for Net Promoter Score (NPS) and client satisfaction, addressing feedback and strengthening the overall client experience.
  • SaaS Delivery and Cross Functional Execution
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, IT, Clinical, and Operations to align implementation, ongoing delivery, and product capabilities with client workflows and business needs.
  • Translate client issues and requests into clear business requirements. Coordinate ticket triage and prioritization based on client impact, urgency, and delivery dependencies; track progress and communicate status through resolution.
  • Own client delivery commitments, ensuring each is documented with a named owner and target date. Manage changes through established change control and proactively escalate risks to agreed timelines.
  • Personally advance deliverables and resolve barriers across teams, including work needed to keep client commitments on track. Maintain awareness of payer requirements, regulatory submission processes, and operational workflows.
  • People Leadership
  • Lead and develop one Customer Success Manager, setting clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and operating rhythms while retaining direct ownership of the account. Contribute to shared customer success and engagement practices.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, or healthcare consulting, including significant client-facing leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated director-level scope and accountability for complex healthcare accounts, including independent ownership of account strategy, executive relationships, commercial outcomes, and day-to-day execution.
  • Deep kowledge of risk adjustment and quality programs, including relevant frameworks such as CMS-HCC, HHS-ACA, HEDIS, Stars, and MSSP/ACO, and the relationships and workflows between health plans and provider organizations.
  • Experience serving clients in healthcare SaaS or meaningful product and IT experience or exposure, including collaboration with technical teams on client issues, work prioritization, and delivery.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, engage credibly with executive and C-suite leaders, and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated success driving account revenue, retention, expansion, and client satisfaction, with the ability to connect solution performance to business value.
  • Strong analytical, consultative, communication, and executive presentation skills, including the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and compelling PowerPoint presentations.
  • Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and remain accountable for execution in an evolving, integrated organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of how Optum Health, Optum Insights, and Optum’s regional organizations make decisions and purchase solutions strongly preferred.
  • Direct customer success or account leadership experience with a healthcare SaaS vendor providing risk adjustment and quality solutions.
  • Prior people management and coaching experience.
  • Performance Measures
  • Performance is measured against established account goals, including revenue attainment, expansion and upsell results, and Net Promoter Score (NPS) and client satisfaction. These measures inform the role’s incentive compensation plan. The Director also monitors retention, solution adoption, delivery commitments, and client outcomes to guide account strategy and corrective action.

Competencies

  • Relationship building and consultative influence
  • Builds rapport and trust, listens actively, understands stakeholder priorities, and offers practical advice. Gains alignment without relying on formal authority.
  • Strategic judgment
  • Connects industry knowledge and client goals to an actionable account strategy; anticipates risks and identifies growth opportunities.
  • Results and accountability
  • Takes personal ownership of deliverables and commercial outcomes, follows through on commitments, and steps in to move work forward.
  • Planning and resourcefulness
  • Prioritizes competing demands, clarifies responsibilities, and mobilizes resources to resolve barriers.
  • Communication and conflict management
  • Communicates clearly with executive and technical audiences, balances stakeholder interests, and handles difficult conversations constructively.
  • Adaptability
  • Adjusts plans and approach as client needs, product capabilities, and organizational processes evolve.

Benefits

WORKING AT VATICA HEALTH ADVANTAGES

Prosperity

  • Competitive salary based on your experience and skills – we believe the top talent deserves the top dollar
  • Bonus Potential (based on role and is discretionary) – if you go above and beyond, you should be rewarded
  • 401k plans– we want to empower you to prepare for your future
  • Room for growth and advancement- we love our employees and want to develop within

Good Health

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans
  • Tax-free Dependent Care Account
  • Life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability

Happiness

  • Excellent PTO policy (everyone deserves a vacation now and then)
  • Great work-life balance environment- We believe family comes first!
  • Strong supportive teams- There is always a helping hand when you need it

The salary for a position is typically determined by multiple factors such as the individual's qualifications, experience, skills, and location. The projected compensation range for the position may vary based on these factors and could range from $195,000 to $217,,000 (annualized USD). However, this estimate represents just one aspect of our total compensation package offered.

jobs.description:
Marketing Automation Specialist – GoHighLevel, ManyChat & Funnels | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: EST / U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to build and manage lead-generation systems across GoHighLevel, ManyChat, funnels, CRM workflows, AI content, and marketing automation tools.

This is a hands-on execution role for someone who understands how to turn traffic, content, and social engagement into qualified leads and booked calls through scalable automation systems.

You’ll own the infrastructure behind lead generation — from landing pages and Instagram DM automations to CRM pipelines, nurture sequences, booking flows, and AI-powered content workflows.

What You’ll Own

GoHighLevel & Marketing Automation

  • Build and manage workflows inside GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Create automated email, SMS, follow-up, and nurture sequences
  • Build and maintain CRM pipelines and lead stages
  • Connect forms, landing pages, calendars, funnels, and CRM workflows
  • Automate repetitive marketing and operational processes
  • Monitor automation performance and troubleshoot workflow issues
  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, tracked, and followed up with
  • Prevent lead leakage across the marketing and sales funnel

Funnels & Conversion Optimization

  • Build landing pages, lead-generation funnels, and booking flows
  • Create clear conversion paths from initial engagement through booked calls
  • Improve funnel messaging, structure, and user experience
  • Monitor conversion rates and identify drop-off points
  • Test and optimize funnel elements based on performance
  • Continuously improve lead-to-booking conversion rates

ManyChat & Instagram DM Automation

  • Build and manage ManyChat automation workflows
  • Create Instagram DM funnels using keyword and engagement triggers
  • Build automated replies, qualification flows, and lead capture sequences
  • Connect ManyChat leads with GoHighLevel and other marketing systems
  • Turn Instagram engagement into qualified leads and booked calls
  • Monitor and optimize DM automation performance

AI Content & Repurposing

  • Use ChatGPT, HeyGen, and similar AI tools to accelerate marketing execution
  • Turn long-form or raw content into multiple marketing assets
  • Batch-create content for LinkedIn, Instagram, email, and short-form platforms
  • Develop content that supports lead generation and conversion — not just engagement
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted content workflows
  • Identify opportunities to increase content output without sacrificing quality

Short-Form Video & Content

  • Repurpose long-form content into Reels, Shorts, and social clips
  • Perform basic video editing using CapCut, Descript, or similar tools
  • Create multiple short-form assets from existing content
  • Optimize content for different social platforms and audiences
  • Support consistent content production and distribution

Integrations & Workflow Automation

  • Connect marketing systems using Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools
  • Build reliable workflows between CRM, forms, funnels, calendars, and marketing platforms
  • Troubleshoot broken integrations and automation logic
  • Reduce manual work through scalable systems
  • Document important workflows and automation processes

Paid Lead Generation

  • Support Facebook and Instagram lead-generation campaigns
  • Assist with campaign setup and lead-flow management
  • Monitor lead quality and acquisition performance
  • Ensure paid leads enter the correct CRM and nurture workflows
  • Help improve and scale paid acquisition as lead-generation systems mature

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel
  • Proven experience building:
    • Lead-generation funnels
    • CRM workflows and pipelines
    • Email and SMS automations
    • Booking systems
    • Follow-up and nurture sequences
  • Strong ManyChat experience, particularly Instagram DM automation
  • Strong understanding of lead generation and conversion funnels
  • Experience using ChatGPT and AI tools within marketing workflows
  • Experience with content repurposing and short-form content
  • Familiarity with Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation platforms
  • Ability to troubleshoot automation and lead-flow issues independently
  • Strong organizational and execution skills
  • Strong written English communication
  • Ability to work during U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting founders, coaches, agencies, or online businesses
  • Facebook and Instagram Ads experience
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) experience
  • Advanced prompt engineering or AI workflow experience
  • Experience with HeyGen or AI-generated video
  • Experience scaling inbound lead-generation systems
  • Experience connecting multiple marketing platforms through APIs or automation tools

Tools & Tech

GoHighLevel | ManyChat | ChatGPT | HeyGen | Zapier | Make | n8n | CapCut | Descript | Meta Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think in systems, funnels, automation, and conversion
  • You’re genuinely hands-on and enjoy building workflows yourself
  • You understand how marketing systems connect from traffic → lead → nurture → booking
  • You move quickly and troubleshoot problems independently
  • You care about measurable business outcomes, not vanity metrics
  • You know how to combine AI, content, CRM, and automation effectively
  • You continuously look for ways to eliminate repetitive manual work
  • You can take ownership without constant supervision

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day reviewing lead flow and troubleshooting a GoHighLevel workflow, then build a ManyChat Instagram DM sequence, optimize a booking funnel, repurpose long-form content into short-form assets using AI, and review the performance of a Meta lead-generation campaign.

You’ll regularly move between automation, funnels, CRM management, AI content, integrations, and conversion optimization.

In short: you build the systems that turn marketing activity into qualified leads and booked opportunities.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified leads generated
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Lead-to-booking conversion rates
  • Automation reliability
  • Lead tracking and CRM accuracy
  • Reduction in manual marketing workflows
  • Consistent content output
  • Speed and quality of campaign execution
  • Improvement in overall lead-generation efficiency

Growth Path

Strong performers can grow into roles such as:

Marketing Operations Lead | Growth Marketing Manager | Automation Strategist | Funnel & CRM Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re highly skilled with GoHighLevel and ManyChat, can build lead-generation funnels and automations from the ground up, and know how to use AI to make marketing systems faster and more effective, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build scalable marketing systems that turn content and traffic into measurable business growth.

jobs.description:
👥 Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio en forte croissance, qui opère plusieurs produits SaaS par abonnement à grande échelle et s'apprête à en lancer de nouveaux dans les prochains mois. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous prévoyons une quarantaine de recrutements par an sur l'ensemble de nos équipes.

Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Talent & People Specialist pour renforcer notre équipe People. Un rôle couteau suisse, RH à 360°, à l'équilibre entre les opérations People (administration, onboarding, SIRH) et le recrutement (entretiens RH, coordination des process, expérience candidat).

Ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est un état d'esprit. Tu as envie d'apprendre vite, tu aimes prendre des initiatives et construire des choses qui n'existent pas encore. Et tu as le goût de convaincre : face à un(e) candidat(e), tu sais raconter le projet DotWorld avec enthousiasme et lui donner envie de nous rejoindre.

Pas besoin d'avoir déjà recruté : si l'humain t'attire et que tu as envie de te construire un vrai socle RH dans une entreprise en pleine croissance, ce poste est fait pour toi.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoindras l'équipe People de DotWorld (4 personnes avec toi), pilotée par Matteo ESCLAPES, notre Head of HR & Finance Ops, qui sera ton manager direct.

Tu travailleras au quotidien avec Noémie NANA GASSA, notre Talent Acquisition Manager, qui t'accompagnera sur tout le volet recrutement, et aux côtés de Lucie POTTIER, notre People & Culture Specialist, en charge de l'administration RH, de l'événementiel et de la culture d'entreprise.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Administration RH et SIRH (Deel)

  • Préparer et suivre les documents RH France : contrats, annexes, avenants, renouvellements

  • Participer à la préparation de la paie et administrer Deel au quotidien (congés, absences, notes de frais)

  • Assurer le suivi administratif des absences, en lien étroit avec ton manager

  • Répondre aux demandes des collaborateur(rice)s et travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe Finance pour garantir la fiabilité des données

Recrutement et expérience candidat

  • Mener les entretiens RH : présenter le poste, comprendre la motivation et la posture des candidat(e)s

  • Être l'ambassadeur(rice) de DotWorld : pitcher notre projet, répondre aux questions, lever les doutes et donner envie aux meilleur(e)s de nous rejoindre

  • Veiller à ce que chaque candidat(e) vive une expérience fluide et reçoive une réponse, quelle que soit l'issue

Onboarding et expérience collaborateur

  • Coordonner le pré-onboarding et l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues : séquences Deel, kits d'accueil, parcours des premiers jours

  • Soigner chaque point de contact pour qu'il reflète la culture DotWorld

Office management

  • Gérer le cycle de vie du matériel collaborateur : réception des ordinateurs, accès et mots de passe (1Password), récupération en fin de collaboration

  • Maintenir la mailing list et les outils collaboratifs internes

  • Faire le lien avec nos partenaires externes (Deel, espaces de travail partenaires)

Amélioration continue

  • Repérer ce qui peut être simplifié, proposer des idées et les mettre en place : automatisation, IA, documentation de nos process RH

  • Tester, mesurer, itérer : ici, une bonne idée ne reste pas sur le papier

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • Séniorité : Junior - de 0 à 2 ans d'expérience (stages et alternances compris)

  • Une première expérience dans les ressources humaines, le recrutement, l'administration ou la communication (stage alternance)

  • Une expérience au contact de clients, de candidat(e)s ou dans un rôle commercial est un vrai plus

Compétences techniques

  • Curiosité pour les outils numériques (Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) et envie de prendre en main un SIRH et un ATS

  • Curiosité pour les outils IA et l'automatisation

  • Aisance rédactionnelle : tu écris de façon claire et soignée

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Appétence pour l'humain et sens du service, côté candidat(e)s comme côté collaborateur(rice)s

  • Envie d'apprendre, curiosité et capacité à monter vite en compétences sur des sujets nouveaux

  • Esprit entrepreneurial : tu es proactif(ve), tu prends des initiatives et tu aimes construire

  • Fibre commerciale : tu aimes convaincre, tu sais présenter un projet avec conviction et embarquer ton interlocuteur(rice)

  • Rigueur et fiabilité, notamment sur les données administratives

  • Discrétion et sens de la confidentialité

  • Autonomie en full remote, avec une vraie culture de l'écrit

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais niveau B2 minimum - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

✅ Les avantages du poste

  • Un vrai tremplin RH à 360° : administration, SIRH, paie, onboarding et recrutement, pour construire un socle complet dès le début de ta carrière

  • Un accompagnement au quotidien par une équipe People expérimentée

  • Du concret dès les premières semaines, et la liberté de proposer et de mettre en place tes idées

  • Des profils variés à rencontrer (Tech, Produit, Data, Growth, Finance...) dans une entreprise qui lance de nouveaux produits

  • Des outils modernes (Teamtailor, Deel, Notion, Slack) et de la place pour automatiser et tester l'IA (Claude notamment)

👣 Les défis du poste

  • Jongler avec des sujets variés dans une même journée (un entretien, une saisie Deel, un onboarding) : l'organisation et la priorisation deviendront vite tes meilleures alliées

  • Monter rapidement en compétences sur des sujets RH nouveaux, avec l'accompagnement de l'équipe

  • Respecter des échéances fixes, comme la paie mensuelle ou l'arrivée des nouvelles recrues

  • Évoluer dans un environnement multi-entités et multi-statuts (CDI, freelances, EOR)

  • Trouver ta place en full remote, en allant chercher l'information et en posant les bonnes questions

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Mise en situation avec notre Head of HR & Finance Ops, Matteo, et notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 1h

  • Entretien culturel avec notre CPOO, Leandra - 1h

  • 1 prise de référence avec un(e) ancien(ne) manager ou tuteur(rice)

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ? Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.

🌴 Vacances sur mesure Prends les congés dont tu as besoin pour te ressourcer. On te fait confiance pour gérer ton temps libre.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

☕ Budget coworking Si tu préfères bosser hors de chez toi, on prend en charge ton espace de coworking à hauteur de 200 euros par mois pour plus de confort et de focus.

🖥️ Budget équipement On te donne un budget pour t'équiper avec tout ce qu'il te faut : ordinateur portable, bureau, chaise, écran, casque… tout pour être au top !

🥳 2 séminaires par an Deux fois par an, on se retrouve en équipe pour des moments inspirants et fun : un au printemps et un à l'automne.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE "Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP "Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY "We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

Video Editing & Content Creation

jobs.description:
About Us

At Pinpoint Global, we build training and compliance platforms that organizations rely on to keep their teams skilled, certified, and audit-ready. We're part of the Valsoft Edelweiss Software Group — a large-scale portfolio of vertical market B2B SaaS companies — and we operate with a startup mindset: high ownership, high velocity, and real ROI.

Our core stack is ASP.NET MVC + MS SQL — battle-tested and ready to evolve. We're looking for true builders: engineers who orchestrate systems, ship production-grade AI, and modernize massive legacy codebases at speed.

The Role

You'll embed directly in our engineering team, working hands-on inside our .NET codebase and broader product suite. Your mission is to act as an organizational force multiplier — turning legacy inefficiencies into intelligent systems, increasing Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and driving measurable business impact through production-grade AI.

This is a full-stack role with direct product impact. If you enjoy owning problems end-to-end, have a relentless bias toward action, and thrive on shipping real systems at high velocity — this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Build & Ship AI Systems

  • Integrate AI capabilities (LLM APIs, intelligent automation, personalization) into our ASP.NET MVC products
  • Design, develop, and deploy production-grade, secure AI systems using scalable polyglot microservices
  • Integrate enterprise LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) into SaaS platforms via fault-tolerant API routing gateways
  • Develop autonomous multi-agent workflows using parallel orchestration tools (Claude Code CLI, OpenAI Codex)
  • Build new product surfaces — smart content recommendations, automated compliance tracking, AI-assisted reporting
  • Rapidly prototype → validate via adversarial testing → deploy → iterate

Architect AI Infrastructure

  • Implement complex RAG pipelines and optimize trade-offs between massive-context hydration and multi-stage semantic retrieval
  • Build vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and manage persistent document embedding queues
  • Build polyglot microservices handling long-running tasks and streaming via WebSockets and Server-Sent Events
  • Ensure SOC 2 compliance, data residency controls, and deterministic execution through policy-as-code agentic governance
  • Deploy and scale models within secure managed cloud boundaries

Modernize & Collaborate

  • Identify high-impact modernization opportunities across our training and compliance platform
  • Help migrate legacy features into scalable, AI-native architectures using agentic swarm coding and automated refactoring
  • Architect zero-touch CI/CD pipelines with adversarial gating and AI-driven test automation
  • Integrate synthetic red teaming into CI/CD to prevent prompt drift, reward hacking, and logic degradation
  • Work directly with non-technical stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable AI solutions
  • Collaborate with product and design to ship features end-to-end

Required Technical Skills

Core Engineering

  • 3–5+ years of enterprise software development experience with strong full-stack web fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with .NET / ASP.NET MVC (our core stack) and C#
  • Fluency across popular languages and frameworks: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, NextJS
  • Solid understanding of relational databases — MS SQL experience a plus
  • Backend experience designing polyglot APIs, decoupled async microservices, and persistent connection protocols (WebSockets/SSE)
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and multi-region cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

AI & ML Systems

  • Practical experience integrating AI/ML APIs or building AI-powered features in production
  • Enterprise LLM integration and dynamic API routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
  • Multi-agent orchestration and advanced CLI tooling (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex)

  • RAG pipeline design: dynamic chunking, vector databases, embedding management

MLOps & Process Automation

  • Zero-touch CI/CD pipelines and advanced Git workflows (including worktree isolation for autonomous sub-agents)
  • Unit test and benchmark automation integrated with AI-driven testing frameworks
  • Adversarial LLM testing and automated synthetic red-teaming
  • Hallucination mitigation, enterprise guardrails, and deterministic policy-as-code execution
  • Real-time token/credit consumption tracking and dynamic access limit monitoring

Bonus Points

  • Experience with prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
  • Familiarity with refactoring or re-architecting legacy .NET applications
  • Background in regulated industries: HR tech, e-learning, compliance, LMS platforms
  • Knowledge of SOC 2 audit requirements and compliance automation tooling

Who You Are

  • Highly hands-on — you ship, not just design; you operate at velocity by orchestrating autonomous tools
  • Entrepreneurial startup mindset — you spot legacy inefficiencies and act with a bias toward rapid action
  • Comfortable with ambiguity — you scope, own, and deliver independently
  • Business-oriented — you care about ROI, operational leverage, and financial metrics like NRR and CAC
  • Strong product instincts — you think about the user, not just the implementation
  • Fast learner — you track real-time shifts in AI ecosystems, APIs, and infrastructure
  • Pragmatic — you use the right secure enterprise tool for the bottleneck, not just the flashiest one

Tech Stack

ASP.NET MVC · C# · MS SQL · Python · TypeScript · LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) · RAG / Vector DBs · Docker · Kubernetes · Azure / AWS / GCP · REST APIs · WebSockets · HTML/CSS/JS

Why Join

  • Shape the AI strategy of a growing compliance and training platform
  • Own meaningful features from day one — not just tickets in a backlog
  • Real modernization challenge: legacy codebase + greenfield AI opportunity in parallel
  • Collaborative, low-ego team that ships and iterates fast
  • Startup velocity inside an established, well-resourced corporate portfolio

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You'll Own

  • Build AI-powered workflows, assistants, agents and automation systems.

  • Apply AI across customer support, CRM, onboarding, claims, renewals, payments, operations and internal tools.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to turn manual processes into scalable AI-native systems.

  • Build integrations with LLMs, internal data, APIs, documents, knowledge bases and business systems.

  • Design evaluation, monitoring and fallback flows so AI outputs are useful, safe and reliable.

  • Prototype quickly, test with users or operators, then productionize what works.

  • Improve speed, quality and consistency across workflows using AI where it creates real business value.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering foundation, preferably with Python and backend systems.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, RAG, workflow automation or AI tools.

  • Able to connect AI systems with real product, data and operational workflows.

  • Good judgement on where AI helps and where rule-based systems or human review are better.

  • Understands evaluation, accuracy, latency, cost, privacy and failure modes.

  • Fast builder who can prototype, test and ship practical systems.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, support automation, CRM or operations automation is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Practical AI builder, not just a prompt experimenter.

  • Thinks in workflows, systems and measurable quality.

  • Can build quickly but still cares about guardrails and reliability.

  • Comfortable working with messy real-world data and processes.

  • Honest about what AI can and cannot do.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

  • Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.excerpt: As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes.
jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

Your Role and Impact:

  • Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.

  • Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.

  • Value Articulation: Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.

  • Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.

  • Technical Credibility: Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.

  • Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.

  • Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

This Role is a Fit for You If:

  • Proven Post-Sales Experience: You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.

  • Technical Credibility: You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources.

  • Stakeholder Range: You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.

  • Structured and Proactive: You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.

  • Commercial Awareness: You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

Bonus Points For:

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale.

  • Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector -- where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.

  • Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.

  • Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.
