We're building the future of advertising, where every signal becomes intelligence and every optimization drives performance. As we continue to grow globally, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to work with cutting-edge AI technology, solve complex challenges, and help redefine what's possible in modern advertising.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Product Engineering team, reporting to the Engineering Manager (Bi Yoo). This role is responsible for building and maintaining the web applications that power our advertising platform, including the Cool AI campaign management system, billing and invoicing module, and advertiser-facing dashboards. The Full-Stack Engineer will work across our frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Java/Spring Boot) stack, delivering features end-to-end from database schema design through API development to polished UI implementation.

Challenges and Opportunities

This role spans the full product surface of a growing ad tech platform. You'll build features that advertisers interact with daily — campaign creation and launch workflows, real-time performance dashboards, multi-platform account

integrations (Google Ads, Meta, Adform), and automated billing systems. There is significant opportunity to shape product architecture as we scale to support new advertising channels, expand our AI-driven campaign optimization, and

onboard enterprise clients with complex billing and permissions requirements.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and implement full-stack features across React (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite) and Spring Boot (Java 17, PostgreSQL) codebases

  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs with proper authentication, authorization (role-based access control), and input validation

  • Design and evolve PostgreSQL database schemas using Flyway migrations, including JSONB modeling for flexible domain objects

  • Develop responsive, accessible UI components following existing design patterns and component libraries

  • Integrate with third-party advertising platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta Marketing API, Adform) for account management and data synchronization

  • Implement and maintain OAuth flows for external platform connections

  • Build complex business logic including billing calculations, invoice generation, and payment processing workflows

  • Write efficient database queries and optimize application performance for large datasets

  • Collaborate with the data engineering team on Snowflake integrations for analytics and reporting features

  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and maintaining code quality standards

  • Troubleshoot production issues across the full stack using AWS CloudWatch logs and application monitoring

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline maintenance and deployment processes

Qualifications

Professional Competencies

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience in full-stack web development

  • Strong proficiency in Java (11+) and Spring Boot, including Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and RESTful API design

  • Strong proficiency in React (16+) with TypeScript, including hooks, state management, and modern component patterns

  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and migrations

  • Experience with CSS frameworks (Tailwind CSS preferred) and building responsive layouts

  • Familiarity with cloud services, particularly AWS (S3, SES, Lambda, ECS, CloudWatch)

  • Experience integrating with third-party REST APIs and OAuth 2.0 authentication flows

  • Understanding of Git workflows, pull request processes, and collaborative development practices

  • Ability to independently own features from technical design through deployment

  • Strong debugging skills across frontend and backend, including browser DevTools and server-side logging

Cultural Competencies

  • Must be able to work primarily between the hours of 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM ET

  • Must have a player/coach mentality, willing to both execute and lead

  • Ability to juggle multiple projects concurrently and set and meet deadlines

  • Skilled at receiving and providing direct feedback

  • Collaborative mindset and great teamwork skills

  • Entrepreneurial & adaptable; great learning skills

  • Curious, research-minded, data-informed

  • Able to search for possible solutions and apply them

  • Creative confidence

  • Proactive communicator

  • A sense of humor and a love of online culture

Overview

The Accounts Receivables Insurance Specialist 1 manages the accounts receivable in accordance with compliance, regulatory and billing guidelines and specific payer rules. Responsible for collection of outstanding receivables through payer portals and/or phone lines. Responsible for the accurate billing of insurance claims by validating coverage, resolving charge review edits, claim edits and front-end clearinghouse and payer rejections. In addition, follows up on outstanding receivables; completes basic appeals; answers, documents and completes inquiries from, insurance companies, internal departments, and 3rd party payers. Works collaboratively with other departments such as Billing, Coding, Cash Posting, etc. to ensure claims are processed/paid correctly.

Responsibilities

Ability to take initiative but also accept direction and seek guidance appropriately. Ability to manage confidential information with sensitivity and discretion (in a HIPAA-compliant way). Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Timely and accurate claims submissions to health insurance carriers for community, government and commercial health plans as assigned, in the form of electronic and paper billing. Timely and accurate submissions of non-complex reconsiderations and/or appeals to health insurance carriers for community, government and commercial health plans as assigned, via paper, fax or web portal. Monitoring, researching, and resolving unpaid, rejected, denied and/or allowance discrepancy claims. Responsible for all aspects of account follow up and collections, as assigned. Ability to analyze accounts and determine the next appropriate action for account resolution. Accurately and thoroughly document the pertinent collection activities in the billing system. Determines and initiates appropriate action to resolve denied and/or rejected invoices, or invoices in allowance discrepancy and prepares payer corrections and/or appeals in accordance with payer plan requirements using electronic and paper processes. Utilizes clinical applications, payer websites and other systems as a research tool to retrieve medical documentation, patient eligibility information, billing guidelines, patient referrals, and hospital or procedure code authorizations to substantiate corrected claims submissions, through written appeals, and coding reviews, etc. Review account level undistributed payments for application to open balances as it applies to assigned payer(s). Reviews and resolves incoming correspondence. Identifies, prepares and appropriately requests adjustments. Responds to inquiries from patients, insurance companies, public agencies, internal departments and 3rd party payers. Identifies and resolves insurance set up errors to facilitate timely billing. Resolves charge review edits, claim edits and clearinghouse and payer rejections to facilitate accurate billing, as assigned. Evaluates Credit/Balance accounts and performs appropriate action to resolve, including but not limited to sending refunds and/or initiating payer recoupments via web portal. Evaluates accounts in an allowance discrepancy status against system loaded contract. Meticulously prepares appeals for appropriate reimbursement from payers. May prepare adjusted and corrected bills, adjust accounts receivable entries, or prepare refunds in accordance with existing operating procedures. jobs.title: CGI Automotive Artist (3Ds Max & V-Ray)
jobs.excerpt: INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands.
jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 10+ years of experience in a technology consulting and/or customer-facing technology implementation role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Exceptional executive stakeholder management and communications, emotional intelligence, and prioritization given internal visibility of this role to all levels of the organization, including Samsara’s C-suite.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$109,480—$165,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position

The Opportunity

AAPC seeks a hands-on lead software engineer to help build and evolve the customer-facing digital products, e-commerce experiences, and marketing technology that take people from discovery through membership, certification, and renewal. Our Marketing team relies on capable platforms, including HubSpot, Contentful, RudderStack, and our CRM. The opportunity now is to connect them with a clear integration strategy, so data flows reliably into a holistic view of our members and customers, and Marketing has the insight it needs to do its best work.

This role is for someone who can see the whole forest and still build what is needed. We default to buying proven platforms and integrating them well, and you know how to work inside those systems as designed. But purchased tools are only part of the picture. Some needs call for custom software: customer-facing applications, e-commerce and member experiences, services, APIs, and event pipelines that fill gaps between platforms and carry logic unique to AAPC. When building is the right call, you design, deliver, and support that software to the same standard as any production system: well-tested, secure, observable, and maintainable.

You will not do this alone. You will work closely with our platform engineering team, understanding and contributing to the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that everything you build runs on. You will also partner with our data platform team to ensure member and customer data, including the identifiers and events needed to connect identities across systems, arrives complete, consistent, and ready to use.

Modern tooling has fundamentally changed what an exceptional engineer can accomplish. In this role, you will treat AI as an extension of your engineering team. By leveraging agentic coding tools, reusable skills, agentic engineering practices, established components, and internal frameworks, you will orchestrate work that historically required a much larger team. You will bring the same thinking to Marketing itself, building AI-enabled tools and workflows that make marketers more self-sufficient.

This is primarily a hands-on engineering role. You will serve as the technical lead for our Marketing Technology team, helping set standards and supporting a team with strong front-end and CMS skills as they grow into well-rounded engineers across integration and data work, automated testing and observability, and agentic engineering practices. From time to time, you will also step into interim team leadership to keep work moving.

What You’ll Do

  • Help define the integration strategy and target architecture for AAPC’s marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Contentful, RudderStack, our CRM, and the other systems Marketing depends on.

  • Design, build, and operate custom services, APIs, and customer-facing applications, including e-commerce and member experiences for both anonymous visitors and logged-in members, where purchased platforms fall short. Support them in production after launch, held to the same standards as the rest of our production software.

  • Build and maintain the integrations, adapters, and CMS components that connect our platforms and let Marketing self-serve routine changes, with loose coupling, well-defined data contracts, and security built in.

  • Partner with our data platform and platform engineering teams to get member, customer, and engagement data flowing reliably into our data platform, including the events, identifiers, and consent data needed to connect identities across web, email, CRM, and commerce, so Marketing has a trustworthy, holistic view of the people we serve.

  • Translate our search and AI-visibility strategy (SEO, GEO, and AEO) into technical capabilities, such as structured data, machine-readable content, metadata architecture, and crawler-friendly application patterns, so people and AI agents can find and understand what we offer.

  • Recommend when to build, buy, integrate, or retire. Reduce our technology footprint by consolidating overlapping tools and moving one-off solutions onto trusted, supported platforms.

  • Partner with our platform engineering team to meet the platform’s infrastructure, deployment, and observability standards, so the software and integrations you build run on our cloud infrastructure with the same monitoring and incident response as the rest of our platform.

  • Go beyond system health to behavioral observability: confirm that critical customer journeys, authentication, integrations, GA4 measurement, consent behavior, and e-commerce flows still work correctly after every release, so engineering catches and owns problems rather than customers discovering them.

  • Contribute to our shared engineering lifecycle: build automated test coverage into your work, use and strengthen the quality gates in platform engineering’s CI/CD pipelines, and verify releases across application boundaries.

  • Own delivery of the software you build, from discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, support, and continuous improvement.

  • Work directly with Marketing to understand the business question behind each request, translate it into technical direction, and push back when a request does not serve the strategy.

  • Serve as technical lead for the Marketing Technology team: help set standards, review designs and code, document architectural decisions, and mentor engineers in integration, data, testing, observability, and agentic practices.

  • Build AI-enabled capabilities for Marketing, such as segmentation, personalization, and workflow automation, with appropriate guardrails for data quality and privacy.

  • Treat consent, privacy, and responsible handling of personal data as design requirements from the start.

  • Create and improve reusable skills, components, frameworks, workflows, and automation that increase the effectiveness of future engineering work.

  • Measure success by marketing and business outcomes, not by the number of stories completed or the amount of code produced.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a recent record of writing and shipping production code yourself, including senior or lead-level ownership of systems that span multiple platforms and teams.

  • Experience designing, building, and operating production customer-facing web applications and digital products, ideally including e-commerce or member experiences.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: you have designed, built, tested, and operated custom services in production, not only configured or connected third-party tools.

  • A track record of designing loosely coupled, distributed systems with well-defined data models and contracts.

  • Hands-on experience integrating marketing and customer platforms, such as marketing automation, CRM, CMS, CDP, and commerce, through their APIs, webhooks, events, and native extension points. This is critical domain experience for the role.

  • Experience building customer data foundations alongside data and platform teams: event tracking, identity resolution inputs, pipelines into a warehouse or data platform, and the data quality practices that keep them trustworthy.

  • Strong judgment about when to configure, integrate, or build, and the discipline to choose the simplest path that will hold up over time.

  • Practical experience deploying and running software on cloud infrastructure, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, monitoring, and production support.

  • Experience using agentic coding tools in your daily work, and the ability to direct, evaluate, and integrate AI-generated work while retaining full accountability for its correctness and quality.

  • Fluency in marketing concepts such as funnels, lead lifecycle, attribution, segmentation, and campaign operations, and the ability to talk with marketers in their terms.

  • Experience leading technically: setting direction, mentoring engineers, and influencing stakeholders who do not report to you.

  • Working knowledge of privacy and consent requirements, such as CCPA, CAN-SPAM, and consent management, as they apply to marketing data.

  • Clear, concise communication, especially when raising questions, explaining tradeoffs, or pushing back on a request.

  • The initiative to improve the systems and processes around you rather than repeatedly working around the same problems.

Preferred Experience

  • HubSpot, including data synchronization between marketing automation and CRM platforms.

  • Contentful or another headless CMS, including content modeling, component development, and integrations.

  • RudderStack or another customer data platform, including event-tracking design and identity resolution.

  • Leading a marketing technology modernization or platform consolidation without disrupting live campaigns.

We value demonstrated capability, judgment, and personal drive. This role calls for someone who has seen marketing technology done well and done poorly, has the scars to show for it, and can use that experience to help a team move quickly and deliberately. We will level this role based on demonstrated capability, from senior through principal.

Show Us What Drives You

We want to know what you chose to build, not just what an employer assigned to you. We encourage you to share something that demonstrates your curiosity, initiative, and passion for the craft. The subject matter does not need to align with AAPC’s products. We are interested in what you chose to learn, the problems you encountered, the decisions you made, and whether you cared enough to bring the idea to life. If you have an integration, data, or marketing technology story you are proud of, or one that taught you a hard lesson, we would love to hear it.


AAPC (www.aapc.com) is the world’s largest and fastest-growing healthcare training, certification, and solutions association.

AAPC Values:

DRIVEN | Self-starts and stays highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals. Shares contagious energy and enthusiasm liberally. Takes initiative without always being directed. Demonstrates confidence in decision-making and effectively balances autonomy and authority with accountability.

HUMBLE | Learns, adapts, and improves relentlessly. Seeks feedback without insecurity and implements coaching. Recognizes others' contributions gratefully. Approaches work and relationships with an abundance mentality. Places the needs of others above self.

TRANSPARENT| Integrity-centered, honest, truthful, and trustworthy in all aspects of work. Keeps commitments to external and internal parties. Holds self strictly accountable, valuing the trust placed in them by others.

SUPPORTIVE | Empowers and uplifts others. Listens actively and responds with empathy and understanding. Prioritizes well-being and growth of team members and customers ahead of own interest. Faces challenges together, believing in collective strength and unity.

INNOVATIVE | Entrepreneurial spirit with a scrappy mentality. Dreams big, sees opportunity, pursues full potential, and finds ways to accomplish the impossible. Rolls up sleeves and does real work. Works quickly, intelligently, and flexibly.

What we Offer:
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account
  • Generous PTO and Holiday Pay
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Remote/virtual-office consideration

Our focus is on finding the best person for each role, based on merit and fit, to ensure success both for our company and for the individual's professional growth.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT COVERTSWARMOur goal is simple: We aim to compromise our clients, constantly.
jobs.description:
ABOUT COVERTSWARM

Our goal is simple: We aim to compromise our clients, constantly. Our Hives – a specialist team – 'swarm' around our targets, always looking for a new way to compromise them. As a result, we provide security insights and advice based upon our client's technological controls and mitigating solutions, and propose improvements that can be made from a training, process, and physical control perspective. We are looking for 2 new Academy Hive Members to join our growing international team from October/November.

THE ROLE

Open to all applicants over the age of 18, this fully paid 12-month programme will see you integrated into the dynamic world of red team operations as a CovertSwarm Hive member, through mentorship, industry-recognised qualifications, and specialisation in areas of interest. We are looking for 3 new Academy candidates to join us for our October/November intake.

As an Academy Hive Member, your primary focus will be on rapidly developing the skills and techniques that make a great ethical hacker. This includes soft skills such as project management, client communications and teamwork, as well as core technical skills such as:

- OSINT and Reconnaissance

- External Perimeter

- Web Applications

- Internal Infrastructure

  • Social Engineering - Phishing, Vishing and Physical

The 12-month programme is structured across four phases, with increasing client-facing responsibility as your capability grows. The first two months are internal-only, focused on operational grounding and reporting standards before you touch a client environment. From month three onward, you'll move through supervised delivery, growing ownership, and independent readiness – with promotion to full Hive member, the target by month 13.

Each Academy Member is supported by a shared mentor pool of domain specialists, a coach focused on your professional development, and a peer buddy to help you find your feet in the Hive culture.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As this is an entry level position, with the aim of training you to become Hive Members, you will share responsibilities with the Hive Members themselves, supporting them on day to day operations wherever possible.

  • Act as a business contact for CovertSwarm clients, fostering and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders and business partners. Ensuring client communication throughout the engagement and contract.
  • Perform cyber security assessment activities against complex networks, applications, operating systems, wired/wireless networks, and mobile applications/devices.
  • Develop and maintain attack plans bespoke to each client to replicate an Advanced Persistent Threat (APT).
  • Create high quality actionable, threat-based, reports on security assessment results, which the client is debriefed on fully following the completion of any assessments.
  • Consult with application developers, systems administrators, and management to demonstrate security assessment results, explain the threat presented by the results, and consult on remediation.
  • Communicate security issues to a wide variety of internal and external "customers" which will include technical teams, executives, risk groups, vendors, and regulators.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

If you have a curious mindset, like problem solving, and are passionate about Cyber Security, we want to hear from you. We seek people with proven passion – not just an interest in the field, but a track record of going further. That might look like:

  • A history of self-directed technical study outside of formal education
  • Personal labs, coding projects, or contributions to security research
  • Completion of entry-level certifications or platform challenges prior to applying, would be advantageous and demonstrate your passion
  • A clear starting direction within offensive security – showing you see this as a vocation, not just an opportunity

Experience with learning platforms such as HackTheBox and TryHackMe is preferred but not a strict requirement.

BENEFITS

Aside from working with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry we can also offer you:

  • A fully remote (working from home – 'anywhere in the world') role with only the need to travel to client sites when in-person meetings are required, or we are running our quarterly meetups.
  • A culture born of vulnerability research. Reporting missing HTTP headers and SSL/TLS weaknesses, and outdated software patch versions is just 'noise' in our view. We focus on the actual point of compromise and continually look for new ways to breach our clients.
  • Work when you want – That does not have to be a 9-5, but we ask that the job is done well, and core meetings are attended online.
  • We go to DEF CON, every year (well, when it is not cancelled!)
  • Software, hardware, and research materials are not bound by strict limits. If you need a resource to deliver to the best of your ability, we will aim to accommodate this.
  • Unlimited Training – If it is relevant and will help you, your Hive team, and CovertSwarm to better breach and educate our clients, then you can do whatever training you need to fulfil this.
  • Unlimited Holiday – We all need downtime, take it, whenever you need it. There are no prizes for burnout. You work to live, not live to work.

- Private Medical Insurance.

- Company Pension.

  • Access to our Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme (UK residents only).
  • If you present at a major infosec event/hacker conference, then we will pay your expenses and give you a bonus to reflect this. We want to give back to this great community that continues to help us all.
  • No corporate politics – The continued growth of CovertSwarm as a business, the team, and the quality of our services depends upon us being radically candid with one another. Always.

We pay good salaries, have a brilliant culture, and some of our Board are hackers, too! However, if you are just chasing the biggest pay packet, or are driven by your ego, then we are not for you, and you are not for us.

Salary: up to £30,000 dependant on skills and experience

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Contract Recruiter for a 3-month engagement to own full-cycle hiring across Scale Media and our brands: Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements. You'll partner directly with hiring managers to fill open roles across growth and marketing, analytics, and other areas of the business, running each search from intake through accepted offer.

This is a hands-on, high-volume role with a defined timeline. You'll need to ramp quickly, build pipelines from day one, and close hires within the engagement window.

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Manage multiple open requisitions at once, from kickoff to offer acceptance.
  • Run intake meetings with hiring managers to define the role, the must-haves, and a realistic profile for the market.
  • Conduct first-round screens that assess both capability and fit with a fully remote, high-ownership team.

Sourcing & Pipeline Building

  • Proactively source passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, communities, and competitor mapping, rather than relying on inbound applicants.
  • Build target lists from DTC, CPG, supplement, and wellness companies for hard-to-fill roles.
  • Write job postings and outreach that are specific and compelling, not generic.

Process & Coordination

  • Keep candidates moving through structured interview panels, and make sure each interviewer knows what they are assessing.
  • Own JazzHR hygiene so every req has accurate status, notes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate scheduling, take-home assessments, and debriefs so the team reaches a decision quickly.

Offers & Closing

  • Manage compensation conversations, extend offers, and close candidates within approved bands.
  • Spot and address candidate concerns early so offers don't fall apart at the finish line.

Hiring Manager Partnership & Reporting

  • Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers on market conditions, candidate calibration, and process.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and source effectiveness, and suggest improvements based on what the data shows.

What You Bring

  • At least 3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including contract or interim roles where you were expected to deliver hires on a set timeline.
  • A proven track record of sourcing and closing candidates across multiple functions at the same time.
  • Comfort with recruiting tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and a modern ATS (JazzHR or similar).
  • Strong written communication skills, from outreach to job descriptions to hiring manager updates.
  • Sound judgment on candidate quality, and the confidence to push back on hiring managers when needed.
  • Strong backgrounds include: in-house recruiters at DTC, eCommerce, or consumer brands; agency recruiters who have moved to (or want to move to) in-house roles; and talent coordinators or sourcers ready to own full-cycle searches.

What Makes You a Fit

  • Hits the Ground Running: You can take over open reqs in your first week and produce qualified pipeline without a long ramp-up.
  • High Ownership: You treat every open req as your own problem to solve, not a ticket in a queue.
  • Fast-Paced and Remote-Ready: You do well in a fully remote, fast-paced environment and keep things moving without being micromanaged.
  • Candidate-First: You know a good candidate experience is part of how we win talent, and you run your process accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: You're equally comfortable recruiting a performance marketer, a supply chain lead, and a data analyst.

Preferred, But Not Required

  • Experience recruiting for supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription brands.
  • Experience hiring for growth and marketing roles in a DTC environment.
  • Experience recruiting for a fully remote team.

Reporting Structure

You will report directly to our Associate Director, HR.

  • Fully remote, full-time, 3-month W-2 contract position

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Senior Project Manager accountable for managing multiple Cogstate projects overseeing the delivery of Cogstate Services. The Senior Project Manager will have experience with the pharmaceutical development process, a special aptitude and interest in scientific and technical information, an ability to motivate and mentor project and portfolio teams, and be a highly driven individual who demonstrates initiative and delivers against tight timelines in an agile environment. The Senior Project Manager will have demonstrated experience managing a full workload of clinical projects and/or internal development projects, and a growing awareness of information technology concepts and terminology and experience with direct and indirect people management. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will have confidence and composure in handling stressful situations, problem solving and communicating calmly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders, particularly in areas of disagreement.

This role will require extensive communication and interactions across multiple time zones with staff, Sponsors and clinical sites in countries all over the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage projects and execute tasks in line with company SOPs and agreed regulatory standards, including the following tasks:
  • Manage client relationships as main POC for individual studies and some sponsor portfolios.
    • Independently lead Cogstate’s complex global clinical trials projects – including implementation of projects with new service offerings in scope, where feedback is necessary to the development and commercialization teams to improve process.
  • Manage Clinical Trials projects in Start-Up, Conduct or Close-Out phases (multiple projects at one time).
    • Proactively manage risks with confidence, demonstrating strong leadership in guiding team members through challenges and making decisive, well-informed decisions.
  • Attending Investigator Meetings (as needed) and ensuring Cogstate is well represented.
  • Work in an Agile environment with a given Portfolio Team.
    • Oversight of resourcing and financials across a Portfolio of Projects- ensure team members follow pre-determined hours allocated in budget to target gross profit consistently
  • Generate invoices for assigned projects in alignment with expected timelines and project progress. Maintain a strong understanding of the broader impact of invoicing on company financials.
  • Actively maintain the change order process.
  • Oversee internal projects focused on developing processes for implementing new technologies, with the ability to map, visualize, and optimize workflows to support commercialization and scaling efforts
  • Develop operational deployment plans for new systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
  • Work closely with Business Development and project team managing relationship and supporting proposals for key accounts.
  • Potential to line manage or indirectly manage and mentor other project management team members and clinical operations staff in the future.
  • Analyze reports for project hours and budget utilization and making course corrections in conjunction with Operations Line Managers.
  • Forecast invoicing based on expected timeline and progress of the study
  • Ability to review Work Orders and determine deliverables and timelines for project.
  • Ensure accurate reporting to internal and external stakeholders on service delivery and progress.
  • People/Staff management: Demonstrate high performance in mentoring other project management team members and clinical staff.
  • Develop/contribute to playbooks for new Sponsors/Partners/systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
  • Participate in internal and external audits and inspections.
  • Support metrics reporting to sponsors.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, business or a technical discipline (psychology, nursing, biology, sociology, computer science or engineering). Master’s preferred (science or business) but not mandatory.
  • PMP Certification (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Previous CRO experience preferable.
  • Previous CNS experience.
  • 7+ Years Project Management experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or CRO environment.
  • Supervisory/mentoring experience (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Relationship Management Experience.
  • Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Budget management experience

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Bonus Scheme: This position is eligible to participate in Cogstate’s annual incentive program, with a target bonus opportunity of 10% of base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.
  • Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
  • 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate’s 401k program.
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
  • Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
  • Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
  • Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.
Wage Range
$125,000—$135,000 USD

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.title: Technical Routing Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
jobs.description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader in the $100B+ CPaaS market. Customers including Airbnb, Snapchat, and thousands of enterprises depend on our APIs and SDKs to deliver SMS, voice, and messaging at scale. The Technical Routing & Quality team sits at the heart of this — owning the configuration and performance of every message and call that traverses the Vonage network.

Why This Role Matters

Every OTP SMS, enterprise marketing message, and API-triggered communication travels through routing groups owned and maintained by this team. As a Technical Routing Analyst, you will own the day-to-day quality and cost performance of global SMS and voice routing, ensuring traffic is delivered reliably, efficiently, and at the best possible margin.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and respond to quality alerts (SMSCR, DLR Success Ratio, Rejected/Undelivered, Queue, Bind-down) via Zendesk and Tableau, following established investigation processes
  • Provide 24x5 follow-the-sun routing assurance coverage in rotation with regional peers
  • Perform proactive quality assurance across SMS and voice destinations — identifying degraded suppliers and initiating route changes
  • Manage country-level routing: evaluate supplier performance against cost and quality targets and implement tiered routing decisions
  • Onboard and test new supplier connections (SMPP/MM4/MM7 protocols) in coordination with Connectivity Operations
  • Identify and escalate carrier degradations, encoding errors, and throughput issues, coordinating resolution with CORT and suppliers
  • Contribute to automation initiatives that improve supplier onboarding times, cost management, and quality alerting
  • Participate in regional handover processes and maintain clear handover notes for the next-shift team
  • Support the migration of SMS services from IBM Data Centres to AWS

What You Will Bring

  • Solid understanding of SMS routing fundamentals — SMPP protocol, DLR codes, encoding, conversion rates, and delivery ratio metrics
  • Experience working with carrier or telco routing systems and monitoring tools (e.g. Tableau, Zendesk, or equivalent)
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate degradation patterns, cross-reference data sources, and drive root-cause resolution
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24x5 operational environment with on-call responsibilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate clearly across time zones with suppliers and internal stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with carrier, product, and engineering teams

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with voice routing metrics (ASR, NER, MOS, PDD) and SIP fundamentals
  • Experience with ML-driven or algorithmic routing systems
  • Knowledge of RCS, Network APIs, or US direct carrier connectivity
  • Background in a CPaaS, wholesale telco, or carrier operations environment

About the Team

The Technical Routing & Quality team is focused on three objectives: reducing tech debt, automating the core business, and investing in growth areas such as Network APIs, RCS, and US direct connectivity. We operate a follow-the-sun model and work closely with Carrier Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to deliver best-in-class routing services.

How You Will Benefit

  • Medical Insurance
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Ericsson Care Line
  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

In 2025 alone, our sales exceeded $65M CAD. We are proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified™ for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at Makeship.com.

Some of the internet’s favourite Creators launch their merch with Makeship, and we’re building the team that finds the next ones.

You know which Creators are about to blow up before everyone else does. You have opinions on the latest streamer drama, the indie game everyone’s sleeping on, and whose merch is actually fire. What if you could get paid to be this chronically online?

Our expertise includes governance support for boards and committees, performance evaluations for executives, and design of competitive total compensation . We also advise on executive benefits, pay-for-performance strategies, . Additionally, we provide insights on emerging trends, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and employment agreements to ensure a holistic and compliant approach to executive talent management.

As a Consulting Principal, you will establish and lead multiple executive compensation consulting projects, contributing to all aspects of client engagements, building and nurturing client relationships and providing responsive, thoughtful high-quality client experiences. As Mercury prepares to become a bank, our Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) program is in active development to meet bank-level regulatory expectations. As an early member of a growing TPRM team, you’ll help run the program day-to-day and contribute how it matures, bringing your own judgment and point of view to a function that is usually more rigidly defined, with room to be creative and make your mark.

As a Third Party Risk Manager, you’ll help protect Mercury, our customers, and the broader financial ecosystem from the risks that come with relying on third parties. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Third Party Risk Management, you’ll complete third-party risk assessments, support risk reporting, and provide second-line oversight.

As a Third Party Risk Manager, you will play a key part in helping protect Mercury, our customers, and the broader financial ecosystem from the risks associated with third parties. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Third Party Risk Management, you will conduct third party risk assessments, help build out related risk reporting, and carry out second line oversight activities to help reduce the impact of third-party risks.

This position focuses on enterprise-wide TPRM, rather than in-depth expertise in a specific domain like security or privacy. You will work closely with subject-matter experts across Compliance, Information Security, Privacy, and Procurement to make sure their requirements are reflected in the program, bringing a view across the full third-party lifecycle and the regulatory expectations that come with banking.*

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assess and risk rate: Complete third-party risk assessments, risk rate third parties, and open and track issues through resolution.
  • Second-line oversight: Review and challenge first-line due diligence and ongoing monitoring, including reporting, approvals and oversight of those activities. First-line owners remain accountable for managing the third-party relationship, including SLAs, business reviews, exit strategies and onboarding.
  • Reporting and data: Support maintenance of third party risk reporting and metrics for management and governance forums, and help keep the underlying data accurate.
  • Tooling and automation: Help implement tooling and automation to make processes more efficient
  • Program uplift: Support and contribute to uplift efforts across the TPRM program, including updates to policies, due diligence, risk assessment processes, and risk management across the third party lifecycle

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of third party risk management experience, including 2+ years in a regulated financial services environment (bank, or fintech working with bank partners)
  • Working knowledge of regulatory guidance on third party risk, including the Interagency Guidance on Third Party Relationships (and related FFIEC, OCC and FDIC expectations), and TPRM industry practices across the third party lifecycle (planning, due diligence, contracting, monitoring, termination)
  • Hands-on experience completing third party risk assessments across multiple risk domains, not only security
  • Experience reviewing and challenging first-line risk work with evidence-based pushback
  • Experience supporting audits or exams of a TPRM program (gathering evidence, responding to requests, following up on findings)
  • Experience building or maintaining TPRM reporting and metrics, with attention to data accuracy
  • Solid program and project management skills, with experience supporting a program that spans multiple cross-functional components and driving process improvements through to implementation
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners (Procurement, Finance, InfoSec, Legal, Privacy) without direct authority
  • Clear communicator who can explain a risk position and hold it under pushback

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience at a bank, or a fintech moving toward banking
  • Experience improving or uplifting an existing TPRM program
  • Experience with TPRM tooling, automation or AI-enabled workflows
  • Familiarity with enterprise risk concepts (risk register, risk appetite, committee reporting)
  • Relevant certification (e.g., CISA, CGRC)

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Bluecadet is an award-winning, internationally-recognized experience design agency focused on producing transformative digital products and environments. We work with story and experience-driven organizations and brands. Past clients include The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Nike, MoMA, Harvard, the MIT Museum, Princeton, The Smithsonian Institution, and the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.

We are looking for a Senior Designer who combines exceptional visual craft with thoughtful experience design. Working across digital, physical, and spatial environments, you'll help shape engaging, user-centered experiences from early concepts through production.

We're looking for a versatile creative thinker who can see the big picture while caring deeply about the details. You'll collaborate with designers, technologists, architects, and storytellers to bring compelling ideas to life.

What You Bring

  • Exceptional visual design skills, including typography, layout, composition, UI design, and visual systems.
  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to translate complex ideas into clear, engaging design solutions.
  • Understanding of user-centered design, interaction principles, and experience flows.
  • Ability to think systematically, connecting individual interactions to the larger user or visitor experience.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, and relevant design and prototyping tools.
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies, spatial experiences, and new forms of storytelling.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.
  • An adaptable, self-directed approach to managing multiple priorities and navigating ambiguity.

What You'll Do

  • Develop compelling visual and interactive design solutions across digital, physical, and spatial experiences.
  • Contribute to creative concepts, user journeys, interaction frameworks, and visual systems.
  • Translate ideas into sketches, wireframes, storyboards, prototypes, and polished designs.
  • Lead assigned design workstreams from concept through production, maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to balance creative ambition, user needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Present work, communicate design decisions, and contribute to client conversations.
  • Mentor junior designers and contribute to the studio's creative culture.
  • Explore new approaches, technologies, and design practices that push our work forward.

Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of relevant professional design experience.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, conceptual thinking, and experience with digital or interactive design.
  • Experience collaborating across disciplines and contributing to projects from concept through execution.
  • Degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Experience Design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

We value designers with deep expertise in their craft and curiosity beyond it. Whether your background is in graphic design, interaction design, or spatial experiences, we're interested in how you connect ideas, people, and technology to create meaningful experiences.

We’re remote first

We operate a remote first model. This means your primary work location is remote, but you are expected to work out of our studios or client locations for: Collaboration sessions with client and/or colleagues, internal workshops, mentoring and team sessions, cultural and social events and on-site work installs, meetings and workshops.

Benefits

  • Three PPO medical plans with national provider access no matter where you're based.
  • Basic Life/AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage, all provided at no cost to you.
  • Traditional 401(k)and Roth plans, with a company match on your contributions.
  • Pre-tax Health Care and Dependent Care FSAs, plus a commuter transit account.
  • PTO, along with dedicated Wellness Time with more PTO added throughout tenure
  • 10 paid holidays a year
  • Paid parental leave for all parents after 12 months of employment, including pregnancy-related medical leave and paid bonding leave.

jobs.title: General Manager, Credit Economy
jobs.excerpt: Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI.
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Dataiku is the enterprise AI platform used by 25% of the Fortune 500. Since June 2026, we have priced our new products on credits. The opportunity now is larger: expand credits across the platform, bring partners and a broader set of technologies onto them, and build a real credit economy that gives customers optionality and control over how they use and pay for AI.

How you’ll make an impact

You will be the single-threaded owner of this new business: one revenue number, one plan, and the mandate to get product, engineering, sales, finance, marketing, and partners working to that plan. AI economics are still to be invented, and you will write the playbook for it.

You will report to the CEO and co-founder and work with the CTO and co-founder. You will have no direct reports. Owners in Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and Marketing stay in their teams, are accountable to you for this business, and meet in one recurring forum you run to review pipeline, launches, and blockers and leave with decisions.

You own the strategy for this business: where to play first, how to package and price it, and how fast to grow it. You share responsibility for a number with the sales leadership.

In your first year, you will:

  • Make credits the favorite way customers commit to Dataiku.
  • Build the partner ecosystem around credits: business development with infrastructure and software vendors.
  • Align the company around credits: product strategy and roadmap with the CPO and CTO, so new capabilities are built, packaged, and metered for consumption; the credit story with the CMO; and sales incentives with the CRO.
  • Give customers and account teams usage reporting they act on.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • You have built an enterprise software business on consumption or usage-based pricing, including the billing, revenue recognition, and compensation it required.
  • You know how to build a plan to scale a business from zero to $100M, and you have carried the revenue number for one: a product line, a business unit, a new market, or a company you founded.
  • You get teams working toward one business goal, and you have results to show for it.
  • You build the financial model yourself and can explain the product to a CIO.
  • You decide fast on incomplete information, argue in the open (including with the CEO), and change your position when the data calls for it.
  • You work AI-native. You use models and agents in your own analysis and operations, and you know how AI is priced and bought: tokens, credits, committed spend.
  • You are US-based (or willing to relocate), and ready to travel to customers, partners, and Dataiku offices worldwide.

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.
Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at:
Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity
Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

As a Senior UX Designer, you’ll both lead design and partner with other designers to create AI-powered experiences across CoLab. You’ll help shape how engineers interact with AI, evaluate its recommendations and work alongside agents to accomplish complex tasks.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll bring strong skills across the full design process, from discovery and problem definition to interaction design, visual polish, and implementation with particular depth in designing AI interfaces.

You’ll partner closely with product managers, engineers, and AI specialists to explore what’s possible, define useful applications, and build experiences grounded in customer needs. As a Senior designer, you’ll also guide design direction across squads, mentor other designers, and establish shared patterns for AI interactions throughout CoLab.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re an experienced UX designer with a demonstrated track record of making AI useful to people. You’ve worked beyond demos and prototypes, and you can speak to what happened when real users encountered your designs: what they understood, where they struggled, and how you improved the experience.

You know when conversation is a useful interaction model and when a structured workflow, direct manipulation, or a combination of approaches will serve users better. You think carefully about how people provide context, communicate intent, review results, and stay in control as AI takes on more work.

You’re comfortable designing for uncertainty. You consider incomplete information, incorrect outputs, long-running tasks, and unexpected behavior as part of the core experience. You help users understand what the system is doing, what needs their attention, and how to correct or recover from a mistake.

You also bring the judgment and influence expected of a Senior designer. You help teams navigate ambiguity, connect decisions across product areas, and balance near-term delivery with a coherent longer-term experience. You care deeply about research, interaction quality, accessibility, and visual craft.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead, partner and support UX design for AI-powered products and workflows from discovery through implementation and iteration.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and AI specialists to identify valuable customer problems and shape how AI capabilities address them.
  • Design conversational, contextual, and agent-driven interfaces that help users express intent, provide relevant information, and act on results.
  • Design agent orchestration experiences that make plans, task progress, dependencies, approvals, and handoffs understandable and manageable.
  • Establish clear patterns for human oversight, including reviewing proposed actions, setting boundaries, intervening in execution, and recovering from errors.
  • Help users evaluate AI outputs through appropriate source context, explanations, and visibility into system limitations.
  • Plan and conduct customer discovery, usability testing, and prototype validation, including realistic scenarios where AI outputs are incomplete, incorrect, or unexpected.
  • Create design artifacts across the full fidelity spectrum, from workflow diagrams and wireframes to interactive prototypes and polished interfaces.
  • Partner with engineers throughout implementation and evaluate the resulting experience using customer feedback, product data, and AI performance insights.
  • Contribute shared AI interaction patterns to our design system, align experiences across teams, and mentor other designers

Qualifications

  • Significant product or UX design experience, typically gained through 5+ years of practice, with a track record of leading complex initiatives at a Senior level.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping AI-powered interfaces. Your portfolio should show your contributions, the behavior of the AI system, the interaction decisions you made, and what you learned from real-world use.
  • Substantial experience with one or more of the following: conversational interfaces, LLM-powered workflows, AI assistants, autonomous or semi-autonomous agents, or agent orchestration tools.
  • A practical understanding of how AI behavior affects UX, including variability in outputs, latency, context limitations, and failure modes.
  • Strong UX fundamentals, including information architecture, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, and systems thinking.
  • Fluency in Figma and the ability to build prototypes that communicate dynamic interactions and system behavior.
  • Using AI tools like Claude and Codex to accelerate your design process with code-based prototypes
  • Strong collaboration with technical partners and the ability to make clear trade-offs between user needs, model capabilities, engineering constraints, and business goals.
  • Experience influencing design direction across teams and helping other designers improve their work.

Nice to Have:

  • Education or practical knowledge in machine learning, how LLMs work, or agent architecture.
  • Experience designing controls for agent permissions, action approvals, activity history, or auditability in enterprise environments.
  • Experience collaborating on AI evaluations and connecting measures of model quality with usability, task success, and user trust.
  • Ability to prototype with code, APIs, or AI development tools to explore realistic interactions, potentially submitting your own PRs for simpler collaboration
  • Experience designing for engineering, manufacturing, or other technical domains where accuracy and human judgment matter.

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.
