jobs.title: Gameplay Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories.
jobs.description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Gameplay Engineer, you will craft tactile and immersive gameplay systems that will fuel the adventure and enable the stories within our games. You will partner with designers to understand the vision and intent behind game features, realize those features in Unreal using C++ and Blueprints, and apply your architectural expertise to enable the iterative development and evolution of our game. You will be a key player in connecting our players to the game world and enabling them to explore, interact and create memorable multiplayer moments.

A Day in the Life:

  • Apply your expertise with the Unreal Engine (C++ and Blueprints) to own the implementation of gameplay mechanics in close collaboration with the design team.

  • Develop flexible, scalable systems designed for iterative development that facilitate emergent game interactions.

  • Playtest regularly with the team to prototype new ideas and ensure gameplay is progressing in accordance with our game’s pillars.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple gameplay features across the game, partnering closely with design and production to achieve creative intent and balance development prioritization.

  • Advocate for excellence in tactile, immersive game feel across the project and the studio.

  • Collaborate closely with design, art and animation to align with game vision and provide technical expertise and perspective on decisions and alternatives.

  • Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and identifying and reducing friction in the development process.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience building game mechanics across one or more projects.

  • Deep expertise in Unreal’s gameplay frameworks, including character/camera controllers, behavior trees, Blackboard and the Gameplay Ability System.

  • Solid understanding of Unreal’s multiplayer framework, including replication RPCs, and the ability to incorporate the implications of a networked multiplayer environment into feature implementation.

  • Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

Nice to Haves:

  • Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine.

  • Prior experience owning the decision-making and implementation of significant portions of control/camera systems, NPC AI/behavior, combat or ability/action features in a multiplayer context.

  • Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay systems for large-scale content.

The Team:

  • You will report to the Lead Gameplay Engineer.

  • You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on.

How We Work

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients 


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.  

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer.  As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the Clinical Risk & Insights function, driving systemic investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), and clinical risk intelligence to strengthen clinical trial execution, inform strategic decisions, and enable continuous improvement across Global Development Operations (GDO).

  • Define and lead the GDO-wide RCA strategy, establishing investigation standards, methodologies, and capabilities to identify systemic risks and prevent recurring issues.

  • Drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), challenging ineffective solutions and sponsoring cross-functional improvements to address systemic risks.
  • Lead the Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) strategy, integrating systemic learning and portfolio risk intelligence into proactive risk identification and clinical trial execution.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, overseeing strategic priorities, talent development, resources, budgets, and organisational RCA capabilities.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across GDO, Clinical Compliance, R&D Quality, study delivery teams, and external stakeholders to strengthen governance, risk management, and operational excellence.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. What we seek in you as an experienced professional, are these qualifications and skills:

  • Degree educated
  • Extensive experience in biopharmaceutical clinical development, Clinical Operations, or clinical quality, with strong knowledge of GCP and clinical trial execution.
  • Proven expertise in RCA, complex cross-functional investigations, systemic risk identification, and CAPA effectiveness.
  • Ability to translate complex clinical risk insights into actionable recommendations for senior leadership and governance forums.
  • Strong strategic leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with experience driving cross-functional improvement and organisational change.
  • Experience in clinical risk management or Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM), including risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and quality indicators.
  • Experience in quality trend analysis, operational excellence, analytics, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience leading teams, including managers, and overseeing budgets, resources, and organisational capabilities.

The Senior Manager, Congress Peer to Peer Engagement translates U.S. peer to peer strategy into coordinated congress programs across the portfolio. This role requires recent, hands on experience leading congress programs from end to end logistics and commercial opinion leader management through on site execution and post congress follow through. The Senior Manager works closely with Congress, Health Care Professional (HCP) Marketing, Omnichannel, Sales, Medical, Corporate Affairs, Advocacy, Strategic Account Managers, Global partners, and agencies to create relevant, well coordinated customer experiences.


This role is an opportunity to shape how healthcare professionals connect and learn at congresses while ensuring that the right people, programs, and partners are aligned from planning through follow through.


What You Will Do


Lead Congress Peer to Peer Planning and Pull Through


  • Translate approved peer to peer and brand priorities into integrated congress plans that define audiences, engagement objectives, program scope, key milestones, and follow through before, during, and after each congress.
  • Coordinate commercial peer to peer activities across priority congresses and commercial meetings, ensuring plans are connected to the broader customer journey and consistent with approved strategy.
  • Build detailed workback plans, timelines, budgets, roles, and decision points with internal partners and agency teams; identify risks early and keep work moving through execution.
  • Partner with Congress and Sales leaders to align congress plans with customer engagement priorities, field needs, and launch readiness.

Coordinate Commercial Opinion Leader Engagement


  • Manage commercial opinion leader engagement across congress programs, including outreach, relationship coordination, availability, briefing, preparation, scheduling, and on site support, consistent with company policies and approved plans.
  • Coordinate opinion leader contracting from initiation through completed agreement, working with Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and other internal partners to keep contracts, documentation, and timing aligned with company requirements.
  • Develop clear faculty and opinion leader preparation materials with relevant content owners; prepare speakers on program objectives, audience needs, logistics, and approved content, and support clinically grounded HCP discussions in partnership with Medical and other content owners.
  • Maintain an organized view of opinion leader participation and program needs across congresses, and identify opportunities to strengthen continuity and the customer experience.
  • Partner with the Experiential Peer to Peer Engagement and Amplification Senior Manager to connect congress voices and insights with experiences and approved content that may extend beyond the event.

Coordinate Cross Functional Congress Engagement


  • Create clear planning rhythms and shared workplans with HCP Marketing, Omnichannel, Sales, Medical, Corporate Affairs, Advocacy, Strategic Account Managers, Global partners, Congress, and agency teams.
  • Clarify objectives, audiences, roles, and handoffs across programs so customers experience coordinated engagement while each function maintains its distinct purpose and review process.
  • Coordinate appropriate opportunities for cross functional participation and ensure that agendas, materials, and logistics are aligned with approved plans.
  • Work with Medical, Legal, and Regulatory reviewers and other partners to move materials and activities through the appropriate review pathways while preserving strategic intent.

Manage Congress Logistics and On Site Execution


  • Own end to end logistics for peer to peer programs, including schedules, venues, registration, travel coordination where applicable, run of show, rehearsals, vendor and agency deliverables, contingency planning, and on site readiness.
  • Coordinate rehearsals, speaker support, room or experience readiness, staffing, and issue resolution to ensure programs run smoothly and provide a positive customer experience.
  • Track budgets, purchase orders, timelines, and deliverables; maintain accurate documentation and escalate risks or changes promptly.
  • Lead post event closeout with partners and vendors, capturing execution learnings and resolving outstanding items.

Measure and Improve Congress Engagement


  • Define and track program measures with Insights and Analytics, including participation, engagement, customer feedback, execution quality, and approved content follow through.
  • Develop concise post congress readouts that summarize performance, customer and partner feedback, key learnings, and recommendations for future planning.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. About Us:

Flourish Research is where clinical trials thrive. Flourish Research is one of the industry’s most progressive and diversified clinical trial organizations, with strong capabilities across cardiology, metabolic disorders, renal, oncology, CNS, pulmonology, and vaccine research. At Flourish Research, we strive toward excellence. In clinical trials and healthcare, excellence means everyone deserves the best care, regardless of their race, color, gender identity, religion, ethnicity, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation, or veteran status. We embrace employees, customers, and patients from these underrepresented groups to help make this vision a reality. Flourish is committed to a safe work environment where all employees, customers, and patients are included, and treated with dignity and respect. The more diversity we have in our team, the more unique perspectives, and ideas we share, and the better prepared we are to serve our communities. WE SEE YOU. WE ARE YOU. WE EMBRACE YOU. WE CELEBRATE YOU! 

 Flourish Research is looking for motivated, talented, creative individuals who want to learn and grow in their careers while contributing to research that changes lives! We offer an excellent comprehensive benefits package, a supportive and collaborative work environment, and endless growth opportunities. 

About the Job:  

We are actively hiring a QC & Data Management Lead. This is a remote position.

Shift: Monday-Friday (40 hours per week)

Location: Remote- United States

PURPOSE: Assure quality research data is collected by adhering to Flourish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), GCP, FDA, and protocol guidelines for all subject data that is submitted into the QC data entry department. Work closely with clinical research coordinators (CRCs) and ensure that the QC data entry department is utilizing the Punctual Accurate Complete True (P.A.C.T.) System. Assist clinical research associates (CRAs) during internal monitoring visits.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  1. Conduct a thorough and precise review of all study charts utilizing Flourish SOPs and sponsor-provided protocols.
  1. Accurately enter data into an eCRF/CRF system according to the sponsor provided eCRF/CRF guidelines in a timely manner.
  1. Identify and report any missing data points or inconsistencies to the CRC in a timely manner to ensure all data is clean and accurate.
  1. Source document creation/approval.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in German (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

And because Greenhouse builds hiring software, you'll have a real voice in how AI is reshaping employment law, both for us and for our customers.

Who will love this job

  • A trusted advisor - you build credibility quickly with HR partners, managers, and executives, and you turn legal risk into plain, practical guidance they can act on
  • A builder who scales - as the sole employment specialist, you prioritize well and multiply your impact through policies, playbooks, and training rather than answering every question one at a time
  • A detail-obsessed drafter - you sweat the language in agreements, policies, and compensation plans because you know that's where the risk lives
  • A pragmatic, curious lawyer - you track a fast-moving landscape (pay transparency, restrictive covenants, new leave mandates, AI in employment decisions) and make sound calls grounded in ethics, integrity, and the human impact of every decision

What you’ll do

  • Serve as the primary legal advisor to the People team (HR business partners, People Operations, Total Rewards, and Talent Acquisition) and business leaders on employee relations, performance management, terminations, reductions in force, leaves of absence, and accommodations
  • Lead wage and hour compliance, including FLSA and state exemption classification, timekeeping and overtime practices, payroll issues, and periodic classification audits in partnership with Total Rewards
  • Review and advise on compensation programs, including sales commission and bonus plans, overpayment recoupment, privileged pay equity analyses, and pay transparency requirements
  • Draft, negotiate, and maintain employment documents and policies, including offer letters, confidentiality and invention assignment agreements, restrictive covenants, separation and contractor agreements, and handbook content with state and country supplements
  • Conduct or oversee workplace investigations, and manage employment litigation matters with outside counsel, from demand letters and EEOC through class and representative actions, mediation, and settlement
  • Advise on employment law outside the US, supporting employer of record and contractor arrangements, entity launches, temporary work-from-abroad requests, and relocations alongside local and immigration counsel
  • Build and deliver training for managers, HR, and recruiters, create self-serve resources, and share clear, actionable updates on legal developments with Legal and People leadership
  • Partner with Product, Privacy, and HR technology stakeholders on the use of AI in hiring and employment decisions, vendor assessments, employee and candidate data retention, and the employment law implications of product launches
  • Support M&A diligence and integration, benefits and EEO/affirmative action compliance, manage outside counsel relationships and budgets, and represent Greenhouse externally as an employment law subject matter expert
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one US state bar
  • 7+ years of labor and employment law experience at a law firm and/or in-house
  • Deep knowledge of US federal and multi-state employment law, especially wage and hour
  • Experience advising on employment matters outside the US and working with employer of record providers and local counsel
  • A track record of managing employment litigation with outside counsel, including settlement strategy
  • Experience with workforce planning and management
  • Experience owning employment policies, agreements, and compensation plan terms, and conducting or overseeing workplace investigations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including giving practical advice to non-lawyers and executives and designing engaging training, plus the judgment and organization to work independently as the subject matter expert
  • Experience using AI tools effectively while verifying output, protecting privileged and employee data, and keeping final legal judgment human
  • In-house experience, strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with the HR tech industry, a plus
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Community Programs team creates the spaces, programs, and opportunities that help our community thrive. We're looking for a Community Engagement and Advocacy Manager to help us strengthen relationships with the people who use, build with, and advocate for Tailscale.

In this role, you'll own and grow three important areas of our community: the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program, our digital communities, specifically Discord and Reddit, and our Community Projects program.

You'll focus on creating meaningful opportunities for community members to connect, contribute, share their expertise, and be recognized for the work they do. Whether that's helping an Insider find their next speaking opportunity, bringing Tailscale staff into conversations on Discord, or showcasing an exciting community-built project, you'll help turn community participation into lasting relationships and advocacy.

You'll work closely with teams across Tailscale, including Developer Relations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, to connect community members with the right people, resources, and opportunities.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people, understands what makes communities thrive, and can turn ideas into thoughtful, well-run programs. You don't need to be deeply technical, but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn from the people building with it.

Key Responsibilities

Insiders Advocacy Program

  • Own the strategy, day-to-day operations, engagement, and ongoing growth of the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program.
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with Insiders, understanding their interests, expertise, motivations, and how they want to participate in the Tailscale community.
  • Develop recurring engagement opportunities that help Insiders connect with one another and with teams across Tailscale.
  • Identify opportunities for Insiders to contribute through speaking engagements, technical content, community events, product feedback, testing, and other initiatives.
  • Partner with internal teams to create clear pathways for Insiders to participate in company initiatives, ensuring opportunities are relevant and mutually beneficial.
  • Identify and nurture emerging advocates across the Tailscale community, creating pathways for deeper participation and potential involvement in the Insiders program.
  • Own the recruitment, onboarding, recognition, and ongoing engagement of Insiders, ensuring participants feel valued, supported, and connected.
  • Gather feedback from program members and continuously improve the Insider experience.
  • Track program participation, contributions, engagement, and outcomes to understand and communicate the impact of the program.

Digital Communities: Discord & Reddit

  • Own the strategy, day-to-day engagement, and overall community experience across Tailscale's Discord and Reddit communities, fostering welcoming, active, and inclusive spaces.
  • Develop and execute engagement initiatives, including community events, AMAs, discussions, and member spotlights that encourage participation and connection.
  • Partner with teams across Tailscale to bring staff into community conversations and create opportunities for meaningful engagement.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Developer Relations to plan and lead Discord and Reddit engagement around product launches, announcements, and key company initiatives.
  • Own day-to-day community moderation, including enforcing guidelines, managing moderation tools and bots, coordinating volunteer moderators, and escalating sensitive issues to appropriate internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve community engagement, structures, and experiences based on member feedback and participation.
  • Recognize and celebrate active members and contributors, creating opportunities for deeper involvement and advocacy.
  • Monitor community conversations, feedback, and engagement metrics to identify emerging themes, share actionable insights with internal teams, and inform community strategy, product decisions, and program improvements.

Community Projects

  • Own the strategy, operations, and continued growth of Tailscale's Community Projects program, recognizing and amplifying projects built by our community.
  • Develop and maintain a clear, repeatable process for discovering, submitting, reviewing, tracking, and showcasing community projects.
  • Build relationships with project creators, understanding what they've built, their motivations, and how Tailscale can support and recognize their work.
  • Partner with Developer Relations, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to identify opportunities to turn community projects into technical content, demos, documentation, social content, and community showcases.
  • Create opportunities for project creators to share their work through community events, presentations, blog posts, videos, and other channels.
  • Identify projects that demonstrate creative or emerging uses of Tailscale and help surface those examples to relevant internal teams.
  • Develop thoughtful ways to recognize and reward contributors, ensuring builders receive visibility and credit for their work.
  • Track program activity, project contributions, and outcomes to help demonstrate how community projects support advocacy, learning, and broader awareness of Tailscale as a platform.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of experience in community management, advocacy, community programs, developer communities, or related roles.
  • Experience owning and growing community programs, including developing initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, and driving engagement.
  • Proven ability to build meaningful relationships with community members, advocates, contributors, and internal teams.
  • Experience managing and moderating online communities, including community guidelines, moderation tools, and maintaining healthy, inclusive environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage authentically and collaborate across teams.
  • Excellent organizational and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong understanding of community engagement and advocacy, with the ability to identify opportunities, recognize contributors, and turn feedback into meaningful improvements.
  • Genuine curiosity about technology and an eagerness to learn about Tailscale's products and community.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing advocacy, ambassador, champion, or contributor recognition programs.
  • Hands-on experience managing Discord, Reddit, or similar community platforms, including moderation bots and automation tools.
  • Experience working with developers, open source, infrastructure, networking, security, or other technology-focused communities.
  • Familiarity with community engagement and intelligence tools such as Common Room.
  • Experience developing community programming such as AMAs, virtual events, member spotlights, and recurring engagement initiatives.
  • Experience identifying and amplifying community stories, projects, or contributor achievements.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Developer Relations, Engineering, Marketing, or Support teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support community events, meetups, and other initiatives.

As a Senior Incident Response Analyst, you'll be a member of the bank's Cyber Incident Response team. We are looking for an experienced senior level analyst with proven skillsets to detect and respond to threats in the environment, interact with business stakeholders and work to restore operations. This is a technical role and will support the Threat Hunting, Intelligence, and Monitoring functions with content creation, threat analysis, detection recommendations, and colleague mentoring.   • Incident Analyst/handler –investigate SIEM/SOAR events as necessary; bring experience in malware analysis, network/endpoint security to respond to and contain incidents.

  • Incident Management – Ensures Information Security incidents are properly detected, documented, investigated, and resolved.
  • Content Development - Support the creation of countermeasures and mitigations in response to an incident.

OR

jobs.excerpt: Column is the software platform for public information.
jobs.description:
Column is the software platform for public information. We build automated tools and workflow solutions that help governments, law firms, and media organizations notify the public. Today, thousands of publishers and tens of thousands of agencies, firms, and individuals rely on Column to keep their communities informed every day. We’re reimagining how public information connects people, institutions, and media.

We're a remote-first team of engineers, designers, and builders who are committed to creating software that supports an informed public.

About the Role

Column | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time

The Content Marketing Manager will build Column’s content engine: turning our expertise, customer stories, frontline insight, and national public notice developments into consistent, high-quality content that establishes Column as the expert on, and advocate for, public information, access to it, and public notice.

You’ll own the marketing calendar and Column’s core publishing channels, including our blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, monthly Public Notice reports, educational resources, case studies, and sales collateral. You’ll stay closely connected to our Customer Success and Services teams so our content reflects what is actually happening in the field.

As Column invests in SEO, media, partnerships, and demand generation, this role will help establish us as the definitive resource on public notice. We’re looking for a strong writer and steady operator who values quality over quantity, publishes consistently, and writes in a voice that is strong, professional, mature, and trustworthy. Candidates should also be able to move fluidly between long-form thought leadership, visual and video content, CMS publishing, and email campaigns while maintaining a consistent, high-quality publishing cadence.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Column’s marketing calendar and publishing cadence across the blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, email, and internal enablement, managing projects from request through drafting, review, publication, and distribution.
  • Follow public notice and public information news nationally, turning legislation, court decisions, industry shifts, and market trends into timely, credible content, including news commentary for our media channels.
  • Build a content source of truth with CSMs and our Services team (affidavits, pagination, and placement), turning their frontline knowledge into educational resources, FAQs, and enablement materials.
  • Write and produce high-quality content across formats, including weekly SEO blog posts, newsletters, customer case studies, guides, press releases, and sales collateral.
  • Own customer storytelling and case studies, from interviews and data collection through written stories, pull quotes, graphics, and video testimonials, while also supporting partnership announcements and sponsored content opportunities.
  • Create compelling visual and video content for marketing campaigns, social media, YouTube, reports, presentations, one-pagers, conference collateral, and other channels, bringing strong graphic design and video production/editing skills to Column’s content.
  • Grow Column’s LinkedIn presence and repurpose content for distribution and conversion, turning reports, customer stories, webinars, product launches, and news commentary into posts, graphics, short video, and email while improving CTAs, lifecycle campaigns, and website performance through testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • Exceptional writer and editor who makes complex, legal, or regulatory subjects clear and credible, with a high bar for accuracy and a mature, trustworthy voice.
  • Consistent, organized operator who manages an editorial calendar, juggles multiple projects, and ships on schedule without sacrificing quality.
  • Genuinely news-engaged, with curiosity about government, law, local media, and access to information, and the judgment to know what is worth writing about and when.
  • Experienced B2B content marketer with a track record of blogs, newsletters, case studies, reports, and educational resources.
  • Strong visual judgment and an eye for design, with experience creating polished assets such as reports, PDFs, presentations, social creative, email graphics, and sales collateral.
  • Digitally fluent and performance-minded, with experience publishing in a CMS, understanding SEO fundamentals, and using data, testing, and conversion insights to improve content and campaigns.
  • Collaborative and comfortable becoming an expert, able to interview customers, CSMs, operators, and leadership and translate what they know into clear content.

What Success Looks Like

Key performance indicators will include:

  • Consistent publishing cadence: Approximately 1 blog post per week, 1 LinkedIn post per week, 1 newsletter per month, 1 Public Notice report per month, 1 case study per month.
  • Campaign and channel support: Timely press releases, webinar and lifecycle communications, conference collateral, sales enablement, and social distribution tied to major launches, partnerships, events, and customer stories.
  • Authority and education: Column’s blog, reports, and resources become a go-to reference on public notice and public information, and Sales, CSMs, and Services actively use them. You also establish a reliable monthly loop with internal teams to surface trends, customer questions, and field insights into published content.
  • Audience growth: Growth in organic traffic, newsletter engagement, LinkedIn followers and engagement, and gated resource downloads.
  • Business impact: Clear attribution between content and pipeline, showing which blogs, newsletters, reports, case studies, and posts generate and influence marketing leads.
  • Editorial execution: Maintain a clear content calendar, independently manage recurring workflows. Ensure content moves efficiently from idea through publication and distribution.
  • Content repurposing: Major webinars, research, case studies, product education, and customer conversations are consistently turned into multiple useful formats across web, email, LinkedIn, video, and sales enablement.

Your First 90 Days

First 60 Days: Learn Column and Build the Foundation

The first 60 days focus on learning Column’s products, customers, voice, and the public notice ecosystem, while quickly contributing to our content engine.

You will:

  • Learn Column’s products, customer segments, positioning, marketing priorities, and the public notice landscape
  • Review our existing blogs, newsletters, case studies, email programs, and sales enablement
  • Take over the Marketing Calendar, Marketing Requests, and recurring content workflows
  • Set up a regular check-in with CSMs and Services team to source insights and stories
  • Build a news-monitoring routine for public notice legislation and public information developments

By Day 60, you will have:

  • Published 2 blog posts
  • Published 2 newsletters
  • Published 1 customer case study
  • Published 2 LinkedIn posts
  • Published 1 Public Notice report
  • Responded to and managed incoming content and marketing requests
  • Actively maintained and managed the Marketing Calendar

By the end of your second month, you understand Column’s voice, audience, products, and priorities—and can independently own standard content projects from request through publication.

Days 61-90: Own and Build

By your third month, you are independently running Column’s content engine: a weekly blog, newsletters, the monthly Public Notice report, steady LinkedIn publishing, and timely news commentary for Glorion.

By Day 90, you have published a second monthly Public Notice report, built a repeatable process with CSMs and Services for sourcing content, and established a consistent, recognizable Column voice across every channel.

Must Haves

  • 2+ years of experience in content marketing, B2B marketing, editorial, journalism, communications, or a related field
  • Excellent writing, editing, research, and interviewing skills, with experience producing substantive long-form content
  • Strong visual judgment and experience creating polished marketing assets in Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
  • Strong project management skills, including managing editorial calendars, multiple stakeholders, and competing deadlines
  • A track record of publishing on a consistent cadence and owning projects from idea through distribution

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with lifecycle marketing platforms like and website tools like Framer
  • Deeper experience with B2B SEO, original research, and A/B-tested email campaigns
  • Experience covering legal, policy, or government news, or building a LinkedIn audience for a B2B brand
  • Experience supporting PR, sponsored content, media, or industry partnerships
  • Familiarity with government technology, legal technology, local media, public notice, or another regulated industry

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $80k-$100k based on experience
  • 401K with match
  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Flexible PTO and fully remote work environment (U.S.-based)

jobs.title: Contracts Administrator – Senior Level
jobs.excerpt: OverviewAbout the Company:Come join our ‘Ohana!  Honu Services located in Kailua, Hawaii was founded on a simple principle: With the right support you can build anything.
jobs.description:
Overview

About the Company:

Come join our ‘Ohana!

Honu Services located in Kailua, Hawaii was founded on a simple principle: With the right support you can build anything. Our mission is to empower clients and optimize client potential through cost effective and exceptional operational support. We provide small businesses within the government contracting industry with specialized operational support services found at major corporations. Our talented and dedicated team has years of experience in taking small businesses to the next level. We are certified in ISO 9001, 20000-1, and 27001 standards to ensure the quality and consistency of our services are best in class.

Visit Honu Services for more information.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

Summary:

The Senior Contracts Administrator is an experienced Contracts Administration professional responsible for providing expert-level contract administration and support to assigned customer companies. This position serves as a subject matter expert on assigned customer contracts and provides guidance on contract requirements, compliance, modifications, funding, performance, and other contractual matters throughout the contract lifecycle.

The Senior Contracts Administrator independently manages complex contracts and serves as a trusted resource to assigned customer companies and internal teams. The position requires the ability to interpret and apply contractual requirements, identify potential risks and issues, and provide clear, practical guidance to support successful contract performance.

The ideal candidate possesses extensive knowledge of Government contracting and demonstrates strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple complex contracts while maintaining a high level of customer service and responsiveness.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

The Senior Contracts Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration and oversight of assigned customer contracts from award through completion and closeout. This position serves as a primary Contracts Administration resource for assigned customer companies and works closely with Program Management, Finance, Operations, Business Development, and other internal teams to ensure contractual requirements are understood and appropriately administered.

The Senior Contracts Administrator reviews and interprets contracts, modifications, solicitations, contract clauses, and other contractual documents; monitors key contractual requirements; and provides guidance regarding contract compliance and performance.

The position is expected to independently manage multiple contracts and competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. The Senior Contracts Administrator proactively identifies contractual risks, upcoming requirements, and potential issues and communicates them to the appropriate parties.

The successful candidate will have strong knowledge of Government contracting and the ability to apply that knowledge to practical day-to-day contract administration. This individual must be comfortable working independently, exercising sound contractual judgment, and communicating complex contractual requirements in a clear and understandable manner.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration & Compliance

  • Serve as a Contracts Administration subject matter expert for assigned customer companies.
  • Independently administer assigned customer contracts from contract award through completion and closeout.
  • Review and interpret contracts, modifications, solicitations, amendments, contract clauses, and other contractual documents.
  • Identify and communicate contractual requirements, obligations, risks, and potential impacts to assigned customer companies.
  • Monitor contract periods of performance, funding, ceilings, option periods, contract line items, deliverables, reporting requirements, and other key contractual milestones.
  • Interpret and apply the FAR, applicable agency supplements, contract clauses, and customer-specific contractual requirements.
  • Review and administer contract modifications, including funding actions, changes to scope, periods of performance, labor categories, contract line items, and other contractual changes.
  • Monitor contract performance and proactively identify upcoming actions, deadlines, and potential areas of concern.
  • Identify contractual compliance issues and provide recommendations for resolution or appropriate escalation.
  • Ensure contract files and records are complete, accurate, current, and maintained in accordance with company requirements.
  • Support contract closeout activities and ensure required documentation and actions are completed timely.
  • Maintain awareness of changes to applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and government contracting practices.

Customer Company Support

  • Serve as a trusted Contracts Administration advisor to assigned customer companies.
  • Develop strong working relationships with customer company leadership, Program Managers, Finance, Operations, and other internal personnel.
  • Provide clear and practical guidance regarding contractual requirements and obligations.
  • Assist customer companies in understanding and managing contract requirements throughout the period of performance.
  • Participate in contract reviews, customer meetings, and other activities requiring Contracts Administration expertise.
  • Respond to contract-related questions and provide timely recommendations and solutions.
  • Help customer companies identify contractual risks before they become performance, compliance, or financial issues.
  • Escalate significant contractual risks, compliance concerns, and other matters requiring management attention.

Contract Modifications & Lifecycle Management

  • Review proposed modifications and assess contractual, operational, and financial impacts.
  • Coordinate the administrative processing of contract modifications and ensure required approvals and documentation are obtained.
  • Monitor modification status and communicate impacts and effective dates to appropriate internal personnel.
  • Track contract funding, option exercises, extensions, changes, and other lifecycle events.
  • Ensure contract information is accurately reflected in applicable systems and internal records.
  • Assist with contract transition activities, including new awards, novations, transfers, extensions, and closeout.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Proactively identify contractual risks and potential compliance issues.
  • Review contract terms and clauses for requirements that may affect company operations, billing, reporting, purchasing, security, property, travel, or other areas of performance.
  • Assist with evaluating the contractual impact of proposed business or operational decisions.
  • Support internal reviews, audits, and compliance assessments involving assigned contracts.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation supporting contract administration decisions and actions.
  • Escalate matters when contractual interpretation, risk, or potential financial exposure exceeds established authority.

Knowledge Sharing & Process Improvement

  • Serve as a technical resource and knowledge-sharing partner within the Contracts Administration team.
  • Share lessons learned, best practices, and contract administration guidance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve contract administration processes, procedures, templates, and controls.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining Contracts Administration guidance and training materials.
  • Support implementation and effective use of contract lifecycle management and other contract administration systems.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives designed to increase consistency, visibility, compliance, and efficiency.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Contracts Management, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in Government contract administration.
  • Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Contracts Administration principles and practices.
  • Strong working knowledge of the FAR and applicable agency supplements as they relate to contract administration and contract performance.
  • Experience independently administering complex Government contracts.
  • Experience with multiple contract types, including Firm-Fixed-Price, Time-and-Materials, Cost-Reimbursement, and/or Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and interpreting contracts, modifications, solicitations, contract clauses, and other contractual documents.
  • Experience administering contract modifications, funding actions, option periods, periods of performance, contract line items, and other contractual changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify contractual risks and provide practical recommendations for addressing them.
  • Strong understanding of the government contract lifecycle from award through closeout.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage multiple contracts, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to exercise sound contractual judgment and appropriately escalate issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certification such as Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or similar.
  • Experience supporting small businesses and/or 8(a) government contractors.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint or similar government contracting systems.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) systems.
  • Experience supporting government contract audits, reviews, or compliance assessments.
  • Experience with contract administration for multiple customer companies or business units.
  • Experience developing or delivering Contracts Administration training.

Core Competencies

  • Contracts Administration Expertise: Demonstrates advanced knowledge of government contract administration and serves as a technical authority for assigned customer companies.
  • Customer Focus: Builds trusted relationships and provides responsive, practical, and solutions-oriented support to assigned customer companies.
  • Contractual Judgment: Accurately interprets contractual requirements and applies sound judgment when evaluating risks and potential impacts.
  • Independent Ownership: Takes ownership of assigned contracts and responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintains a high level of accuracy when managing complex contractual requirements and documentation.
  • Communication: Clearly explains contractual requirements and recommendations to both contracts professionals and non-contracts personnel.
  • Risk Awareness: Proactively identifies contractual, compliance, and performance risks.
  • Organization: Effectively manages multiple contracts, deadlines, priorities, and competing requirements.
  • Problem Solving: Evaluates contractual issues and develops practical solutions.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with customer companies and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Contributes expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen the broader Contracts Administration function.
  • Accountability: Demonstrates ownership of commitments, deadlines, contract actions, and customer support.

Physical Requirements:

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Position may require typing and reading from a computer screen. Must have enough mobility, including but not limited to bending, reaching, and kneeling to complete daily duties in a timely and efficient manner. May include lifting weigh up to thirty (30) pounds, as necessary.

Location/Work Schedule:

This is a remote work-from-home position. While the role offers flexibility, the Contracts Administrator – Senior Level is expected to be available during standard business hours and maintain a dedicated workspace. Occasionally, this position may require support outside of regular hours, including early mornings or evenings, to meet critical deadlines or business needs.

Salary Range:

$85,000 - $1000,000.00

Benefits:

  • 100% company paid employee coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match and Roth IRA option    
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance and AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability    
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Various Employee Perks and Discounts

Honu Services reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Functions and qualifications may vary depending on business needs. Honu Services is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics.

Pay Range

USD $85,000.00 - USD $100,000.00 /Yr.
