jobs.description:
Voir la version française ci-dessous

About Flinks 🚀

Flinks is the embedded finance platform that brings together connectivity, intelligence, and payments — giving businesses the infrastructure they need to build and deliver seamless financial experiences at scale.

As a leader in Open Finance in Canada, we’ve grown since 2016 into one of North America’s most trusted platforms for financial data access, enrichment, and money movement. We work with innovators across many industries, including lending, fintech, banking, insurance, and wealth management.

Today, our platform connects to 15,000+ financial institutions across North America and powers over 1M monthly connections. We also give our customers unprecedented visibility into 4,500+ real-time financial insights to support smarter decisioning. Companies rely on Flinks to streamline onboarding, verify income, assess credit risk, and power faster payment experiences.

We’re on a mission to drive financial innovation and help businesses build financial experiences that feel effortless, connected, and customer-first. That’s where you come in.

What You'll Be Doing 🔥

  • Shape how AI agents and assistants work in our SDLC: where they operate, what they can touch, and how their output is reviewed, traced, and approved. You will partner with Security and Compliance to make this work in a regulated environment.
  • Encode standards as code: quality gates, security scanning, and policy checks live in templates and pipelines, not review checklists.
  • Build and own our internal developer platform: a Backstage-based portal and service catalog with software templates that scaffold a production-ready service (repo, pipeline, infrastructure, dashboards, alerts, ownership) in minutes.
  • Build agent-facing interfaces, such as MCP servers, that expose the catalog, pipelines, and infrastructure to AI agents safely. Track agent-assisted changes with the same DORA and quality metrics as human ones.
  • Evolve our cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure and extend self-service (Terraform, declarative APIs, PRs) so teams provision what they need with guardrails instead of tickets.
  • Cut developer toil: local development, preview environments, test feedback time, and pipeline duration.
  • Treat developers as your customers: gather feedback, document, drive adoption, and keep platform code tested, versioned, and maintainable.

Who You Are

  • At least 8 to 10 years in platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, with real software development along the way. Any language works (we use C#, Go, and Python); you write and maintain production code, not only configuration.
  • Hands-on Backstage experience (catalog, software templates, TechDocs, plugins), or you have built an equivalent internal developer portal and can walk us through it.
  • Kubernetes, GitOps (Argo CD or Flux), and Terraform in a major cloud. GCP or Azure is a plus.
  • CI/CD and release engineering: pipeline templates, environment promotion, safe rollouts and rollbacks.
  • You use AI coding tools daily and have a point of view on where they fit in a team's SDLC.
  • Working knowledge of observability: traces, metrics, logs, SLOs.
  • A practitioner, not a strategist: senior enough to drive initiatives and build from scratch with minimal direction. You do the hands-on work.

Great to haves

  • Custom Backstage plugin development, or running Backstage at scale
  • Building MCP servers or agent tooling, or integrating LLMs into CI/CD and developer workflows
  • Defining governance for AI-generated code: review standards, permission boundaries, audit trails
  • Policy-as-code and supply chain security (OPA, Kyverno, SBOM, artifact signing)
  • DORA metrics, developer satisfaction measurement, ephemeral environments
  • Regulated or financial-services delivery experience

Why This Role Matters at Flinks 💡

  • Greenfield: you define the golden path rather than inherit it.
  • Everything you build is used by every engineering team at Flinks.
  • High visibility: AI-enabled delivery is a top company priority.
  • You help decide how AI agents build and ship software in a regulated environment, in a strong learning environment with plenty already in place to build on.

The Interview Process 🏗

  • Introductory call with our Head of People
  • Hiring manager conversation
  • One-hour technical interview

À propos de Flinks 🚀

Flinks est une plateforme de finance embarquée qui réunit connectivité, intelligence et paiements. Elle offre aux entreprises l’infrastructure dont elles ont besoin pour créer et proposer des expériences financières fluides à grande échelle.

Chef de file de la finance ouverte au Canada, nous avons connu une croissance soutenue depuis 2016 et sommes devenus l’une des plateformes les plus fiables en Amérique du Nord pour l’accès aux données financières, leur enrichissement et les transferts de fonds. Nous collaborons avec des entreprises innovantes de nombreux secteurs, notamment le prêt, les technologies financières, les services bancaires, l’assurance et la gestion de patrimoine.

Aujourd’hui, notre plateforme se connecte à plus de 15 000 institutions financières en Amérique du Nord et permet plus d’un million de connexions par mois. Nous offrons également à nos clients une visibilité sans précédent sur plus de 4 500 indicateurs financiers en temps réel afin de favoriser une prise de décision éclairée. Les entreprises comptent sur Flinks pour simplifier l’intégration de leurs clients, vérifier les revenus, évaluer le risque de crédit et accélérer les paiements.

Notre mission est de stimuler l’innovation financière et d’aider les entreprises à créer des expériences financières simples, connectées et centrées sur le client. C’est là que vous entrez en jeu.

Ce que vous ferez 🔥

  • Concevoir et prendre en charge notre plateforme de développement interne : un portail et un catalogue de services basés sur Backstage, avec des modèles logiciels permettant de générer en quelques minutes un service prêt pour la production (dépôt de code, pipeline, infrastructure, tableaux de bord, alertes et responsabilités).
  • Intégrer les standards directement aux outils : contrôles de qualité, analyses de sécurité et vérifications de conformité aux politiques dans les modèles et les pipelines, plutôt que de s’appuyer sur des listes de vérification manuelles.
  • Définir la façon dont les agents et les assistants d’IA interviennent dans notre cycle de développement logiciel : leurs environnements d’exécution, leurs niveaux d’accès et les mécanismes de révision, de traçabilité et d’approbation de leurs contributions. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes Sécurité et Conformité pour mettre en place ces pratiques dans un environnement réglementé.
  • Créer des interfaces destinées aux agents, comme des serveurs MCP, qui donnent aux agents d’IA un accès sécurisé au catalogue, aux pipelines et à l’infrastructure. Mesurer les changements réalisés avec l’aide de l’IA à l’aide des mêmes indicateurs DORA et de qualité que ceux utilisés pour évaluer le travail des développeurs.
  • Faire évoluer notre infrastructure infonuagique et Kubernetes, et étendre les capacités de libre-service (Terraform, API déclaratives et demandes de fusion) afin que les équipes puissent accéder aux ressources dont elles ont besoin avec des garde-fous intégrés, plutôt que de devoir soumettre des billets.
  • Réduire les tâches répétitives des développeurs en améliorant le développement local, les environnements de prévisualisation, les délais de rétroaction des tests et la durée des pipelines.
  • Considérer les développeurs comme vos clients : recueillir leurs commentaires, documenter les solutions, favoriser leur adoption et maintenir une plateforme dont le code est testé, versionné et facile à maintenir.

Votre profil

  • Vous avez au moins 8 à 10 ans d’expérience en ingénierie de plateforme, en DevOps ou en infrastructure, ainsi qu’une solide expérience en développement logiciel. Nous utilisons notamment C#, Go et Python, mais toute expérience pertinente en programmation est considérée. Vous savez écrire et maintenir du code en production, et pas seulement de la configuration.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique de Backstage (catalogue, modèles logiciels, TechDocs et plugiciels), ou vous avez conçu un portail de développement interne équivalent et êtes en mesure de nous présenter votre expérience en détail.
  • Vous maîtrisez Kubernetes, GitOps (Argo CD ou Flux) et Terraform sur une plateforme infonuagique d’envergure. Une expérience avec GCP ou Azure est un atout.
  • Vous avez de l’expérience en CI/CD et en ingénierie des mises en production : modèles de pipelines, promotion entre les environnements, déploiements et retours en arrière sécuritaires.
  • Vous utilisez régulièrement des outils de codage assistés par l’IA et avez une opinion réfléchie sur la place qu’ils devraient occuper dans le cycle de développement d’une équipe.
  • Vous avez une connaissance pratique de l’observabilité : traces, métriques, journaux et objectifs de niveau de service (SLO).
  • Vous êtes une personne de terrain, et non uniquement une personne de stratégie. Vous avez suffisamment d’expérience pour mener des initiatives et bâtir des solutions à partir de zéro avec peu de supervision. Vous aimez mettre la main à la pâte.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans le développement de plugiciels Backstage personnalisés ou dans l’exploitation de Backstage à grande échelle.
  • Expérience dans la création de serveurs MCP ou d’outils pour agents, ou dans l’intégration de grands modèles de langage (LLM) aux pipelines CI/CD et aux flux de travail des développeurs.
  • Expérience dans la définition de règles de gouvernance pour le code généré par l’IA : normes de révision, limites d’autorisation et pistes d’audit.
  • Connaissance des politiques en tant que code et de la sécurité de la chaîne d’approvisionnement logicielle (OPA, Kyverno, SBOM et signature d’artefacts).
  • Expérience avec les indicateurs DORA, la mesure de la satisfaction des développeurs et les environnements éphémères.
  • Expérience en livraison de solutions dans un environnement réglementé ou dans le secteur des services financiers.

Pourquoi ce poste est important chez Flinks 💡

  • Un terrain à bâtir : vous définirez le parcours de référence plutôt que de simplement reprendre un modèle existant.
  • Un impact à grande échelle : les solutions que vous développerez seront utilisées par toutes les équipes d’ingénierie de Flinks.
  • Une grande visibilité : la livraison assistée par l’IA est l’une des principales priorités de l’entreprise.
  • Un rôle qui façonne l’avenir : vous contribuerez à définir la façon dont les agents d’IA conçoivent et livrent des logiciels dans un environnement réglementé, tout en évoluant dans un milieu stimulant où plusieurs fondations sont déjà en place.

Le processus d’entrevue 🏗

  • Appel d’introduction avec notre responsable des ressources humaines.
  • Rencontre avec le gestionnaire d’embauche.
  • Entrevue technique d’une heure.

jobs.description:
About Mindset Care, Inc.

Mindset was founded to create a better experience for those with a mental illness and their caregivers in applying for Social Security Disability benefits.

Our team of Social Security Disability lawyers and representatives has helped thousands of individuals through the arduous process of obtaining Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and/or Supplemental Security Income (SSI) through the Social Security Administration.

Position Overview: We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Social Security Disability Hearing Case Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for assisting clients with the application process, gathering necessary documentation, advocating on behalf of clients, and ensuring that all claims are processed accurately.

Due to this being a remote role, you’ll need reliable internet with speeds of at least 100 Mbps download and 30 Mbps upload, a comfortable place to work, and a backup plan for occasional internet outages. We will provide your MacBook as well as a headset, keyboard, and monitor as needed. You will be responsible for maintaining a setup that supports a productive workday. During scheduled working hours, employees must be able to perform the position’s essential duties and meet its attendance, availability, productivity, confidentiality, and performance expectations, subject to approved leave, reasonable accommodations, and applicable law.

Responsibilities:

  • Gather required documentation and information from clients to support their claims.
  • Provide guidance and support to clients throughout the claims process which can be lengthy.
  • Advocate on behalf of clients to ensure that their claims are processed accurately and efficiently.
  • Communicate with social security administration officials to resolve any issues or discrepancies that may arise.
  • High call volume
  • Keep detailed records of client interactions and claim status updates.
  • Stay up-to-date on changes to social security policies and procedures.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, or a related field (preferred).
  • Previous experience working with social security claims or similar benefits programs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to empathize with clients and provide compassionate support.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite and other relevant software programs.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Knowledge of social security policies and procedures (preferred).
  • A dedicated, private, and quiet workspace appropriate for confidential client conversations.
  • Ability to remain attentive, responsive, and free from recurring personal interruptions during scheduled working hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a remote or virtual office environment.
  • Knowledge of virtual phone systems and online scheduling software.

Schedule:

  • 40 hours a week, limited overtime (typical working hours are 9:00 - 6:00 pm EST)

Benefits:

  • Remote first policy
  • Large responsibility from the start
  • The ability to ascend within the company
  • A team of creative, transparent entrepreneurs driven to accomplish our mission

jobs.title: Lead Substation Engineer 1 - Grid
jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesThis position will offer you the ability to directly apply your knowledge of protective relaying and controls systems for HV and EHV substations.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

This position will offer you the ability to directly apply your knowledge of protective relaying and controls systems for HV and EHV substations. As a Lead Substation Engineer, you will:

  • Work on a wide range of substation modifications and upgrades to support client requirements and reviews including creating calculations, document designs, and specifications.
  • Prepare relaying philosophies, including selecting relay, control, and communications equipment, developing SCADA and telecommunication concepts and configurations, and overseeing the preparation of I/O assignments and connection diagrams.
  • Guide junior and senior-level engineers and designers in protection and controls engineering design efforts, including providing guidance with the coordination of detailed design phases for all aspects of the engineering work.
  • Support challenging assignments that include investigating, trouble-shooting, and solving a wide variety of engineering issues.
  • Perform analysis and design of single line diagrams, substation relaying & metering diagrams (i.e. A.C. schematic diagrams), and D.C. Schematic diagrams.
  • Prepare engineering studies for client and peer review.
  • Perform independent reviews of work performed by others including calculations and drawing preparation.
  • Coordinate and provide guidance to other engineers, project managers, client personnel, and suppliers to ensure a complete and timely design.
  • Perform reviews of existing facilities to propose upgrades and replacements, and present findings and recommendations to clients and peers.
  • Develop your career via peer-learning through sharing of knowledge with other experienced engineers by way of Sargent & Lundy’s systems of process and associated “Communities of Practice.”
  • Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced engineers.
  • There is the potential for you to travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for construction coordination and field verification of designs.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • This position requires a Bachelor of Science Engineering degree.
  • 12 or more years experience designing substations at 138kV and above.
  • PE license.
  • Experience with serving as firm/client liaison in a support or lead engineering role.
  • Experience in writing and providing support documentation for relay calculations.
  • Experience with the design techniques, tools, and principles involved in the production of technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.
  • Proficiency with any of the following programs: SKM, ETAP, ASPEN, CDEGS, or vendor software.
  • Familiarity with design codes and standards, such as NEC, NESC, NEMA, IEEE and ANSI.
  • Experience with various vendor protective relay equipment typically used in substation protection, including SEL, ABB, GE, Areva, and Basler.
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • A Bachelor of Science Electrical Engineering degree is preferrable.
  • A degree from an ABET accredited engineering program.
  • Prior experience is desirable to include in-line, bus and equipment protection, breaker, transformer and similar equipment control, RTU and data concentrator based SCADA systems, telemetering and communications (fiber optics, microwave, power line carrier, etc.).
  • AutoCAD or MicroStation experience.
  • Construction and start-up experience.
  • Testing or commissioning experience.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, L&I
jobs.excerpt: Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare.
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead Integrations for Datavant's Legal & Insurance product offering. Integrations is the connective tissue between Datavant's platform and the systems of record our customers already run their business on. Your work will move medical records and insights between those customer systems and Datavant's platform, so customers can request, receive, and act on information without leaving the tools they work in every day. Today, this kind of connectivity and interoperability is often custom-built, manual, and fragmented. Our customers operate under tight timelines, incomplete information, and strict regulatory constraints. Your job will be to make integration standardized, reliable, and scalable.

In this role, you'll work closely with engineering, analytics, operations, and commercial teams to build the future of Datavant's Legal & Insurance offering. You'll define a common connector framework and a common connectivity layer, including modern approaches such as MCP, so that new integrations are configured and repeatable rather than bespoke. You'll make sure records and AI-generated analysis insights flow back into customer systems in a form people can use right away, and you'll shape the developer and integrator experience that makes Datavant easy to build on.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how a growing vertical connects to the customers it serves. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, rolls up their sleeves, drives clarity in complexity, and enjoys building at the intersection of healthcare, law, insurance, and data.

What You Will Do

  • Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for Legal & Insurance integrations.
  • Own the strategy for a common connector framework and connectivity layer, including MCP and other approaches that make Datavant's data and workflows accessible to AI agents, so integrations can be delivered faster and reused across customers.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between Datavant's platform and customer systems of record, defining how requests, records, and insights move in each direction while partnering with the teams that own the underlying workflows and data.
  • Deliver records and analysis insights, such as summaries and chronologies, back into customer systems so users can act on them inside their existing workflows, with less manual handoff and more workflow automation.
  • Build an excellent developer and integrator experience, including documentation, sandbox and testing tools, and self-service onboarding.
  • Partner with engineering, solutions, UX, CX, and operations to identify friction in today's integrations and translate it into scalable product solutions.
  • Improve outcomes across reliability, delivery success, time to integrate, share of volume flowing through integrations, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven record of leading complex, enterprise-grade, data-centric B2B SaaS products, ideally platform, API, or integration products.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver a product from concept to launch.
  • Experience with integrations, connectors, or data exchange products; bonus points for experience in healthcare data or in legal and insurance medical record workflows.
  • Technical depth to work through architecture and design tradeoffs with engineers, including APIs, webhooks, data models, authentication, and event-driven patterns.
  • Experience scoping and delivering integrations with enterprise customers and their systems of record.
  • Comfort designing products in highly regulated, high-stakes environments, balancing compliance with user experience.
  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, distills complexity into clear direction, and works well with engineering, analytics, and executive stakeholders to drive execution.

We are committed to building a diverse team of Datavanters who are all responsible for stewarding a high-performance culture in which all Datavanters belong and thrive. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

At Datavant our total rewards strategy powers a high-growth, high-performance, health technology company that rewards our employees for transforming health care through creating industry-defining data logistics products and services.

$170,000—$200,000 USD

jobs.title: Vulnerability Management & Security Assessment Engineer (L2) – Qualys VMDR
jobs.excerpt: About GruveGruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses.
jobs.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position summary:

Responsible for enterprise InfoSec operations covering vulnerability scanning and analysis, security assessments, control reviews, remediation validation, compliance reporting and incident management. The role focuses on technical troubleshooting, evidence validation, remediation coordination and continuous operational improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Vulnerability Management Operations (Scanning & Analysis)

  • Administer and troubleshoot vulnerability scans using Qualys VMDR or equivalent platforms.
  • Investigate scan failures, authentication issues, scanner connectivity and asset discovery gaps.
  • Analyze CVEs, CVSS severity, affected assets and vulnerability trends.
  • Validate asset coverage and investigate discrepancies in scan results.
  • Support risk-based prioritization based on severity, exploitability, asset criticality and remediation SLAs.
  • Investigate recurring findings and potential false positives; coordinate with Security SMEs as required.

Security Assessment & Review Support

  • Coordinate technical security assessments and infrastructure control reviews.
  • Review evidence for access management, patching, configuration compliance, logging and backup controls.
  • Validate submitted evidence against defined security requirements and assessment checklists.
  • Identify control gaps, missing evidence, policy deviations and compliance issues.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure and application owners to resolve assessment observations.
  • Maintain assessment records and escalate complex control interpretation issues to Security or Risk SMEs.

Remediation Tracking & SLA Monitoring (Including Rescan Validation)

  • Coordinate remediation activities with Server, Network, Database, Cloud and Application teams.
  • Track vulnerability aging, action owners, remediation deadlines and SLA breaches.
  • Review remediation plans and follow up on overdue critical and high-severity findings.
  • Validate remediation through rescans and review updated vulnerability status.
  • Investigate recurring vulnerabilities and discrepancies between remediation claims and scan results.
  • Track exceptions and escalate unresolved findings for appropriate risk review and approval.

Compliance Reporting & Audit Support

  • Generate vulnerability, remediation aging, assessment status and compliance reports.
  • Analyze trends, overdue findings, SLA breaches and recurring control deficiencies.
  • Maintain vulnerability registers, assessment trackers, dashboards and evidence repositories.
  • Support internal and external audits by coordinating and validating technical evidence.
  • Track compliance against organizational security policies and applicable control frameworks.
  • Recommend improvements to reporting accuracy, evidence quality and audit readiness.

Incident & Service Management (Including Improvement)

  • Troubleshoot complex vulnerability management platform and assessment workflow incidents.
  • Perform root-cause analysis for recurring scan failures, authentication issues and reporting discrepancies.
  • Manage incidents and service requests within defined SLAs using approved ITSM workflows.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management processes, as applicable.
  • Maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles and shift handover documentation; provide guidance to L1.
  • Identify automation opportunities, recurring operational gaps and process improvements; coordinate implementation through approved change procedures.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3–6 years of experience in cloud infrastructure operations, administration and production support across Microsoft Azure and/or AWS environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Qualys VMDR or equivalent vulnerability management tools.
  • Strong understanding of CVEs, CVSS, vulnerability scanning and remediation validation.
  • Experience with security assessments, technical evidence reviews and control gap identification.
  • Knowledge of Windows/Linux, networking, databases, cloud and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools, reporting and SLA management.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Global 24x7x365 support across APAC, EMEA and NLAM, with rotational shifts and follow-the-sun handovers.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

  • Qualys certification or exposure to Qualys Policy Compliance and related modules.
  • Knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks or other security frameworks.
  • Exposure to GRC platforms, audit management and risk exception workflows.

ISO Manager, InfoSec Solutions

Working at Thoropass

At Thoropass, we are revolutionizing the compliance and audit industry by integrating cutting-edge AI technology with expert human insight. Our team is dedicated to delivering

exceptional customer experiences and high-quality outcomes.

We’re driven by our mission to build a world that’s safer for consumers and ensuring compliance is never a blocker to innovation. By bringing together remarkably talented individuals, we’re looking to help the industry see compliance as an advantage. Join us as we collaborate to establish our platform as the world's leading choice for compliance and audit solutions.

Our Values

These are the behaviors and skills we look for in our people. Living by these values ensures we are building a team that can grow together and deliver the best possible outcomes for each other and our customers.

Take thoughtful risk: We solve for today while being considerate of tomorrow—creatively leveraging our tools and abilities to hit ambitious goals.

Be curious, ask, and learn: We always seek to better understand our industry and our customers. We don’t shy away from mistakes—using every bit of data to learn and iterate.

Win together: Compliance is a team sport. We proactively engage with one another and check our egos at the door in search of the best ideas.

Move the needle: Our goals are lofty for a reason. We set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and challenge ourselves to close the gap between those goals and results.

What We Do

Thoropass is transforming the landscape of security compliance and audits. As the only all-in-one platform that combines compliance automation software with a tech-enabled audit firm and pentest services, we offer a modern approach to information security compliance and audit. Our AI-powered solutions, such as First Pass AI, are designed to streamline compliance and accelerate audits for frameworks like SOC, PCI, ISO, HITRUST, HIPAA, and more. Thousands of companies trust Thoropass for high-quality audit and assessment services, delighting in a truly differentiated experience.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, Thoropass has rapidly expanded with $97M in funding from top investors including J.P. Morgan, PayPal Ventures, Fin Capital, Centana, Canapi, and Bain Capital. We operate as a virtual, global company with a presence in over 18 countries. With substantial growth in both customers and revenue, we are strategically positioned for continued expansion in 2025 and beyond.

About the Role

Forget everything you think you know about information security auditing. We’re on a mission to reinvent the outdated, clunky audit process—and we’re doing it with cutting-edge AI, automation, and a relentless commitment to customer success.

At Thoropass, auditing isn’t about manually sifting through endless evidence or checking boxes—it’s about solving complex security problems for our customers in smarter, faster, and more innovative ways. Investments in our AI-powered auditor tech stack and industry leading audit process, are designed to support you and drive efficiency in your work so you can focus on what matters the most.

As a Manager, InfoSec Solutions, you’ll own a portfolio of accounts, manage a high-performing team, and help shape the future of audit technology. In this role, you’ll not only ensure the delivery of exceptional ISO audits for emerging technology companies but also collaborate directly with our Labs team to advance our AI-powered audit engine.

This isn’t your typical audit job—it’s a chance to lead innovation, tackle complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on the industry.

What You'll Do

In this role, you’ll combine your audit expertise with a drive for innovation to execute audits at scale and advance our cutting-edge technology.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

  • Deliver World-Class Audits: Oversee the performance of ISO audits and ensure the accuracy, quality, and timely delivery of audit reports.
  • Lead and Mentor: Manage a team of junior to mid level auditors, fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and customer focus.
  • Drive Efficiency: Execute and iterate processes that make it possible to perform ISO audits at scale without sacrificing quality.
  • Enhance Customer Experience: Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the integrated audit experience for customers, making audits more seamless and insightful.
  • Be a Thought Leader: Provide expert guidance on information security and ISO standards, while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation.

Skillsets/ Requirements

You’re not just an auditor—you’re a problem solver, innovator, and leader who thrives in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment.

Here’s what makes you a perfect fit for this role:

  • ISO Expertise: Deep expertise in ISO reporting standards (ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001 etc), with 7+ years of experience performing ISO audits in an audit or consulting firm.
  • Technology Enthusiast: Familiarity with advanced cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure) and a passion for leveraging technology to solve problems.
  • Collaborative Leader: Proven ability to manage and mentor a team, while working cross-functionally to achieve big-picture goals.
  • Problem Solver: Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to break down complex problems into actionable solutions.
  • Forward-Thinking: A visionary who sees how AI and automation can transform the audit process and is eager to help lead that transformation.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Innovate with Impact: Work at the cutting edge of audit technology, collaborating to advance our AI engine and redefine how audits are done.

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in the DACH region: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

We have offices in Paris and Amsterdam, and offer remote working from Germany, France, the Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

You should apply if

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You’re excited by AI: you’ll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in German
  • AI Literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a 50 State Licensed Per Diem On-Call Nurse, you will be the voice Daymark patients reach when they call overnight or on the weekend. Serving patients across the country, you will listen to what is going on, help them understand their options, and connect them to the right next step.

This is a remote, on-call role built around a rotating schedule. Your focus is making sure no patient feels alone with a question, and making sure every after-hours contact is handed off cleanly to the patient’s care team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Be the First Point of Contact After Hours. Answer inbound calls from patients and caregivers, bringing a warm, steady presence to people who may be anxious, uncomfortable, or unsure what to do next.
  • Listen, Clarify, and Guide. Understand the patient’s concern through conversation, review the relevant context in their record, and use Daymark’s established pathways and protocols to help the patient understand what their concern may mean and what to do next. Help patients reach the appropriate resource at the moment, including guidance they can act on at home, contact with their treating oncology practice, or escalating care.
  • Coordinate and Hand Off. Document each contact in the EHR and communicate open items through team channels.
  • Follow Operational Standards. Adhere to Daymark’s policies, procedures, and documentation standards, including confidentiality of all patient health information in accordance with HIPAA.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Licensure: An active, unrestricted Registered Nurse license with multi-state (Nurse Licensure Compact) privileges is required. Current licensure in additional non-compact states (e.g., California, Michigan, New York, etc.) is preferred. Daymark may sponsor additional state licensure for this role.
  • Experience: A minimum of 3 years of nursing experience, with oncology experience required. Experience on a nurse advice line, in telephone navigation or triage, or in remote patient support is strongly preferred.
  • Sound Judgment & Communication: Ability to understand a patient’s concern through conversation and record review. A warm, clear telephone presence with patients and caregivers, and structured communication when coordinating with providers or handing off to the care team.
  • Comfort Working Independently: Confident handling calls on your own, following clear protocols and escalation paths.
  • Comfort with Technology: Proficiency with EHR systems and comfort with tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, and cloud-based phone platforms.
  • Patient-Centric Approach: A deep commitment to Daymark’s mission to support cancer patients with dignity and compassion.
  • Reliability: Dependable availability during scheduled on-call weeks and timely responsiveness to patient calls.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a per diem, fully remote role. Coverage follows a rotating on-call schedule that includes weeknight overnights as well as weekends. Holiday coverage may be requested. Specific scheduling expectations and compensation details will be discussed during the interview process, however the hours of coverage need are: Weeknights: 5pm-8:30am ET and Weekends: 8pm Friday - 8:30am Monday ET. Per diem employees are not eligible for benefits unless otherwise specified by organizational policy.

Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

All Daymark Health patient-facing roles require Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and compliance with Daymark's Employee Vaccination and Testing policy. Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.

All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.

[Remote] Senior Recruiter Role Overview

Our firm, a disruptor in the recruiting space, is looking for someone who is ready to roll up their sleeves and dive right into the growing number of client searches - a detail oriented, strong communicator will find themselves working across a variety of companies and industries. Our Sourcing Specialists handle 95% of all sourcing and Recruiting Assistants handle initial candidate activity. Your key responsibilities will be to engage interested candidates and consult clients. While you’ll be working from home, you will still be in a highly visible role. Everyone at the company will see and feel the impact of your work every day.

The [Remote] Senior Recruiter Role

We are looking for a Senior Recruiter who has experience working to fill a wide range of roles (including technical) to assist us as we grow our business nationally. You will help:

  • Oversee data collection (you may do some but we will have resources to help with the bulk of candidate research)
    • Oversee cold outreach of candidates (you may do a little but the expectation is our team will do >95% of it)
    • Review interested candidates for their fit; phone screen candidates
    • Make recommendations on which candidates are appropriate for client interviews
    • Consult clients on role and candidate expectations

The Perfect [Remote] Senior Recruiter Candidate Will

  • Have worked with a variety of roles, across industries and seniority levels
    • Has sold recruiting services in the past, but no longer interested in that aspect of the industry (you won’t be selling here)
    • Be comfortable and experienced with many projects at once & capable of keeping details straight

• Truly enjoy engaging with people

  • Have worked extensively in an ATS like Bullhorn or Trakstar (we use Trakstar)
    • Be a fun person who often finds themselves trying to take on more responsibility and build better systems to get the job done

Who Will Be Successful

  • You must be a self-starter, driven to help the company grow
    • You must be available during the hours of 8:45 AM and 5:15 PM Eastern (US)
    • You have 10+ years of recruiting experience
    • You know how to adapt your approach to fit the role, making practical data and experience driven decisions

Beyond the Bullets

Your favorite part about the job is speaking with people. The fast connections. You chase the rush of having a submittal. You chew through resumes with confidence – you know a fit when you see it. You can’t help but keep those pending resumes to review down to 0. You have a variety of interests and enjoy absorbing information because you will need to – hopping off one call for an agricultural client to the next client in fintech. You’re excited that you’ll have support on sourcing and scheduling so you can spend time on what you enjoy and are good at. While you’re supported, you also like that you’ll be left to make your own decisions throughout the day.

The squad: Database Observability

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.

  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.

jobs.description:
About the team

Support Engineering is part of Customer Engineering and Success at CircleCI. Our team works around the clock across North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe to deliver technical support for our product.

We build and manage AI agents that answer customer questions and solve technical problems. People step in when a problem needs deeper work. We share what we learn with Product and Engineering to make CircleCI better.

About the role

As a Support Engineer, you help our customers get back to building quickly. You will build and manage the AI agents that support CircleCI customers. You test how well the agents work, fix what they get wrong, and keep their knowledge current. You also solve hard customer problems that agents cannot yet solve.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and improve AI support agents. This includes their instructions, workflows, and the knowledge they use.
  • Test agent answers for accuracy and clarity. Fix errors and record what you learn.
  • Investigate customer problems that need a person. Use logs, code tools, and monitoring data to find the cause.
  • Write and update help articles so customers and agents can find correct answers.
  • Report bugs and incidents. During an incident, give customers clear and timely updates.
  • Share customer feedback with Product and Engineering.
  • Meet response targets on the cases you own.
  • You describe what the product can and cannot do. We do not oversell.
  • Join the on-call rotation.

What You'll Bring:

  • 2 or more years in technical product support or software engineering
  • Hands-on use of AI tools at work. You write clear instructions for AI, review the results, and take responsibility for them. You have built or tested AI agents or workflows.
  • Experience finding the cause of problems in cloud or distributed systems. You read logs to trace what went wrong.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. You have used tools like kubectl to find why an application or cluster is failing.
  • Experience supporting self-hosted or on-premises software. You have used tools like Helm and support bundles to find why an installation is failing.
  • Hands-on experience with build, test, and deploy automation. You have written automated tests and set up a CI/CD pipeline for a project.
  • Knowledge of iOS application testing and code signing.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, Git, and the Linux command line. You can write scripts to reproduce problems.
  • Knowledge of networking and security basics.
  • Experience troubleshooting single sign-on (SSO), OAuth, and access controls. You have worked with identity providers and code hosting sign-in.
  • Clear writing and speaking. You can explain technical ideas to different audiences.
  • Experience working across time zones, with clear handoffs.

Nice to have

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.
  • Experience with tracing and monitoring tools.
  • Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, including OIDC trust policies.
  • Experience with self-hosted build runners, or with Windows, macOS, or Arm build environments.
  • Experience with security response, such as vulnerability (CVE) triage, certificate problems, or abuse reports.
United Kingdom Base Pay Range
£62,000—£77,250 GBP

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.excerpt: At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters. As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us.
jobs.description:
At Woolpert, you’ll do work that matters.

As a leading global architecture, engineering, and geospatial firm, we help clients solve complex challenges that shape communities, strengthen critical infrastructure, advance technology, and improve the world around us. Here, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, tackle meaningful projects, and build a career defined by growth, opportunity, and impact.

Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring a Digital Asset Manager to join our dynamic Proposals Team. This position reports to the Director of Proposals. The Digital Asset Manager serves as the primary administrator and day-to-day owner of Woolpert's digital asset management (DAM) platform, including asset intake, metadata and taxonomy standards, permissions, digital rights documentation, integrations, reporting, and user enablement. This position develops, applies, and improves governance standards, taxonomies, and workflows that keep project imagery, graphics, video, presentations, resumes, and marketing content accurate, well organized, and easy to find and reuse across the firm. Work is complex and important to the organization and is performed with minimal supervision and wide latitude for independent judgment, including resolving cross-system issues, partnering directly with vendors and system owners, and assisting less-experienced team members.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

  • Administers and maintains the DAM platform end to end, including configuration, asset intake, cataloging, permissions, distribution, retention, and archival, and resolves issues with limited oversight.
  • Develops, documents, and maintains project-level and asset-level metadata standards, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, and naming conventions, and leads periodic reviews to keep them current.
  • Establishes and applies quality-review criteria for incoming assets, evaluating completeness, duplication, and compliance, and confirms required metadata and usage information are captured before publication.
  • Plans and conducts audits of asset collections to identify, correct, retire, or archive inaccurate, duplicate, or obsolete assets, and recommends corrective actions to content owners.
  • Leads the ingestion, normalization, and rationalization of legacy or acquired asset collections, coordinating timelines and requirements with contributing teams.
  • Defines and enforces clear distinctions among working files, final approved assets, restricted materials, and archival records.
  • Maintains rights-related metadata and supporting documentation, including copyright, licensing, permissions, usage restrictions, and image credits, and partners with Legal and Communications to resolve higher-risk usage questions.
  • Oversees the accuracy of employee profiles, headshots, project experience, and resume-related content maintained in or supplied to the DAM, and works with data owners to resolve gaps.
  • Monitors and troubleshoots data flows between the DAM and connected enterprise, proposal, and content-management systems, and serves as a day-to-day point of contact with system owners and vendors on configuration, defects, and enhancements.
  • Diagnoses and resolves complex user, system, and workflow issues, escalating only those requiring enterprise-level decisions or contractual action.
  • Designs and delivers user training, and creates and maintains user guides, workflow documentation, and quick-reference materials.
  • Provides expert user support and guidance on search, metadata, permissions, rights, and asset-distribution practices.
  • Analyzes and reports on DAM adoption, asset usage, data completeness, and search activity, and translates findings into recommendations that improve reuse and content quality.
  • Recommends and implements approved improvements to taxonomy, configuration, documentation, training, and workflows, and evaluates new capabilities for fit.
  • Assists and provides work direction to less-experienced team members, contractors, or contributors supporting the DAM.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

  • 5 years of experience in digital asset management, content or knowledge management, records/library services, or a comparable enterprise information system.
  • Experience developing and applying metadata, taxonomy, or cataloging standards to digital content.
  • Experience administering or serving as a primary user of an enterprise DAM, content management, or knowledge management platform.
  • Advanced knowledge of digital asset management concepts, including metadata, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, file formats, and asset lifecycle practices.
  • Ability to develop, document, and enforce governance standards, procedures, and workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills when handling high volumes of content.
  • Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex system, workflow, and user issues, including cross-system problems.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to train, advise, and influence nontechnical users and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to analyze usage and adoption data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate's degree or higher in library science, information science, information management, digital media, archives, communications, marketing technology, or a related field preferred.
  • 7 or more years of experience administering a digital asset management, content management, or knowledge management platform.
  • Experience leading system integrations, APIs, marketing technology, proposal technology, or AI-enabled content workflows.
  • Experience in an architecture, engineering, geospatial, consulting, or other professional-services environment.
  • Experience developing training programs and supporting enterprise users at scale.
  • Experience supporting DAM migrations or post-acquisition content integrations

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, OR TRAINING:

  • DAM, taxonomy, metadata, or information governance training or certification preferred.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of copyright, licensing, permissions, and digital rights management practices.
  • Familiarity with information architecture and data-quality management concepts.
  • Familiarity with documentation and metadata requirements for AI-generated and AI-edited assets.

Travel Requirements:

  • Must be able to travel up to 5% of the time for business purposes.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

  • Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).
  • Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.
  • Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.
  • Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.
  • Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a senior, client-facing Engagement Manager who owns the client's success from the first scoping conversation through final acceptance.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior, client-facing Engagement Manager who owns the client's success from the first scoping conversation through final acceptance.

This is a services-led role that starts before the contract is signed. Once the work is underway, you are the person the client holds accountable for the outcome, and the person Mirantis holds accountable for delivering it.

Our solutions are highly customized, and the engagements you run will span cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and AI workloads for both enterprise clients and cloud service providers. You may run multiple engagements at once, or a single large multi-workstream program where complexity warrants it, holding Mirantis, client, and third-party teams to a common schedule while keeping the critical path clear and the commercial health of the engagement intact.

The environment is fast-evolving and frequently ambiguous. Bringing order to it is the job. You'll be the calm center of the engagement — the person who holds client confidence when the schedule slips, who escalates early rather than absorbing problems quietly, and who can move from a working session with engineers to a C-level update without changing gears.

What You'll Do

  • Own the client's success end to end — from pre-sales scoping and solution design through contract, pilot, delivery, and acceptance — across both Enterprise and Cloud Service Provider (CSP) engagements.

  • Serve as the client's primary point of contact and the senior Mirantis voice on the engagement, building trust and sustaining client confidence under delivery pressure.

  • Partner with sales, solution architects, and engineering during pre-sales to scope and estimate custom work, author the delivery sections of the statement of work, and coordinate the internal teams needed to win the opportunity.

  • Run multiple concurrent client engagements, or a single large multi-workstream program where complexity and time commitment warrant it.

  • Translate client business objectives into executable plans, holding Mirantis, client, and third-party teams to a common schedule and a shared set of commitments.

  • Deliver in line with Mirantis delivery procedures — maintaining RAID logs, integrated plans and schedules, and providing clear, concise status reporting — applying the level of rigor the engagement warrants, whether the work is phased or iterative, and actively managing the critical path to remove blockers before they affect committed dates.

  • Manage technical delivery in coordination with Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to meet client objectives.

  • Ensure client readiness by coordinating the infrastructure, dependencies, and prerequisites the client owns, and hold third-party vendors and subcontractors to their timeline and quality commitments.

  • Own the commercial health of the engagement — scope, change, and the delivery inputs that drive its financial performance — identifying and documenting scope creep as it arises, driving the change order process, and partnering with Services Operations on measurement and reporting.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, ensuring all stakeholders have clear visibility, and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.

  • Report status across the full stakeholder spectrum, from project teams to Mirantis and client executive and C-level leadership.

  • Identify opportunities through ongoing delivery to expand Mirantis’ engagement with the client, and work with Sales to develop follow-on work based on client needs, emerging requirements, and evolving business priorities.

  • Improve delivery processes and collateral, and mentor the project managers on the team.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in project or program management leading complex, client-facing solution implementations in a professional services, consulting, or technology vendor environment.

  • Experience delivering enterprise infrastructure or cloud platform implementations — you understand what it takes to stand up, integrate, and get acceptance on infrastructure in a client environment.

  • Experience running multi-party delivery across client teams, third-party vendors and subcontractors, and internal product and engineering organizations distributed across time zones.

  • Pre-sales experience: scoping and estimating custom work, and authoring the delivery sections of statements of work.

  • Commercial ownership of engagements — scope control, change orders, and accountability for how an engagement performs financially.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to engage credibly with engineers and architects on tradeoffs, dependencies, and risk.

  • Demonstrated ownership of client outcomes. You have been accountable when a program succeeded or failed, not only the person tracking it.

  • A pragmatic, outcome-driven mindset - you focus on delivering value, not just managing tasks

  • Bachelor's degree in a business or technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or similar.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure solutions based on Kubernetes, OpenStack, and/or hybrid cloud concepts.

  • Familiarity with AI concepts — including data pipelines, LLMs, and model lifecycle — and experience delivering projects related to them.

  • Experience delivering projects for data center environments.

  • Experience managing vendor or subcontractor relationships as part of project delivery.

  • Familiarity with using AI tools and agents to streamline process execution and reporting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engagements deliver to scope, schedule, and quality — and where constraints emerge, expectations are managed early enough that client trust holds.

  • Engagements perform to their financial plan, with scope change identified, documented, and converted into change orders rather than absorbed.

  • Plans, RAID logs, and reporting are current and trusted, and risks reach leadership before they affect committed dates.

  • Delivered results generate follow-on work, and you help shape what comes next.

Location and Travel

This is a remote role with moderate travel, typically 10–25%, for client engagements, workshops, and internal team meetings. Travel may be international. Candidates must be willing and able to travel internationally, including to the United States, and to hold or obtain the documentation required to do so. You may support clients globally, with some flexibility in working hours to accommodate client and delivery team time zones.

Why Mirantis

  • Work with a global leader in hybrid cloud, open-source infrastructure, enterprise AI cloud, and neocloud.

  • Partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers on next-generation platform and AI initiatives.

  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous growth.

  • Competitive compensation, strong benefits, and stock options.

  • Work for an established leader in the Cloud Native industry with over 800 enterprise customers, HQ’d in Silicon Valley.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented, and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune and Global 2000 customers implement modern open-source cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Flexible working schedule and remote / or hybrid work environment.
  • Receive a competitive compensation package.

Mirantis ranked in the top 50 of G2's Best IT Cloud Products of 2021!

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis helps organizations ship code faster on public and private clouds. The company provides a public cloud experience on any infrastructure from the data center to the edge. With Lens and the Mirantis Cloud Native Platform, Mirantis empowers a new breed of Kubernetes developers by removing infrastructure and operations complexity and providing one cohesive cloud experience for complete app and devops portability, a single pane of glass, and automated full-stack lifecycle management with continuous updates.

Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at .

Scope of the Role

The Software Engineer II is a mid-level technical contributor in the organization who is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions. They are developing and building the applications and systems that run the company. This could be the backend systems, the frontend user experience, the products, or the tools to keep the business running. They may work independently or as part of a team and contribute to the technical direction of the software engineering department. The impact they should have on the company is to deliver high-quality software products that meet the needs of customers and stakeholders, while also continuing to develop their technical skills and knowledge. They should have a keen focus on learning and professional development, as well as a willingness to collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
