What we are looking for:

Amsive is looking for an Associate Director, Social & Influencer Strategist to own a portfolio of client accounts, develop organic social and influencer strategies, and guide the team responsible for day-to-day execution. This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who can turn business goals and audience insights into clear plans, give useful creative direction, and keep multiple brands moving forward.

The Associate Director is accountable for the strategic quality, delivery, and performance of assigned social and influencer programs. Working with department leadership, Client Experience (CX), project management, creative, and channel specialists, this person sets account priorities, coaches team members, reviews work, and helps resolve challenges before they affect the client.

What you will be doing:

Own assigned social and influencer accounts

  • Lead assigned accounts from discovery and planning through execution, reporting, and ongoing optimization. Understand each client’s business, audience, brand voice, scope, and measures of success.
  • Serve as the primary social and influencer subject matter lead for assigned clients. Build trust through clear recommendations, proactive ideas, and consistent follow-through.
  • Lead strategy presentations, planning discussions, and performance reviews. Translate results into practical decisions about content, platforms, creators, and investment.
  • Partner with CX on client communication and relationship coordination, and with project management on schedules, dependencies, and approvals. Bring the strategic recommendations and delivery decisions needed to move the work forward.

Develop organic social strategy

  • Build organic social strategies grounded in audience research, social listening, competitive analysis, brand positioning, and client objectives.

  • Translate strategy into clear briefs, content calendars, campaign concepts, and actionable direction for social managers, creators, designers, and copywriters.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

About the Role

As Lead Product Manager for Agentic Commerce, you'll define what agentic payments and rewards look like at Imprint, then go build it. This is a zero-to-one role: you'll run a small skunkworks team that ships in tight increments, puts new products in front of real users fast, and lets the market tell us what works.

We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply fluent in payments, and genuinely obsessed with AI agents. You don't just follow the space; you use agents every day and build with them yourself.

Agentic Commerce is a small, high-autonomy team inside Imprint's payments organization. It operates like a startup within the company: few dependencies, short cycles, and a bias toward shipping something real over polishing a plan.

You'll report to the product leader for Payments, Risk and Customer Operations, and partner day to day with engineers on our payments and messaging platform. You'll also work closely with partnerships, risk, compliance and our brand partners to turn experiments into products that can run at scale.

The Opportunity

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for agentic commerce at Imprint, from how agents initiate and authorize payments to how cardholders use agents to earn and redeem rewards.

  • Run a fast build-measure-learn loop: frame a bet, ship the smallest version that tests it, read the signal, and decide whether to scale, pivot or kill it.

  • Prototype hands-on with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor and similar) to get from idea to something users can touch in days, not quarters.

  • Get close to the power users who already use agents to optimize their spending and rewards, and turn what you learn into products they'd pay attention to.

  • Track the agentic payments ecosystem (network and wallet agent programs, agent payment protocols, tokenization) and decide where Imprint should build, partner or wait.

  • Work with risk, compliance and our bank partners to design agent-initiated payment flows that are safe and auditable from day one.

  • Make the case for what's working to leadership and brand partners, and help shape how Imprint takes agentic products to market.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: you've talked to dozens of power users and partners, picked the first two or three bets, and shipped at least one experiment to real users.

  • First 6 months: a repeatable cadence of small releases, with clear evidence on which agentic use cases drive engagement, spend or rewards value.

  • First 12 months: at least one agentic product live with brand partners, and a point of view on agentic commerce that shapes Imprint's broader product strategy.

Your Profile

  • 8+ years building products, as a product manager, founder or both, with a track record of taking something from zero to real usage.

  • Strong payments experience: card networks, issuing, acquiring, tokenization, wallets or money movement. You understand how a transaction actually flows and where the hard problems live.

  • Demonstrated high agency in ambiguous environments. You've been handed a blank page with no team, playbook or clear owner and delivered measurable impact anyway.

  • A genuine, hands-on passion for AI agents, shown through what you've built, shipped or tinkered with, not just what you've read.

  • Fluency with core LLM and agent concepts (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails) and the judgment to turn them into reliable products that handle real money.

  • Comfort prototyping with modern AI-native tools and working directly in code alongside engineers.

  • Clear, concise communication. You can explain a complex system to an engineer, a bank partner and an executive in the same afternoon.

We care more about what you've done than how your resume is titled. If you meet most of these and are excited by the role, we encourage you to apply.

Bonus Points

  • You've founded a company, ideally after starting your career as a PM, and spent time building in payments along the way.

  • You were the first PM at an early-stage startup.

  • You've built or shipped an agent, agent integration or agentic payments product.

  • Experience with credit cards, rewards or loyalty programs.

  • You're a rewards optimizer yourself, and you already have agents doing some of that work for you.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $190K - $210K

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As an Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist, you’ll help ensure Samsara’s invoices and vendor payments are processed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies. You’ll report to the Accounts Payable Manager and support the procure-to-pay process.

You’ll partner with colleagues across the company and with vendors to resolve questions, keep payments moving, and improve AP processes as Samsara grows.

This role can be based in an office or fully remote within Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to make a real-world impact. Samsara helps the industries that power our world operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably. Your work will help support the teams and processes behind that mission.
  • You’re motivated to grow. You’re interested in building your AP expertise, taking ownership of your development, and learning as the business evolves.
  • You enjoy improving how work gets done. You look for practical ways to make processes clearer, more efficient, and ready to scale.
  • You value working as a team. You build respectful partnerships, communicate openly, and contribute to an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Invoice and payment processing

    • Process a high volume of invoices accurately and on time.
    • Process invoices in multiple currencies for domestic and international vendors.
    • Partner with colleagues across the company to ensure invoices and payments are processed appropriately and in line with company policies and procedures.
    • Support weekly payment runs and help ensure vendors are paid on time.

    Vendor management

    • Respond to vendor inquiries through the company’s email management tool.
    • Maintain accurate accounts payable vendor records.

    Reporting, month-end close, and cross-functional initiatives

    • Reconcile account statements.
    • Support the monthly AP close, including the soft-close process, AP aging reviews, and accrual preparation.
    • Assist with the AP forecast.
    • Prepare analyses, schedules, and presentations to support audits and tax filings.

    Processes, systems, and controls

    • Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and systems, and recommend changes that support scale.
    • Document AP processes in accordance with policies and internal controls.
    • Perform and maintain AP SOX and operational controls, and follow applicable policies and internal controls.
    • Model Samsara’s cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2–3 years of accounts payable experience.
  • Knowledge of basic accounting principles.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of transactions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to partner with business stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify and help resolve issues.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or business administration.
  • Experience with ERP systems; NetSuite experience is preferred.
  • Zendesk experience.
  • SOX compliance experience.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships

Job Details

Role: Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships
Department: Business Development

Compensation: $112,000 - $163,000 CAD + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!


About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.


The Role

Joining Thrive’s Business Development department as Associate Director, Strategic Partnerships, you’ll be one of Thrive’s senior technical voices in sales moments. You’ll be involved in business development calls, RFPs, and audits across a range of different kinds of opportunities. With a background in paid media, you’ll articulate Thrive’s values, differentiators, and the driving principles behind managing modern paid media campaigns. You’ll partner with our team to qualify opportunities, execute sales workflows, and present and defend recommendations in high-stakes rooms. You’ll translate complex ad platform, measurement, and creative data into clear, credible insights tied to client business outcomes. Internally, you’ll own Thrive’s audit discipline, coach the stakeholders who contribute to it, and help the team develop content for use within the sales process and other company functions. Externally, you’ll participate in client travel, events, and key moments for existing clients.

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Set the standard for Thrive's technical audit discipline across paid media, measurement, and creative. Own the quality of strategic audits and RFP responses, ensuring recommendations are evidence-based, actionable, and tied to client outcomes.
  • Client: Build client confidence as a senior technical advocate throughout the new business process and existing partnerships. Present and defend strategic recommendations to executive stakeholders, translating complex technical findings into clear business insights.
  • People: Build audit capability across Thrive by coaching cross-functional contributors across Performance, Creative, Data, and Strategy. Establish quality standards, provide feedback, and develop resources that strengthen the team's technical expertise and delivery.
  • Company: Support Thrive's growth by strengthening how the company qualifies and wins new business opportunities. Partner with Business Development leaders to shape sales strategy, identify client growth opportunities, and inform service positioning and market differentiation.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days, you’ll learn Thrive’s sales process and performance marketing approach, including observing our audit process, how we think about multichannel strategies that generate leads and revenue for our most complex clients, and begin leading technical components of calls, as well as begin leading sales-focused audits with some support.
  • In your first 60 days, you’ll lead technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven audits and RFPs.
  • In your first 90 days, you’ll own all technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven audits and RFPs from back-end analysis through to pitch.

Qualifications

  • You’ve directly managed, audited, and optimized enterprise paid media programs with at least $250,000 USD in monthly spend, across e-commerce and/or demand generation.
  • You’re recognized as a performance marketing expert, with hands-on depth in Google Ads, Meta, and at least two other major platforms (e.g., Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Amazon, programmatic/DSPs).
  • You have a strong understanding of measurement: incrementality and lift testing, MMM, attribution, server-side and conversion tracking, and GA4 or equivalent analytics.
  • You’ve led audits end-to-end and spearheaded the technical components of the sales process, turning account-level data into insights and prioritized recommendations.
  • You have excellent analytical skills: you’re comfortable working through large datasets, building forecasts and budget scenarios, and pulling unique insights from both quantitative and qualitative data.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and have the ability to make complex technical findings clear and persuasive for any audience.
  • You’ve presented and defended recommendations to C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders in high-stakes new-business and expansion conversations.
  • You’ve coordinated sales, strategy, media, creative, and data contributors across audits and RFPs, owning scope, timelines, narrative, and quality.


---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

jobs.title: Manager of Global Strategic Finance
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Manager, Global Strategic Finance to drive execution of global financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes that support decision-making across our organization.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Manager, Global Strategic Finance to drive execution of global financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes that support decision-making across our organization.


This finance position will focus on the operationalization of our global planning and forecasting cycle, consolidation accuracy, internal reporting, and financial governance. You will partner with business leaders across all regions and functions to collect planning data, validate assumptions, and deliver financial visibility that supports operational and strategic decision-making. This role reports to the Director of Global Strategic Finance and works cross-functionally with Finance Operations, Accounting, and business unit leadership.


You will be the execution backbone of the global financial planning process—ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and consistency across a complex, multi-region organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute global financial planning and forecasting cycle — Manage the mechanics of annual budgeting and quarterly rolling forecasts; coordinate planning submissions across business units and geographies; validate data quality, challenge assumptions, and consolidate forecasts into a unified plan; manage planning calendar, timelines, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support global consolidation and close processes — Assist with P&L consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and month/quarter/year-end close activities; prepare consolidation workpapers and variance analysis; coordinate with regional finance teams and Accounting to ensure accuracy; support preparation of GAAP and management reporting views.
  • Develop and maintain financial reporting dashboards and KPI trackers — Build and refresh internal dashboards tracking key financial KPIs, budget vs. actual, and performance trends; highlight variance drivers and business performance insights; support monthly management reporting and internal governance meetings.
  • Monitor covenant and liquidity metrics — Track debt covenants, cash position, and liquidity metrics; prepare monthly covenant tracking reports; flag potential covenant risks early; support liquidity forecasting and treasury coordination.
  • Partner with business units on planning and forecast accuracy — Work with regional finance leads and business unit managers to validate planning assumptions, educate on forecasting methodology, and improve forecast accuracy over time; resolve data discrepancies and support root cause analysis.
  • Support financial modeling and scenario analysis — Build and maintain financial models supporting budget vs. actual analysis, sensitivity analyses, and scenario planning; assist in developing base case and alternative scenarios for internal governance discussions.
  • Drive process improvements and system enhancements — Identify opportunities to streamline planning processes, improve data quality, and enhance forecasting systems; work with IT and Finance Operations to implement tools and automation that reduce manual work and improve accuracy; leverage AI and automation tools to increase efficiency.
  • Support financial controls and data governance — Ensure data integrity in planning systems; support Accounting in reconciliations and validations; document planning assumptions and methodology; partner with Finance Operations to maintain strong process controls.

Skills & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of finance experience — including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and business partnering.
  • FP&A or corporate finance experience — In a strategic finance, financial planning, or corporate finance function.
  • Global and/or multi-entity finance experience preferred — Comfortable working across regions, entities, and consolidation scenarios.
  • EPM proficiency preferred — Experience with EPM planning tools (Adaptive Insights, Vena, Hyperion, Anaplan, etc.); willingness to learn new systems is essential.
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills — Ability to build financial models, perform variance analysis, and develop scenarios; advanced Excel skills required.
  • Attention to detail and process discipline — Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple competing deadlines, and commitment to accuracy in financial reporting.
  • Business partnering skills — Ability to work effectively with business leaders, finance teams across regions, and cross-functional stakeholders; comfort building relationships and managing expectations.
  • Strong communication skills — Ability to clearly explain financial data and insights to both finance and non-finance audiences; comfort presenting findings to leadership.
  • Problem-solving mindset — Ability to identify issues, dig into root causes, and recommend solutions; comfort with ambiguity and iteration.
  • AI and automation fluency — Comfort using LLM tools and AI-assisted applications to improve forecasting accuracy, automate manual processes, and enhance data quality; experience evaluating or implementing AI-driven efficiency tools is a plus.
  • ERP experience preferred — Familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).
  • MBA or CPA is a plus — Signals commitment to financial rigor and professional development.
  • PE-backed or growth-stage SaaS experience — Preferred.

About Us

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you! 

Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

You will partner with stakeholders to understand the unique needs of their iteration workflows and author bespoke tools using C++ within the Unreal editor and in-game environments that will accelerate those pipelines. jobs.excerpt: We are building a partner program from scratch.  Our Head of Channel recruits the partners and decides how the program runs.
jobs.description:
We are building a partner program from scratch. Our Head of Channel recruits the partners and decides how the program runs. You make sure it runs.

That means every referral gets logged, every registered deal gets a decision, and every partner-sourced opportunity can be traced back to the partner who sent it. When a partner asks where their deal stands, you know the answer before they finish the email.

This is an inside role that also travels. When you are not at an event, you will spend most of your time in our CRM, our partner tracking tools, and spreadsheets that other people depend on. Expect some of the processes you build in your first quarter to be rewritten by your second. The program will grow faster than its first version.

We will judge this role on whether the partner pipeline is accurate, current, and moving.

What You'll Own

  • Partner records. Onboard new partners into our systems, keep agreements, contacts, and tiers current, and close out partners who go quiet.
  • Deal registration. Receive registrations, check them for conflicts with existing opportunities, route them for a decision, and tell the partner the outcome. Quickly, and in writing.
  • Pipeline hygiene. Every partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunity carries the right source, the right partner, and the right stage. You find the ones that do not and fix them with the owner.
  • Reporting. Build and run the weekly partner pipeline report for our scorecard. When a number moves, know why before someone asks.
  • Referral payouts. Track what each partner has earned under their agreement and prepare payouts for approval and accounting. You calculate. You do not approve.
  • Event follow-through. Handle registrations, badge lists, and shipping for the events the Head of Channel picks, then get every contact from the event into the CRM within the week. A conference without follow-up is a very expensive trip.
  • Partner communications. Send program updates, distribute enablement materials built with marketing, and keep the partner contact list clean enough that the right person gets the right email.

What Comes to Us

The Head of Channel decides which partners we sign, which events we attend, and which tools we use. Partner agreements, referral fees, and payouts are approved by the CEO.

You will not sell. When a partner brings a deal, our sales team works it, and you keep the record of it straight from first referral to close.

If something in a registration or a payout looks wrong, flag it. Catching it is part of the job, and nobody here will be annoyed that you did.

REQUIRED

  • One to two years in sales operations, channel operations, revenue operations, or partner support at a B2B technology company

  • Daily working experience in a CRM such as Zoho, HubSpot, or Salesforce

  • Willingness to travel up to 30 percent of the time

  • Spreadsheet skills strong enough to build a report someone else can trust

  • Written communication that partners can act on without a follow-up call

  • Attention to detail that holds up on the hundredth record, not just the first

  • CCP certification within twelve months of hire, supported by Agile IT

  • U.S. person status, required by the nature of our customers' work

PREFERRED

  • Experience with a partner relationship management platform

  • Experience coordinating trade shows or conferences

  • Familiarity with the Microsoft partner ecosystem

  • Exposure to defense, federal, or another regulated market

  • Experience with Zoho or Autotask

Additional Information:

  • Salary: $70,304 to $85,000 per year. The final offer depends on experience, skills and location.

  • Comprehensive benefits package (medical, retirement plan, PTO, professional development).

  • Work environment: This role is remote, with travel up to 30 percent of the time, mostly to the partner events on our calendar. We meet in person as a full company once a year, and the next one is in San Diego in early 2027.

  • You will report to our Head of Channel.

  • You will be the second person on a channel team of two. The upside is that you will see how a partner program gets built from the inside. The cost is that some days you will also be the person who finds out what does not work yet.

As one of six original AOS-G resellers for GCC High, we help defense contractors meet CMMC compliance and operate securely in Microsoft cloud environments. Our customers build fighter jet components, naval propulsion systems, satellite payloads, and aerospace platforms that support the Department of War. Other:

Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
Nomios' mission is to build a 'secure and connected' future. Organisations across Europe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures. In support of our continued UK growth, we are seeking an experienced SOC Analyst to join our 24/7 Security Operations Centre. Candidates must have previous hands-on SOC experience, with a strong preference for experience gained within a managed service provider (MSP) or managed security service provider (MSSP) supporting multiple customer environments.

Please note: this role has a planned start date of January 2027. We welcome applications from candidates who can commence employment at that time.

You will be working across a diverse set of customer environments as part of our Security Operations Centre, focusing on investigation, understanding attacker behaviour and contributing to the continual improvement of SOC capabilities.

Your role as Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analyst

As a 24/7 SOC Analyst, you will be on the frontline of our Security Operations Centre, monitoring, investigating and escalating security events across multiple customer environments. You will apply established SOC experience from day one, work confidently within customer-specific workflows and service commitments, and collaborate with Senior and Lead Analysts on complex investigations. You will use platforms including Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, Palo Alto Networks XSIAM, XDR and XSOAR, SentinelOne, CrowdStrike Falcon and Google SecOps to establish what happened, how activity progressed and what action is required.

You will join a modern, continuously evolving SOC run by people who are technical at heart and understand what analysts need to succeed. Career development is a core focus, with clear pathways into Threat Intelligence, SOC Engineering, SOC Professional Services, senior SOC roles and Incident Response for those who want to specialise. You’ll be part of a collaborative, agile team that values curiosity, humour and a genuine interest in technology. The environment is built around continuous improvement, with everyone having a voice in shaping how the department evolves. Regular team events and knowledge-sharing sessions create a supportive, engaging place to work.

Key Responsibilities

Detect and investigate

  • Monitor and triage alerts across SIEM, EDR or XDR, email and web security platforms.

  • Investigate suspicious activity and determine whether escalation is required.

  • Follow SOC runbooks and investigation workflows.

  • Build clear timelines of activity and maintain accurate investigation notes.

  • Escalate complex cases to Senior and Lead Analysts with appropriate context.

  • Review vulnerability management output and provide basic prioritisation insight.

Hunt and improve

  • Take part in directed threat hunting activities.

  • Suggest improvements to detections, dashboards and runbooks.

  • Support testing of new use cases and detection logic.

Collaborate and communicate

  • Provide clear written updates for customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Participate in shift handovers to maintain continuity.

  • Work closely with Senior and Lead Analysts to develop your skills and technical depth.

Requirements

We hire result-orientated, smart, and high-energy individuals who bring a can-do attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile and deliver exceptional outcomes. You should be organised and rigorous, with excellent analytical skills. Good communication with internal stakeholders is vital, as is the ability to work as part of a dynamic team.

Required skills:

  • Previous hands-on experience working in a Security Operations Centre. This role is not suitable for candidates seeking their first SOC Analyst position.

  • For candidates from an MSP or MSSP background, a minimum of one year's hands-on experience using comparable SOC technologies and supporting multiple customer environments.

  • Experience triaging, investigating and escalating security alerts across SIEM, EDR or XDR platforms.

  • Strong understanding of attacker behaviours, TTPs and common malware execution chains, including phishing leading to script or binary execution.

  • Ability to identify indicators of compromise, build clear investigation timelines and distinguish legitimate administrative activity from suspicious behaviour.

  • Ability to read and interpret Windows event logs, authentication logs, process trees, network telemetry and other relevant log sources.

  • Understanding of core network protocols including DNS, HTTP, SMB and LDAP, together with operational knowledge of Windows, macOS and Linux.

  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and experience applying it during investigations or detection development.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide accurate customer updates, investigation notes and shift handovers.

  • Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint, plus experience of Salesforce or a comparable case-management platform.

Desirable skills:

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender; Palo Alto Networks XSIAM, XDR and XSOAR; SentinelOne; CrowdStrike Falcon; or Google SecOps.

  • Experience using VirusTotal, ANY.RUN, Shodan, Qevlar, Vectra AI, Tracebit or Thinkst Canary as part of investigations, threat hunting or security validation.

  • Ability to query in KQL, CQL, S1QL, XQL or similar languages, and to improve detections, dashboards, runbooks or detection logic.

  • Hands-on technical certifications, particularly those assessed through practical labs or examinations rather than solely through multiple-choice testing.

  • A relevant degree in cyber security, digital forensics, incident response, networking, information technology, computing or programming.

  • Practical AI experience beyond browser-based prompting, such as building agents or agentic workflows; working with VS Code, Codex, Claude Code or Cowork; or using Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT for threat hunting, detection-rule creation and detection-as-code workflows through GitHub or GitLab.

  • Scripting or programming experience that supports investigation, automation, enrichment or detection engineering.

Job Specifics

  • Location: This role is home-based with occasional visits to the office in Basingstoke

  • Hours: 12-hour shifts: 2 days, 2 nights; 4 days/nights off. Flexibility with hours will be required in the event of a major incident

  • Security clearance: Eligibility for SC clearance (lived in the UK for five years consecutively) required. DV clearance eligibility is advantageous.

  • Start date: January 2027

Why would you choose to come and work with us?

We invest in our people. You will get to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where you are free to use your initiative in support of our strategic objectives. You will work alongside high calibre sales, technical, and operational experts as part of a supportive, tight-knit team, within which every individual has an important part to play and makes a real difference. Nomios offers a highly competitive salary and commission scheme along with industry-leading benefits.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now!

Job summary

Forward Deployed Engineers at DigiCert are software engineers who embed with a business function (Sales, Support, Finance, Legal, HR, Procurement, Marketing), learn how the work actually gets done, and ship production AI solutions that drive measurable efficiency and ROI: agents on our systems of record, automated workflows, and AI-native tools wired into the architecture people already use.

You are the hands-on CTO of each engagement. You’ll find where AI delivers the highest return, decide the technical plan, write and deploy the code, and keep improving it after launch.

This is not a research role. You will own the work from first conversation to production, and are judged on what ships and what it returns, not on pilots or demos.

What you will do

  • Embed and find the work.Sit with business users, understand and maptheir workflows, data, and systems, and find where AI accelerates growth or saves the most time and money.
  • Own the architecture.Decide whether to build, buy, or configure solutions, weighing cost, speed, and long-term fit, and lead the technical side of vendor evaluations.
  • Write and ship production code.Build integrations, agents, and workflows with retrieval, tool use, and human-in-the-loop review. Test, deploy, and support what you ship.
  • Make AI reliable.Build systems that hold up against fragmented data and unpredictable model behavior. Find the failure cases before users do and decide where humans stay in control.
  • Build the shared foundation.Partner with IT, Security, and Engineering on model access, identity and permissions, data connectivity, observability, and evaluation. Turn one-off wins into reusable components, so each engagement ships faster than the last.
  • Prove the value.Every solution ships with a baseline, a measured improvement, and a hard number (hours saved, cost avoided, cycle time cut) for the sponsoring executive.
  • Leave the business stronger.Work with our enablement team to train operators and power users, so systems keep running and improving after you move on.

How we work

The Enterprise AI team is intense by design. It's a small team with an outsized impact on the business: what we ship changes how DigiCert runs, and the results reach the top of the company. The pace is fast and the standards are high, but so is the support. People share what they learn, challenge each other, and step in to help.

Microsoft Defender Monitoring

Security Incident & Endpoint Support

  • Validate remediation status and endpoint protection recovery as directed.
  • Avoid unauthorized containment or remediation actions and follow established security escalation procedures.

Operations & Service Management

  • Follow Security Incident, Incident, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Ensure timely alert acknowledgement, escalation and SLA compliance.
  • Maintain accurate incident records, operational checklists and shift handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with L2/L3, SOC, Endpoint, Identity and Infrastructure teams.
  • Support routine security reporting, alert tracking and operational reviews.
  • Identify recurring alerts and report monitoring or documentation gaps to L2.
  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM shift handovers and uninterrupted 24x7 monitoring.

  • Strong attention to detail and adherence to security procedures.

  • Familiarity with malware, phishing, endpoint threats and common attack techniques.
  • Basic PowerShell and Windows troubleshooting knowledge.

  • Security Monitoring | Microsoft Defender | Alert Triage | Endpoint Protection | Basic Threat Analysis.

Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Enterprise Account Executive

As an Account Executive at Quince, you will be responsible for developing, managing, and growing a portfolio of enterprise merchandise clients across industries including Finance, Legal, Sports, Media, and Entertainment. This role requires a proactive and strategic approach to business development, relationship management, and ability to operate in a fast-paced dynamic start up environment. Commission is uncapped, and top performers are rewarded accordingly. You will have a deep understanding of Quince's product offerings and be able to represent the brand and drive meaningful sales growth across a variety of customers and industries.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, manage, and grow your own book of business
  • Promote Quince to prospective and existing enterprise clients through a variety of outreach opportunities
  • Leverage existing relationships with companies and distributors to drive large volume sales and manage both existing and new project opportunities
  • Effectively represent Quince through outstanding product knowledge and outstanding service
  • Proactively seek opportunities for creative expansion within the segment
  • Maintain/track your business pipeline in HubSpot and Sales Navigator

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of Corporate or B2B sales experience with enterprise-level business
  • Proven track record of generating a book of business & driving sales growth
  • Proven track record of successfully identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing opportunities at Enterprise level
  • Proven track record of successfully positioning and selling solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
  • Proficiency in CRM tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Outside-of-the-box thinker who is motivated by results
  • Entrepreneurial attitude and an ability to work independently and competitively in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Excellent proactive, solution oriented, problem-solving skills and flexibility
  • Strong verbal and written communication with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace

Preferred:

  • Experience in corporate gifting sales such as ASI, PPAI
  • Knowledge of print, promotional, and apparel industries

Posted range is reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location.

Base Salary
$80,000—$120,000 USD

Posted range is reflective of total On-Target Earnings (OTE) and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

On-Target Earnings (OTE)
$130,000—$200,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Gerente de Produto
jobs.excerpt: Um portfólio de produtos bem posicionado começa com a compreensão do mercado, das necessidades dos clientes e das oportunidades de cada cultura.
jobs.description:
Um portfólio de produtos bem posicionado começa com a compreensão do mercado, das necessidades dos clientes e das oportunidades de cada cultura. Na Enza Zaden, você terá um papel estratégico no desenvolvimento e posicionamento de variedades, conectando as estratégias globais às necessidades dos mercados regionais.


Como Gerente de Produto - SOLANÁCEAS, você contribuirá para o crescimento sustentável do negócio, buscando maximizar as vendas, a participação de mercado e a margem bruta por meio da gestão do portfólio e da introdução de novas variedades na América do Sul.


Faça a diferença como Gerente de Produto


Nesta posição, você será responsável por contribuir para a definição e implementação das estratégias de mercado e de portfólio para as culturas sob sua responsabilidade. Seu trabalho envolverá o acompanhamento do desempenho comercial das variedades, a identificação de oportunidades e a definição do melhor posicionamento dos produtos nos diferentes mercados da região.


Você atuará em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Gestão de Portfólio, Desenvolvimento de Produtos, Vendas, Marketing e Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, garantindo que as estratégias globais sejam traduzidas em planos regionais e ações locais.


Além disso, manterá contato próximo com clientes estratégicos e outros parceiros do setor, trazendo informações relevantes sobre suas necessidades e sobre as tendências do mercado para apoiar o desenvolvimento e a introdução de variedades.


Nesta posição, suas atividades incluirão:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar o posicionamento das variedades de Solanáceas no mercado regional, em colaboração com a Gestão de Portfólio, buscando ampliar a participação de mercado, as vendas e a margem bruta;
  • Analisar os resultados de vendas e as previsões comerciais da região, alinhando informações e oportunidades com os gestores de Vendas das subsidiárias;
  • Alinhar o portfólio de variedades comercializadas na região com a estratégia global, em conjunto com a Gestão Global de Portfólio;
  • Contribuir para a construção de planos estratégicos de mercado e de culturas ou segmentos, considerando os mercados convencional e orgânico;
  • Traduzir os planos estratégicos em ações táticas e operacionais, acompanhando sua implementação nos mercados sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e atualizar modelos estratégicos de produto por cultura ou tipo de cultura, considerando características relevantes das variedades, necessidades dos clientes e informações de mercado;
  • Compartilhar com a equipe de melhoramento informações e recomendações sobre conceitos, modelos de produto e oportunidades para atender às necessidades dos diferentes mercados;
  • Participar da execução dos planos de clientes, oferecendo informações e suporte técnico à equipe comercial;
  • Propor o avanço de variedades nas diferentes etapas do processo de desenvolvimento e introdução, de acordo com os processos internos da empresa;
  • Definir, quando necessário, a alocação de sementes de variedades em introdução e de variedades já existentes na região, em alinhamento com a Gestão Global de Portfólio;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as lideranças regionais de Vendas e a Gestão Global de Portfólio para alinhar as estratégias de produtos e clientes aos objetivos da Enza Zaden;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Desenvolvimento de Produtos, Vendas e Marketing, compartilhando dados, estratégias e resultados, além de acompanhar a implementação dos planos de mercado;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes estratégicos e outros parceiros do setor, como associações e consultores, para compreender suas necessidades e identificar tendências e oportunidades.

O que você traz como nosso futuro colega


Como Gerente de Produto, você combina visão estratégica, conhecimento técnico e compreensão das necessidades do mercado para contribuir com o desenvolvimento e o posicionamento de um portfólio competitivo.


Você se sente confortável analisando informações comerciais e de mercado, identificando oportunidades e transformando estratégias em planos de ação. Também gosta de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, conectando diferentes áreas e construindo relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e parceiros.


Buscamos uma pessoa com iniciativa, capacidade analítica e orientação para resultados, que tenha interesse em contribuir para o desenvolvimento de produtos e para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.


Além disso, você possui:

  • Formação superior em Agronomia, Engenharia Agronômica, Engenharia Agrícola ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência profissional no agronegócio, preferencialmente nos mercados de sementes ou hortaliças, em atividades relacionadas a gestão de produtos, desenvolvimento de portfólio ou vendas técnicas;
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com planejamento de mercado, análise de vendas e desenvolvimento de estratégias de produto;
  • Capacidade de analisar informações de mercado, necessidades dos clientes e tendências do setor;
  • Visão comercial e orientação para resultados;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e facilidade para construir relacionamentos com clientes, parceiros e equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Organização e habilidade para transformar estratégias em planos de ação e acompanhar sua execução;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas a clientes, áreas de produção e mercados sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Inglês e espanho avançado/fluente.

Enza Zaden como sua empregadora

A Enza Zaden é uma empresa internacional familiar que desenvolve variedades inovadoras de hortaliças desde 1938. Junto com mais de 3.300 colegas ao redor do mundo, trabalhamos com sementes de hortaliças com melhor sabor, maior produtividade e fortes resistências. Fazemos isso a partir da nossa missão: “Breeding to feed the world”. Todos os dias, mais de 480 milhões de pessoas consomem hortaliças cultivadas a partir das nossas sementes, e isso é motivo de muito orgulho para nós.


Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho e cuidamos uns dos outros. Boas ideias têm espaço para crescer e, juntos, seguimos avançando. É assim que continuamos a crescer e inovar, tanto como empresa quanto como colegas.


O que você pode esperar de nós

Acreditamos que é importante que você possa crescer no seu trabalho e se sentir bem com o que faz. Por isso, investimos no seu desenvolvimento, bem-estar e satisfação profissional.

Por meio do nosso programa de desenvolvimento Great to Grow, do nosso foco em vitalidade e de atividades que aproximam os colegas, criamos um ambiente de trabalho onde você pode continuar aprendendo e contribuir com energia e entusiasmo.


Vamos nos conectar

Está em busca de uma carreira que cresça junto com você? Candidate-se utilizando o botão de inscrição. Você receberá uma confirmação automática em poucos minutos. Informaremos os próximos passos em até 10 dias úteis.


Esta posição não poderá ser preenchida em regime temporário ou interino.


Tem dúvidas sobre a posição ou sobre o processo seletivo? Fique à vontade para entrar em contato com a área de RH no e-mail


A Enza Zaden é uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em histórico, identidade ou características pessoais.

Quer saber mais sobre a Enza Zaden? Visite nosso site.

jobs.title: Director of Marketplaces
jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity:We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Marketplaces to own our Amazon and third-party marketplace channels globally.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Marketplaces to own our Amazon and third-party marketplace channels globally. In this role, you will own the long-term planning, daily execution, and optimization of Amazon & additional marketplace performance for Caraway, including paid advertising, SEO and organic ranking, forecasting, reporting and analytics, business operations, review generation, listing and account management, product detail page improvements, and brand and pricing integrity across marketplaces.

This role will push us to think differently about our business and about how Amazon affects it, including how AI-driven shopping is changing the way customers find products. Our team moves fast, relies on data, and is always testing. You will be pivotal in helping Caraway become a generational brand with household-level awareness.

This role reports to Wilko Reinholz, Chief Marketing Officer.

Who You Are:

You have deep experience running Amazon seller accounts and turning strategy into results. You bring strong P&L expertise, a proactive mindset, and experience managing external Amazon agency relationships. You obsess over understanding how Amazon’s search and recommendation systems work, and how they are evolving with AI, and you optimize organic performance by leveraging keyword opportunities, reviews, competitive monitoring, pricing and promotion tactics, advertising, and third-party tools. You are relentless in building review funnels.

You protect brand equity as fiercely as you pursue sales: you know how to make marketplace pricing and assortment complement, rather than undercut, our DTC site and retail partners. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are data-driven, and enjoy owning all aspects of the Amazon channel, from day-to-day operations to long-term planning. You have omni-channel experience with at least two other marketplaces (e.g., Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, , Wayfair; including global marketplaces). You have a keen eye for product and merchandising opportunities, and understand how to leverage Email, SMS, Influencers, Affiliate, Paid Advertising, etc. to drive outside traffic to Amazon. You work well with creative, marketing, and logistics partners to bring our assortment to life.

Responsibilities:

  • P&L Ownership: Lead Amazon & Marketplaces for Caraway (globally). Set KPIs and targets, channel strategy, and drive sustainable revenue and margin growth.
  • Advertising and Traffic: Own in-platform marketing (PPC, DSP, video, OTT, Amazon Marketing Cloud) with a focus on organic ranking. Use Caraway’s email, SMS, influencer, affiliate, and PR channels to drive outside traffic to marketplaces. Judge ad spend on incrementality and contribution margin, and coordinate with paid social and search so we do not compete against ourselves.
  • Listings and Conversion: Oversee product setup and content (copy, imagery, keywords, attributes, A+ content) with internal and external teams. Own conversion strategy and testing.
  • Pricing, Assortment and Brand Protection: Set marketplace pricing and assortment so they support, not undercut, our DTC site and retail partners. Enforce MAP and monitor unauthorized sellers, hijackers, and counterfeits.
  • Operations and Account Health: Manage margin, account health, customer service experience, seller rating and case log management.
  • Inventory and FBA: Own FBA & FBM strategy, including inbound placement, inventory positioning, in-stock rates, and fee and freight costs. Work with Finance and Inventory Planning on demand forecasts, and update them as conditions change.
  • Product Launches: Plan and run on-time Amazon launches from start to finish, working with internal and external teams.
  • Growth: Work with Amazon directly on new opportunities to drive incremental growth (e.g. shows, exclusive color drops, bundles, etc).
  • Promotional Calendar: Own the promotional calendar (Deal of the Day, Lightning Deals, coupons, event deals) with Marketing, Finance, and Ecommerce to drive revenue and organic ranking.
  • Reviews: Build and run strategies to increase high-quality reviews and ratings. Monitor customer reviews and use what you learn to improve products, listings, and customer service.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Work with Caraway’s Data & Analytics team to report on key Amazon metrics, find insights, and turn them into improvements. Build dashboards that connect marketplace results to company-wide revenue and marketing measurement, and present results, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Market Awareness: Track competitors and marketplace changes, including algorithm updates, AI shopping features, fees, and policies.
  • Partners: Build strong working relationships with our Amazon agency, other agency and platform partners, Amazon contacts (such as CSMs), and internal teams (Strategy, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Ops). Decide over time which work should move in-house.
  • New Geographies and Marketplaces: Evaluate new channels and geographies to expand our marketplace presence and businesses: sequencing, localization, and operational set up.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • 8+ years of experience building, leading, and managing the Amazon and Marketplace channel for an eight-figure plus Amazon business (bonus if that includes international marketplaces)
  • Deep, hands-on Amazon experience (Seller Central), with a P&L ownership track record, not just campaign management
  • Fluency across the full Amazon stack: search/SEO, content, retail media (Sponsored Ads, DSP, AMC), FBA/supply chain, and platform operations
  • Practical, hands-on approach to organic ranking and review strategy
  • Strong experience in inventory management, merchandising, listing optimization, margin management, and pricing
  • Experience protecting brand pricing and positioning in a marketplace environment, ideally for a premium or DTC-heritage physical product brand (housewares, kitchen, or adjacent categories a plus)
  • Good instincts for new product opportunities based on keyword research and customer insight
  • Keen eye for new product development opportunities based on keyword research and customer insights
  • Experience managing agencies and cross-functional stakeholders while staying hands-on with the day-to-day
  • Expertise with Amazon and marketplace tools such as Helium 10, SmartScout, Amazon Brand Analytics, and advertising management platforms
  • Proficiency with analytics tools such as Looker, Excel, SQL, or Tableau
  • A growth mindset with a desire to test new ideas to unlock new, outside-the-box opportunities

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - 195,000. Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors determining the base pay at offer, including but not limited to: skills, qualifications, experience. This range provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

Life at Caraway:

Who We Are:

Caraway is a home goods brand on a mission to craft well-designed, non-toxic essentials that thoughtfully raises the standards of what you cook with. We’re passionate about creating elevated products, made without forever chemicals, that are better for you, your family, and the planet. We prioritize a holistic approach to the creation of Caraway products. We partner with ethical manufacturers where their employees are safe, paid fairly, given benefits, and work regulated hours. Our eco-friendly manufacturing process emits less CO2 than traditional non-stick coatings, and we use sustainable packaging practices and ship in packaging made from recycled materials. We pride ourselves on continuously striving to do and be better—for you and the planet—in every step of the process.

Since launching in November 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest growing digitally-native brands of the last decade and are now sold in retailers including Target, Bloomingdale’s, Crate & Barrel, The Container Store, Costco, Zola, and many more.

We’ve amassed over 200,000+ five-star reviews from more than 2.5M+ happy customers and thousands of press hits from the likes of Vogue, Domino, Good Housekeeping, Food & Wine, Architectural Digest, PureWow, Fortune, and CNN.

Team: You will be joining a passionate and collaborative fully-remote team that prides itself on high-quality work, supporting one another, sharing our successes, and building a brand we truly love, together.

Culture: At Caraway, we value continuous learning and career growth. We strive to continually optimize our processes, ensuring that we’re thoughtful in everything we do, both internally and externally. We listen to our employees, celebrate our wins, and constantly look for ways to be better for our team, and the world.

Workplace: Being a fully-remote company, we have no headquarters and are truly distributed across the country. Our leadership team sits on both the East and West Coast and we have folks in a variety of states. We offer a monthly stipend towards co-working space should folks need to switch up their working environment every now and then.

Benefits: We value you and your family. With this in mind, full-time eligible employees are provided:

  • Equity: We believe in our product and that the sky's the limit for where our business is going. You are an asset to Caraway’s success and we think you should be rewarded for it.
  • 401k: A 3% company match to help you plan for for your future
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental + vision coverage options with generous employer contributions + access to FSA/HSA/Dependent Care FSA’s
  • Parental Leave: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, depending on tenure, and access to additional fertility care services via KindBody
  • A Setup that works for you: From MacBook to PC, we’ve got you covered. Let us know what you prefer and we’ll get your at-home set up stocked!
  • Elevate your Workspace: Annual reimbursements for you to elevate your workspace, from standing desks to desktop succulents, you got it!
  • Fully Remote: Need to pick up the kids? No problem. Have a doctor’s appointment? Enjoy! Flexibility when you need it most.
  • Coworking Reimbursement: Need a break from the home setting? Monthly reimbursements for you to get out of the house and work from anywhere. From day passes, to monthly memberships, the world is your oyster, we mean office.
  • Events + Swag: Connection is top of mind (Yes, even in our completely remote environment). We have monthly virtual events, company wide offsites, and many opportunities for new Caraway swag!
  • Leveling Up with Caraway: In addition to exciting opportunities and exposure in your day-to-day work, we offer annual reimbursements to full-time employees to support their professional development aspirations!
  • #AwayFromCaraway: We believe healthy, happy humans do better work. We offer unlimited PTO in addition to our 11+ paid annual holidays and quarterly wellness days.
  • Wellness Reimbursement: Monthly reimbursements for you to stay well. From meal services to gym memberships to monthly massages, we want our team to have the flexibility to choose what wellness means for them.
  • Employee Discount: We provide an employee discount on all Caraway Home products so you can continue to level up your kitchen and home life, too!
  • Home Upgrade(s): Complimentary product as a new hire + continuous to expand your Caraway Home collection.

Caraway is an Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as during outreach, reviewing applications and analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
