jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Microsoft 365 Administrator based in Asia-Pacific to help manage, maintain, and secure our Microsoft cloud environment—including Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Purview.

You’ll be our first IT team member in the region, giving colleagues across Asia-Pacific support in their own working hours. You'll also play a key role in keeping our environment secure, well documented, and audit-ready for our clients and regulators.

What You’ll Do:

  • Administer Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Intune.
  • Resolve escalated technical issues (Level 2/3) for colleagues across Asia-Pacific in their local working hours, and be IT’s point of contact in the region.
  • Manage the user and device lifecycle—onboarding, role changes, and offboarding—across Entra ID and Intune, following our access control procedures.
  • Support our security and audit-readiness work, including Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels and data loss prevention), access reviews, and vulnerability and patch management.
  • Run and test backup and recovery, and take part in disaster recovery tests that produce the evidence our auditors and clients ask for.
  • Ensure the environment stays compliant with our internal policies and with data protection requirements such as GDPR and HIPAA.
  • Work closely with the IT team in Europe and the Americas on identity, infrastructure, and security projects.
  • Automate routine work with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and our approved AI tools.
  • Follow change management and keep runbooks, configurations, and support processes documented.
  • Stay up to date on the latest Microsoft 365 and security features and assess potential benefits for the organization.

What are we looking for?

· Fluent in English, written and spoken

  • Based in Asia-Pacific, ideally in Taiwan, Thailand, or India, able to work 100% remotely
  • Willing to overlap part of your working day with colleagues in Europe
  • Logical, analytical, and always ready to learn something new!
  • Comfortable working independently as the first IT person in the region, and as part of a global team
  • 1–5+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration, including Entra ID, Intune, and Exchange Online (but we’re open to ambitious early-career professionals, too)
  • Good communication skills and a customer-service mindset

Nice to Have:

  • Microsoft Defender, Entra Conditional Access, and Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels, DLP)
  • Identity governance: role-based access, access reviews, and privileged access
  • SharePoint site architecture and permissions management
  • Scripting and automation with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Git
  • Microsoft 365 backup and recovery tools, such as Veeam
  • Experience supporting audits or working with frameworks such as ISO 27001, HIPAA, or GDPR

Why Milestone One?

  • Work fully remotely from Asia-Pacific, with flexibility and trust
  • Be the first IT team member in the region, with real ownership and visibility
  • Join a collaborative, supportive global team making a difference in clinical research
  • Gain experience in Microsoft cloud security and real-world compliance frameworks
  • Get certified, level up your career, and take on exciting projects—one milestone at a time
  • Be part of something meaningful: secure, compliant, modern digital workplaces built with care and curiosity

Ready to grow with us? Apply now and let’s shape the future of secure digital work—one milestone at a time!

At Milestone One, it’s the people that move us forward.

We’re not just supporting clinical research—we’re laying the foundation stones for stronger study delivery. Milestone One is a Site Enabling Services organization with global headquarters in Zug, Switzerland, supporting clinical study sites around the world. Our IT runs on a secure, cloud-based Microsoft environment, and every milestone we reach is powered by passionate people like you.

At Milestone One, we work with purpose. Our team values curiosity, accountability, continuous learning, and a drive to go the extra mile. We're looking for people who think logically, solve creatively, and genuinely enjoy a challenge.

If that sounds like you, this might be your next step!

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: BryceTech is seeking a Program Manager to provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for a complex, multi-disciplinary support contract serving the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD).
jobs.description:
BryceTech is seeking a Program Manager to provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for a complex, multi-disciplinary support contract serving the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD). This individual will be responsible for ensuring the successful planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of program management, financial management, comptroller, and customer support services across multiple Navy departments, programs, and geographic locations. The Program Manager will serve as the primary interface between BryceTech and Government leadership, ensuring contract objectives are achieved within established schedules, budgets, performance standards, and customer expectations.

Responsibilities

  • Provide overall program leadership and direction, overseeing the successful execution of all contract requirements and ensuring alignment with Government objectives

  • Develop and maintain program management plans, schedules, resource allocation strategies, and performance metrics to support effective contract execution

  • Oversee personnel, subcontractor coordination, staffing levels, labor-hour utilization, and resource requirements across geographically dispersed teams

  • Direct program planning and control activities, including budgeting, cost management, Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) development, schedule management, and performance monitoring

  • Establish and maintain risk management processes to identify performance, financial, staffing, and schedule risks and develop appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

  • Oversee the delivery of financial management, comptroller, program management, and customer support services, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and quality across all functional areas

  • Provide strategic oversight of program execution, including tracking technical milestones, deliverables, funding requirements, and evolving customer priorities

  • Lead Agile program management initiatives, including the application of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, backlog management, and performance tracking across multiple teams

  • Establish effective communication channels with the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO), Contract Specialist (CS), Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and other Government stakeholders

  • Conduct biweekly contract status meetings to review program execution, performance risks, issues, and proposed mitigation or corrective actions

  • Prepare and present program status briefings, management reports, performance assessments, and recommendations to Government leadership

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Global Study Delivery Lead Location: Remote-Flexible/Global Job Type: Full-Time, exempt Reports To: Chief Operating Officer SUMMARYTo lead and be accountable for Civia's global study delivery function, setting the standard for operational excellence, building high-performing delivery capability, and ensuring the successful delivery of all studies to time, cost, quality, and client expectations.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Global Study Delivery Lead

Location: Remote-Flexible/Global

Job Type: Full-Time, exempt

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

SUMMARY

To lead and be accountable for Civia's global study delivery function, setting the standard for operational excellence, building high-performing delivery capability, and ensuring the successful delivery of all studies to time, cost, quality, and client expectations.

SCOPE

This is a hands-on, operational delivery role — not advisory and not a back-office systems function. The Global Study Delivery Lead is the global delivery authority for Civia’s studies, accountable for delivering them to time, cost, and quality, acting as a primary client point of contact, and owning project-management excellence across the organisation. Its defining way of working is close, day-to-day partnership with in-country delivery teams — enabling them and holding a single, high standard everywhere — and it is the single accountable owner of how delivery performance is reported. Where study-level delivery is managed at country level, this role owns delivery across the entire global portfolio, together with the methodology, baselines, and KPIs that make it repeatable.

The role operates at enterprise level within the study delivery leadership structure and holds no responsibility for strategic partners. The methodology, documentation, and reporting it builds are a means to an end: consistently delivering studies and exceeding client expectations.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Accountability for delivering Civia’s study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, globally
• Partnering closely with in-country delivery teams to raise and hold a single, high standard across every study and geography
• Acting as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, building trust and ensuring every commitment is met
• Ownership of project-management excellence across Civia, holding internal functions to account for delivery
• Direct, decisive intervention whenever delivery performance is at risk
• Identification, creation, and implementation of the methodology, documentation, baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that make delivery repeatable
• Sole ownership of study-performance reporting — ensuring delivery is represented accurately, currently, and in KPI terms always
• Sustained client confidence through delivery that consistently meets and exceeds expectations
• The accountable leader in Civia for setting the tone and expectations for study management, fostering excellence, and a mentor who develops less experienced delivery colleagues.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Study Delivery — Time, Cost & Quality

• Own delivery of the global study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, end to end across start-up, recruitment, execution, and close-out
• Maintain a forward-looking view of delivery health and forecast accuracy, and intervene directly and decisively when any study is at risk
• Drive the trade-offs and recovery actions that keep studies on schedule, on budget, and at the required quality
• Protect delivery quality, timelines, and cost discipline through proactive risk identification and resolution

Client Leadership & Point of Contact

• Act as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, owning the relationship and representing Civia’s delivery performance
• Provide transparent, forward-looking delivery communication — progress, risks, variance, and recovery actions
• Build trust through reliability and consistency, ensuring every commitment made to a client is met
• Enable repeat work by making Civia predictable and exceptional to deliver with

Project-Management Excellence Across Civia

• Own the standard of project-management excellence across Civia, leading the study delivery and project-management methodology
• Set clear ownership, decision rights, governance routines, and escalation pathways for study delivery
• Coach and uplift delivery and project-management capability so studies are run to a consistently high standard everywhere
• Hold internal functions accountable for their contribution to delivery commitments
• Mentor and develop more less experienced delivery and project-management colleagues, actively building the next generation of delivery talent

Global Partnership & Cross-Functional Alignment

• Work closely and continuously with in-country delivery teams— the primary partnership through which studies are delivered — enabling them, aligning on priorities, and holding a single, high standard everywhere
• Align Site Operations, Recruitment, Regulatory, Data, Quality, and Safety with country teams to deliver each study to plan
• Facilitate portfolio- and study-level delivery reviews and drive timely resolution of bottlenecks
• Establish clear accountability so every country team and function knows what it owns and by when
• Escalate constructively and act decisively when delivery performance deviates from plan

Methodology, Baselines, Forecasts & KPIs

• Identify, create, and implement Civia’s study delivery methodology, documentation, and processes — the means by which studies are delivered reliably
• Define the reporting baselines and forecasting models against which all study delivery is planned and measured
• Design, implement, and own the KPI framework for study delivery, ensuring metrics are meaningful, comparable, and acted upon globally
• Act as the single source of truth for study-performance reporting — owning the accuracy, currency, and integrity of every system, report, and KPI
• Embed a single, repeatable way of working that removes delivery variability across studies, sites, and geographies

Governance, Risk & Continuous Improvement

• Establish disciplined governance routines and a performance cadence across the portfolio
• Ensure continuous audit and inspection readiness is built into delivery
• Lead corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives, closing the loop from insight to embedded change
• Continuously refine methodology based on delivery data, lessons learned, and evolving client and regulatory expectations

Performance Measures (KPIs)

• On-time delivery: Studies delivered to agreed timelines across the global portfolio
• On-budget delivery: Delivery to cost and margin protection across the portfolio
• Quality: Delivery to required quality, with continuous audit and inspection readiness sustained
• Portfolio delivery vs commitment: ≥100% of study commitments met across the global portfolio
• Client satisfaction: Strong sponsor feedback on delivery and repeat awards
• Country-team partnership: Strength of collaboration with in-country delivery teams, evidenced by consistent, high-quality delivery and expectations exceeded across geographies
• Forecast accuracy: Delivery performance tracking on or ahead of approved baselines and forecasts
• Reporting integrity: Study performance always represented accurately and current, with systems, reports, and KPIs trusted as the single source of truth
• Delivery variability: Year-on-year reduction in delivery variance and avoidable slippage
• Project-management maturity: Consistent, high-standard application of delivery methodology and KPIs across all studies and geographies

Experience & Qualifications:

Required Experience

• 10-15 years of relevant experience with deep operational understanding of clinical trial delivery and its dependencies
• Track record of delivering strategic and operational outcomes
• Proven ability to design, document, implement, and scale delivery and project-management systems
• Strong regulatory, GCP, GDPR and operational literacy
• Strong analytical and financial literacy — builds baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that hold up
• Platform experience with CRIO, HubSpot, and Monday.com

Mindset

• Deeply focused on delivery — driven to complete studies to time, cost, and quality
• Client-first and self-starting; takes ownership of the relationship and closes delivery gaps on their own initiative
• Uncompromising on delivery standards and determined to exceed client expectations

Behavior

• Brings structure, clarity, and a single way of working to complex, multi-geography delivery
• Operates hands-on and close to the work, building strong, trusting partnerships with in-country delivery teams to raise the standard everywhere
• Acts decisively when delivery is at risk; closes the loop from insight to embedded change
• Communicates with authority, transparency, and credibility at leadership level
• Focuses on practical solutions and supports others in learning and improving through challenges.

Personal Traits

• Highly accountable, resilient, and composed under pressure
• Self-directed, organised, and adaptive — treats being a self-starter as the baseline, not the goal
• Builds confidence with teams and stakeholders through follow-through and reliability
• Takes pride in honest, current reporting — owns delivery issues as a reflection of the function and moves quickly to put them right

Qualifications:

  • ​B.S. or B.A.; MBA or equivalent advantageous. Science related degree preferred.

The Content Production Assistant is a key member of the Content Operations team, responsible for uploading, formatting, publishing, and maintaining digital content across TechnologyAdvice's websites. The role offers hands-on experience with multiple content management systems (CMS), exposure to different websites and content types, and opportunities to develop technical, problem-solving, and content operations skills.

  • Identify opportunities to improve publishing accuracy, efficiency, and existing workflows.

  • Experience uploading, formatting, publishing, or maintaining digital content.
  • Familiarity with basic SEO practices, including metadata, headings, image alt text, and internal linking.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, particularly when reviewing content, formatting, and links.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive, detail-oriented tasks while maintaining consistent quality and productivity.
  • Ability to troubleshoot routine content or CMS issues, follow established processes, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Willingness to learn new CMS platforms, receive feedback, and adapt to changing workflows and priorities.
  • Familiarity with ClickUp or similar task management tools is a plus.
  • Must have a working laptop/pc and, internet, and a backup connection.
  • Agile professional who excels in a fast-paced environment and thrives on continuously pivoting strategies to drive business needs forward.

**The duties and responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is in general terms and are not definitive. The job holder is expected to accept any reasonable alterations that may from time to time be necessary.**

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 14 days of annual paid time off, plus all regular Philippine government-declared holidays to unwind and recharge. Plus 5 additional days after 1 year.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Full enrollment in Philippine statutory benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and HDMF.

  • De Minimis Allowance: Enjoy a monthly rice subsidy, following government guidelines.
  • Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Philippines at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the Philippines throughout their employment with our company.

We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

Impact Advisors is building a security product for health systems, and this is a founding role on it.


The position requires behavioral modeling at scale: establishing baselines across large populations, detecting deviation, and delivering models that perform reliably in production within customer environments. Source data is varied and often not structured for security use, so the work spans raw data through to deployed models.


The successful candidate will own the analytical layer end to end, including feature development, modeling, evaluation, deployment and ongoing operation. Candidates are expected to come from cyber security or an adjacent domain in which the same problem shape occurs, such as fraud, abuse, payments risk or insider risk.

Responsibilities

Modeling and analysis

  • Profile unfamiliar data, assess what it supports, and establish baselines for users, roles, devices and systems
  • Develop detection and scoring approaches using methods appropriate to the problem, including peer group comparison, clustering, classification, outlier detection and time series
  • Tune models against production data, reduce false positives without loss of coverage, and maintain performance as underlying systems change
  • Define evaluation criteria, measurement methods and drift detection

Data and delivery

  • Build the data path supporting the models, from ingestion and normalization through to reliably computed features
  • Own deployment and ongoing operation of models in production
  • Develop visualizations that allow customer security leads to interpret and challenge model output

Applied AI

  • Select the appropriate model for each task across statistical, classical machine learning and language model approaches, and justify the selection
  • Apply small and local models where deployment constraints require them
  • Use AI coding tools as part of standard development practice

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, mathematics, statistics or computer science
  • 5+ years applying data science to a security, fraud, abuse or risk domain, including models deployed to production
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience at data volumes where tooling selection affects outcomes
  • Demonstrated anomaly detection experience: population baselining, peer group comparison, and data-derived thresholds
  • Ability to reason about base rates and alert volume, including deriving required precision from population size and alert capacity
  • Experience building data pipelines
  • Experience deploying and maintaining models in production, including versioning, monitoring and retraining
  • Hands-on experience applying language models in production
  • Clear written and verbal communication of technical findings to non-technical audiences

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Credit Loss Ratio
  • Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
  • Portfolio Delinquency Rates
  • Operational Loss Events
  • Regulatory Findings and Remediation
  • Fraud Loss Reduction
  • AML Compliance Effectiveness
  • Cyber Risk Incident Metrics
  • Risk Appetite Compliance
  • Capital and Liquidity Adequacy
  • Audit and Regulatory Examination Outcomes

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$100,406—$165,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

As a Senior Analyst Relations Manager at Tailscale, you’ll play a key role in shaping how industry analysts understand our technology, vision, and place in the market. Sitting within Product Marketing, you’ll own and grow our analyst relations program, deepen existing relationships, and build new ones across the broader analyst ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and leadership, dive deep into emerging technologies, and turn analyst insights into meaningful recommendations that influence product strategy, positioning, and business decisions. This is an opportunity to build a high-impact program, shape Tailscale’s presence in evolving markets, and make a tangible difference as we grow.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll help shape product direction, influence analyst perspectives, and strengthen Tailscale’s market positioning. You’ll build and execute a proactive calendar of analyst inquiries, briefings, and research aligned with product priorities and emerging market opportunities. You’ll also turn analyst feedback and market intelligence into actionable insights that inform decisions across the company, ensuring analyst relations becomes a meaningful driver of Tailscale’s growth.

This role might be perfect for you if you have experience in analyst relations at a B2B technology company, an interest in enterprise security and infrastructure, and the curiosity to learn about emerging technologies like AI. We're looking for someone who can confidently engage with analysts, ask thoughtful questions, and exercise good judgment about which insights are most relevant to Tailscale.

Because we're a fully remote company, we're looking for a motivated individual who is comfortable working asynchronously, thrives in ambiguity, and has a focus on getting it right, not being right.

Key Responsibilities

  • Running Tailscale's analyst relations program, establishing a consistent cadence of analyst engagement and ensuring we get meaningful value from our analyst relationships and research subscriptions.
  • Leading regular analyst inquiries across secure connectivity, privileged access management, AI governance, and emerging areas of technology. Develop sufficient product and market knowledge to independently manage most inquiries, bringing in subject-matter experts when needed.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with relevant industry analysts, identifying opportunities for ongoing engagement with established firms and emerging analysts.
  • Capturing and sharing analyst insights, synthesizing key findings, market trends, and recommendations into actionable updates for Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, and leadership.
  • Coordinating and executing analyst briefings, including identifying relevant analysts, preparing briefing materials, working with internal stakeholders, and managing follow-ups.
  • Monitoring analyst research, reports, and emerging market categories to identify opportunities for Tailscale to participate in relevant evaluations, research, and industry conversations.
  • Supporting analyst evaluations and research processes, including preparing submissions, gathering information from internal teams, and coordinating responses to analyst requests.
  • Develop analyst-facing materials in collaboration with Product Marketing that clearly communicate Tailscale's products, positioning, differentiation, and market vision.
  • Maintaining an organized repository of analyst intelligence, making research, notes, recordings, and past conversations easily accessible and useful to internal teams.
  • Supporting original market research initiatives, including industry surveys and internal reports focused on topics such as AI, zero trust, and enterprise security.
  • Tracking program effectiveness, including analyst engagement, research participation, visibility, and internal utilization of analyst insights.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, communications, analyst relations, or a related field within B2B technology, with at least 1 year of experience directly working with analysts.
  • Experience helping establish or improve analyst relations processes and programs.
  • Familiarity with the technology analyst ecosystem, including firms such as Gartner and Forrester and a deep understanding of how analyst inquiries, briefings, and research processes work.
  • An affinity for complex, highly technical subjects and an interest in learning about networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and AI technologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and summarize complex information for different audiences.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify useful insights and distinguish relevant recommendations from broader industry commentary.
  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with analysts and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and systems, with an interest in using AI to organize, surface, and make analyst research and insights more accessible and actionable for internal teams.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple ongoing activities and deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the persistence and follow-through needed to develop relationships and keep projects moving.
  • The ability to work independently, seek input when needed, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • A bias toward action, execution, and iteration.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, networking, infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, or enterprise AI.
  • Existing relationships with analysts covering cybersecurity, networking, infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise technology markets.
  • Experience successfully securing inclusion for their company in a Gartner Magic Quadrant, including managing the submission and evaluation process.
  • Experience with market research, industry surveys, or research-based content.
  • Startup or high-growth technology company experience.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

$190,000—$237,000 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!

jobs.description:
About You

Do you have a passion for the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry?

Do you want to work across a mix of strategy consulting projects that draw from competitor, customer, medical and commercial insights?

Are you a highly motivated professional interested in being part of a dynamic team of self-starters, working with global healthcare and pharmaceutical clients across the full product life cycle?

If so, consider turning your expertise into a valuable career at Prescient. We welcome applications from experienced life science consultants with a track record of leading client engagements and developing teams to join our growing Competitive Strategy practice.

About Our Competitive Strategy Practice

Prescient has four core practices: Commercial, Competitor Intelligence, Medical, and Value, Pricing and Access. We specialise in supporting our biopharma clients in making insightful strategic choices for their products and portfolios. Our offerings are designed to anticipate and respond to competitive risk across the product life cycle – from early pipeline through post-launch – delivering timely insights and strategic implications that enable integrated decision making across competitive intelligence, marketing, medical and commercial functions.

The Competitive Strategy practice is on an exciting journey to expand our customer-centric team. When you join this exciting venture, you will work with global healthcare and pharmaceutical clients across the full product life cycle, from discovery to loss of exclusivity, to help them unlock the full potential of their brands and portfolios.

As a Principal, you will spend approximately 80% of your time on project delivery and team leadership and 20% on business development, primarily within existing accounts.

About the Opportunity

You will be part of a fast-growing PE-backed business that allows high-performing employees to make an impact and contribute to growing the business. You will have the chance to channel your experience and know-how into supporting the development and commercialization of our clients’ assets and portfolios.

As a Principal, you will lead multiple concurrent engagements end to end – from scoping and design through to final recommendations – with considerable independence. You will lead and develop a team of Engagement Managers, Consultants and Analysts, typically including direct reports, and will be accountable for the quality, timeliness and profitability of the work you oversee.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, shaping the strategic questions our projects are designed to answer, and will partner with Directors and Vice Presidents to grow accounts through our “land and expand” model. You will also help build the practice by participating in or leading internal initiatives such as team training, new methodologies and tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reporting: Report to a Director or Vice President within the Competitive Strategy practice, ensuring clear communication on project portfolio progress, risks, resourcing and account opportunities
  • Project Leadership and Delivery:
    • Lead multiple concurrent competitive strategy and competitive intelligence engagements end to end, owning design, planning, client and people management, evidence collection, analysis and reporting
    • Work with clients to ensure projects are designed to answer the right strategic business questions, and ensure deliverables meet Prescient’s quality standards, timelines and budgets
  • Client Management:
    • Serve as the lead day-to-day relationship holder for client stakeholders, establishing yourself as a credible strategic advisor who anticipates needs and brings a clear point of view
    • Lead challenging client conversations – including scope changes, expectation setting and course corrections – balancing client satisfaction with commercial discipline
  • Business Development and Account Growth:
    • Identify, scope and convert new opportunities within existing accounts, leading proposal development and contributing to pricing
    • Contribute to strategic account plans alongside Directors and Vice Presidents, and pursue opportunities with new brands within existing clients
  • Subject Matter and Therapeutic Area Expertise:
    • Act as a valued subject matter expert externally on the clinical, regulatory and commercial aspects of your therapeutic area(s), and serve as a knowledge resource to internal teams
    • Apply a working knowledge of FDA, EMA and other relevant regulatory guidelines to sharpen competitive insights and implications
  • People Leadership: Line manage, coach and develop Engagement Managers, Consultants and Analysts; support recruitment in coordination with the talent acquisition team; and ensure a sustained focus on delivering concise, impactful insights
  • Practice Development: Participate in or lead internal initiatives that advance Prescient’s capabilities, such as team training, new methodologies and tools, and ensure technology and data & analytics are embedded across programmes
  • Thought Leadership: Contribute to thought leadership content, in collaboration with senior leaders and the marketing team, that strengthens Prescient’s brand and business development activities
  • Conference and External Engagement: Plan and lead conference coverage for your accounts, directing team coverage and engaging with a wide range of experts and delegates at priority symposia, presentations, posters and booths

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience in biopharma consulting or client services, typically 8 or more years in life sciences research, analytics or consulting; CI experience is strongly preferred and a mix of industry and consulting experience is a plus
  • Strong results orientation with a proven track record of:
  • Leading multiple engagements end to end, delivering high-quality outputs on time and within budget
  • Managing and developing team members, ideally including 2 or more years of direct-report experience
  • Contributing to business development, including shaping proposals and growing existing accounts
  • Deep expertise in one or more therapeutic areas – oncology, immunology or biosimilars experience is strongly preferred – including the clinical, regulatory and commercial dynamics of US and EU markets
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA, EMA and other relevant regulatory guidelines
  • Strong client management skills:
    • Credibility to engage senior client stakeholders as a trusted advisor and lead discussions on findings and their strategic implications
    • Experience managing scope and expectations against an agreed statement of work, keeping clients satisfied while maintaining commercial discipline
    • Ability to recognize and act on opportunities to expand Prescient’s support within an account
  • Confident communication skills, with the ability to distill complex matters into a clear business case and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams
  • Ability to dive “in the weeds” while pulling back to see the big picture
  • Demonstrated leadership ability, with a willingness to make decisions and own the follow-through
  • Ability to give and receive feedback constructively
  • Strong learning agility to navigate ambiguity, adapt to change and rapidly acquire new therapeutic or methodological expertise
  • BA/BS required; an advanced degree in a life science discipline is preferred

What We Offer

  • A competitive package and remuneration linked to performance
  • A strong values-based culture grounded in collaboration, curiosity and excellence
  • Tailored career development based on your interests and aspirations – not a one-size-fits-all approach
  • A team of smart, supportive colleagues who invest in each other’s success
  • Leaders who are accessible, ambitious for the team and committed to mentorship
  • An opportunity to lead client engagements and teams, and to help shape our growing Competitive Strategy practice
  • A flexible working schedule and recognition for outstanding contributions
  • A flat hierarchy that empowers you to take ownership and make an impact

About Prescient Healthcare Group

Prescient® is a pharma services firm specializing in dynamic decision support and product and portfolio strategy. We partner with our clients to turn science into value by helping them understand the potential of their molecules, shaping their strategic plans and allowing their decision making to be the biggest differentiating factor in the success of their products. When companies partner with Prescient, the molecules in their hands have a greater potential for success than the same science in the hands of their competitors.

Founded in 2007, Prescient is a global firm with a footprint in 10 cities across three continents. Our team of nearly 475 experts partners with 27 of the top 30 biopharmaceutical companies, the fastest-growing mid-caps and cutting-edge emerging biotechs, including some of the biggest and most innovative brands. More than 70% of our employees hold advanced life science degrees, and our teams deliver an impressive depth of therapeutic, clinical and commercial expertise.

The annual full time base salary range for this role is ($145,000 - $175,000). Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines. Prescient offers PTO and paid holidays, the terms of which are set forth in the program policies. All full-time employees also are eligible to participate in various benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance and 401K; in each case in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Prescient has been a portfolio company of Bridgepoint Development Capital since 2021 and Baird Capital since 2017. For more information, please visit .

Process Improvement & Documentation

You Will Love This Job If You Have

The VP of Events will partner closely with the Executive Director/Founder to shape the strategy and growth of Life Science Connect’s precision medicine portfolio, while owning the business side: financial results, team leadership, and day-to-day management. Building from a strong core event, this leader will expand the portfolio in the US and abroad, grow audience and client engagement, launch targeted extensions, and develop a year-round community that delivers business value.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Strategy & Growth
  • Partner with the Executive Director/Founder to develop and execute a strategic plan for the precision medicine event portfolio, focused on market relevance, audience growth, sponsor engagement, and year-round community development.
  • Deliver financial, operational, and brand goals, including customer retention, satisfaction, and growth metrics.
  • Identify growth opportunities across adjacent markets, customer segments, and geographies.
  • Set product and pricing strategies that reflect audience needs, client goals, and market opportunity.
  • Build strategic partnerships with industry organizations, market leaders, clients, and other ecosystem partners that expand reach, strengthen market relevance, and create portfolio growth opportunities.
  • Guide marketing, experiential, and partner programs that extend engagement before, during, and after each event.
  • Partner with team and advisory board to guide portfolio direction, innovation, and year-round community engagement.

Financial & Performance Management
  • Own portfolio financial performance and P&L results, including revenue growth, profitability, budgets, forecasts, and invoice approvals, in coordination with the team, department head, and finance.
  • Establish a regular performance cadence that provides visibility into portfolio results, growth opportunities, risks, and mitigation plans.
Team Leadership
  • Lead the team through regular 1:1s, professional development, coaching, and mentoring.
  • Track team and individual performance against targets, KPIs, and MBOs.
  • Recruit and assess new hires as needed.
  • Build a culture of cross-department collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Event Execution
  • Deliver a strong customer experience that creates meaningful engagement and measurable ROI for audiences and clients.
  • Partner closely with the Executive Director/Founder on market and content strategy and execution.
  • Lead event delivery across marketing, sales, operations, and shared services.

Travel as Required

Experience
10+ years of progressive experience in B2B events, conferences, media, or portfolio leadership, including senior-level accountability for event strategy, team leadership, P&L performance, new event launches, strategic partnerships, and substantial portfolio growth.
  • Life sciences experience preferred; precision medicine, diagnostics, oncology, genomics, or related.
  • Strong strategic thinking and commercial acumen, with experience using market, customer, and performance data to identify growth opportunities and guide decisions.
  • Experience leading teams, managing performance, and supporting professional development.
  • Experience integrating an event portfolio, business, or team into a broader parent company.
  • Experience partnering with a founder or senior executive on strategy, with the judgment to share ownership of market and content direction while leading the business day to day.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive strategic and tactical results while leading and collaborating effectively cross functionally.

Compensation & Benefits
Life Science Connect offers a generous compensation package. In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy:
• Medical / vision / prescription / dental coverage for you and your family
• 100% company‑paid short‑ and long‑term disability insurance
• 100% company‑paid life insurance
• 401(k) with dollar‑for‑dollar company match up to 6%
• 15 vacation days and 6 personal days on day 1
• 13 company‑paid holidays

jobs.description:
Overview

The Principal Healthcare Consultant will play a central role in helping our clients to execute strategies to help them compete and win. We partner with health plans to adapt their product strategies to the evolving needs of their clients, creating offerings that strengthen and sustain their competitive advantage. The Principal works alongside plan client leaders in product management and line-of-business leadership to deliver on this opportunity: designing competitively differentiated benefits and services products for employer groups with highly tailored needs and finding where such investments can create leverage across books of business.

The Principal then leads engagements alongside our other consultants to execute this strategy, translating it into technology and operational designs, and enabling them within the plan's ecosystem. Strategic product thinking paired with practical execution is what sets us apart from traditional consulting firms. The Principal will be instrumental in achieving this balance, advising executive clients to set product strategies that can win share in the market, while ensuring that client staff and NASCO successfully execute the strategy to achieve desired goals.

Responsibilities

  • Advises health plan executives on product strategy and innovation, helping them decide what to bring to market, when, and for which segments
  • Leads product strategy engagements from framing through executive readout, including portfolio review, product concept definition, and prioritized roadmaps
  • Defines and designs competitive health plan products, including benefit and plan design, network and pricing constructs, and funding arrangements, working with plan product, actuarial, finance, and sales partners to balance cost, value, and feasibility
  • Helps plans respond to highly tailored employer group needs, identifying where group requirements can be met through configurable offerings rather than one-off builds and where product investments create leverage across books of business through shared capabilities and sequencing that reduce costs and shorten time to market
  • Assesses market, regulatory, and competitive dynamics, including national carrier positioning, to shape offerings that differentiate rather than follow
  • Translates product strategy into executable plans, targets, success measures, and timelines aligned to plan years, rate filings, and bid cycles
  • Leads engagement on strategic work, directing the contributions of other consultants who take plans through operational design, configuration, and enablement within the plan's ecosystem
  • Participates in strategic pre-sales pursuits alongside commercial leaders, leading executive discoveries, framing customer problems, and establishing the value case before solutions are positioned
  • Develops practice points of view and reusable frameworks on health plan product strategy and innovation, working with the Market Intelligence team to ground them in current market data, and builds our reputation as a strategic partner by sharing them through customer forums, industry events, and published perspectives, including case studies and proof points of customer outcomes
  • Shares customer and market insight with product management to inform roadmap priorities and positioning

Qualifications

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Consulting or advisory experience serving health plans
  • Experience at a Blue Cross Blue Shield plan or national carrier, or familiarity with Blues plan operations and inter-plan programs
  • Product leadership across multiple lines of business, including Medicare Advantage product development and bid experience
  • Familiarity with core payer administration platforms and how platform capabilities enable or constrain product design
  • Published perspectives, industry speaking, or recognized thought leadership in health plan product strategy

Experience

  • 10 years of experience in healthcare payer operations, product management, product strategy, healthcare consulting, or related leadership roles
  • 5 years of experience leading complex strategic initiatives or consulting engagements
  • 5 years of experience working on or with health plans
  • 8 years in consulting, strategy or solution design
  • Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and influencing strategic business decisions
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving multiple business functions and stakeholder groups

Required Training, Certification and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Finance, Marketing, or a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred Training, Certification and Education

  • Master’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field
  • Advanced coursework or formal training in innovation, portfolio management, or healthcare transformation

Working Conditions

  • Remote home office
  • Requires frequent interaction with internal and external stakeholders
  • Travel up to 20% may be for customer workshops, executive sessions, and industry events
  • Must be able to use workstation at least 8 hours a day

Benefits Overview

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

Physical and Mental Health Benefits

  • Choice of Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits
  • Generous PTO with buy/sell options
  • 9 Company holidays, a floating day off, and a day off for volunteering
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness program - earn insurance discounts or credit towards health-related items

Financial Health Benefits

  • 401K Plan with employer matching contributions
  • Company-funded spending/reimbursement accounts to help with out-of-pocket medical expenses
  • Bonus and Recognition programs
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Consultation with financial planner
  • Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
  • Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

Other Benefits

  • E-Learning – Comprehensive and current library of e-learning and performance support assets, available on demand and at no cost

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other grounds, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability. Must have legal authority to work in the US.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard is building a safer foundation for software. We work with security and engineering teams who care deeply about supply chain security, open source, and modern infrastructure. We’re looking for a BDR who already knows how to run outbound, and is ready to take it further into more technical conversations, more complex organizations, and more strategic account development.

This role is about earning attention from engineers and security leaders, not just landing meetings. You’ll partner closely with enterprise AEs to break into high-value accounts and build pipeline that actually converts.

What you’ll do:

  • Drive enterprise account strategy - Work alongside AEs to map target accounts and identify the right entry points across security, platform, and engineering teams.
  • Run thoughtful, technical outbound - Craft highly personalized outreach that resonates with developers, DevOps, and security leaders — no generic sequences.
  • Understand how modern infrastructure works - Research how companies build and ship software (containers, CI/CD, cloud environments) to make your outreach relevant and credible.
  • Lead meaningful early conversations - Qualify opportunities by understanding technical context, risk posture, and business priorities.
  • Build real pipeline, not just meetings - Focus on creating opportunities that move forward — quality over quantity.
  • Act as an extension of the AE - Collaborate on account plans, messaging, and deal progression.
  • Use tools intelligently - Leverage Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, and data tools to execute efficiently — but never at the expense of quality.
  • Continuously improve the motion - Test messaging, share insights, and help refine how we engage the market.
  • Be a feedback loop to the business - Bring insights from conversations back to marketing and product — especially what resonates (or doesn’t) with technical buyers.

What we're looking for:

  • At least 6 months of BDR/SDR experience (or equivalent transferrable experience)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound (not just inbound qualification)
  • Experience engaging multiple stakeholders within technical or complex organizations
  • Strong writing skills — especially in crafting personalized, relevant outreach
  • Curious and motivated to learn how modern software and security actually work
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building your own approach
  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, or similar tools
  • Track record of hitting or exceeding pipeline targets
  • Required to be a French Canadian speaker

What makes this role compelling:

  • Sell something technical buyers respect — security + open source + developer-first
  • Go deeper technically — engage with real infrastructure and security problems
  • Operate as part of the deal team — not just top-of-funnel support
  • Have real impact on revenue — not just activity metrics

Compensation: $100,000 OTE

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

As Axonius enters an AI-first era, the story we tell must keep pace. As our Product Marketing Manager, you’ll shape how we talk about the product and the role of AI in cybersecurity. You’ll also help ensure our field teams across sales, sales engineering, and customer success can tell that story with confidence. This is a hands-on role. You’ll write the words, build the assets, and spend time with the people who use them: our field, customers, and partners.

  • Positioning and messaging: Craft new positioning and messaging as we enter an AI-first era. Turn product capabilities into clear value propositions across web copy, product collateral, and narratives that resonate with our buyers.

Education
