jobs.description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

jobs.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

Conduct power system studies and analysis to meet regulatory compliance requirements for existing and future NERC and regional reliability standards. This role focuses on power system protection schemes and studies, ensuring protection coordination, and disturbance monitoring capability to adequately support the safety and reliability of the bulk electric system.

The successful candidate for this position has a strong background in power systems with emphasis in protection and control, including experience with industry standards and tools for power system protection. The successful candidate is familiar with protective functions commonly used for conventional and non-conventional generating units and can effectively utilize that knowledge and background in a demanding environment. 

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Perform power system protection studies using software (e.g., ETAP, ASPEN OneLiner), including short-circuit analysis and protection coordination for transmission systems and generation facilities.
  • Review and evaluate existing protection systems, relay settings, and coordination practices to identify potential issues and recommend improvements.
  • Evaluate Digital Fault Recorder (DFR), SCADA, and substation monitoring systems to assess existing capabilities, configurations, and data recording functionality against regulatory requirement (e.g., NERC PRC-028 and ERCOT NOGRR255).
  • Conduct gap assessments of clients’ existing disturbance monitoring systems installed onsite (including DDR and FR capabilities,) and recommend improvements to meet applicable technical requirements.
  • Support clients in NERC compliance activities, including NERC PRC-002, PRC-019, PRC-024, PRC-027, PRC-028, and other relevant standards.
  • Prepare engineering calculations following established principles and methods, while managing assigned budget, schedule, and quality standards. Lead projects by delegating appropriate tasks to junior-level team members and coordinating team efforts for successful completion.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and mentorship to junior-level engineers on protection engineering best practices.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, flow charts, working instructions, and other materials necessary for the continuity and success of the projects. 
  • Leads process improvement efforts, identifying opportunities to enhance organizational efficiency while maximizing team bandwidth and ensuring the quality and timeliness of client deliverables. 

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor’s (and higher) degree in Electric Engineering with focus on power system engineering.
  • 4 - 5 years of experience in power system protection, engineering studies, or related consulting services.
  • Strong understanding of power system protection principles, protective relays, short-circuit analysis, and protection coordination.
  • Experience working with Inverter-based resources (IBRs) including solar, wind, and battery energy storage systems. Experience with conventional generation facilities is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Digital Fault Recorders (DFRs), disturbance monitoring systems, SCADA, and substation communication systems.
  • Experience with power system analysis and protection software such as ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, ETAP, PSSE, PSCAD, SEL Quickset, and GE Enervista UR Setup.
  • Experience working with SEL equipment, software, and/or developing programming files using SEL Quickset.
  • General understanding of NERC reliability standards and their application to protection systems and maintenance.
  • Strong analytical problem solving, technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to work independently, and to collaborate with clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Lead the Change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on media planner and buyer who loves building as much as executing? We're seeking a Media Planner & Buyer to lead paid social and programmatic campaigns that drive audience growth and client results, and to help shape how our media function grows.

About the Role

  • Hourly Rate: $55
  • Contract Duration: ASAP through mid-January 2027, with potential to extend
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Weekly Hours: 40 hours per week
  • Availability: Eastern or Central time zone hours preferred; some availability between Christmas and New Year's required

Company Description

We're an early-stage startup in the AI space, building a news product alongside a new offering for the advertising toolbox. Our team is small, fast-moving, and based mostly in DC and Chicago. As we grow, we're bringing on an experienced media planner and buyer to run our paid campaigns and help us define what this function should look like long term.

As our Media Planner & Buyer, you'll lead paid campaigns that support audience growth and client programs, taking work from brief to live campaign on tight timelines. You'll personally build and optimize campaigns across paid social and programmatic platforms, partner with our audience, creative, and client teams, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. This is also a bridge role: you'll help us spot recurring needs, put process in place, and define what a future permanent hire in this seat should own. We're looking for an entrepreneurial builder who is as comfortable spending a full day trafficking campaigns as half a day writing a memo or brainstorming with leadership.

Scope of Support

Media Strategy and Planning

  • Consult on audience strategies and build media plans for varied audiences, from local readers and broad consumer segments to business leaders, policymakers, and opinion influencers
  • Translate campaign goals into practical targeting, channel, and budget recommendations
  • Contribute strategic thinking through memos, recommendations, and brainstorms with the team and founder

Campaign Execution and Optimization

  • Personally build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and programmatic platforms such as The Trade Desk and StackAdapt
  • Own execution end to end, from setup, trafficking, and QA through budget pacing, testing, optimization, and reporting
  • Deliver against commitments for reach, impressions, engagement, and other campaign goals

Cross-Functional Partnership and Building the Function

  • Partner with audience, creative, and client teams to get campaigns live quickly and adapt as priorities shift
  • Turn performance data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Recognize when the request and the real need differ, and deliver both
  • Flag recurring needs, propose processes, and advise on how to resource media going forward, including the scope of a future permanent hire
  • Look for ways to streamline workflows with AI, such as building agents or automations
  • 7 to 10 years of experience leading and executing paid social and programmatic campaigns at an agency, media company, public affairs firm, or similarly fast-paced environment
  • Hands-on, current expertise in Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and at least one programmatic platform such as The Trade Desk or StackAdapt
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, geographic and contextual targeting, first-party data, retargeting, and the capabilities and limits of each platform
  • Self-directed working style: you identify what needs to happen, solve problems, flag risks early, and follow through with minimal oversight
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns accurately under tight deadlines
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive with ambiguity and enjoy creating structure rather than stepping into a predefined role
  • Nice to have: real comfort with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini, and curiosity about using them to work smarter

Additional Information

This is a W2 role.

We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. jobs.excerpt: Join Kainos and Shape the Future At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact.
jobs.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

The problem we collectively solve for customers


Organisations invest in Workday to transform how they run their People, Finance and Planning services – yet most fail to realise the value they set out to achieve. Programmes drift from the business case, legacy operating models and fragmented processes are simply re-platformed, and people are not ready, willing or able to work differently at go-live. The result is a modern platform sitting on top of yesterday’s organisation, with value eroding in the months after deployment.


Kainos Transformation & Advisory exists to close that gap. Working alongside C-suite sponsors from vision and business case through to measured outcomes, our three specialisms act as one team: we define and protect the value case and programme governance, design the target operating model and harmonised processes Workday will enable, and ensure the organisation’s leaders and people are ready to adopt and sustain the change. Together we help customers deliver the transformation they intended – easier, smarter and faster – and have the evidence to prove it.


Main purpose of the role


Lead Kainos’ operating model advisory, helping customers redesign how People, Finance and Planning services are organised and delivered. Ensure Workday enables a simpler, standardised and scalable model rather than replicating legacy complexity.


Core responsibilities


  • Advise C-suite and functional leaders (CHRO, CFO, COO, Shared Services leaders) on future-state target operating models, service delivery and organisation design, securing executive alignment on difficult design choices.
  • Lead process harmonisation and standardisation in a billable capacity across countries, business units and acquisitions – challenging local variation and defining global process standards and design principles aligned to Workday best practice.
  • Translate strategy into design: service catalogues, roles and responsibilities, governance, shared services / centre-of-excellence models and the data and controls needed to operate Workday at scale.
  • Originate and lead operating model and process advisory engagements, Phase 0 / Pathfinder assessments and proposals, growing the T&A pipeline.
  • Build and lead the specialism – methods, reference models and accelerators, thought leadership and a high-performing team – working closely with Workday solution architects and delivery leadership.

Essential criteria


  • 10+ years in consultancy or industry operating model / shared services transformation, with significant time at Director level or similar.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing target operating models for HR, Finance or Payroll functions.
  • Track record of leading global process harmonisation or standardisation within an ERP Cloud programme.
  • Credibility to challenge and influence C-suite and senior functional leaders.
  • Strong commercial and business development experience.
  • Excellent structured problem-solving, facilitation and communication skills.

Desirable criteria


  • Workday HCM, Financials or Planning knowledge (certification an advantage).
  • Shared services / GBS design or M&A integration experience.
  • Process methodology (Lean, Six Sigma, APQC) or organisation design qualification.
  • Big 4 / tier-1 consultancy background

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du keine Vorerfahrung im Vertrieb. Durch unser eigenes Schulungssystem + deinen eigenen Mentor wirst du strukturiert für deine Rolle im Performance-Marketing ausgebildet.

  • Eigene Inhouse-Design-Abteilung: Schnelle Bereitstellung von Creatives und Grafiken, damit du dich auf die Optimierung und Steuerung der Kampagnen fokussieren kannst.

  • Erreichte Kennzahlen sind die höchste Form der Anerkennung für dich!

  • Du hast den Anspruch an dich selbst, ein echter A-Player zu sein und bist gern umgeben von hochmotivierten Menschen.

  • Vorkenntnisse im Media-Buying (Werbebudget von mindestens 10k€+) sind vorteilhaft - aber nicht erforderlich.

jobs.excerpt: About Patronus AIPatronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI.
jobs.description:
About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

At a glance

  • Engagement: Independent contractor, fully remote
  • Pay: $50 - $125/hr
  • Start: Rolling
  • Location: Remote
  • Team: Talent Acquisition

The role

The data behind our work is produced by practicing domain experts on contract: Unreal engineers who ship games, software engineers, and specialists in whatever domain a customer needs next. We are hiring Growth Associates to find those people and get them into the funnel, across one to three domains each.

This is not a volume seat. Every expert you put forward sits a screener written by the people who will review their work, and you are measured on how many of them pass it rather than on how many you sent. A large pipeline that fails the screener is a bad week.

The people worth finding are rarely applying. They are shipping, and the evidence that they are good is public: commits, credits, talks, papers, answers in the forums their peers read. Your job is to read that evidence and start a conversation that someone with a job they like will reply to.

What you'll do

  • Hit a weekly target for qualified experts added, by domain, set with the Internal Strategic Projects Lead running the project.
  • Find people doing the work now rather than people who did it once. In game development that means shipped credits and current engine versions, not a decade-old title.
  • Work the venues these people actually use: GitHub, engine and framework forums, Discord servers, conference speaker lists, studio credits, paper author lists, specialist job boards. LinkedIn is one channel out of several.
  • Write outreach that survives contact with a senior engineer who is not looking.
  • Hand off clean. Every expert reaches the funnel with their domain, seniority and the evidence behind both, so nobody has to re-research them.
  • Tell us what the market is telling you. If a domain is not there at the rate we want, we would rather hear it in week one.
  • Use AI aggressively. Market mapping, research, outreach drafting and funnel analysis should all be automated as far as they can be, so your hours go to the judgment calls.

Who we're looking for

Required

  • Three or more years sourcing technical or specialist talent, including at least one hard pool you can describe in detail: who they were, where you found them, why that worked.
  • A method you can explain without naming LinkedIn Recruiter. Where do these people gather, how did you work that out, what got you a reply.
  • You can name the last five people you found who were not applying and not on the first page of results.
  • Enough technical fluency to read a GitHub profile, a set of game credits or a paper and form your own view of whether the experience is real or adjacent.
  • You build your own tooling. Scripts, automations, enrichment, prompts. Tell us about something you assembled rather than something you subscribe to.
  • You are comfortable being measured on whether your candidates pass.
  • Clear, precise writing in professional English. Your outreach is the first thing an expert reads about us.
  • Ability to work independently and asynchronously against deadlines.

Nice to have

  • Sourcing for professional knowledge work for a marketplace or contingent workforce at volume.
  • Experience sourcing against a quality gate someone else owned.
  • A genuine interest in AI evaluation, with a realistic view of both the potential and the limits.

What this role is not

You do not run interviews, extend offers or close. Full-cycle hiring sits with our technical recruiters.

How hiring works

  • Resume review and a conversation with Talent Acquisition
  • A short practical exercise on a live domain
  • Onboarding and your first domain

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

Annual Base Salary
$100,406—$153,409 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. Flexible Working

Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

Description

Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel.

We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.

About the Role

Ledgebrook is seeking a Manager, Data Quality to help build and lead our Data Quality function within the Product & Data team. This is a ground-floor opportunity: you’ll be closely involved in designing and building the function you’ll go on to lead.

This is a builder role. Data Quality exists today largely as project work, and you’ll play a central role in turning it into a formal, scalable discipline, with the validation frameworks, KPIs, dashboards, and operating rhythms that make our data trustworthy as we grow from MGA to full-stack carrier.

Working with our AVP, who will set the high-level direction, you’ll take real ownership of the hands-on design and build: shaping the roadmap, designing processes, building the first versions of our tooling, and driving adoption across the business. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is willing to take smart risks, and is excited to try new approaches and learn quickly from what works.

You’ll partner closely with engineering, actuarial, claims, analytics, and operations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Stand up the Data Quality function: Define the operating model, standards, and roadmap for enterprise data quality, and formalize it from ad hoc project support into a repeatable, governed process.
  • Build Data Quality KPIs and dashboards: Design and launch DQ metrics and monitoring from the ground up, including statistical trending, anomaly detection, and completeness measures.
  • Own the validation framework: Define business data validation rules and build automated reconciliations, controls, and alerting across policy, premium, and claims data.
  • Drive root-cause remediation: Move the team from reactive fixes to proactive prevention by tracing data issues back to where they start and fixing them at the source.
  • Lead migration and launch quality: Plan and run UAT, validation, and sign-off for system migrations, new data feeds (including TPA integrations), and new product launches.
  • Bridge business and engineering: Translate business requirements into clear specifications and efficient designs for Data Engineering, and establish shared, documented data definitions.
  • Build and develop the team: Help shape hiring, mentor analysts, and set the standard for quality and ownership as the function scales.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in data quality, data analytics, or similar insurance data-focused roles, including meaningful experience analyzing Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance data.
  • Advanced SQL, Excel, and Power BI for investigation, data modeling, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and senior leaders across the organization.
  • Close attention to detail and the curiosity to trace complex data inconsistencies back to their source.
  • Strong ability to translate business needs into technical requirements
  • Comfort integrating AI tools in day-to-day workflows to drive efficiencies.
  • A self-starter who takes full ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and handles ambiguity well.

Nice To Haves:

  • Experience applying statistical methods to monitor data and portfolio health (e.g., mix-shift trending, control limits, variance, and anomaly detection).
  • Experience at an MGA or a carrier that partners with MGAs.
  • Experience leading or managing analysts.

At Cimpress Open, merchandising is about creating standout shopping experiences that inspire customers and drive conversion. Our team combines visual merchandising, UI/UX, CX, marketplace SEO, and data analytics to elevate the shopping journey for our custom products across Amazon EU and US.

HR Talent & Performance Coordinator

Are you an organized, detail-oriented HR professional with a passion for talent acquisition, performance management, and people strategy? Do you enjoy building efficient recruitment processes, enhancing the candidate and employee experience, and helping people grow and do their best work? If so, Codekeeper offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

We are looking for a proactive and ownership-driven individual to drive recruitment, coordinate our performance management cycle, and support HR operations. You will play a key role in running goal-setting and review processes, supporting managers in giving meaningful feedback, and turning performance insights into development opportunities for our team. Along the way, you’ll refine processes, drive continuous improvement, and help us attract, develop, and retain top talent. The ideal candidate is eager to grow within the role, contribute to cross-functional projects, and bring fresh ideas to strengthen our evolving HR practices.

We are accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit, so we encourage early applications.


Role Description

The HR Talent & Performance Coordinator will be responsible for managing the overall Human Resources (HR) strategies, systems, tactics, and procedures across Codekeeper. They will oversee recruitment activities, including sourcing, attracting, screening, interviewing, and assessing potential candidates, and onboarding new employees. They will also coordinate the performance management cycle, including goal-setting, performance reviews, and feedback processes, and work with managers to support employee development, recognize strong performance, and address performance concerns constructively.


Key Responsibilities

Recruiting

  • Source, post, and optimize job openings on various platforms
  • Design and manage application and screening processes according to company policies
  • Expand recruitment reach and improve candidate engagement

Screening & Interviewing

  • Collaborate with department managers to define role requirements
  • Conduct initial screening calls and evaluate candidates based on established criteria

Offer Management

  • Present job offers to successful candidates, detailing position terms, remuneration, and benefits

Performance Management

  • Coordinate performance management processes, including goal-setting, reviews, and feedback
  • Support managers and employees throughout the performance cycle
  • Help identify development needs and support employee growth

Process Optimization

  • Explore new platforms, tools, and strategies to enhance recruitment and performance processes
  • Document procedures and workflows in the relevant HR folders

HR Management

  • Develop, structure, and document HR procedures aligned with company policies
  • Manage onboarding processes to ensure a seamless transition for new hires

Employee Relations

  • Organize three online team gatherings and one offline team event per year to foster engagement and a strong company culture


About the Company

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.


What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference


Skills We Are Looking For

  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal

  • Ability to adapt and multitask in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and strategic thinking skills


Required Experience

  • Professional Experience: A minimum of 1–2 years in a similar HR or recruitment role

  • Background in recruitment, with experience in screening, interviewing, and assessing candidates

  • Experience in performance coaching, training and development

Additional Info

  • Job Location: Remote

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

At ALICE Technologies, we’re reimagining how the world’s most complex projects get planned and built. Our AI construction simulation and optimization platform transforms the way contractors and owners bid, plan, and execute projects—from bridges and tunnels to data centers and solar farms.

Why join us

  • Pioneer AI in construction tech – Every initiative you lead will embed AI into the flow of work, from automated schedule generation to visual, on-drawing planning.

You’ll be at the intersection of AI, construction workflows, and intuitive design, turning deep user insights into solutions that change how the built world gets planned.

You’ll harness AI at every stage—from discovery to prototyping, validation, execution, release, and post-launch tracking—to surface insights faster, iterate smarter, and measure outcomes more effectively. This approach will help us move quickly, learn continuously, and deliver products that hit the mark.

Bonus: If you have experience in construction, engineering, or construction tech, you’ll be able to draw on that domain knowledge to shape products that speak directly to the challenges of the field.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills—able to translate complexity into compelling narratives.

jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Early Stage, Global Commercial Development – Pancreatic Cancer, this role will lead the global commercial strategy to enable earlier identification and diagnosis of pancreatic cancer. The Senior Director will shape the future early-detection ecosystem—connecting science, screening and surveillance pathways, diagnostic innovation, healthcare delivery, and disease education—with Revolution Medicines’ longer-term early-stage portfolio ambitions. This is a strategic and hands-on position requiring deep cross-functional influence, external ecosystem engagement, and the ability to build markets before established commercial pathways exist. The position is primarily remote, with travel for scientific, stakeholder, and team meetings.

Specifically, you will be responsible for

  • Set disease-area strategy: Own the global commercial market-shaping strategy for pancreatic cancer early detection, including high-risk identification, surveillance, symptom recognition, diagnostic work-up, and referral to multidisciplinary care.

  • Map the patient journey: Identify barriers and opportunities from first symptoms or high-risk status through imaging, testing, specialist referral, diagnosis, staging, and access to treatment; develop hypotheses to improve pathways to earlier-stage care.

  • Evaluate diagnostics innovation: Assess the emerging landscape of blood-based detection tests, molecular biomarkers, AI-enabled imaging, radiology tools, and other diagnostic approaches; translate evidence maturity and workflow requirements into commercial implications.

  • Build the external ecosystem: Develop a strategic map of academic centers, NCI and other research networks, healthcare delivery partners, technology and diagnostic companies, and patient advocacy organizations; recommend priority partnership opportunities.

  • Develop market insights and forecasts: Lead global market research, epidemiology and patient-flow analyses, screening/adoption scenarios, potential stage-shift assumptions, and evidence-based assessments of the opportunity and investment required to enable earlier diagnosis.

  • Shape education strategies: Partner with Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs, Patient Advocacy, and appropriate review functions on compliant, unbranded disease-awareness, provider education, and patient-engagement strategies that address knowledge and referral gaps.

  • Advance evidence and access planning: Collaborate with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Precision Medicine/Diagnostics, Market Access, and external partners to identify evidence needs, operational dependencies, and payer or health-system considerations for emerging detection approaches.

  • Engage priority stakeholders: Translate insights from gastroenterologists, high-risk surveillance programs, primary care, radiology, genetics, pancreatic surgeons, oncology teams, and advocacy groups into practical market-shaping priorities.

  • Connect detection to the portfolio: Coordinate with daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib early-stage commercial leaders to ensure early-detection planning is informed by likely treatment pathways, molecular testing needs, and future patient-identification opportunities.

  • Lead global strategic planning: Prepare executive-level recommendations, scenario analyses, measurable milestones, and phased investment plans; align U.S. and key ex-U.S. perspectives with the broader pancreatic cancer disease-area strategy.

  • Manage strategic partners: Select and direct agencies, research vendors, and specialist partners; establish effective ways of working and deliver integrated, high-quality outputs within budget.

  • Build modern capabilities: Partner with IS Commercial and analytics teams to apply digital, omnichannel, and data-driven approaches to ecosystem intelligence and appropriately reviewed disease education.

  • Up to 50% of travel required.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree with at least 15 years, or advanced degree with at least 8 years, of progressive commercial experience in a biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical company, including strategic marketing and ideally sales.

  • Proven success developing and executing global commercial strategy and influencing cross-functional product or disease-area teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to derive actionable insights and analytics that inform innovative commercial strategies and investment decisions.

  • Strong leadership, with the ability to lead teams, collaborate effectively across functions, and influence without direct authority.

  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively and deliver results within established timelines.

  • Strong clinical and scientific acumen; ability to translate preclinical and clinical data into commercial implications.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills; ability to represent Revolution Medicines effectively with external stakeholders.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and passion for improving outcomes for people with cancer.

  • Ability to assess the clinical, economic, and practical feasibility of screening, surveillance, and diagnostic strategies in a setting where scientific and commercial evidence continues to evolve.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in pancreatic or other gastrointestinal cancers, oncology diagnostics, or development of new disease-area markets.

  • Experience with screening or surveillance initiatives, molecular diagnostics, liquid biopsy, imaging, or AI-enabled diagnostic pathways.

  • Experience building external alliances across industry, academic medicine, patient advocacy, and healthcare systems.

  • Prior involvement with a global oncology product launch or major market-creation initiative in a competitive environment.

  • Experience in a smaller, rapidly growing company with evolving operating models.

As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience.   • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword Health is seeking a Partner Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of a portfolio of partner relationships. This is an individual-contributor role with direct accountability for how partnerships actually run day to day: configuration, billing, integrations, implementations, escalations, and account business reviews. The right candidate brings the operational rigor to run complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships end to end, and the judgment to know when to resolve something directly and when to escalate it.

Set it. Scale it. Keep them coming back. — This is not just an email role. It’s a customer loyalty and retention role, with ownership across email, SMS, push notifications, segmentation, automated journeys, loyalty communications, and customer lifetime value.

You’re a lifecycle marketing expert who knows how to build smart, personalized customer journeys that drive retention, loyalty, and revenue. You’re great at creating and managing campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and other owned channels, making sure every touchpoint feels personal, effective, and well-timed. You know how to turn strategy into execution, keep programs running smoothly, and use platforms like Braze, Klaviyo, or SFMC to deliver personalized one-to-one marketing at scale. If that sounds like you — and you’re passionate about increasing customer lifetime value, reducing churn, and building marketing that keeps customers engaged for the long haul — you might have what it takes to be our next Retention Marketing Manager.

Growth opportunity:

This role starts with ownership of our lifecycle marketing engine across email, SMS, push notifications, segmentation, and automated customer journeys. For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into broader leadership across Loyalty, including retention, subscriptions, rewards, customer engagement, and lifetime value. We are looking for someone who can lead the function today and has the potential to grow with it tomorrow.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

Here’s what you’ll be up to in this busy role:

  • 2+ years of people management experience, including coaching, developing, and leading teams.

  • 3+ years Experience working in marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Klaviyo, SF Marketing Cloud, etc. Braze certifications strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with CRMs like Salesforce.
  • Direct response marketing experience.
  • Familiarity with rewards and subscription programs, loyalty communication flows and lead funnels.
  • Data-driven with strong analytical skills and ability to measure effectiveness of programs and communicate actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of consumer marketing principles, customer segmentation and multi-channel marketing.
  • Extremely organized, strong attention to detail, solid presentation skills, business acumen, problem solving along with project management skills.
  • Experience in health/supplement space an asset.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.

Other Qualities You’ll Need

At AlgaeCal we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • You’re humble, you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
  • You’re hungry to learn more
  • You’re people smart, in the sense that you’re a great teammate

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

Service Processing Specialist, Commercial Lines Support

Role Summary
Provide day to day back-office support for commercial lines account managers by managing certificate requests, policy checking, accurate data entry, and time sensitive follow ups including audits and cancellation prevention. The role reduces administrative workload so U.S. based CSRs and account managers can focus on client conversations and higher value work.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Certificate of Insurance Support
    a. Triage certificate requests from inbox or ticket queue
    b. Confirm insured, holder, holder address, required wording, and special instructions
    c. Request certificates from carriers or generate certificates only when permitted by agency process and authority
    d. Track status, follow up, and deliver certificates using approved templates
    e. Maintain a simple log or task record for turnaround time and completion
  • Policy Checking and Data Accuracy
    a. Verify policy details against carrier documents and endorsements
    b. Enter and update policy data accurately in the agency management system for renewals, changes, and endorsements
    c. Maintain clean file naming, indexing, and document attachment standards
  • Audits and Compliance Follow Up
    a. Track audits due, audits received, and outstanding audit requests
    b. Follow up with insureds and carriers for audit completion using approved templates
    c. Monitor and escalate audit related cancellation warnings and non-compliant audit cancellations
  • Cancellations and Non-Pay Prevention
    a. Monitor non pay notices and pending cancellations
    b. Send reminders and follow ups based on agency timing rules and templates
    c. Document actions taken and escalate urgent items to the assigned account manager
  • Inbox Management and Workflow Support
    a. Support shared inbox delegation by sorting, routing, and filing items
    b. Flag items requiring U.S. team review and escalate as needed
    c. Use standardized templates for certificates, audit follow ups, payment follow ups, and status checks
    d. Maintain clear activity notes in the agency management system for visibility and continuity
  • Claims Status Support, If Assigned
    a. Send claims status requests and follow up for updates using approved templates
    b. Record responses and next steps in the system and notify the assigned account manager
  • Quality Assurance
    a. Perform periodic self checks of entries and attachments for completeness and accuracy
    b. Follow E and O minded documentation standards and participate in corrective actions as needed

Required Skills and Attributes

  1. Strong attention to detail and process discipline
  2. Clear written communication and consistent use of templates
  3. Self-starter who can learn workflows quickly and ask clarifying questions when needed
  4. Comfort managing shared inboxes and task queues
  5. Ability to manage deadlines and repetitive follow ups without dropping items

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

You will lead the development team, establish engineering standards and ensure successful delivery of a scalable, maintainable Contentful-based solution.

Ideally you are also an AI-first technical leader who can embed AI-native and spec-driven development practices into everyday engineering, using emerging tooling to improve delivery efficiency while maintaining technical quality, security and accountability.

Technical Leadership and Migration Delivery

  • Establish appropriate review, security and quality practices for AI-generated code and migration outputs.
  • Drive experimentation, knowledge sharing and measurable improvements in team productivity through AI adoption.

Engineering Quality and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Own engineering quality, implementation consistency and technical delivery outcomes.
  • Establish standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, migration validation and release readiness.
  • Lead technical planning for migration, cutover, rollback and post-migration support.
  • Provide technical direction, mentoring and coaching to developers.
  • Act as a trusted technical contact for client stakeholders, architects and delivery teams.
  • Communicate technical risks, trade-offs and recommendations clearly, aligning decisions with business objectives.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Significant engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex digital platform deliveries.
  • Proven experience with enterprise CMS migrations, replatforming or major headless CMS implementations.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Contentful, Sitecore and associated migration and integration challenges.
  • Strong understanding of React, TypeScript, API-driven architectures and application modernisation.
  • Experience leading engineering teams, making technical decisions and assuring delivery quality.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development and the ability to drive adoption of AI-native, spec-driven engineering practices.
  • Strong knowledge of automated testing, CI/CD, release processes and technical risk management.
  • Strong stakeholder communication, consultancy and technical leadership skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous technical leadership of a Sitecore-to-Contentful migration.
  • Experience with Next.js, Sitecore JSS and composable architecture.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate complex migrations, legacy application modernisation or engineering workflows.
  • Experience with multilingual, multisite or enterprise content platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successfully leads delivery of the Contentful migration across content and applications.
  • Establishes clear technical direction, engineering standards and accountability within the team.
  • Embeds AI-native development practices that demonstrably improve delivery efficiency and quality.
  • Proactively manages technical risks and builds confidence with stakeholders.
  • Develops team capability through technical leadership, coaching and continuous improvement.

C5 Expectation: A technical leader accountable for engineering delivery, technical quality and team effectiveness, working closely with Architects while driving implementation and technical decisions across the development team.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. You will own features end to end across our iOS and Android app using React Native and our web app using SvelteKit, while helping set the technical standard for the team. You will contribute across the development lifecycle, from understanding product requirements and designing solutions through to development, testing, release and ongoing improvement.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Design, develop and maintain features across the ROLR prediction markets platform, spanning the React Native iOS and Android app and the SvelteKit web app.

  • Turn product requirements and designs into reliable, production-ready software.

  • Contribute to key customer journeys including onboarding, account management, market discovery, trading and account activity.

  • Build and maintain backend-for-frontend (BFF) API routes and third-party integrations required to support the product.

  • Work closely with Product, Design and QA throughout the development process.

  • Collaborate with other engineers on technical solutions and implementation decisions.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.

  • Mentor less experienced engineers and lead technical design discussions for larger pieces of work.

  • Identify and resolve technical issues throughout development and in production.

  • Support testing, releases and troubleshooting when required.

  • Consider performance, reliability, security and scalability when developing new functionality.

  • Contribute to the continued development of ROLR's technology platform as the product and business grow.

You’ll Need To

  • Have 5+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 2 years shipping production mobile or web front ends in TypeScript.

  • Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production applications.

  • Have a track record of owning features end to end, from technical design through release and production support.

  • Have experience building and shipping iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo, including Expo Router, EAS builds, over-the-air updates and App Store / Play Store releases.

  • Measure how the cycle lands through completion rates, quality of feedback, and manager and employee sentiment, then improve it each year

Engagement Measurement

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Use People data and analytics to identify trends, track key metrics, and make data-driven recommendations

Automations

Role type: Contractor

Location: Remote

About the opportunity

micro1 is looking for experienced Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) professionals with expertise in SysML v1 and exposure to SysML v2, or demonstrated hands-on experience with SysML v2 modeling, to support a customer project focused on AI training and evaluation.

In this role, you'll apply your systems engineering knowledge to develop reference models, assess AI-generated SysML v2 outputs, and establish clear standards for technical accuracy and model quality.

Candidates may use suitable SysML modeling tools to create and evaluate system models. Experience with graphical or textual modeling approaches is welcome.

Your expertise will help evaluate how effectively AI systems interpret engineering requirements, represent complex system architectures, and produce consistent, traceable models.

What you’ll do

  1. Interpret and translate engineering requirements into accurate SysML v2 models, emphasizing model fidelity and traceability.
  2. Develop reference solutions and exemplar system architectures using SysML v2 to serve as benchmarks for AI evaluation tasks.
  3. Use appropriate systems modeling tools to create, review, and validate SysML v2 models.
  4. Create, refine, and document evaluation rubrics to assess the quality and correctness of AI-generated SysML v2 models.
  5. Review, assess, and provide structured feedback on SysML v2 models, ensuring technical accuracy and adherence to modeling best practices.
  6. Analyze requirements, Concepts of Operations (ConOps), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and architectural specifications to inform modeling efforts.
  7. Collaborate asynchronously through written and verbal communication to clarify project deliverables and resolve technical ambiguities.

Required qualifications

  1. Professional experience in systems engineering, with hands-on expertise in SysML v1 and some exposure to SysML v2, or demonstrated experience with SysML v2 modeling.
  2. Ability to interpret engineering requirements and translate them into technically accurate system models.
  3. Understanding of model-based systems engineering principles, requirements traceability, and system architecture.
  4. Experience working with systems modeling tools and applying MBSE methodologies to engineering projects.

Preferred qualifications

  1. Strong understanding of requirements engineering, system architecture, interface control, and model traceability.
  2. Experience using MBSE modeling tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, or other compatible systems modeling applications.
  3. Familiarity with SysML v2 modeling environments, including graphical or textual approaches.
  4. Experience working with ConOps, ICDs, and other foundational systems engineering documentation.
  5. Strong technical writing and communication skills, particularly in remote or asynchronous environments.
  6. Experience in complex engineering domains such as aerospace, space, defense, automotive, maritime, or communications.

jobs.description:
This role is open to candidates living within one hour of Danish time, all year round: Western, Central or Eastern European Time (WET, CET or EET). Applications from outside these timezones will not be considered.

About Linkfire and the team

Linkfire is the marketing platform the music industry uses to connect fans with the music they love. Every click on our smart links runs through our platform, millions of times a day, and artists and labels rely on our reporting to understand how their campaigns perform.

Our data platform turns that traffic into analytics inside the product, reporting for major labels, and the numbers the business runs on. Data here is part of the product, not a by-product of it.

Engineering is small and distributed, so you get a wide surface area and real ownership. The platform is still taking shape, and you will have a real say in where it goes next: architecture, tooling and the standards we hold ourselves to. You will work alongside the engineers who built this platform, and they will bring you into how it all fits together.

What you will do

  • Help steer how the platform evolves, and grow into owning it end to end.
  • Build and maintain our production data pipelines on Snowflake and Airflow, along with the Python services that power them.
  • Build quality in from the start: everything you ship comes with tests and monitoring, rather than having them added later.
  • Help build the AI agents that take repetitive data questions and investigations off the team's plate.
  • Work with Product Managers and stakeholders early, so data is designed into features rather than added afterwards, and explain your choices to people who are not engineers.
  • Take requests or roadmap items from idea to production, including challenging concepts and decisions early.
  • Own the day-to-day flow of data work: requests from product and customer-facing teams, changes to existing pipelines, and new sources and feeds.
  • Model data so analysis and reporting are easy. Dashboards stay with our analyst, but you know what they need and you build for it.
  • Leave the platform better than you found it: documentation, tests, standardisation, and retiring what we no longer need.

What we are looking for

  • Five or more years building production data pipelines.
  • Strong Python. You have built services from scratch, with automated tests, sound design patterns and code that stays easy to maintain and scale.
  • Deep experience with a cloud data warehouse in production, ideally Snowflake. If your depth is in BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, we will give you room to go deep on Snowflake in your first months.
  • Hands-on with Airflow or a similar orchestrator, and comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes and Argo CD.

How you work

  • Product at heart. You see data end to end, from how it is collected to who uses it and why.
  • Curiosity beyond your own stack. We work T-shaped: deep in data, interested in everything around it.
  • You spot problems and bring solutions, and you find the balance between doing it right and getting it done.
  • You use AI daily and have opinions on where it helps. Tell us about it when you apply.
  • You communicate clearly and directly, mostly in writing.

The stack

This is what we run today. You don’t need experience with all of it, and we’ll help you get up to speed on the rest.

  • Snowflake, with production pipelines in Python on an in-house framework.
  • Airflow on Amazon MWAA for orchestration.
  • Weld for ELT and reverse ETL, Metabase for internal and embedded dashboards.
  • AWS (SNS, S3), Docker, Kubernetes and Argo CD.
  • GitHub Actions, Terraform and Atlantis for CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with parts of our stack beyond Snowflake and Airflow, such as Terraform, Weld or Metabase.
  • Event-driven ingestion on AWS.
  • Building with LLMs, for example tooling that automates investigations or answers questions about data.

Location

Copenhagen office if you want one, fully remote if you do not, as long as you live within one hour of Danish time all year round: UTC+0 to UTC+2 in winter, UTC+1 to UTC+3 in summer. That covers WET, CET and EET, from Portugal in the west to the Baltics and Finland in the east. Full-time, permanent.

Why join Linkfire

  • Six weeks' paid holiday. Wherever you are based, plus a 4% company pension contribution if you are in Denmark, and competitive compensation.
  • Room to grow. Clear, defined roles and a career framework, with the explicit goal of helping every engineer progress, whether that means going deeper or taking on more scope.
  • Experienced peers. Engineers who have built and run this platform for years, and who will treat you as a peer from day one.
  • Scale you can see. Your pipelines turn every click on the platform into the numbers artists and labels act on.
  • Work you can point at. A small team and a large platform, so what you build matters.
  • Remote-first. Flexibility, and colleagues across several countries.

Linkfire is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and identity, and we hire on skills, experience and how you work.

Functional Title: Telemedicine Staff Psychiatrist
Job Title: Psychiatrist III
Agency: Health & Human Services Comm
Department: Chld /orAdolPsych Psychiatry
Posting Number: 22928
Closing Date: 11/20/2026
Posting Audience: Internal and External
Occupational Category: Healthcare Practitioners and Technical

Pay Frequency: Monthly
