Facility Location: Waco Center for Youth
Job Location City: WACO
Job Location Address: 3501 N 19TH ST
Other Locations:
MOS Codes: 210X,44PX,60W,SEI12

Brief Job Description:

Would you thrive in an environment where you learn and grow personally and professionally all while helping make a positive impact on people’s lives? Do you appreciate being around others like yourself who are dependable, trustworthy, hard workers who believe in the value of teamwork? HSCS is dedicated to building an atmosphere where employees feel valued and supported while providing specialized care for Texans in need. HSCS is comprised of ten psychiatric hospitals, two youth residential treatment facilities, and thirteen state supported living centers. The psychiatric hospitals are a hub of excellence for forensic mental health and complex psychiatric care, with all facilities accredited by The Joint Commission. They provide state-of-the-art treatment that is recovery-oriented and science-based. If providing hope and healing through compassionate, innovative, and individualized care interests you, we welcome your application for the position below.

The Telemedicine Psychiatrist III performs highly advanced psychiatric assessment work and reports directly to the State Hospital Medical Director. Work involves conducting psychiatric activities, monitoring trends, and diagnosing and treating State Hospital patients. Administers quality and appropriate specialized psychiatric treatments, assessments, and procedures as needed. Reviews and analyzes system data to ensure recovery plans are individualized and decisions are made in conjunction with the Recovery Team. Ensures that the recovery plans are implemented as designed by providing consultation or training as needed to direct care staff. Attends weekly and monthly meetings and leads or chairs discussions to inform and create buy-in to necessary changes, with follow-through on the implementation plans. Participates in committees of the State Hospital Governing Body and performance improvement activities. Participates in or directs, as requested, any other clinically-related committee that is formed for the State Hospitals to recommend guidelines and standards of care in response to changes in research literature, regulatory environment, or public health as requested by the State Hospital Medical Director or State Hospitals Chief Medical Officer. Plans, assigns, and guides the work of others in the process of the multi-disciplinary approach to patient care. May supervise others dependent upon State Hospital structure. Performs other duties relative to the position. Works under minimal supervision, with extensive latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Performs other duties as assigned. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs):

  • Attends work on a regular basis and may be required to work a specific shift schedule or, at times, even a rotating schedule, extended shift, and/or overtime in accordance with agency leave policy, and performs other duties as assigned. The telemedicine psychiatrist is expected to be engaged in hospital-related activities and to be available during scheduled work hours.
  • Utilizes a multi-disciplinary approach to complete psychiatric assessments of individuals and administers psychiatric treatments and medications within the State Hospital policies/procedures as deliberated with and agreed upon. Conducts all required performance improvement reviews with recovery team members as required by The Joint Commission (TJC), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), Texas Administrative Code (TAC), and State Hospital System policies. Attends and participates in other meetings and committees as requested. Performs medication reviews and other audits in accordance with policy. Plans, assigns, and guides the work of others in the process of the multi-disciplinary approach to patient care per standards.
  • Establishes physician-patient relationship by direct face-to-face contact or telemedicine. All interaction with patients and staff will be conducted utilizing an agency approved video conferencing software, and audio and visual settings must be on during the duration of any patient visit or meeting where patient care is being discussed. For newly admitted individuals, contact must be established immediately upon admission. Treats each individual with the most effective medication and the most effective dosage. Reviews lab work, modifies recovery plans, and records deliberations and recommendations accurately and timely in the electronic health record.
  • Develops and implements psychiatric recovery plans documenting how supports and interventions are customized for the individuals’ psychiatric needs, as well as their strengths and preferences. Documents how recovery plans are person-centered and least restrictive interventions based on risk vs. benefit analysis and treatment history, and how psychiatric supports and interventions are integrated with the supports and interventions from other disciplines.
  • Develops and organizes implementation timeframes and provides guidance to the recovery team and direct care staff while following HHSC and local policies and procedures, TJC standards, CMS conditions of participation, TAC, and other state statutes.
  • Reads and analyzes medical records, leads discussions in staff meetings, participates in conference calls concerning clinical psychiatric issues, and interacts with and makes recommendations to family members, guardians, and Legally Authorized Representatives (LAR) when requested, and obtains timely medication consents.
  • Ensures collaboration between psychiatry and other medical specialists when needed. Provides other medical specialists with necessary information and ensures that psychiatry notes reflect this collaboration. Maintains open and regular communication with the Medical Director, Superintendent, and other staff to ensure the transfer of needed information for the continuity of services. Participates in various Medical Staff Committees and Sub-committees (Utilization Management, Infection Control, Pharmacy, Therapeutics, etc.) designed to ensure patients are receiving quality care.
  • Consults with other psychiatrists, other medical staff, psychologists, nurses, social workers, and others to collaboratively develop psychiatric interventions, identify environmental factors that may impact psychiatric care, and participates in restraint reduction efforts by coordinating medication and behavior therapy.
  • Manages acute psychiatric care, including authorizing emergency restraints and writing orders for the emergency use of medication.
  • Works with Advanced Practice Registered Nurses (APRNs) as the delegating physician. May manage other staff by providing regular feedback, conducting performance evaluations, and taking corrective action when needed, dependent upon hospital organizational structure.
  • Reviews and monitors system data and trends related to the quality of psychiatric care provided at the State Hospital. Addresses issues identified through monitoring of data and presents changes to the recovery plan. Attends meetings and chairs discussions to inform and create buy-in to necessary changes, with follow through on hospital performance improvement plans. Participates in desk and onsite audits by reviewing records and applying audit tools.
  • Participates in mandatory training per HHSC policies and procedures, HIPAA policies, state and federal rules and regulations, and TJC standards and CMS conditions of participations to provide quality psychiatric services and care to individuals served.
  • Develops, implements, organizes, and provides leadership in the area of Psychiatric Services following HHSC policies and procedures, state and federal rules and regulations, and TJC standards and CMS conditions of participations in order to provide quality psychiatric services and care to individuals served.
  • Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs):

  • Knowledge of methods and procedures in the field of general medicine and general psychiatry.
  • Knowledge of principles of the development, implementation, and documentation of person-centered, individualized care and recovery plans.
  • Knowledge of the principles of psychiatric treatment and ability to work collaboratively with staff.
  • Knowledge of the state formulary guidelines for maximum doses, and if exceeded, provides detailed documentation of exception, ensuring efficacy, safety, and tolerance.
  • Knowledge and skill in providing services to people with psychiatric disorders in an in-patient hospital setting.
  • Knowledge and skill in effectively using an electronic healthcare system and Microsoft Office products.
  • Skill in the care and treatment of patients.
  • Skill in the use of medical and psychiatric diagnostic and treatment tools and equipment.
  • Skill in conducing psychiatric research when necessary.
  • Ability to assess, diagnose, and prescribe/supervise treatment to assigned patients while conforming to local policy, Texas Administrative Code, and applicable laws to decrease psychiatric symptoms/disorders.
  • Ability to direct psychiatric activities.
  • Ability to examine, diagnose, and treat mental disorders.
  • Ability to interpret psychological diagnoses and analyses.
  • Ability to develop policies and procedures.
  • Ability to prepare and supervise the preparation of psychiatric histories and medical records.
  • Ability to solve medically difficult issues by considering opinions of consultants and/or appropriate literature including accepted guidelines.
  • Ability to work with the recovery team by facilitating a unified, effective team approach using the expertise of all team members and involving patients to ensure high quality patient care.
  • Ability to participate with other psychiatric staff to provide continuous quality improvement and to promote quality care by adhering to the plan of improvement and state initiatives.
  • Ability to manage “polypharmacy” and to justify and document when the use of multiple psychotropic medications is necessary.
  • Ability to plan, assign, and/or supervise the work of others.
  • Ability to work independently using good judgement and advanced time management skills.
  • Ability to participate in annual training as well as any other required specific training to ensure up-to-date skills and knowledge in required areas such as CPR and safe use of restraints.
  • Ability to organize and present information effectively, both orally and in writing.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications:

  • Must possess a valid Texas driver's license or obtain it no later than 90 days after hire date to drive a state vehicle. Applicants with an out-of-state driver's license must provide an original certified driving record from the state of driving licensure. Eligible driving record required based on HHSC Fleet Management policy. Must be able to drive state vehicles and golf carts.

• Must hold an M.D. or D.O.

  • Must have or be able to obtain a Texas medical license and be board certified or board eligible in Psychiatry, or in a state with reciprocity with Texas.
  • Must be able to obtain or have a current unrestricted registration certificate from the Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA).
  • Must be able to obtain or have a National Provider Identifier (NPI#) as defined by Medicare Part B.

Initial Screening Criteria:

  • Child and Adolescent Psychiatry training is preferred.
  • At least three years’ experience working as a Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist is preferred.
  • Experience working with people with psychiatric disorders is preferred.
  • Experience delivering psychiatric care via telemedicine is preferred.
  • Experience leading a multidisciplinary inpatient team is preferred.
  • Experience in working with a recovery team.
  • Experience in identifying maximum doses of several antipsychotic medications.

Additional Information:

Applicants must pass a fingerprint criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen, and registry checks including the Client Abuse/Neglect Reporting System (CANRS), Nurse Aide, Medication Aide, and Employee Misconduct, and List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Males between the ages of 18-25 must be registered with the Selective Service.

All applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment at a state-operated facility. Waco and Terrell Center for Youth applicants must be 21 years of age.

Flexibility in work hours may be required for this position. The position may be required to work overtime and/or extended hours.

Compliance with HHSC immunization policy and State Hospital operating procedures related to immunizations is required. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, healthcare workers are considered to be at significant risk for acquiring or transmitting hepatitis B, measles, mumps, rubella, varicella (chicken pox), tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis (whooping cough), and influenza. All of these diseases are vaccine preventable. As a result, State Hospital policy requires employees be vaccinated according to their level of contact with individuals. In the event you choose to not be immunized for the influenza virus, you may be required to wear a mask and take other protective measures.

Waco Center for Youth is a psychiatric residential treatment facility that serves teenagers ages 13 through 17 with emotional difficulties and/or behavioral problems. Waco Center for Youth bases its treatment philosophy on the belief that both behavior change and an understanding of self and others are equally important in achieving significant long term success in treatment. The mission of Waco Center for Youth is “to give each youth a chance for change” by providing comprehensive psychiatric residential treatment services to emotionally disturbed adolescents of the state of Texas. The facility is operated by the Health and Human Services Commission and is accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Health Care Facilities.

Review our Tips for Success when applying for jobs at DFPS, DSHS and HHSC.

Active Duty, Military, Reservists, Guardsmen, and Veterans:

Hire Virtue is conducting a confidential search for a Director of Marketing & Communications to lead the development and execution of marketing campaigns, brand content, and corporate communications for an organization preparing for product commercialization and continued growth.

This opportunity is suited to a marketing leader who can translate strategic priorities into coordinated plans, manage daily execution, and develop the people and processes needed to deliver results.

Reporting to senior marketing leadership, the Director will oversee marketing initiatives, coordinate internal and external resources, and ensure communications consistently engage both professional and consumer audiences.

Position Overview

The Director of Marketing & Communications will turn the organization's marketing strategy into effective campaigns, compelling content, and consistent communications across channels.

Initial priorities will include refining audience messaging, developing educational materials, coordinating launch preparation, and establishing reliable campaign planning and reporting processes. As commercialization progresses, the Director will help strengthen the team's capabilities and support broader market engagement.

The role combines team leadership with direct involvement in writing, campaign development, project management, and performance analysis.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate established marketing and business priorities into actionable campaign plans, content calendars, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Develop and manage integrated campaigns that build awareness, educate audiences, and support product adoption.
  • Apply brand positioning and messaging consistently across websites, email, social media, presentations, and marketing materials.
  • Create, edit, and oversee content for professional and consumer audiences, translating complex information into clear and relevant communications.
  • Coordinate marketing activities for product launches, ensuring materials, channels, and internal resources are prepared for key milestones.
  • Manage corporate communications related to organizational developments, research progress, publications, and partnerships.
  • Support public relations activities through media materials, executive talking points, announcements, and coordination with external partners.
  • Lead and develop marketing staff while managing agency and vendor relationships.
  • Partner with commercial, product, and other internal teams to gather information, align deliverables, and maintain appropriate review processes.
  • Manage assigned budgets, monitor spending, and recommend adjustments based on priorities and campaign performance.
  • Establish campaign measures, prepare performance reports, and use results to improve messaging, channel selection, and audience engagement.
  • Maintain clear workflows and accountability for deadlines, content quality, and execution.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • A bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related discipline.
  • Progressive experience in marketing and communications, including responsibility for teams, campaigns, or major cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience developing and executing campaigns for both professional and consumer audiences.
  • A record of supporting successful product launches or significant market introductions.
  • Strong writing, editing, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Practical experience with digital marketing, content development, brand management, and corporate communications.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver quality work within established timelines.

  • Comfort using campaign data to evaluate effectiveness and recommend improvements.
  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong communication and collaboration.

Preferred Experience

  • Marketing within healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
  • Supporting commercialization within an emerging or evolving product category.
  • Developing educational content for specialized professional audiences.
  • Building awareness through organic content, partnerships, and public relations.

The annual salary range is $170,000–$195,000, plus bonus and equity.

The benefits package includes:

  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays.

Working Environment

The organization values collaboration, accountability, clear communication, and thoughtful execution. The Director will be expected to develop others, welcome different perspectives, and maintain a practical focus on quality, consistency, and results.

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Clinical Research Associate (Level I/II) – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Senior Clinical Research Associate (Level I), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

What You’ll Do:

• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable

Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreYellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

This is a hands-on treasury role sitting at the centre of how Yellow Card moves money. You will be responsible for making sure liquidity is where it needs to be, in the right currency, across our banks, liquidity providers, and offshore accounts, so that payouts, settlements, and trades are never held up for lack of funds. Day to day, that means moving capital between accounts, executing wires and stablecoin trades, and reacting fast when a payment is blocked because an account has run dry. You will report to the Head of Liquidity & Custody and work alongside the team's Senior Liquidity and Pricing Specialist, who owns rate-setting and forecasting; this role owns execution, getting the money where it needs to be, accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

Liquidity & Cash Management:

  • Execute offshore and local fund movements between Yellow Card's banks and liquidity providers to keep accounts funded for USD, EUR, GBP and other local-currency payouts.
  • Monitor account balances daily across banks and liquidity providers, and top up accounts proactively rather than waiting for a payment to be blocked.
  • Initiate wires, ACH, and SWIFT transfers across our banking partners within approval limits.
  • Trade with liquidity providers to convert stablecoin to fiat (and fiat to stablecoin) to rebalance exposure and fund payouts, locking rates directly with liquidity provider trading desks where needed.
  • Assist with liquidity movements, planning and projections, and the management of capital cycles and repayments.

Banking & Liquidity Partner Relationships:

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Yellow Card's liquidity providers and banking partners across our African markets, the US, the UK and EU.
  • Coordinate wallet whitelisting and clean-up with liquidity providers whenever banking or wallet infrastructure changes.
  • Monitor counterparty exposure and settlement risk on liquidity partners, and escalate access, settlement, or counterparty issues promptly.

Settlement, Reconciliation & Reporting:

  • Reconcile liquidity provider and bank statements against internal records to ensure accuracy.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks and balance discrepancies, including trades executed directly with liquidity providers outside of standard portal statements.
  • Collect and maintain monthly liquidity provider statements to support month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate, complete records of all fund movements and payment transactions.
  • Support treasury risk reporting by generating treasury dashboards covering liquidity.

Ad Hoc & Cross-Functional Support:

  • Process and review customer refunds.
  • Support funding approvals for opex and payroll liquidity needs.
  • Partner with Finance, Compliance, and Product/Engineering on liquidity-impacting issues, incidents, or new market and product launches.
  • Document processes as you run them and cross-train with other members of the Liquidity team, so day-to-day execution never depends on one person alone.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: Hands-on experience in treasury or liquidity operations experience at a crypto exchange, stablecoin/fintech company, or financial institution and are able to step directly into daily execution with minimal ramp-up.
  • Education: Bachelor's in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics or related discipline; advanced degree (CA(SA), CIMA/CGMA, CFA) preferred.
  • Multi-market liquidity: Demonstrated experience moving fiat and crypto/stablecoin liquidity across multiple banks, liquidity providers, and markets, ideally including African corridors and multi-currency (USD, EUR, and GBP) environments.
  • Payments & trading: Direct, hands-on experience initiating wire/ACH/SWIFT payments and executing spot FX or stablecoin conversions with liquidity provider trading desks.
  • Crypto Fluency: Familiarity with crypto custody/settlement platforms and stablecoins (USDC, USDT).
  • Technical Skills: Strong reconciliation skills and attention to detail.
  • Able to work hours that align mainly with the US business day, to provide coverage during the after-hours window.
  • Traits: Able to work calmly and quickly under time pressure to resolve urgent liquidity shortfalls; a self-starter with high integrity, comfortable operating with real financial authority and a degree of autonomy.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to treasury management systems or reconciliation automation tools, and general familiarity with the regulatory environment crypto-asset service providers operate in.

What We Offer

  • Impactful and Purposeful Work: You will be helping to drive financial inclusion across Africa.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 25+ countries across the world.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.

Ready to Join Us?

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let's innovate, disrupt, and lead together!

An overview of this role

Growth Marketing is the activation and delivery arm of GitLab marketing: campaigns, regional and field marketing, lifecycle and product led growth, marketing engineering and operations, corporate events including Transcend, partner marketing, community programs and Co-Create. If a program connects GitLab to a customer or a buyer, it lives here, and the team is accountable for pipeline, first orders, Flex conversion and expansion, and post sale adoption.

As Principal Growth Marketing Strategist you work directly with the VP of Growth Marketing as a strategic partner and operator. You hold the whole picture of the engine: the goals every function has committed to, the budget and where it is moving, the strategic projects that do not fit cleanly inside any one function, and the decisions that are waiting on an answer. You keep that picture current, you act on it when the VP is engaged elsewhere, and you use it to move work faster.

This is an individual contributor role at the Principal level. You do not manage a team.   • Prepare the VP for high stakes moments: executive updates, leadership material, keynotes, customer and partner meetings, with the numbers checked and the first draft written.

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience in B2B software marketing with senior leadership experience: you have owned a marketing function, a large program budget or a go to market motion, and you have been accountable for a pipeline or revenue number.
  • Breadth across marketing. You have worked in or closely with demand and digital, field and events, lifecycle or product led growth, partner marketing and marketing operations, and you can hold a credible conversation with an expert in each.
  • A track record of landing cross functional projects that nobody owned, through influence rather than authority, with executives, peers and individual contributors.
  • Business fluency: you read a P&L, a pipeline report and a budget model comfortably, you understand consumption and subscription business models, and you can explain a trade off to a CFO in plain language.
  • Program and operating rhythm experience: goal frameworks, business reviews, planning cycles, and the discipline to keep them honest without turning them into bureaucracy.
  • Hands on AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you have built or configured something with them, and you are curious about how they change the way a marketing organization operates.   • Executive communication: concise writing, clear verbal briefs, comfort presenting to and being questioned by VPs and C level leaders, and the judgment to know what travels up and what does not.
  • Discretion. You will handle confidential people, budget and strategy information every day.
  • Familiarity with developer, DevOps or platform engineering audiences, or the ability to get there fast.
  • The ability to use GitLab, and to travel occasionally for events and leadership offsites.

About the team

Growth Marketing at GitLab is one integrated engine of roughly 100 people across ten functions, led by the VP of Growth Marketing and reporting into the Chief Product and Marketing Officer. The team runs Transcend, GitLab's flagship event program, the GitHub competitive motion, the regional and partner marketing engines in AMER, EMEA and APJ, the lifecycle and product led growth motions behind GitLab's self serve business, and marketing's AI transformation. The leadership team operates on a small set of shared principles: speed with quality, an ownership mindset, and customer outcomes. jobs.excerpt: About Circle Cardiovascular Imaging: Circle’s vision is to enable healthier Lives through better imaging by transforming cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MR) and other advanced imaging technologies to improve Cardiovascular Care.
jobs.description:
About Circle Cardiovascular Imaging:

Circle’s vision is to enable healthier Lives through better imaging by transforming cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MR) and other advanced imaging technologies to improve Cardiovascular Care. Circle Cardiovascular’s 'cvi42' is the Cardiac MR market leader imaging processing software.

Circle Cardiovascular Imaging (Circle) designs, builds, and implements the best-in-class cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance Imaging solutions. At the heart of everything we do is our unrelenting drive to continually offer better solutions for healthcare providers that improve healthcare outcomes. This fuels our creativity, informs our decisions and it is the reason we are passionate about our work and most importantly why we are successful. We are careful stewards of resources focused on optimizing both customer and investor value. We strive to make Circle a place where employees are highly valued, engaged, and have opportunities for professional development. Our roots are medical and digital, our passion is contagious, and our people are amongst the best.

Position Overview:

The Account Sales Executive (ASE) for the Outpatient Imaging & Physician Office Market is a specialized, quota-carrying role dedicated 100% to the US outpatient segment: independent and freestanding imaging centers (IDTFs), hospital-affiliated outpatient imaging, and private cardiology and physician practices. These accounts are independent businesses that must generate revenue, win physician referrals, and protect margin, so the segment is economically very different from the hospital market. The ASE sells the same Circle platforms as our geography-based ASEs (CMR, CCT, SHD, and EP) but wins by speaking the buyer’s language: reimbursement, referral growth, throughput, differentiation, and return on investment. The ideal candidate pairs genuine cardiovascular imaging fluency with real business acumen, understands how an imaging center or cardiology practice is paid and who its customers are, and can show how Circle’s applications, especially coronary CTA with AI-based plaque quantification, unlock new billable service lines and a measurable financial case for adoption. The role is measured on sales results.

Understanding the Outpatient Customer: Economics & Value Positioning

Success depends on understanding how these accounts run as businesses and how Circle creates financial value for them. The ASE must be fluent in, and able to sell against, the realities of the segment:

  • How they get paid. Freestanding centers and office-based practices are largely fee-for-service, billing per study under the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule and commercial equivalents, generally at lower rates than the hospital OPPS setting. The ASE must understand technical, professional, and global billing and how reimbursement shapes what a center can afford and where it makes money.
  • New billable service lines. Coronary CTA (CCTA) with AI-based quantitative plaque analysis now carries established CPT codes and Medicare payment, so Circle becomes a source of incremental revenue rather than pure cost. The ASE must be able to build the per-study and annual revenue case.
  • Who their customers are. Unlike a hospital, the outpatient center’s customer is the referring physician who sends patients, and for cardiology practices their own panel. Referral capture and retention is the lifeblood of the business, and the ASE must position Circle to win and keep referrers through faster, more advanced reporting.
  • How they compete. Centers compete with the local hospital and each other on turnaround, service, advanced capability, and referring-physician experience. The ASE must turn Circle’s advanced cardiac imaging into a competitive advantage for the account.
  • Return on investment. The ASE must independently build a credible ROI case covering incremental reimbursement, new volume, throughput and read-time gains, payback period, and downstream referral value, and present it to an owner or administrator who thinks like a business owner.
  • Ownership and buying models. The segment ranges from single physician-owners who decide quickly to practice administrators, MSOs, multi-site imaging groups, and private-equity-backed platforms that buy centrally. The ASE must find the real economic decision-maker and run both fast single-site deals and structured multi-site agreements.

General Responsibilities:

  • Own a US outpatient territory of imaging centers, IDTFs, and private cardiology and physician practices, prospecting and closing new business while expanding Circle across CMR, CCT, SHD, and EP, with a strong emphasis on CCTA-driven opportunities.
  • Lead the full sales cycle, engaging physician-owners, practice administrators, lead cardiologists and radiologists, and platform or MSO executives, and bringing in Circle’s Clinical Application Specialist (CAS) team for deeper technical and workflow discovery.
  • Build and present the financial and clinical business case, quantifying incremental reimbursement, new billable service lines (CCTA plaque analysis), throughput, and ROI, tailored to each account’s economics and reimbursement setting.
  • Help accounts stand up and grow advanced cardiac service lines, positioning Circle as the enabler of new revenue and a tool to win and retain referring physicians.
  • Map and engage the outpatient decision-making unit (owner, practice or office manager, billing and operations, referring physicians, and IT) and navigate single-site, multi-site, and PE or MSO buying structures to secure contracts.
  • Deliver pre-sales demonstrations online, at congresses, and on-site, covering the core aspects of Circle’s applications, and partner with the CAS team for in-depth, workflow-specific demonstrations.
  • Work with the Marketing Demand Generation Manager to align outreach with marketing programs and generate pipeline in the segment, and provide regular forecasts and market feedback to sales management.
  • Achieve and exceed sales targets, continuously building product, clinical, and reimbursement knowledge and staying current with CPT coding, Medicare payment changes, competitor activity, and consolidation and private-equity dynamics.

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Proven track record in a quota-carrying sales role, ideally selling into outpatient imaging centers, IDTFs, or private physician and cardiology practices; medical device, imaging, or healthcare software sales strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of US outpatient reimbursement (Medicare Physician Fee Schedule versus hospital OPPS; technical, professional, and global billing; CPT coding; the economics of fee-for-service imaging), or the clear ability to learn and sell it quickly.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to independently build and present an ROI and revenue case to physician-owners and administrators who think like business owners.
  • Understanding of referral-driven practice economics, including how centers and cardiology offices attract and retain referring physicians, and how to position Circle to strengthen that base.
  • Cardiovascular imaging fluency, ideally as a technologist, clinical applications specialist, or vendor representative, with the credibility to independently lead a conversation on CCTA, plaque analysis, and core Circle workflows.
  • Ability to navigate diverse buying structures, from single physician-owners and administrators to multi-site groups, MSOs, and PE-backed platforms, running both fast single-site deals and structured multi-site agreements.
  • Strong negotiation and closing instincts, and strong presentation and communication skills, articulating clinical value and business impact to clinical, non-clinical, and business-owner audiences.

Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, bio-engineering, IT, or a related area; equivalent experience as an imaging technologist, a clinical or vendor specialist in cardiovascular imaging, or in outpatient imaging sales will also be considered.

About the Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and vacation
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Employee Wellness Program
  • Professional development and tuition reimbursement program
  • Gratifying internal recognition/kudos programs
  • Annual salary review – based on company and individual performance
  • Fun, inclusive, ego-free environment where diversity and individual thoughts are encouraged and valued

Upon joining Circle CVI, you will be welcomed into a collaborative and supportive company with uncompromising values on quality, innovation, culture, and customer service. Join us in changing the medical technology world and submit your application below!

jobs.description:
About Ars X Machina

As a 2026 AdAge Best Places to Work company, Ars X Machina (AXM) is a full-service media planning, buying, and analytics agency headquartered in San Francisco, with a remote team distributed across the U.S. We craft omnichannel, data-driven media strategies that span the entire paid media landscape. From audience development and strategic planning to budget forecasting, execution, optimization, and reporting, we manage the full media lifecycle end-to-end. Our experience spans both B2B and B2C, supporting brand-building and performance-driven campaigns.

What sets AXM apart? Our agility, strategic leadership, and innovative mindset, all rooted in a collaborative, people-first culture where both clients and team members thrive.

As Director of AI Innovation & Enablement, you’ll help lead Ars X Machina’s evolution from an AI-enabled agency to an AI-native one, where teams can securely query approved knowledge and data, automate work, and turn answers into better decisions and new ideas. You’ll evolve our current AI capabilities and lead the architecture that helps teams find efficiencies across paid media planning, activation, measurement, and operations, giving people more time to execute the highest-value work. Those same capabilities will drive innovation through sharper strategies, new services, and proprietary solutions for clients.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll evaluate technology, configure AI assistants and agents, build automations, connect approved knowledge and data, and test outputs across approved AI platforms and systems. You’ll make those capabilities useful to teams through role-specific training, coaching, office hours, and playbooks grounded in real work, helping employees combine marketing expertise, AI, data, automation, and human judgment.

Working with the Leadership team, you’ll lead one AI roadmap across Media Planning & Investment, Analytics & Data Science, and Operations. You’ll use an Agile approach to prioritize initiatives, build and test with teams, learn quickly, and scale what works. You’ll guide responsible use and investment decisions while driving proven ideas into daily practice. Success will show up in stronger employee skills, sustained adoption, faster and higher-quality work, and new value clients can see.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own a focused AI strategy and roadmap

  • Translate agency and client priorities into a focused AI portfolio using Agile Scrum. Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, automation, martech, and data capabilities; separate practical opportunities from hype and recommend where AXM should experiment, invest, partner, or develop new capabilities.
  • Manage intake, prioritization, pilots, rollout, measurement, and maintenance. Recommend platforms, investments, and sequencing, deciding what to test, scale, defer, or stop.

Design and validate AI workflows

  • Partner with Media Planning & Investment, Analytics & Data Science, and Operations to identify recurring work and test approved AI workflows for new business development, research, campaign builds, trafficking, pacing, optimizations, and reporting. Scale concepts across the agency after team validation of quality, usefulness, and risk.
  • Identify opportunities for agents to coordinate multi-step media, measurement, and operational workflows across agency teams. Define autonomy limits, required human oversight, and standards for testing, monitoring, and maintaining agent-driven work.

Evolve, build, and scale AXM’s AI portfolio

  • Build and maintain approved assistants, agents, and automations, with clear ownership, support, and cost controls.
  • Make approved AXM knowledge and client data securely queryable, with appropriate permissions and answer validation.
  • Partner with Leadership and the AXM client facing team to apply proven AI capabilities to client challenges and develop sharper strategies, new services, and proprietary solutions.

Drive adoption and develop a workforce of marketing technologists

  • Provide hands-on training, office hours, and playbooks that help teams apply AI to their daily work. Partner with Managers and AI champions to remove barriers, set adoption goals, and track sustained use.
  • Build role-based AI learning paths for onboarding and development, covering workflow design, automation, output evaluation, and peer coaching through real client work.

Protect quality, client data, and responsible use

  • Work with Operations and IT to protect company and client data and keep AI outputs reliable. Check answers against their sources, verify calculations, and retest after updates.

Measure value

  • Track verified adoption, quality, build time, and net business value against baselines.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience: 5+ years in marketing technology, analytics, operations, consulting, or equivalent relevant work. Strong understanding of paid media and agency workflows, preferably gained at an ad agency. Demonstrated success rolling out AI or automation with teams, with measurable gains in adoption, quality, efficiency, or client value.
  • Technical Skills: Hands-on proficiency with AI platforms, including assistants, agents, automations, knowledge sources, workflows, and output evaluation. Familiarity with APIs, data structures, and low-code automation is highly preferred. Scripting or coding experience to prototype automations and troubleshoot integrations is a plus, as is experience with Agile or Scrum.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, training, facilitation, and stakeholder management. Ability to explain technical concepts across differing skill levels, build trust, secure leadership commitments, and develop role-based learning paths and AI champions.
  • Other Requirements: Ability to prioritize initiatives, meet deadlines, and measure value. Sound judgment on confidentiality, security, permissions, and human oversight; discipline to document, maintain, simplify, and retire ineffective workflows.

Production software engineering, model training, and a computer-science degree are not prerequisites.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required.

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

A vertical de Risco e Prevenção à Fraude do Grupo Boticário sustenta transações em escala massiva em múltiplos canais de venda, franquias e e-commerces. Buscamos uma pessoa Product Manager II (Especialista) com alta maturidade profissional, visão de plataforma técnica e excelente capacidade de articulação institucional. Sua missão será liderar o discovery, o roadmap e a execução dessa nova plataforma, atuando como o elo de confiança entre Engenharia, Ciência de Dados e as áreas de Negócio/Operações, resgatando a credibilidade da frente e garantindo que segurança transacional e experiência do cliente caminhem juntas.
  • Liderança da Estratégia de Produto de Plataforma: Definir a visão, o roadmap tático-estratégico e os marcos de entrega da nova plataforma de antifraude, liderando o decoupling e a migração gradual do legado para nova arquitetura orientada a microsserviços e eventos;
  • Gestão e Articulação de Stakeholders: Construir pontes e pactos de confiança com áreas de Negócio, Operações de Prevenção à Fraude, Crédito, Canais Comerciais e Compliance, traduzindo complexidades de arquitetura em valor tangível para o negócio;
  • Governança e Comunicação Executiva: Estruturar narrativas claras sobre o racional da nova arquitetura, gerenciar expectativas, reportar riscos e dependências em fóruns executivos e liderar alinhamentos em cenários de alta pressão ou questionamento técnico;
  • Definição e Gestão de Indicadores (North Star & Guardrails): Estabelecer e acompanhar métricas de produto e eficiência operacional, tais como taxa de perda por fraude (loss rate), falso positivo, tempo de resposta/latência de análise transacional, SLAs de motor de risco e estabilidade sistêmica;
  • Parceria com Engenharia e Dados: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Tech Lead, Arquitetura e equipes de Data Science para integrar modelos preditivos de Machine Learning e regras de negócio com mínima fricção e alta disponibilidade;
  • Cultura de Produto e Excelência Técnica: Atuar como referência metodológica na squad, aplicando discovery contínuo, hipóteses bem estruturadas, definição de MVPs e refinamento técnico de contratos de API.
  • Vivência no ciclo de vida completo de produtos digitais complexos, com foco em plataformas transacionais, infraestrutura de tecnologia, pagamentos, crédito ou risco/fraude;
  • Domínio de Migração de Legados: Experiência prática na condução de transições arquiteturais complexas (desacoplamento de monolitos, microsserviços, mensageria/APIs), sabendo orquestrar convivência entre legado e novo ambiente sem impacto na operação;
  • Gestão de Relacionamento e Inteligência Política: Alta capacidade de negociação, escuta ativa e influência sem autoridade formal para atuar em ambientes de atrito, alinhando expectativas divergentes e recuperando a credibilidade de iniciativas técnicas frente ao negócio;
  • Comunicação e Storytelling Estratégico: Habilidade diferenciada de sintetizar discussões profundas de engenharia e dados para tomadores de decisão não técnicos, sustentando posicionamentos com clareza e dados consistentes;
  • Orientação a Métricas e Decisão Baseada em Dados: Familiaridade com métricas financeiras e analíticas de prevenção a fraude (conversão vs. risco, churn transacional, falsos positivos e chargebacks);
  • Trabalho em Ambiguidade: Resiliência e autonomia para estruturar problemas abertos, mapear incertezas e tomar decisões estratégicas mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Formação ou histórico profissional na intersecção de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência prévia no segmento de antifraude, atuando com motores de regras (Rule Engines) e integração de modelos estatísticos/ML em tempo real;
Diferenciais:
  • Conhecimento de ecossistemas omnicanal de grande porte (varejo, franquias, e-commerce ou fintechs com alto volume transacional).

Colibri Digital are looking for three New Business Development Managers to win new customers within data, cloud and AI consulting.

The key to this position is experience selling consulting or professional services. You will have sold complex, high-value services engagements, ideally in data, cloud or AI, where the value is in outcomes rather than product.
This is a pure new-logo role. There is no inherited account base, no book of existing customers and no pipeline handed over on day one. You will build your own territory from scratch, from target list to first signed project, and you will have the autonomy to do it your way.
We sell complex, high-value consulting engagements, and our buyers don't respond to transactional selling. You'll succeed by being consultative and relationship-led: earning trust, understanding a client's business challenges better than anyone else at the table, and shaping solutions around the outcomes they care about.

Why this role is worth a conversation?
You get to build, not just inherit. A blank sheet is a real opportunity here. You'll decide where to focus, who to target and how to open the door, and you'll see the direct result of every relationship you build.
You'll have something worth talking about. We're trusted partners of AWS and Databricks and we lead from the front on Generative AI adoption, helping clients move from experimentation to production-grade impact. You'll be opening conversations about work that matters, with global brands and public sector leaders.
You won't sell alone. You will partner closely with our delivery, solution architecture and partner alliance teams from the first conversation, to qualify, shape and close opportunities that are credible and deliverable.
You'll help shape how the team wins. You're joining a growing new-business team, with multiple openings, at the point where its approach is still being formed. Your ideas on how we target, engage and win will carry real weight, and uncapped commission means your results are rewarded.

Key Responsibilities

  • Your territory. Defining your target market, researching and prioritising accounts, and building a territory plan that turns a blank sheet into a healthy, self-generated pipeline.
  • New customer relationships. Identifying and engaging decision-makers in organisations we don't yet work with, and building credible, trusted relationships from first conversation through to contract.
  • Consultative selling. Leading discovery-driven conversations that uncover the real business challenge, then framing our value around measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction and new market opportunities, rather than technology features.
  • Your own pipeline. Generating opportunities through outbound outreach, industry events, networking, referrals and our AWS and Databricks partner ecosystems.
  • The full sales cycle. Taking opportunities from first contact and qualification through solution shaping, proposal, negotiation and close of the first foundational project.
  • Foundations for long-term accounts. Landing new logos in a way that sets them up to grow, with multi-threaded relationships and a smooth handover into account growth.
  • Creative deal structures. Developing commercial models that align our delivery with the customer's desired outcomes.
  • Forecasting and bookings. Meeting monthly, quarterly and annual new-logo bookings targets, and keeping an accurate, well-qualified pipeline and forecast in our CRM.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

We're particularly interested in evidence that you have:
  • A proven new-logo track record. A verifiable history of exceeding targets by winning net-new customers rather than growing existing accounts. Be ready to talk to us through specific logos you opened and how you won them.
  • Built a territory from scratch. You have started with an empty patch before and created a pipeline through your own prospecting and relationship-building.
  • A consultative, relationship-first style. You win through curiosity, insight and trust. You ask great questions, listen hard and build relationships that last beyond a single deal.
  • Sold consulting or professional services. You have sold complex, high-value services engagements, ideally in data, cloud or AI, where the value is in outcomes rather than product.
  • Executive presence. You are confident presenting to C-suite decision-makers (CEO, CFO, CDO, CTO) as well as technical leaders, and can navigate complex buying groups.
  • Drive and autonomy. You are self-motivated, resilient and energised by building something from the ground up.
  • Excellent communication. You are articulate, persuasive and credible in both writing and conversation.

Benefits

  • A competitive salary, depending on experience, with an uncapped commission structure
  • Salary Sacrifice Pension plan of 5+3
  • 25 days' annual leave + 1 birthday day
  • Private Medical and wider benefits
  • Remote-first within the UK, with flexibility around client needs
This is a client-facing role, so there will be travel to client sites, partner events and Colibri/Nasstar offices, including central London, when required.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to build and maintain the data platform behind Kindsight's customer-facing analytics products. You will work across the full pipeline: ingesting data from customer environments into our data lake, and transforming it through a dimensional data warehouse that powers dashboards and AI-driven insights. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building production data systems and wants depth in modern data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and multi-tenant analytics at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and maintain ELT pipelines that ingest data from customer Salesforce environments into our AWS data lake, covering both scheduled batch loads and near-real-time change data capture.

  • Develop data transformation layers (medallion architecture) and dimensional models in dbt on Redshift or Snowflake, implementing incremental logic, slowly changing dimensions, and derived metrics against defined specifications.

  • Write and optimize advanced SQL for transformation, aggregation, and data quality validation across large, multi-tenant datasets.

  • Work hands-on with AWS: S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Step Functions, Lambda, IAM, Lake Formation, and CloudWatch.

  • Onboard new customer data sources by extending existing configuration-driven pipelines, and verify each onboarding against defined acceptance criteria.

  • Build automated data quality checks, reconciliation queries, and monitoring so that pipeline failures are caught and diagnosed quickly.

  • Investigate and resolve data issues end to end — from source system behaviour through ingestion and transformation to the final reported number.

  • Contribute to infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or Terraform) for the pipelines and resources you work on.

  • Support dashboard and reporting development in QuickSight or Tableau, ensuring the underlying data models serve them correctly.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building and operating production data pipelines.

  • Advanced SQL. You are comfortable with window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query performance tuning, and you can debug a wrong number by reading the query plan and the data.

  • 2+ years of hands-on AWS experience, including S3, Glue, Athena or Redshift, IAM, and at least one orchestration service such as Step Functions, or Airflow.

Bonus:

  • Experience integrating Salesforce data, including the REST and Bulk APIs, Change Data Capture, and Salesforce data models and objects.

  • Familiarity with fundraising or nonprofit sector data, or CRM and ERP data models more generally.

  • Experience with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, or Delta Lake

  • Experience with multi-tenant data platforms and tenant isolation patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, particularly AWS CDK.

  • Experience with BI development in QuickSight or Tableau.

Oxford Medical Simulation Inc (OMS) is scaling fast in the US and we’re hiring a commercial, Account Manager to own renewals and expansion across a portfolio of academic institutions.

This is a role for someone who loves running a book of business, building executive relationships, and closing revenue - protecting and growing ARR through structured renewal motion, account planning, and value-led commercial negotiation.

You do not need prior virtual reality experience. We’ll train you on OMS’s platform and products. What matters most is that you can retain and grow accounts with rigor, pace, and commercial instinct.

What You’ll Own

  • Renewal revenue: own end-to-end renewals for your portfolio,

  • Forecasting & accuracy: maintain a reliable forecast and pipeline, with strong CRM hygiene and forecasting in Hubspot

  • Executive relationships: build multi-threaded relationships across faculty leadership, program directors, simulation leadership, procurement, IT, and budget owners

  • Commercial negotiation: lead pricing, packaging, and contract negotiations (including multi-year deals), partnering with Legal/Finance as needed

  • Account strategy: run account plans for top customers, mapping stakeholders, renewal risks, competitive threats, and expansion paths

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Build and execute account plans to expand footprint across programs, campuses, cohorts, or departments

  • Identify new buying centers and develop expansion opportunities (e.g., additional programs, multi-campus rollout, new use cases)

  • Recurring QBRs and touch points with key stakeholders to drive utilization and best practices for Success

  • Own and progress commercial conversations through procurement, contracting, and approvals

  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Product, Clinical, Support) to remove blockers and protect revenue

  • Represent OMS at conferences and events to deepen customer relationships and uncover expansion opportunities

Who You Are

We’re looking for a commercial AM who has consistently delivered results.

Required

  • 3+ years experience in quota-carrying Account Management (renewals + expansion) in B2B healthcare or healthcare academia SaaS

  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding 100%+ NRR targets

  • Experience managing renewals end-to-end, including pricing and negotiation

  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and CRM excellence ideally in Hubspot

  • Comfort with complex, multi-stakeholder environments and long buying cycles

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare education, clinical training, simulation, or adjacent markets

  • Experience working through procurement, IT review, and contracting processes common in academia

You’ll thrive here if you

  • Love owning a number and building a plan to hit it

  • Are proactive, organized, and relentless about renewal risk management

  • Can communicate value with senior stakeholders and defend price with confidence

About Oxford Medical Simulation

OMS helps health systems, nursing schools, and medical schools deliver training and assessment better, cheaper, faster and at scale.

Our award-winning simulation platform is transforming the way healthcare and educational institutions train, assess, and recruit healthcare professionals. By combining cutting-edge 3D visualization with artificial intelligence and leading educational theory, OMS delivers all of the benefits of physical simulation while driving significant savings and improving patient care.

Founded in 2017 and commercially launching the award-winning OMS Platform in late 2018, OMS has experienced rapid growth with deployments spanning more than 100 Healthcare and Academic institutions around the world including Mayo Clinic, Advent Health, Johns Hopkins, the NHS, and the world’s #1 pediatric hospital.

Who we are

We are Skiers / Boarders, Runners, Rowers, Pilots, Magicians, Weavers, Photographers, Game Heroes, Movie Buffs, and every other variety of people. We are hard working. We are passionate about what we do. We care about the work. We care about each other. We care about pushing the envelope and we care about using our working lives to make the world a better place.

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Security Consultant binnen een centrale overheidsdienst voor digitale veiligheid bouw je de dienstverlening rond cybersecurity testing en exposure management uit, beheer je die en ontwikkel je ze verder. De dienstverlening ondersteunt overheidsorganisaties en lokale besturen bij het tijdig identificeren en behandelen van kwetsbaarheden.

Cybersecurity testing omvat onder meer penetratesten, vulnerability disclosure-programma's, bug bounty-programma's en andere vormen van offensieve beveiligingstesten. Exposure management omvat onder meer vulnerability management, attack surface management (ASM) en de bijbehorende processen, methodologieën en oplossingen voor het beheer van kwetsbaarheden en blootstellingsrisico's.

Je vertaalt de behoeften van stakeholders naar een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en concrete dienstverlening. Daarbij bewaak je de kwaliteit van resultaten en werk je samen met interne teams en externe dienstverleners. Je professionaliseert de dienstverlening, borgt expertise binnen de organisatie en verbetert voortdurend de processen, methodologieën, werkwijzen en ondersteunende oplossingen.

De functie combineert product ownership met diepgaande inhoudelijke expertise. Naast het uitwerken, aansturen en verbeteren van de dienstverlening neem je actief deel aan de dagelijkse werking. Je ondersteunt complexe dossiers, beoordeelt de kwaliteit van activiteiten en resultaten en draagt bij aan de uitvoering van de dienstverlening.

  • Behoeften en uitdagingen van overheidsorganisaties en lokale besturen vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen en verdere ontwikkelingen van de dienstverlening.
  • Activiteiten binnen cybersecurity testing en exposure management organiseren, uitvoeren, coördineren en op kwaliteit bewaken.
  • Stakeholders ondersteunen bij het bepalen van scope, prioriteiten, aanpak en remediaties.
  • Resultaten, rapporten en deliverables reviewen en valideren.
  • Processen, methodologieën en ondersteunende oplossingen binnen het toepassingsgebied beheren en verder ontwikkelen.
  • Sourcing- en aanbestedingstrajecten voorbereiden en begeleiden, met inbegrip van requirements, evaluatiecriteria en kwaliteitsvereisten.
  • Externe dienstverleners aansturen en de geleverde dienstverlening opvolgen via SLA's, KPI's, service reviews en verbeteracties.
  • Toezien op het gebruik van erkende methodologieën en referentiekaders, zoals OWASP, PTES of gelijkwaardige standaarden.

Kennisborging en continue verbetering

Je bouwt expertise rond cybersecurity testing en exposure management actief op en borgt die binnen de organisatie via kennisdeling, documentatie, standaarden en werkwijzen. Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling van interne competenties, zodat interne teams op termijn een grotere rol kunnen opnemen binnen de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast volg je technologische en marktgerelateerde evoluties op en vertaal je die naar verbeteringen van processen, methodologieën, tooling en dienstverlening.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als Security Consultant binnen data-, infrastructuur- of applicatieomgevingen.
  • Ervaring binnen een overheidscontext.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het analyseren, optimaliseren en documenteren van securityprocessen en governance.
  • Ervaring met het coördineren van verschillende teams en het opvolgen van KPI's en KRI's.
  • Ervaring met Vulnerability Management.
  • Diepgaande expertise in een specifiek kennisdomein binnen information security, bijvoorbeeld het implementeren van information security managementprocessen, het uitvoeren van kwetsbaarheidsanalyses en pentesten, het optimaliseren van applicatiebeveiliging met kosteneffectieve maatregelen, het implementeren van Privileged Access Management of het invoeren van encryptieoplossingen.
  • Ervaring met pentesting.
  • Ervaring met securitybeheertechnieken en referentiekaders, zoals de ISO 27000-serie, COBIT for Security, NIST, OWASP en de CIS Critical Security Controls for Effective Cyber Defense.
  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring, ondersteund door relevante certificaten afhankelijk van het expertisegebied, bijvoorbeeld CISM, CISSP of CEH.
  • Je beheerst het Nederlands op niveau C2 van het Europees Referentiekader voor de Talen.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Strategic leadership and management

· Oversee the delivery and goal achievement of projects within the designated program(s), serving as the point of escalation for resolving issues that gCSM cannot resolve.

GCO Representative for the designated program(s)

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

You will build the AI runtime, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation that make the platform's AI features work in production - with cost, latency, and safety treated as first-class engineering constraints. We build on proven commercial models and win on integration, domain knowledge, and evaluation discipline.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: ship AI that customers depend on daily in mission-critical workflows - not demos.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Applied, not research. We use proven commercial models and win on integration, retrieval, orchestration and safety validation. Fine-tuning is an optional track, not the goal.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. Domain knowledge, delivered through retrieval and evaluation, is the moat, not model weights. You will invest early in your customers' domain.
  • Production-first. We ship AI that customers depend on daily. Demos don't count; reliability, cost and safety do.
  • Platform and product. You will build reusable AI capability while enabling products to ship features fast.
  • A founding role. As a found
  • ing AI hire, you will set the patterns and evaluation discipline the team adopts, and help hire the team.
  • Value-based. You will validate with product teams and customers and prioritise by value, building what moves outcomes rather than what is novel.

What You'll Do

AI Runtime and Orchestration

  • Build and operate the runtime, tool calling and orchestration for production agent workflows.
  • Design model selection and tiering, with cost and latency as first-class constraints.
  • Implement and tune retrieval (RAG) and grounding where it measurably improves quality.

Evaluation, Safety and Quality

  • Stand up evaluation harnesses and golden sets, and use them to make ship or no-ship calls and to catch regressions and drift.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks for model and agent quality.
  • Build guardrails and safety controls, treating retrieved content and tool outputs as untrusted.

Production Ownership

  • Own the production behaviour of what you ship, including latency, cost, reliability and failure modes.
  • Partner with product to decide when an agent is, and is not, the right tool.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by setting evaluation and safety patterns others adopt, raising the bar in interviews and mentoring.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production AI: You have shipped software backed by LLMs or ML to real production users, beyond demos and notebooks.
  • Evaluation over vibes: You reason about evaluation, not just prompting.
  • Cost and latency: You treat cost and latency as design constraints from the start.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Agents in production: Agent or RAG systems in production, and the failure modes that come with them.
  • Routing and cost wins: Model routing or measurable cost reduction.
  • Calibrated evaluation: Evaluation harnesses driving decisions; LLM-as-judge calibrated against humans.
  • Optimisation track: Fine-tuning or distillation.
  • Judgement: Knowing when not to use an agent.
  • Languages: Strength in Python or C#/.NET.
  • Semantic data: Experience grounding AI in structured, well-modelled business data.
  • Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software, and its reliability, security and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.
