Private Equity Growth Platform has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Associate, Corporate Development. This position reports to Chief Growth Officer and serves an integral part of the M&A deal process, as well as supporting the external development activity and market strategy development.

Role Overview

The Senior Associate of Business Development will play a key role in driving corporate growth through mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships. This position focuses on the execution of the deal pipeline, financial data gathering, market analysis, and building relationships with prospective partners. The ideal candidate possesses deep experience in specialty medical practice M&A alongside a broader background in healthcare M&A transaction execution.
This is a remote, work-from-home position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Sourcing & Relationship Development
  • Build Relationships: Develop trust and maintain deep relationships with physician practice owners, brokers, bankers, and industry advisors.
  • Partner with Leadership: Partner closely with physician dyad leaders to ensure alignment, credibility, and consistent communication with potential sellers.
  • Represent the Organization: Travel to target practices to present the company’s value proposition and assess cultural, operational, and strategic fit.

Pipeline Management & Deal Evaluation
  • Manage the Pipeline: Track and manage a disciplined sourcing pipeline from initial outreach and data gathering through to Letter of Intent (LOI).
  • Assess Value Drivers: Demonstrate a thorough understanding of value drivers at both the physician practice and surgical center levels.
  • Profile Markets: Create detailed market profiles and strategic recommendations for target regions.
  • Build Materials: Prepare external pitch decks, investment summaries, and transaction materials for executive leadership and in-person pitches.

Financial Modeling & Transaction Support
  • Gather Financial Data: Collect baseline financial and operational data to support pro forma financial modeling for M&As and de novo projects.
  • Inform Modeling Assumptions: Provide key modeling assumptions based on growth projections and collaborate with stakeholders to validate pro forma outputs.
  • Progress Deal Materials: Drive the progression of deal modeling, transaction structuring, and due diligence materials into underwriting and completion.
  • Support Negotiations: Participate in and help lead deal negotiations, providing accurate transaction details and summaries to enterprise stakeholders to inform financial decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with internal stakeholders (finance, operations, clinical leadership, legal) to maintain momentum through signing, closing, and transition.

Leadership & Team Culture
  • Mentor Analysts: Oversee the work product of Analysts to ensure financial projections are accurate for specific deal structures, acting as a behavioral role model.
  • Foster Culture & Integrity: Positively contribute to the team culture and conduct all business matters with the highest degree of integrity.
  • Maintain Compliance: Understand healthcare compliance-related issues and proactively raise risks to appropriate company stakeholders in a timely manner.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree required; Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience: 5–7 years of experience in M&A investment banking, corporate development, accounting, transaction advisory, or healthcare consulting.
  • M&A Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience in specialty medical practice M&A as well as general healthcare sector M&A.
  • Technical Skills: Mastery of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; strong ability to synthesize complex data into a clear investment thesis.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting financial sections and detailed analyses to clinical practice boards and stakeholders.

About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced Creative Director to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is hands-on in visual development, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experience Strategy & Design

  • Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.

  • Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.

  • Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.

  • Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

2. Creative & Art Direction

  • Lead the creative direction across projects, defining the visual language, tone and overall approach.

  • Develop and present concepts, mood boards, visual references and creative treatments.

  • Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.

  • Maintain creative consistency and quality across all outputs and disciplines.

3. Creative Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and guide multidisciplinary creative teams, providing clear direction, feedback and creative decisions.

  • Work closely with UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists, Creative Technologists, Developers, Animators, 3D Artists, Sound Designers and Producers.

  • Encourage collaboration, experimentation and creative problem-solving.

  • Ensure all disciplines remain aligned with the agreed creative vision and quality expectations.

4. Technology & Production Collaboration

  • Work closely with Creative Technology and Production teams to ensure concepts are technically and operationally achievable.

  • Understand relevant technologies, platforms and physical environments, recognising their opportunities and limitations.

  • Balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, scope, budget and schedule.

  • Identify potential constraints early and develop creative solutions without compromising the core experience.

5. Creative Oversight & Delivery

  • Maintain creative oversight from concept development through to final delivery.

  • Review designs, prototypes and integrated experiences, providing clear and constructive feedback.

  • Make timely creative decisions and guide adaptations throughout development and production.

  • Identify and resolve creative and experience-related issues, ensuring the final work maintains the quality, coherence and intent of the approved vision.

Requirements

Your Journey

Must Have

  • Experience: developing immersive and interactive experiences across physical and digital environments.

  • Senior Creative Direction Experience: Extensive experience leading the creative vision and execution of multidisciplinary projects from concept through final delivery.

  • Visual Design & Art Direction: Strong artistic foundation with the ability to independently establish visual direction and create initial concepts, treatments and style frames.

  • Experience Design: Proven expertise in shaping engaging user and audience experiences, including experience strategy, UX and interaction design.

  • Content Production: Demonstrated experience directing sophisticated and technically complex content production across animation, game engines, film, UI and interactive experiences.

  • End-to-End Creative Ownership: Ability to maintain creative leadership and involvement throughout development and production, ensuring the final experience reflects the approved creative vision.

  • Multidisciplinary Leadership: Experience guiding creative teams across visual design, motion, animation, content, UX/UI, 3D and creative technology.

  • Creative Technology Understanding: Strong understanding of technology-driven experiences, including technical possibilities, limitations and integration considerations.

  • Production Awareness: Ability to balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, production constraints, budgets and schedules.

  • Creative Communication: Ability to present concepts, communicate artistic direction, provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

Nice to Have

  • Background in brand experiences involving immersive, interactive or technology-driven creative work.

  • Experience directing creative work across a broad range of content formats and production disciplines.

Engagement Opportunity

The collaboration will begin on a freelance basis, with the intention of transitioning into a full-time role if there is a strong mutual fit. This is a remote position.

This opportunity is part of Fivestone Studios' long-term creative needs.

Thank you for applying. We’re committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it’s not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

Highlights

Location / Time Zone: US / Canada time zone

jobs.description:
Overview

As the Talent Acquisition Specialist at DBMG, you will collaborate with key stakeholders to understand hiring needs across business units to meet immediate and future staffing plans. This critical role will ensure that we acquire the best talent possible to join our business as well as mentors other members of the recruiting team. They oversee the entire candidate experience from lead sourcing, interviewing and ultimately hiring candidates in concert with talent acquisition initiatives that support delivering the companys strategic priorities. This role supports the full life cycle recruitment across DBM Globals business units. From generating a pipeline to maintaining a successful offer acceptance rate, they are responsible for managing the entire candidate process, building scaled processes, analyzing data, and creating a deep partnership with the business.

Responsibilities

Key Performance Objectives

  • Provide talent acquisition solutions and market insight to meet business growth plans and drive key results
  • Develop pipeline of talent for active and passive needs
  • Own and lead sourcing strategies that increase the volume of potential qualified candidates
  • Influence and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, such as effective job descriptions, candidate outreach, employer value propositions, and excellent interview and onboarding experiences, to drive positive candidate experiences.
  • Work with department leadership to create plans and identify resources for staffing needs
  • Partner with marketing and other departments to create compelling campaigns that enhance employer branding and visibility
  • Provide exceptional candidate experience, while managing the full recruitment lifecycle
  • Participate in key projects that enhance internal recruitment process, focusing on immediate and long-term needs
  • Exercise a high level of professionalism and confidentiality when working with staff, projects, and proprietary information
  • Develop and execute recruiting strategies for hard to fill and frequently filled positions
  • Network through industry contacts, association memberships, trade groups, social media, and employees
  • Collaborate with hiring managers and stakeholder employees regularly to keep parties informed, establish co-ownership, improve morale, and source new candidate leads
  • Conduct regular follow-up with hiring managers to determine the effectiveness of recruiting plans and implementation
  • Research and recommend new sources for active and passive candidate recruiting
  • Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient, and positive for both hiring managers and candidates
  • Own the full candidate lifecycle for a variety of positions
  • Collaborate with internal clients to develop sourcing strategy for current and future needs
  • Proactively source candidates using internet resources, social media, employee referrals, recruiting techniques and other creative methods
  • Create and negotiate offers with candidates that may include complex compensation, incentive plans, relocation, or other hiring issues
  • Ensure a smooth and positive candidate and hiring manager experience
  • Liaise closely with internal functions such as HR, Talent Management, IT, and other business units as necessary to onboard candidates effectively
  • Work with hiring managers to ensure job requirements and expectations are clearly understood and candidates are assessed against appropriate criteria
  • Engage in recruiting projects; collaborate with multiple stakeholders and business units to improve candidate engagement
  • Will work on other functions as needed

Qualifications

Core Competencies:

  • In-depth knowledge of recruitment processes, with experience pipelining for future roles
  • Exceptional prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once
  • Strong understanding of latest recruitment trends, including the use of Social Media tools for recruitment
  • Experience with Paycom Applicant Tracking, ADP Workforce Now, iCIMS, and/or Service Now is a plus
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Construction industry experience is highly preferred
  • Experience in a research capacity for candidate generation
  • Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects, and relationships
  • Experience sourcing through social media
  • Strong attention to detail while operating with a high sense of urgency
  • Strong sourcing, interviewing, and negotiation skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with a penchant towards metrics
  • Experience recruiting talent in competitive markets
  • Strong understanding and ability to recruit at all levels of the organization from entry level to executive
  • Knowledge of EEO, ADA, and OFCCP requirements
  • Decisive ability to shift priorities and function effectively in a dynamic fast paced work culture
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work with minimal supervision and guidance is essential
  • Ability to interact with all levels of management
  • Ability to travel as needed

Education/Training - Work Experience

  • Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience YOE in TA Role2-4 years recruiting experience required
  • 3+ years within construction highly desired

Software & Technology

Position will require the frequent use of ICIMS, LinkedIn Recruiter, MS Office Suite, Bluebeam PDF, Concur, ADP Workforce and Paycom

Work Environment & Physical Demands

Position requires as many hours needed to fulfill the daily and weekly obligations required to carry out the job's essential functions. Working long days including evenings and weekends can be required for this position. Position may require travel. A clean driving record will be required along with current and valid drivers license and proof of acceptable insurance. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request for those who have disabilities that qualify under the American with Disabilities Act.

DBM Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer with an Affirmative Action Plan.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

  • Base: $150,000 to $170,000, set by level and expertise based on initial interviews.
  • Annual Bonus: company EBITDA plus personal performance. No commission.

Job Description: Research Evaluation Specialist (PhD, Master's, or Researcher)

Role Type: Contractor (Approximately 15 hours per week)
Location: Remote, Worldwide

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Research Evaluation Specialists with advanced academic qualifications or substantial research experience to contribute to the development of rigorous evaluation materials for advanced AI models.

In this role, you will leverage your subject-matter expertise, research skills, and analytical reasoning to create challenging questions and evidence-based answers that assess AI model capabilities. You will conduct in-depth research, verify findings using authoritative sources, and refine evaluation materials to ensure accuracy, complexity, and clarity.

Prior experience in AI training, data labeling, or model evaluation is required, along with strong research expertise in your respective discipline.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop original, high-difficulty question-and-answer pairs that assess advanced AI model capabilities within your area of expertise.
  2. Research, verify, and thoroughly document answers using primary sources, scholarly literature, and authoritative references, including clear citations and supporting reasoning.
  3. Design questions that require advanced reasoning, methodological understanding, and synthesis across multiple sources while avoiding oversimplified solutions.
  4. Test questions against AI systems, identify items that do not adequately challenge the models, and iteratively increase complexity while maintaining factual accuracy.
  5. Write questions and answers with exceptional precision and clarity, eliminating ambiguity and ensuring that responses are logically defensible.
  6. Incorporate reviewer feedback and consistently follow project guidelines and quality standards.
  7. Maintain high standards of research integrity, documentation, and analytical rigor across all deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. A completed Master's or PhD, active doctoral candidacy, or equivalent research experience as a specialist, researcher, assistant professor, or professor in the relevant discipline.
  2. A demonstrated record of scholarly research, advanced subject-matter expertise, and familiarity with primary academic literature.
  3. Exceptional analytical thinking, attention to detail, and strong written communication skills in English.
  4. Experience locating, evaluating, and cross-verifying information from authoritative sources.
  5. Strong ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality research within a remote working environment.
  6. Expertise in developing original, challenging, and methodologically sound questions that assess deep subject-matter understanding.
  7. Required: Previous experience in AI training, data labeling, or AI model evaluation.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based, with payment provided for each task that meets the project's specifications and quality requirements. The time required to complete tasks may vary depending on individual expertise and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply, and contributors are expected to complete a specified number of tasks each week.

Start Timeline and Availability

  • Hiring Timeline: Positions are typically filled within 48 hours.
  • Availability: Candidates should be prepared to begin promptly.
  • Project Start: Selected candidates are expected to start their first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines advanced academic or research expertise with practical experience in AI training or evaluation. They can develop sophisticated evaluation questions, support answers with authoritative evidence, identify weaknesses in AI-generated responses, and deliver precise, well-documented work independently while maintaining rigorous research and quality standards.

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionIntegrated Business Planning (IBP) brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Integrated Business Planning (IBP) brings together forecasting and planning across marketing, sales, finance, procurement, manufacturing, and customer service into a unified process. This integration ensures alignment across the enterprise, leading to superior customer outcomes.

As one of the CMR/HDX Demand Planners, you will collaborate closely with an IBP data scientist to generate reliable forecasts and coordinate demand reviews. This particular role will be focused on the Cellular Mollecular Research and Health Care Diagnostics sales channels (CMR/HDX). Your role will be crucial in ensuring effective demand schedules, streamlining internal processes, and ultimately enhancing the customer experience.

Responsible for analyzing overall product demand, forecasting future demand and product needs, and providing input into component demand schedules.

Assists in the improvement of demand forecasting accuracy for internal and external customers, working with demand data scientist(s) to determine the appropriate algorithm for statistical forecasts.

The work of the demand planner will enable Agilent to maximize account sales and inventory turns by accurately forecasting demand, managing product history and promotional demand, and identifying historical sales trends and demand patterns.

Works with the demand data scientist(s) to maintain integrity of data for demand model inputs and analyzes internal demand stream information.

Collaborates on Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes to enhance demand sensing and adjustment of long-term view of the Integrated Business Planning (IBP).

Develops reports and leads demand review forums, reporting on attainment of business objectives, adherence to demand forecast schedules and driving consensus on unconstrained demand.

Principle Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Develop Demand Forecasts: Utilize IBP data scientist modeling, market intelligence, and field sales input to create accurate demand forecasts.
  • Coordinate Demand Reviews: Collaborate with sales and marketing stakeholders to conduct thorough demand reviews.
  • Execute Demand Planning: Provide reliable forecasts to ensure effective demand planning.
  • Analyze Historical Sales Trends: Review past sales trends, research demand drivers, and evaluate forecast results to inform future planning.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis: Investigate key metrics such as forecast accuracy, bias, and value add to identify underlying issues.
  • Derive Consolidated Forecasts: Generate a comprehensive forecast of unconstrained demand.
  • Evaluate IBP Deviations: Discuss and understand the impact of last month's IBP deviations on the current month's plan.
  • Facilitate Best Practices: Proactively facilitate and re-engineer best practices, fostering consensus among functional experts.
  • Drive Improvement Actions: Implement actions for improvement and develop a stakeholder communication plan.
  • Monitor Forecast Consumption: Track forecast consumption and plan attainment to ensure alignment with goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.

  • 8+ years relevant experience for entry to this level.

  • Extensive knowledge and specialized expertise in sales, marketing, or finance; experience in forecasting or planning is a plus.

  • Strong executive presence and leadership skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to assess complex business problems and deliver impactful results.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with different levels of management.

  • Self-motivated and capable of operating independently.

jobs.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Portfolio Omnichannel Strategy & Operations Team is seeking a social media expert to manage commercial social execution across the Revolution Medicines oncology portfolio. This newly-created role spans tumor types, branded promotion and unbranded disease state education (DSE), and digital engagement with healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients and caregivers through direct-to-patient (DTP) initiatives.

The Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Social Strategy & Operations will serve as the US Portfolio Omnichannel team’s social subject matter expert, translating approved marketing and engagement strategies into effective paid and organic social programs. This individual will manage social profiles, maintain channel playbooks and execution standards, coordinate social deliverables with agencies and platform reps, and facilitate channel-specific discussions with the Promotional Review Committee (PRC). The role also provides hands-on email expertise, including campaign workbook population, tracking link creation and quality assurance (QA). This role will also act as a SME in regard to the email channel.

Aligned to social strategy, this role will work closely with Portfolio Omnichannel leads, HCP and Patient Marketing Leads, Corporate Communications, Analytics & Insights, IS/IT and PRC partners, this individual will apply and improve established processes, support in-line products and launches, and recommend execution improvements based on performance insights. Brand-aligned Marketing Leads retain ownership of brand and disease state strategy, objectives and core messaging.

The role will work in a matrix with Portfolio Omnichannel Tumor & NPP leads, who own overall customer engagement strategy and priorities for their tumor franchises. With direction from these leads and the hiring manager, the Senior Manager will manage day-to-day social execution, provide channel expertise and recommendations, and escalate decisions on new platforms, capabilities, resources and strategic priorities for alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Portfolio Omnichannel Tumor & NPP leads to execute commercial social programs across tumor types and indications, supporting branded and DSE initiatives for HCP, patient and caregiver audiences.

  • Translate approved brand objectives, audience insights and customer journeys into actionable social execution plans; recommend channels, content formats, paid and organic approaches and targeting in alignment with broader omnichannel priorities, and in partnership with media agencies.

  • Own social profile builds, launches, updates and ongoing maintenance, including profile content, account credentials, access permissions, agency access and account transition or retirement processes.

  • Maintain and update social playbooks and execution standards as platforms evolve, documenting capabilities, creative specifications, PRC guidance and operational workflows. Adapt established templates for new channels in partnership with Portfolio Omnichannel leads and review partners.

  • Coordinate social-specific deliverables with creative (AOR) and media agencies, aligning briefs, timelines and quality expectations with brand marketing and Omnichannel leads. Partner on paid social builds, targeting, flighting and optimization; monitor pacing against approved media allocations and flag variances to budget owners. Coordinate organic publishing and profile activity with marketing and communications partners.

  • Oversee social launch and ongoing QA, confirming creative rendering, links, tracking, profile functionality and alignment with PRC approvals; coordinating asset refreshes and retirement. Partner with Analytics & Insights team and media agencies to review agreed performance measures, support testing and recommend improvements to creative, targeting and customer journeys.

  • Partner with Corporate Communications and Analytics & Insights to assess social listening use cases and support approved pilots or integration into Portfolio Omnichannel operations, sharing relevant audience and conversation insights with commercial teams.

  • Prepare and maintain floor plans for social profiles and ad units for PRC submissions, documenting copy, imagery, disclosures, links and interactive elements. Maintain version control and alignment between approved materials and live executions

  • Join PRC discussions on proposed social channels, platform changes, ad units and creative questions as needed. Gather platform and agency inputs, partner with Medical, Legal and Regulatory reviewers to resolve execution questions, and document decisions in practical channel guidance.

  • Coordinate social moderation and escalation processes with Corporate Communications, PRC partners, applying approved responses and company procedures for monitoring and routing adverse events, product complaints and sensitive inquiries.

  • Identify emerging and innovative social channels, ad formats and platform capabilities that could improve customer engagement. Bring practical recommendations to Omnichannel leads, assess feasibility with agencies and PRC, and support approved pilots with clear hypotheses and success measures; share findings to inform broader adoption.

Email Operations Responsibilities

  • Provide email operational support for HCP and DTP campaigns, populating and maintaining execution workbooks with approved content, audience requirements, deployment details and tracking specifications.

  • Create and validate UTM parameters and campaign links using consistent naming conventions; coordinate with media, analytics and email partners to support reliable measurement across social and email.

  • Lead pre-deployment email and eblast QA, reviewing test sends for copy, personalization, links, tracking, rendering, mobile usability and required footer elements. Confirm approval alignment and coordinate issue resolution and deployment readiness with execution partners.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • 6–8 years of progressive marketing experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including oncology and substantial hands-on experience in social media execution and operations.

  • Deep knowledge of paid and organic social media, profile management, audience targeting, creative formats and campaign operations across major platforms.

  • Experience supporting branded and unbranded programs and adapting channel execution to HCP and patient audiences.

  • Experience managing promotional review submissions and working with Medical, Legal and Regulatory partners to address social channel and creative questions in a regulated environment.

  • Hands-on email execution experience, including campaign workbooks, UTM and link creation, test sends and pre-deployment QA.

  • Experience coordinating creative and media agency deliverables, managing project timelines and executing multiple concurrent social campaigns or launches within approved plans and resources.

  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail and ability to translate campaign results into practical recommendations.

  • Clear communication, effective cross-functional collaboration and ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority in a growing organization.

Preferred Skills:

  • MBA or relevant advanced degree.

  • Experience launching targeted oncology therapies, Specialty Care or rare disease products and supporting multiple brands, indications or tumor types.

  • Experience maintaining social playbooks, preparing annotated PRC floor plans and applying moderation processes and channel governance standards.

  • Familiarity with social listening tools and translating audience insights into marketing recommendations.

  • Experience with HCP and patient email programs, including headquarters-led email and rep-triggered email (RTE), marketing automation and modular content.

  • Experience in a high-growth, recently commercialized environment.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

As a Security Operations Engineer at Samsara, you will join a global team dedicated to protecting our people, systems, and information. You will triage and investigate security alerts, run incident response efforts, and help improve the tools, runbooks, and automated workflows we use to detect and respond to threats.

This role is an ideal next step if you have built foundational experience in a SOC or hands-on security environment and want to develop your technical craft. At Samsara, we view this level as a collaborative apprenticeship: you will develop independent execution skills on discrete investigations, break down incoming alerts into actionable steps, partner with incident stakeholders to remediate findings, and work alongside experienced responders during complex security incidents. You will also explore modern AI tools and insights to simplify routine tasks and optimize your day-to-day workflow.

We are looking for someone who follows the evidence, communicates with intellectual honesty, asks thoughtful questions, and brings a collaborative, pragmatic approach to security operations.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States and in the Pacific Timezone.

You should apply if:

  • You enjoy investigating: You like working through unfamiliar activity, connecting evidence from different sources, and explaining what happened.
  • You want to improve how security operates: You notice repetitive work, unclear instructions or noisy alerts and want to help make them better.
  • You want to develop your craft: You’re looking for hands-on responsibility, feedback from experienced colleagues, and opportunities to grow across incident response and automation.
  • You want your work to have real-world impact: You’re motivated by helping protect the technology behind industries that keep the world moving and help workers return home safely.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor, triage and investigate security alerts across identity, endpoint, email, SaaS and cloud environments, using our tools, runbooks and escalation procedures.
  • Own routine investigations and incidents through to a documented outcome: gather evidence, establish a timeline, assess the activity and explain your conclusions.
  • Support experienced responders during major security incidents through evidence collection, technical analysis, and agreed containment and recovery actions.
  • Maintain clear investigation records and provide useful updates and handovers to teammates across regions.
  • Improve runbooks, help tune detections, and contribute small scripts or automated workflows with guidance and review from teammates.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements.
  • Champion Samsara’s cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Hands-on experience triaging and investigating security alerts in a security operations, incident response or similar role.
  • Experience using security tools such as a SIEM, endpoint detection and response platform, or email security platform to investigate suspicious activity.
  • An understanding of common threats, such as phishing, account compromise and suspicious endpoint activity, and the networking, operating system and identity concepts needed to investigate them.
  • Ability to query and interpret logs, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and recognise when further investigation or escalation is needed.
  • Some scripting experience: you can read, adapt and write small scripts in Python or another language to support an investigation or simplify repetitive work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting findings, explaining uncertainty and providing effective handovers.
  • A careful approach to sensitive information, willingness to ask for help, and openness to feedback.

We welcome different routes into security. A particular degree or certification is not required; we’re interested in what you can do, how you approach problems, and what you’re ready to learn next.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience investigating activity in cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, SaaS applications, or identity systems.
  • Exposure to writing or tuning detections, threat hunting, or investigating activity across multiple data sources.
  • Experience using Python, APIs or automation platforms to improve a security workflow.
  • Familiarity with evidence collection or forensic analysis on macOS, Windows or Linux.

You do not need experience in every area above. Bring a solid operational foundation, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$95,200—$144,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. Brief Description:

The primary purpose of this position is to provide day-to-day case management oversight and coordination of assigned caseload to ensure parties responsible for tasks are completing them timely, as well as act as a primary resource for patients, healthcare providers and field reimbursement. The Case Manager is responsible for ensuring prior authorizations, reauthorizations and appeals are obtained timely, as well as ensuring accurate documentation of payer information and patient status. In addition, the Case Manager is responsible for completing a pre-screen to determine eligibility for additional services such as injection services, co-pay mitigation, and patient assistance programs (PAP), if applicable.

Specific job duties:

  • Provide day-to-day oversight and coordination of caseload to ensure all case elements and tasks are completed timely and ensure cases move through the process as required.
  • Act as single point of contact responsible for prior authorization and appeal processing communications to patients, healthcare providers, field reimbursement representatives and other external stakeholders.
  • Communicate patient benefits and responsibility timely and accurately.
  • Assess and refer patients appropriately for special programs/services when appropriate.
  • Performs quality checks on cases and report trends to leadership.
  • Responsible for good housekeeping techniques, adhering to quality and production standards while complying with all applicable company, state and federal safety and environmental programs and procedures.
  • Troubleshoot complex cases, spanning multiple disease-states, while interfacing with key stakeholders (internal/external) to ensure optimal start to therapy
  • Report Adverse Drug Events that have been experienced by the patient in accordance pharmaceutical requirements.
  • Recognize a product quality complaint and forward caller/written information to a manufacturer.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

  • Two (2) or more years of relevant experience in pharmacy benefit management preferred
  • Medical Assistant, Social Worker or Senior Reimbursement Specialist experience preferred
  • Certification preferred but not required
  • Proficient in MicroSoft Office applications
  • Knowledge of medical and claims processing terminology
  • Excellent written/verbal communication to include providing clear instructions
  • Must possess a strong critical thinking skillset along with the ability to multi-task

jobs.title: Claims Adjuster, APD (AV)
jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

The AV APD Adjuster resolves first-party and third-party vehicle damage and property damage claims involving autonomous and driver-assist vehicles. The role moves quickly on repairable and total-loss files, and applies extra care to sensor, camera, and software-dependent components that traditional appraisal does not cover.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and decide coverage, liability, and damages on assigned APD and property damage claims, using vehicle data and video to confirm whether the system or a human was in control
  • Direct inspections and repairs, including calibration of cameras, lidar, radar, and other driver-assistance or automated-driving hardware after a loss
  • Evaluate total-loss versus repair, valuation, salvage, and rental or loss-of-use exposure for specialty and purpose-built vehicles
  • Preserve vehicle data before repair or release, and coordinate access with the operator or manufacturer
  • Identify and refer subrogation and recovery opportunities, including against manufacturers, suppliers, and other operators
  • Negotiate with repair facilities, body shops, and third-party carriers; control severity and cycle time
  • Flag potential bodily injury, litigation, or regulatory-reporting exposure to the BI adjuster, litigation adjuster, or Team Lead within the same day
  • Keep reserves current and file notes complete and audit-ready

Who you are

  • Detailed understanding of the SAE J3016 levels of driving automation (Levels 0–5), including the difference between driver-assist (Levels 0–2) and driverless (Levels 3–5) systems, and how each level shifts responsibility between the human, the system, and the operator
  • Determine who or what was in control at the time of loss: human driver, driver-assist feature, or automated driving system
  • Request, preserve, and read AV evidence: telematics, event data, camera and sensor footage, remote-assistance logs, and software version
  • Apply coverage, liability, and damages analysis across fleet-operator, manufacturer, supplier, and third-party exposures
  • Work with AV operator safety, legal, and risk teams under tight response timelines
  • Meet federal and state crash-reporting, privacy, and data-handling requirements for AV incidents
  • Document files so a supervisor, carrier, or auditor can follow the liability decision

Qualifications

  • 2–4+ years of auto physical damage or commercial auto claims experience
  • Working knowledge of estimating platforms, ADAS calibration, and total-loss valuation
  • Comfort reading event data, dash-camera video, and operator incident reports
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent claims experience
  • Active adjuster license(s) as required by the states handled, or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire
  • Proficiency in the claims system, document management, and Microsoft Office
  • Clear written and verbal communication with claimants, counsel, carriers, and client partners

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Chief Digital Officer (CDO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Digital Officer (CDO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's digital strategy, leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, and leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, innovation, and business growth across insurance and investment operations.

The CDO will oversee digital platforms, technology-enabled business transformation, automation, data-driven innovation, and digital product development. Working closely with executive leadership and business units, the role will ensure that digital capabilities support the organization's strategic objectives, enhance competitiveness, and deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Digital Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide digital strategy and transformation roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize business processes through technology, automation, and digital innovation.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth, operational priorities, and customer expectations.
  • Lead large-scale digital transformation programs across insurance, investment, finance, and corporate functions.
  • Establish digital governance frameworks, transformation priorities, budgets, and performance measures.

Digital Platforms & Product Development

  • Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of digital platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital insurance solutions, including online policy applications, premium payments, claims submissions, renewals, and policy servicing.
  • Support digital investment platforms for account management, portfolio reporting, transactions, and client engagement, where applicable.
  • Collaborate with product, technology, and business teams to develop innovative digital financial products and services.
  • Ensure platforms are scalable, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with customer and business requirements.

Technology Innovation & Emerging Solutions

  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, cloud computing, robotic process automation (RPA), blockchain, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote technology adoption to improve underwriting, claims processing, customer service, risk assessment, investment operations, and reporting.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate the commercial value of new technologies.
  • Establish partnerships with fintech companies, insurtech providers, technology vendors, and digital solution providers.
  • Monitor digital industry trends and translate relevant innovations into practical business opportunities.

Data & Analytics

  • Develop a data-driven organizational culture through effective data governance, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Oversee digital analytics capabilities to support customer insights, business performance, risk assessment, and strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with data teams to develop dashboards, predictive models, and reporting systems.
  • Improve data accessibility, quality, accuracy, and consistency across business units.
  • Ensure responsible data use and compliance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

Operational Automation & Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive business processes.
  • Drive workflow digitization across underwriting, claims, policy administration, investment operations, finance, HR, and compliance.
  • Improve process efficiency, service turnaround times, productivity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Promote integration between enterprise systems, CRM platforms, policy administration systems, and financial applications.
  • Measure the operational impact and return on investment of digital transformation initiatives.

Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Digital Risk

  • Work closely with IT, information security, risk, and compliance teams to ensure secure digital operations.
  • Promote cybersecurity awareness and responsible technology practices.
  • Ensure digital platforms comply with applicable financial services regulations, privacy laws, and data protection standards.
  • Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience initiatives.
  • Establish appropriate controls for third-party technology providers and digital service partners.

Digital Customer Experience

  • Improve customer journeys through seamless digital onboarding, self-service, communication, and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer, marketing, and business teams to improve digital customer engagement.
  • Use customer feedback, analytics, and usability testing to enhance digital platforms.
  • Expand digital access to insurance products, investment services, and financial information.
  • Promote consistent experiences across websites, mobile applications, branches, and other customer touchpoints.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead digital transformation, digital product, data, and technology strategy teams.
  • Establish digital performance objectives, budgets, governance structures, and delivery accountability.
  • Collaborate with the CIO, CTO, CISO, COO, CXO, and business leaders to coordinate technology priorities.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, implementation partners, consultants, and strategic digital partners.
  • Present digital strategy, transformation progress, investment requirements, and performance results to the CEO and Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Technology Management, Digital Transformation, Business Administration, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in digital transformation, technology leadership, IT strategy, digital product development, or technology-enabled business innovation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive technology/digital management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, fintech, or other regulated financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of digital platforms, cloud technologies, enterprise systems, automation, data analytics, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience managing technology budgets, digital projects, vendor relationships, and cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity, data governance, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial awareness, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Progress against the enterprise digital transformation roadmap.
  • Digital adoption and active usage rates across customer channels.
  • Percentage of business processes digitized or automated.
  • Reduction in operational costs and manual processing time.
  • Digital customer acquisition and onboarding rates.
  • Digital platform availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Customer satisfaction with digital products and services.
  • Return on investment (ROI) of digital initiatives.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity incidents and digital risk mitigation performance.
  • Delivery of digital projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Revenue generated or supported through digital channels.

Senior Implementation Manager

Lead complex customer implementations, align stakeholders, and turn technical deployments into meaningful business outcomes.

Senior Implementation Manager
