About Balto

Balto builds AI for contact centers. We help agents in the moment, score every call so leaders don’t have to, and show teams what their customers are really saying, all in one place.

Full-Time, Remote, U.S. Only

About the role

As a Senior Implementation Manager, you’ll lead complex customer implementations from kickoff through go-live. You’ll bring together executives, business owners, IT teams, and Balto partners around the outcomes customers want to achieve, while ensuring the technology is configured effectively.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently between business priorities, technical decisions, and hands-on project execution.

What you’ll own

  • Your implementations: lead 6–10 concurrent customer projects from kickoff through go-live.
  • Customer outcomes: align stakeholders on clear goals, success criteria, priorities, and decisions.
  • Technical delivery: guide integrations, manage risks, and keep executive sponsors informed.

Who we’re looking for

You’re a seasoned implementation leader who combines strong technical judgment with excellent project management and customer skills. You can organize a complex group of stakeholders, earn the confidence of senior leaders, and keep everyone focused on the outcomes that matter.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Bring clarity and direction to complex, multi-stakeholder customer projects
  • Move comfortably between executive-level business conversations and technical discussions with IT
  • Anticipate risks, manage competing priorities, and drive projects forward with ownership
  • Build trust across Customer Success, Sales, Support, Engineering, and customer teams
  • Raise the bar through strong judgment, organization, and examples others can learn from

Key responsibilities

Customer outcomes and alignment

  • Define implementation objectives and measurable success criteria with customer leaders and project stakeholders
  • Align executives, business owners, and IT teams around shared priorities, decisions, and responsibilities
  • Keep sponsors informed of progress, risks, tradeoffs, and how the work supports business goals

Project leadership

  • Own implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, and execution across 6–10 concurrent projects
  • Lead kickoffs, working sessions, status reviews, and go-live coordination with clear next steps
  • Identify blockers early, resolve competing priorities, and maintain focus on the core implementation goals

Technical implementation

  • Guide softphone, email, chat, SMS, SSO, CRM, and call-data integrations; validate configuration and deployment
  • Partner with customer IT teams, Technical Support, and Engineering to troubleshoot complex integration issues
  • Lead hands-on technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex implementation challenges, including software installations, audio routing, call identification, APIs, firewalls, and integration configurations.
  • Serve as a technical escalation resource, independently diagnosing issues and partnering with Engineering when additional support or development is required.

Cross-functional execution

  • Coordinate Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Engineering for smooth handoffs and timely decisions
  • Maintain accurate project records in Asana and Salesforce and communicate On Track / At Risk / Off Track / On Hold status
  • Share effective approaches and technical knowledge that strengthen the implementation team
  • Develop and maintain clear technical documentation, implementation procedures, and configuration guides to support consistent and scalable customer deployments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, reduce deployment timelines, and strengthen the overall customer experience.
  • Provide technical guidance and share best practices with other Implementation Managers to strengthen team capabilities.

What you’ll bring

Must-haves

  • Substantial experience independently leading complex, customer-facing software implementations or solutions engagements
  • Demonstrated success aligning executive, business, and technical stakeholders around customer outcomes
  • Excellent project management, prioritization, risk management, and multi-project execution skills
  • Confident executive communication and the ability to translate between technical and business topics
  • Strong technical fluency to partner with IT and ensure software integrations are configured effectively
  • Proactive ownership, sound judgment, and a track record of navigating complex customer challenges
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software integrations, including APIs, application configurations, and technical deployment issues.
  • Ability to independently navigate complex enterprise customer environments and provide technical direction to both internal teams and customer stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CCaaS, VoIP, contact-center platforms, or enterprise SaaS deployments
  • Familiarity with APIs, JSON, SSO, CRM integrations, Salesforce, and Asana
  • Experience mentoring peers or improving implementation processes through influence

What success looks like

  • Deliver complex customer implementations on time, with clear communication and a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Independently navigate technical challenges and resolve implementation blockers while minimizing customer disruption.
  • Deliver predetermined customer outcomes and focus implementation on those goals.
  • Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams to ensure successful deployments.
  • Contribute to improvements in implementation processes, documentation, and overall team effectiveness.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Learning Stipends

Our hiring process

Our process includes interviews and a required practical skills assessment. We’ll look at how you align stakeholders around customer outcomes, lead a complex implementation, communicate with executives, and navigate technical decisions.

Why Balto

Six values shape how we work:

  • Anchor on Success. We start every task by picturing what success looks like, then set ambitious goals to get there.
  • Love Every Customer. Every customer, whatever their size or complexity, should feel valued and supported.
  • Talk Things Out. We solve problems through open, honest conversations, without the barriers of hierarchy.
  • Always Be Growing. Everyone owns their professional development, and our culture backs them up.
  • Own the Work. We take initiative, solve problems proactively, and produce results we’re proud of.
  • Start with Gratitude. We recognize each other’s contributions, even in tough discussions.

Choosing Balto means joining a company where your work is meaningful, your growth is encouraged, and your contributions are valued. It’s go time.

How to apply

Visit balto.ai/careers, select See Open Roles.

Balto is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on protected characteristics under applicable law.

Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Principal Offensive Security Engineer

Alteryx is searching for a Principal Offensive Security Engineer in the United States. Join a team that values diverse perspectives, technical curiosity, and collaboration to improve the security of our products and enterprise environments.

Position Overview

As a Principal Offensive Security Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader within Alteryx’s Offensive Security program. You will lead risk-prioritized penetration testing, red-team engagements, and adversary simulations across product and enterprise environments.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will personally scope and execute complex engagements while setting technical direction, improving testing methods, and mentoring other practitioners.

A key focus of this role will be the practical use of artificial intelligence in offensive security. You will develop and evaluate AI-assisted workflows that improve offensive testing and operational effectiveness.

You will also partner closely with Security Operations, Detection Engineering, Incident Response, Application Security, Cloud Security, IT, and Engineering to validate defensive controls and improve Alteryx’s ability to detect and respond to realistic adversary behavior.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead risk-prioritized penetration testing and offensive security assessments across products, web applications, APIs, infrastructure, cloud, identity, SaaS, and enterprise technologies.
  • Identify, validate, and safely exploit vulnerabilities and demonstrate how weaknesses can be chained into realistic attack paths.
  • Scope, design, and execute red-team campaigns and adversary simulations based on relevant threats, emerging techniques, and business risk.
  • Develop, validate, and incorporate AI-assisted workflows into offensive security activities, such as reconnaissance, campaign development, social engineering, tooling, and analysis.
  • Develop custom scripts, tooling, payloads, and automation to support offensive security engagements.
  • Conduct offensive security and red-team assessments with a primary focus on GCP and modern identity platforms, extending testing to AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes as relevant.
  • Partner with SOC, Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams to plan and execute purple-team exercises that validate telemetry, detections, investigation workflows, and response capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering and defensive teams to prioritize remediation, retest fixes, and verify improvements to detections, logging, monitoring, playbooks, and defensive controls.
  • Clearly document findings, attack paths, business impact, and recommended remediation, and communicate results to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Own the technical direction and execution of the offensive security roadmap in partnership with security leadership. Mature testing methodologies and provide hands-on mentorship and technical pairing to other offensive security practitioners.
  • Measure program effectiveness through verified remediation, reduced exposure to critical attack paths, and repeatable validation of detection and response coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant information security experience, including significant hands-on experience in penetration testing, red teaming, adversary simulation, or offensive security.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex penetration tests or offensive security engagements.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in one or more core domains, such as application/API exploitation, cloud offensive security, identity, or enterprise environments, with practical working knowledge across other domains and the ability to chain weaknesses into realistic attack paths and assess business impact.
  • Strong knowledge of attacker techniques across initial access, credential access, privilege escalation, persistence, lateral movement, defense evasion, and data access.
  • Hands-on offensive security experience in at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and modern identity environments, including technologies such as Active Directory, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, and SSO.
  • Experience with modern offensive security tooling and frameworks across web, identity, network, and adversary-emulation testing.
  • Ability to develop or modify offensive security tooling using languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or similar.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience incorporating AI into offensive security or red-team operations, with concrete examples of workflows or tools you developed or adapted, how you validated the results, and the operational benefits achieved.
  • Demonstrated experience planning or leading purple-team exercises and translating offensive findings into defensive improvements.
  • Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and the ability to map offensive activity to adversary techniques and defensive coverage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risk to engineering teams, security leadership, and executives.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring offensive security engineers, setting technical direction, and influencing outcomes across engineering and security teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to the offensive security or AI security community through conference presentations, open-source tooling, published research, vulnerability disclosures, or participation in industry working groups.
  • Experience building or maturing an internal red-team or offensive security program.
  • Experience conducting advanced adversary-emulation or assumed-breach exercises.
  • Experience building AI integrations using agent frameworks, LLM APIs, or local or hosted models.
  • Experience assessing AI-enabled applications, LLM-integrated systems, or agentic workflows.
  • Additional depth in SaaS security, endpoint/EDR evasion, exploit development, or social engineering.
  • Experience designing repeatable purple-team validation programs.
  • Strong hands-on offensive security experience in GCP; experience assessing Kubernetes environments is also preferred.
  • Relevant practical offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, OSED, CRTO, GXPN, or comparable certifications.

jobs.excerpt: The roleGauntlet is looking for an AI Research Engineer to help improve how we build, evaluate and use AI agents across the business.
jobs.description:
The role

Gauntlet is looking for an AI Research Engineer to help improve how we build, evaluate and use AI agents across the business.

We already have agents running in production, including Aria, our in-house generalist agent. They're used across research, engineering and business workflows, and we've learned a lot from seeing how they perform in practice. Some tasks work extremely well; others produce inconsistent results, and changes to models or tooling can introduce unexpected problems. Today, much of that feedback is still subjective. We want to build a more systematic way of understanding what works, what doesn't and why.

A major part of this role will be building the evaluation frameworks that allow us to measure agent performance on real tasks. You'll work with our engineers, quantitative researchers and other teams to understand where agents struggle, turn those observations into measurable experiments, and use the results to improve the systems we're building.

You'll also contribute directly to our existing agents and internal tooling. Initially, the work will be more engineering-focused as you get familiar with our systems, shipping improvements and integrations that teams can use. Over time, you'll take on more open-ended research, helping us develop better approaches to evaluation, agent behaviour and infrastructure.

We're also thinking beyond individual agents. One of our longer-term goals is to build a shared system of knowledge and reusable skills that our agents can draw from and improve over time. You'll play an important role in developing that infrastructure and how we evaluate its effectiveness.

This is an applied research role with a meaningful engineering component. We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating difficult problems, can design good experiments and is comfortable building and shipping the solutions that come out of them.

About Gauntlet

Gauntlet builds the financial systems of the future. While much of onchain finance is focused on point solutions, we operate across the entire stack to offer best-in-class vault products. Today we serve over $1.7B in client TVL across some of the largest fintechs/neobanks, protocols, exchanges, and capital allocators in crypto - and, increasingly, traditional asset management. Our team brings together traditional finance and crypto-native expertise to deliver durable, sophisticated products for institutional clients moving onchain.

Why this role is different

    This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, quantitative research and DeFi, tackling problems where advances in AI can have a direct impact on financial markets and onchain strategies.

    You'll go beyond building individual agents, helping define how they're evaluated, how they learn from real-world tasks and how their capabilities scale across the business. With few established benchmarks in this space, you'll have the freedom to explore new approaches and take your ideas from research through to production, working directly with the teams putting them to use.

What you'll do;

  • Build evaluation frameworks for AI agents, including datasets, sandbox environments and metrics that measure performance on real-world tasks.
  • Design experiments to compare models, agent harnesses, tools and execution environments, identifying regressions and understanding the trade-offs between performance, reliability and cost.
  • Work with teams across Gauntlet to turn qualitative feedback about agent behaviour into concrete research questions, experiments and measurable outcomes.
  • Investigate agent failures, understand whether problems come from the model, harness, tooling or prompting, and develop ways to improve performance.
  • Build and improve agent harnesses, internal tools and integrations, including contributing to Aria and other agents used across the business.
  • Help develop shared knowledge and reusable skills across agents, creating systems that can learn from previous work and improve over time.
  • Work alongside Infrastructure and Security to ensure agents can operate reliably and safely within our production environment.

What we're looking for;

  • Hands-on experience building, evaluating or improving LLM models or agents, whether through professional work, applied research, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
  • Strong Python skills and good software engineering fundamentals. You're comfortable writing production-quality code and understand the importance of testing, maintainability and reliability.
  • Experience with applied research, machine learning or data science, including designing experiments, working with datasets and drawing conclusions from results.
  • A good understanding of how LLM agents work beyond prompting, including tool use, harnesses, context management and common failure modes.
  • The ability to take an open-ended problem, break it down into testable questions and work independently towards a solution.
  • Experience building tools or systems that other people use, with an understanding of how to evaluate their effectiveness beyond technical benchmarks.
  • Comfort working across research and engineering, collaborating with different teams and adapting as priorities change.
  • Genuine interest in AI agents and how they can be made more capable, reliable and useful.

Nice to have;

  • Experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, reinforcement learning environments or model testing infrastructure.
  • Contributions to open-source agent frameworks, harnesses, evaluation datasets or benchmarks.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Hermes, OpenClaw or similar tools.
  • Experience in applied ML research, model training, fine-tuning or reinforcement learning.
  • An advanced degree or postgraduate research experience in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or a related field.
  • Experience in financial markets, quantitative research, DeFi or risk modelling.
  • Familiarity with AI security considerations, including access controls, prompt injection and data protection.

    • You don't need prior experience in crypto or DeFi. Strong research and engineering fundamentals matter more, and you'll work closely with people across Gauntlet who understand the financial systems and strategies our agents support.

    We expect strong candidates to have experience working in a professional engineering or research environment, but we're more interested in what you've built and how you approach problems than a specific number of years on your CV.

Benefits

    • Remote first — work from anywhere in the United States

    • Regular in-person company retreats and cross-country "office visit" perk

    • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees

    • $1,000 WFH stipend

    • Monthly reimbursement for home internet, phone, and cellular data

    • Unlimited vacation

    • 100% paid parental leave of 12 weeks

    • Fertility benefits

    • Opportunity for incentive compensation

Please note at this time our hiring is reserved for potential employees who are able to work within the contiguous United States and Canada. Should you need alternative accommodations, please note that in your application.
The national pay range for this role is $175,000 - $195,000 base plus additional On Target Earnings potential by level and equity in the company. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for a company of our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide. Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced API Gateway Architect to lead an organization-wide migration from Apigee to AWS API Gateway. The role involves designing target-state architecture, establishing API governance standards, and building scalable, secure, and reusable API platform solutions. The candidate will also lead efforts to establish AWS-native alternatives for Apigee capabilities such as analytics, reporting, and developer portal functionality.

Job Description

The architect will assess the existing Apigee environment across multiple teams and services, identify feature gaps, and define the migration strategy to AWS API Gateway. This includes designing standardized API architecture, security patterns, observability frameworks, and reusable infrastructure components.

The role also focuses on developing centralized logging, monitoring, analytics, and reporting solutions to ensure visibility into API traffic, performance, errors, and consumer usage. The candidate will work closely with engineering, security, infrastructure, and platform teams to establish governance standards and ensure a smooth, phased migration with appropriate rollback strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess the existing Apigee environment, including routing, rate limiting, quotas, security policies, and shared gateway capabilities.
  • Conduct feature-parity and gap analysis between Apigee and AWS API Gateway.
  • Define enterprise-wide AWS API Gateway reference architecture and implementation standards.
  • Design API security solutions covering OAuth2/OIDC, JWT validation, mTLS, API keys, and WAF.
  • Establish centralized logging, monitoring, metrics, distributed tracing, and reporting architectures.
  • Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Define API governance standards covering security, versioning, tagging, and cost management.
  • Own migration planning, phased cutovers, canary/blue-green deployments, and rollback strategies.
  • Provide architectural guidance and collaborate with engineering teams throughout the migration.

Required Skills

  • AWS API Gateway
  • Apigee Edge
  • Terraform
  • Strong AWS expertise: Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC, Route 53, and multi-account strategy.
  • API platform architecture and governance.
  • API security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, API keys, and WAF.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Job Title

Vendor Onboarding Specialist

Job Description Summary

C&W Services is seeking a Vendor Onboarding Specialist to support a high-priority initiative for one of our large clients. This role will focus heavily on vendor sourcing, research, outreach, and onboarding, while also supporting contract management and compliance functions within our Facilities Hub. Candidates should be highly detail-oriented, self-motivated, have great phone skills and be comfortable using online tools to execute a defined process efficiently.
This is an ideal opportunity for professionals with experience in customer service, vendor management, or administrative coordination who can thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Research, Outreach & Onboarding (Primary Focus):

  • Source and research service providers using Google Maps, search engines, or AI tools (e.g. Copilot) based on project needs and locations.
  • Log potential vendors into standardized trackers with accurate contact and service area data.
  • Conduct direct outreach to vendors via phone and email to explain subcontractor opportunities.
  • Guide interested vendors through the onboarding process, including documentation, answering questions, and uploading files to internal systems.
  • Identify which locations each vendor can service and track accordingly.
  • Provide status updates and flag onboarding completions to the internal team.
  • High-volume outbound calling capability (40–60 calls per day target)
  • Explain program value, overcome hesitation, and secure commitments
  • Follow-through with urgency to move vendors to completion

Vendor Compliance & Contract Administration (Secondary Support):

  • Support internal vendor compliance efforts to ensure alignment with client and company standards.
  • Educate new and existing vendors on compliance and performance expectations.
  • May be asked to assist in issuing vendor agreements and amendments in coordination with Legal and Risk Management teams.
  • Submit and track Internal Change Forms for accurate record-keeping (SOX compliant).
  • Maintain databases and spreadsheets to track contract documentation, compliance materials, and onboarding progress.

Qualifications

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Minimum 3 years in a role that involves:
  • High-volume phone-based outreach (call center, inside sales, account development, vendor management, or dispatch environments preferred)
  • Convincing/persuading external parties.
  • Managing structured onboarding/compliance tasks (e.g., contracts, insurance verification, licensing, or regulated documentation)
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment with recorded calls & performance tracking
  • Detail-oriented enough to validate insurance & compliance requirements
  • Competent with spreadsheet tracking and structured workflow processes
  • Experience working with contractors, service providers, trades, or vendors strongly preferred

Remote Work Requirements

  • The workspace must be able to accommodate multiple screens and provide an ergonomic setup that supports productivity.
  • To maintain business continuity, employees are expected to have a backup plan for connectivity disruptions, including access to an alternate location (such as a co‑working space, library, or other reliable environment) in case of home internet or power loss.

Preferred

  • Phone sales experience
  • Experience supporting facilities, maintenance, or service‑based operations
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • 3–5 years of professional experience in administrative support, customer service, recruiting, or vendor management preferred
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), online research tools, and AI-enabled platforms preferred
  • Strong ability to follow structured processes and escalate appropriately when needed
  • Able to multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Self-directed with the ability to work independently and with a team
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and support evolving business needs

Key Competencies & Traits

  • Calm, composed, and decisive in high‑urgency situations
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Highly organized with strong time‑management skills
  • Collaborative and adaptable across teams and systems
  • Comfortable working in a metric driven environment

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position summary:

We are looking for a skilled L2 Cloud Administrator to support day-to-day operations of Azure and AWS infrastructure. The role is responsible for incident resolution, cloud resource administration, monitoring, performance troubleshooting, patching, backup validation, security remediation and infrastructure lifecycle management. The administrator will work closely with L1 operations, L3 Cloud team and cross-functional teams to ensure cloud availability, security, operational efficiency and SLA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

Azure Cloud Operations

  • Provide L2 support for Azure infrastructure incidents, alerts and service requests.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Azure Virtual Machines, disks, storage accounts and related resources.
  • Monitor Azure resource health, availability, performance and utilization using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Troubleshoot VM startup, connectivity, CPU, memory, disk and operating system issues.
  • Support Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs) and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Manage approved VM provisioning, resizing, patching, backup validation and lifecycle activities.
  • Support Azure Backup, Recovery Services Vault and disaster recovery operations.
  • Assist with access management using Azure RBAC and support security and compliance remediation.

AWS Cloud Operations

  • Provide L2 operational support for AWS infrastructure incidents and service requests.
  • Administer and troubleshoot EC2 instances, EBS volumes, snapshots and related resources.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, utilization and alerts using Amazon CloudWatch.
  • Troubleshoot instance availability, connectivity, performance and operating system issues.
  • Support VPC, subnets, security groups, route tables and network connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Perform approved instance provisioning, resizing, patching, backup validation and lifecycle activities.
  • Support AWS Backup, snapshots and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Assist with IAM access reviews, security remediation and compliance activities within authorized scope.

Operations & Service Management

  • Resolve cloud infrastructure incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  • Execute approved changes and operational tasks following established procedures.
  • Support cloud patching, vulnerability remediation, backup verification and recovery activities.
  • Investigate monitoring alerts and escalate complex platform, networking, identity and architecture issues to L3 Cloud SMEs.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Maintain runbooks, operational documentation, incident records and shift handovers.
  • Coordinate with Security, Network, Windows/Linux, Storage/Backup and Application teams.
  • Monitor resource utilization and identify capacity, performance and cost optimization opportunities.
  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM follow-the-sun handovers.

Required Skills:

  • 3-6 years hands-on experience in Azure and/or AWS cloud infrastructure operations.
  • Knowledge of Azure VMs, disks, storage accounts, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Knowledge of AWS EC2, EBS, snapshots and CloudWatch.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, including Azure VNets, NSGs, AWS VPCs, subnets, security groups and routing.
  • Experience with cloud VM provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, patching and lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of Azure RBAC and/or AWS IAM, security controls and access management.
  • Understanding of cloud backup, recovery, disaster recovery and vulnerability remediation.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and ITIL-based Incident, Problem and Change Management.
  • Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI or AWS CLI.
  • Experience in SLA-driven enterprise production operations and a 24x7 support environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) certification.
  • AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate or equivalent AWS certification.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.
  • Exposure to Azure Automation, Azure Update Manager or AWS Systems Manager.
  • Knowledge of cloud cost management, tagging, capacity optimization and compliance monitoring.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, backup and disaster recovery tools.
  • Familiarity with hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure integration.

Location / Support Model

Global 24x7x365 support across APAC, EMEA and NLAM, working in a rotational shift-based, follow-the-sun operating model.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | UK | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.

In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python, with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.

At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas. They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems. They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.

  • Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.
  • Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.
  • Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.
  • Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.
  • Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.
  • An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.
  • Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.

Bonus Points For:

  • You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.
  • Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation
  • Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams
  • Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration
  • Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the compensation range for this role is GBP 107,000 - GBP 134,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:

Salary: £75,000 - £90,000 DOE

Location: Fully remote

Eligibility Requirements: Due to the nature of the work, the successful candidate must be UK-based and eligible for DV clearance.

About the role

TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.

Responsibilities

Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

  • Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.
  • Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.
  • Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.

Agile Delivery Management

  • Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.
  • Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.
  • Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.
  • Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.

Lightweight Governance & Reporting

  • Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.
  • Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.
  • Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.
  • Help define and mature TwinStream’s delivery governance model — ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.
  • Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.
  • Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.
  • Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.
  • Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience — technical or non-technical.
  • Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.
  • Support commercial teams during pre-sales, estimation, and contract/change discussions as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Ways of Working

  • Contribute to improving TwinStream’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.
  • Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.
  • Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.

Key Skills

  • Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams, not just single-project coordination.
  • Strong understanding of flow-based agile delivery and programme-level planning.
  • Proven ability to identify cross-cutting risks, large dependencies, and structural blockers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all levels of the organisation.
  • Confidence operating in environments that value structure but avoid heavy process.
  • A pragmatic, solution-focused mindset and the ability to bring clarity in uncertainty

There are many great reasons to join our team!

Pension Plan

Secure your future with our competitive pension plan that offers an 8% employer contribution.

Private Medical Healthcare

Your health and well-being are our top priorities. Enjoy comprehensive private medical healthcare, which includes dental and optical care for you and your family.

Learning and Development

Your career is in your hands. We empower you to take charge of your own development, giving you the autonomy to shape your growth.

Flexible Working

We understand the importance of balancing work and life. Flexibility is not just a policy for us; it is part of our culture. We are passionate about helping you seamlessly integrate work with your home life.

Electric Vehicle Scheme

Drive sustainability forward with our electric vehicle leasing scheme. You can take advantage of this initiative through a convenient salary sacrifice program.

Holidays

Enjoy annual leave of 28 days, plus bank holidays, allowing you to recharge and spend time on what matters most.

Team Events

We love celebrating our achievements! In addition to our quarterly meetings, you can look forward to our Christmas and summer parties—opportunities to relax, reflect, and have fun as a team.

Additional Benefits

We provide life assurance for your peace of mind and a cycle-to-work scheme to support your health and sustainability goals.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you

Further Information:

Due to the nature of the work and the sectors we support, any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the relevant security screening and clearance process.

This role requires eligibility for [BPSS / SC / DV] clearance. As part of the vetting process, candidates must meet the UK Government's residency and right-to-work requirements associated with the required level of clearance.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How You Can Make a Difference

The Director, CX Data & Customer Analytics is the analytics leader for the Customer Organization, responsible for helping CX leadership understand, explore, define, and deliver scalable analytics and enterprise reporting that enables effective performance management, business growth, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in customer experience.

This role is both a strategic business partner and a hands-on analytics leader. The Director works closely with CX leadership to translate business priorities into measurable outcomes, operating metrics, reporting products, and analytic solutions that improve visibility, accountability, decision quality, and action.

This role leans heavily toward business and strategic impact. The Director serves as an enabler of decision-making for CX leadership, helping shape where the organization focuses and what it does next—not simply reporting on what has already happened. The role is accountable for influencing business outcomes such as customer retention and growth, cost to serve, operational effectiveness, and customer experience.

The Director also partners with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Science, AI, and Technology teams to build durable semantic models, governed reporting assets, and reusable data products that support CX analytics at scale, including gold-layer data assets in Databricks.

This is a hands-on leadership role. Hands-on may be needed to advise analysts in their code, decision logic, or performance optimization. The Director is expected to be credible in the work, not only accountable for managing the work.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Serve as the primary analytics and insights partner to CX leadership, helping leaders define strategic questions, customer experience measures, operating metrics, and decision needs.
  • Build a deep understanding of HealthEquity's business model and how client, member, broker, and partner experiences connect to business performance, retention, growth, and operational efficiency.
  • Quantify the value at stake—including retention, revenue, cost to serve, operational risk, and customer experience impact—and use it to build business cases, guide investment decisions, and prioritize the CX analytics roadmap.
  • Translate business priorities into measurable outcomes, analytics strategies, reporting products, and action plans that drive customer and business results.
  • Own the CX analytics roadmap, aligning investments to customer priorities, value at stake, strategic business objectives, executive priorities, operational reporting needs, regulatory and risk considerations, automation opportunities, and measurable business value.
  • Develop scalable analytics, dashboards, scorecards, and enterprise reporting that help the Customer Organization monitor performance, identify risk, evaluate trends, and improve customer experience.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CX leadership by translating complex analytics into clear business narratives, recommendations, and decision support for executive audiences.
  • Establish intake, prioritization, and delivery practices that focus the team on the highest-value work while communicating tradeoffs in a supportive, transparent, and business-oriented manner.
  • Negotiate competing priorities with stakeholders based on business value, urgency, reuse potential, risk, effort, and strategic alignment, including the ability to say “not right now” without damaging trusted partnerships.
  • Distinguish between ad hoc analysis, repeatable operational reporting, certified analytics, and scalable data products; ensure valuable ad hoc work is converted into operational analytics, semantic models, and engineering-backed data assets when appropriate.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to design, sponsor, and mature semantic models that enable governed, consistent, and performant analytics and reporting at scale.
  • Partner with Data Governance to improve metric definitions, data quality, lineage, stewardship, certification, and trust in CX reporting and customer experience analytics.
  • Use CX platforms, survey data, call center metrics, agent performance data, CSAT, NPS, customer journey signals, contact drivers, quality measures, and operational data to identify trends, root causes, opportunities, and risks.
  • Apply data science fluency to increase pattern recognition, segmentation, driver analysis, predictive modeling, forecasting, anomaly detection, and proactive performance management across the Customer Organization.
  • Partner with Data Science and AI teams to identify, prioritize, and operationalize advanced analytics and AI-enabled use cases, including agentic AI capabilities built against governed semantic models and Databricks gold-layer data assets.
  • Drive report rationalization, automation, dashboard performance improvement, self-service enablement, and retirement of low-value or duplicative reporting assets.
  • Measure analytics effectiveness through business outcomes influenced, decisions changed, stakeholder adoption, reporting quality, reduced manual effort, improved decision speed, customer experience improvements, and measurable business impact.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing analytics and reporting team that combines business partnership, technical depth, curiosity, accountability, and measurable impact.
  • Create role clarity, delivery standards, operating rhythms, and development plans that improve team execution, stakeholder trust, and analytics maturity.
  • Manage and carry out personnel actions for direct reports, including hiring, scheduling, coaching, training, performance management, compensation recommendations, and corrective or disciplinary action as appropriate.
  • Provide hands-on guidance to analysts on SQL, Python, Databricks notebooks, dashboard logic, business rules, data validation, query performance, and reusable analytical patterns.

Required Technical and Expertise

  • Deep business acumen with a strong understanding of how customer experience influences retention, growth, customer lifetime value, operational efficiency, and cost to serve.
  • Must be able to write SQL, Python, and Databricks notebooks/workbooks well enough to guide analysts, review logic, validate results, and advise on performance optimization.
  • Deep understanding of analytics engineering concepts, semantic model design, dimensional modeling, metric definition, dashboard design, and scalable reporting patterns.
  • Strong familiarity with customer experience and operational performance measures, including call center metrics, queue performance, handle time, first-contact resolution, abandonment, transfer rates, quality measures, CSAT, NPS, and customer experience trends.
  • Experience with CX survey or Voice of Customer platforms such as Qualtrics or similar tools, and the ability to integrate survey signals with operational and behavioral data.
  • Working knowledge of Databricks, lakehouse architecture, gold-layer data assets, BI platforms, governed metrics, and reusable data products.
  • Data science understanding or hands-on experience in predictive modeling, classification, forecasting, segmentation, recommendation, anomaly detection, and pattern recognition.
  • Understanding of agentic AI, AI assistants, and AI-enabled analytics patterns, including the use of governed semantic models as trusted sources for AI agents and decision-support tools.
  • Ability to partner with engineering teams on data model requirements, performance considerations, reusable logic, testing, data quality, reliability, and production readiness.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders without direct authority, using data, insights, business cases, and structured decision support to drive action and results.

Key Success Factors

  • Demonstrated hands-on analytics depth, including direct experience with SQL and Python and the ability to inspect, challenge, and improve analytical logic.
  • Proven ability to partner strategically with CX or operational leadership to translate business objectives into measurable analytics products, insights, and enterprise reporting.
  • Experience making prioritization decisions using business value, urgency, reuse potential, risk, and delivery capacity while maintaining a strong stakeholder experience.
  • Experience moving high-value ad hoc analysis into scalable reporting, governed metrics, semantic models, or data engineering-supported assets.
  • Ability to operate in a resource-constrained environment with a bias toward MVP delivery, iteration, reuse, and measurable business impact.
  • Comfort working across Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Technology, Data Science, AI, and business leadership teams to deliver trusted analytics at scale.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to frame opportunities and problems in business terms, quantify the value at stake, and prioritize investments based on business impact rather than request volume or urgency.
  • Demonstrated success influencing executive and senior leadership decisions through analytics, insights, storytelling, and fact-based recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

What You Will Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Operations, or related field required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in customer analytics, CX analytics, business intelligence, customer insights, data science, consulting, strategy, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing analytics, BI, insights, reporting, or analytics engineering teams.
  • Experience leading analytics transformation, reporting modernization, KPI standardization, self-service analytics, dashboard rationalization, customer intelligence programs, or semantic model adoption.
  • Experience supporting senior leaders through operating reviews, performance management routines, executive dashboards, strategic planning, and decision support.
  • Experience in healthcare, financial services, benefits administration, contact center operations, regulated environments, or consumer-facing service organizations preferred.
  • Experience in consulting, customer intelligence, customer experience strategy, business intelligence, or customer insights environments preferred.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to make complex data actionable and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical leaders.
  • Strong people leadership skills with the ability to coach analysts, raise quality standards, develop talent, and create a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Salary Range

$137500.00 To $182000.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. Role Type: Contractor

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Data Science & Analytic Methodology Subject Matter Experts to contribute to a high-impact project focused on advanced analytical pipelines and large language models (LLMs).   3. Experience in teaching, mentoring, or providing technical leadership in data science or related analytical disciplines.
  4. Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to document methodologies clearly and communicate complex concepts in English.
  5. Familiarity with designing evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or assessment systems.
  6. Experience in defense, intelligence, or government analytical environments is highly valued.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines strong data science expertise with practical experience in analytical methodology, automation, and LLM integration. jobs.excerpt: Wiser Solutions is hiring a Senior ML Engineer to help build our customer-facing AI platform and get the first features into customers' hands.
jobs.description:
Wiser Solutions is hiring a Senior ML Engineer to help build our customer-facing AI platform and get the first features into customers' hands.

Our data runs at real scale: well over 100 million product and pricing records a day from retailers and marketplaces worldwide. The problems are concrete ones like product matching, classification, and attribute extraction. The right answer is often a mix of trained models, embeddings, retrieval, and LLMs, and cost per record matters as much as accuracy.

We want someone who uses AI first, moves fast, and would rather show a working prototype than a slide deck. You'll own ML systems end to end, from idea to experiment to production, and keep improving them once they're live. You don't need to be a data engineer. You need to be the person who turns a customer problem into a model that works.

What You Will Do

  • Take customer problems from idea to working prototype quickly, prove or kill an approach with data, and move what works into production

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models for matching, classification, and extraction problems. This covers classical ML, embedding models, and LLMs, and you pick the simplest approach that meets the quality and cost bar

  • Design and ship RAG systems, embedding-based retrieval, and LLM-powered features on AWS

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retraining

  • Build evaluation that tells us whether something works: labeled golden sets, offline metrics (precision, recall), LLM-as-judge where it fits, and shadow or A/B testing before rollout

  • Monitor models in production for drift, output quality, latency, and cost per prediction, and fix what you find

  • 7+ years in ML engineering, applied data science, or AI engineering

  • A track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production and owning them after launch. You can walk us through the architecture, the tradeoffs, and the metrics that showed it worked

  • Hands-on experience training and evaluating models: feature engineering, experiment design, choosing metrics, handling class imbalance and noisy labels, and knowing when a model is good enough to ship

  • Hands-on experience building production applications with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings, and vector databases

  • Working knowledge of MLOps practices and tooling, such as MLflow, SageMaker Pipelines, Weights & Biases, or similar

  • Experience with AWS for ML workloads (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3)

  • Strong Python and solid engineering habits: version control, testing, CI/CD, and code review

  • A habit of building quickly to learn: you'd rather test an idea in two days than debate it for two weeks

  • Daily use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and curiosity about new AI tools as they come out

Preferred:

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, and a clear sense of when to fine-tune versus prompt engineer versus train a smaller task-specific model

  • Experience keeping inference cost down at high volume through distillation, quantization, caching, or tiered model routing

  • Background in retail, e-commerce, or product data (catalog matching, taxonomy mapping, attribute extraction)

  • Experience with entity resolution or similarity search at scale

  • Comfort working with data pipelines and orchestration tools like Airflow (helpful, not required)

Base pay is one part of our total compensation package. Pay is established on an individual basis after considering multiple factors such as relevant experience, education, and other qualifications. In addition, we take into account geographical differentials and make sure pay is equitable with our current staff. If you require accommodation to complete any part of the application process or need an alternative manner to apply, please contact us at or call (855) 469-4737.

Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Poland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Poland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

Build Your Career:

At JCTM we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.

Challenging Projects:

As a Desktop Publisher Specialist with JCTM, you will support the production, editing, formatting, and finalization of Coast Guard publications in a high-volume environment. This role requires mastery of editing and layout tools, strong command of written English, experience applying templates and publication standards, and the ability to help deliver polished, compliant products across the publishing lifecycle.

  • Desktop Publishing and Formatting: Prepare, edit, and format directives, forms, general messages, and other publication artifacts using approved templates, layouts, and standards.
  • Copyediting and Proofreading: Correct grammar, punctuation, usage, consistency, readability, and technical writing issues across draft and final publication products.

  • Library and Database Maintenance: Maintain accurate publication metadata, titles, coding, categorizations, and archive information to support reliable searchability and records integrity.
  • General Message Processing: Support regular business-hour processing, maintenance, and archiving of message products in accordance with required system formats and records processes.
  • Production Tracking: Keep publication status current in trackers and support reporting of edits, publications processed, remediation actions, and related production metrics.

State-of-the-Art Technology:

Expand your expertise by working with current versions of Microsoft Office 365, Adobe Acrobat Pro, Microsoft SharePoint, and connected collaboration and publishing systems in a virtual, cloud-enabled environment.

New Skills:

Work alongside experienced publishing and compliance professionals while building your expertise in government publishing workflows, accessibility support, records accuracy, metadata management, and publication lifecycle operations.

You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to JCTM’s strategic goals through increasingly complex publishing assignments, process improvement efforts, and broader support to enterprise publication management.

  • Mastery of editing, proofreading, layout, and template application

  • Highly proficient command of English grammar, punctuation, and business writing standards

  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with sponsors, leads, and cross-functional stakeholders
