Forge (Emerald X) is seeking an experienced Senior Data Platform Project Manager / Agile Scrum Master to lead execution across our enterprise data platform and analytics portfolio. This role will provide project leadership and Scrum facilitation for the teams building and operating Forge's data foundation, including data ingestion and integration, data lakehouse and warehouse capabilities, master data, governance, semantic models, business intelligence, and reporting.

The role will lead initiatives from discovery and backlog definition through design, development, QA, user acceptance testing, deployment, and closeout. The successful candidate will bring structure, transparency, and delivery discipline to a cross-functional team of data engineers, architects, analysts, product owners, business stakeholders, and implementation partners. This is a hands-on delivery leadership role, not a data engineering role, but it requires sufficient technical fluency to understand data pipelines, integrations, cloud platforms, dependencies, and release risks.

The Senior Data Platform Project Manager / Agile Scrum Master will manage multiple concurrent initiatives, facilitate the Agile operating cadence, remove impediments, maintain delivery artifacts, and provide clear communication to both technical teams and senior business leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of data platform, integration, analytics, and reporting initiatives from intake and discovery through production deployment and transition to support.
  • Serve as Scrum Master and Agile delivery lead for the data platform team, promoting effective Agile practices and helping the team continuously improve delivery velocity, quality, and predictability.
  • Facilitate backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, technical design reviews, sprint reviews or demonstrations, retrospectives, and release-readiness activities.
  • Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, establish acceptance criteria, sequence dependencies, and maintain a healthy, actionable backlog.
  • Work with data engineers and technical leads to size user stories, plan sprint capacity, monitor progress, identify blockers, and keep commitments aligned with available resources.
  • Build and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, RAID logs, RACI charts, stakeholder registers, decision logs, status reports, test plans, deployment checklists, and lessons learned.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across data engineering, application teams, enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, business intelligence, data governance, vendors, and business functions.
  • Manage delivery of cloud data-platform capabilities, including source ingestion, API and file-based integrations, data transformation, master data, data quality, governance, data models, and Power BI reporting.
  • Coordinate structured QA and user acceptance testing, including test planning, business tester readiness, defect triage, evidence collection, sign-off, and readiness for production deployment.
  • Ensure releases follow Forge change-management and deployment-governance requirements, with appropriate approvals, documentation, QA/UAT evidence, communications, and support transition.
  • Identify delivery risks, resource constraints, scope changes, technical dependencies, and decision points early; drive resolution and escalate when necessary.
  • Provide concise, audience-appropriate status reporting to project teams, business stakeholders, technology leadership, and executive sponsors.
  • Promote consistent use of Jira and Confluence for user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint tracking, decisions, documentation, and delivery transparency.
  • Support continuous improvement of Forge's data-delivery and PMO practices, balancing governance and accountability with practical, outcome-focused execution.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of project or program management experience delivering enterprise technology initiatives, including significant experience with data platforms, analytics, business intelligence, integration, or cloud-based systems.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as an Agile Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager for data engineering, software development, analytics, or integration teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum practices, including backlog management, user stories, acceptance criteria, estimation, sprint planning, standups, reviews, retrospectives, velocity, and impediment removal.
  • Experience managing projects involving data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs or web services, relational databases, data warehouses or lakehouses, master data, data quality, and reporting.
  • Experience coordinating QA, UAT, change control, deployment readiness, production releases, and transition to operational support.
  • Advanced project planning, organization, risk management, dependency management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to translate between business outcomes and technical delivery details and to communicate

technical information clearly to senior management.

  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams, offshore development partners, consultants, and third-party vendors.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence; experience with complementary planning and reporting tools is valuable.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent initiatives and evolving priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering initiatives on Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or comparable modern data and analytics platforms.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures, data lakehouse patterns, semantic models, customer or audience data, master data management, and enterprise data governance.
  • Experience leading data-platform work in a public company, private-equity portfolio company, media, events, or another highly regulated and dynamic environment.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience supporting M&A data integration, platform consolidation, or enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Success Profile

The strongest candidate combines disciplined project management with practical Scrum leadership. They can create order from ambiguity, keep a technical team focused without adding unnecessary process, and build trust across business and technology stakeholders. They are comfortable discussing data pipelines, integrations, testing, and release dependencies, while remaining focused on business value, delivery outcomes, team health, and clear accountability.

We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

As part of our commitment to innovation, your role will involve implementing AI-powered testing methodologies to improve coverage and identify issues proactively. jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areILO Group is a proudly women-owned education strategy and policy firm.
jobs.description:
Who we are

ILO Group is a proudly women-owned education strategy and policy firm. We are a dedicated team of strategic partners and specialists who support school districts and states in executing on their biggest bets and their highest priority efforts. We work as members of our partners’ teams—operating side-by-side with the country’s leading educators, experts and government partners.

Our work is as diverse as our partners ambitions are bold: we work across leadership development, comprehensive project management and implementation support, systems transformation and more. We enable education leaders to be the catalysts for enduring change that benefits their students, schools, and communities.

In addition to technical assistance to districts and states, our expert team provides the capacity and expertise to power difference-making partnerships of our own: Women Leading Ed and The Forum for Educational Leadership.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a Senior Consultant team member who will primarily focus on client projects. The candidate we bring aboard in this role will be responsible for project and workstream management, research and data analysis, document creation, and contributing insights to help our clients design and implement strategic initiatives at their respective districts and organizations.

You will be a great fit for this role if you have 5 - 7 years of work experience; strong analytics, information presentation, and document creation abilities; facilitation skills and comfort with public speaking; knowledge of the K-12 education landscape; and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Our team members often need to be fast-learners and adaptive to quickly changing circumstances.

Why ILO Group

Our clients are state education agencies, school districts, and adjacent education organizations, including nonprofits and foundations, who are committed to implementing initiatives to improve student outcomes. As a result, you will have the opportunity to work with these leaders and their teams to understand their needs, provide real-time, in-the-moment support, and develop strategic and operating plans to implement sustainable solutions.

You will join a team of high-performing and creative individuals who are dedicated to supporting education leaders across the country in delivering a high-quality education to every student. In addition, as ILO Group is a “startup,” you will have the opportunity to have a voice in the organization’s internal operations, decision-making, and strategy. As ILO Group continues to grow, we are invested in the growth of our team as well. We anticipate various opportunities for consultants to grow in their expertise and skills in support of our clients and in partnership with their ILO Group teammates.

Opportunity

This person must demonstrate the ability to:

  • Support the execution of projects, which includes supporting work plans, managing project timelines, and contributing significantly to high-quality project execution to ensure the delivery of innovative and effective solutions to our clients’ challenges
  • Partner with Project Leads on project decision-making through quantitative and qualitative data analysis to identify trends and insights, with curiosity and a keen attention to detail
  • Demonstrate clear writing, both in presentations and documents, and craft communication tailored to the intended audience
  • Design and draft high-quality presentations, reports, and communications and refine with senior team members
  • Contribute to the facilitation of presentations and stakeholder engagement as needed with respect to project scopes
  • Develop and coordinate meetings and events ranging from those designed to provide leadership coaching support to coordinating across various client business units to support initiative implementation
  • Leverage acumen to engage in knowledge sharing with internal and external stakeholders, including providing qualified guidance in response to client needs
  • Support clients by bringing a problem-solving, strategic mindset and by developing high-quality materials, tools, and resources rooted in research and best practices
  • Participate as an active partner in client conversations, share insights, take notes, and follow through on the next steps
  • Serve as a contributing member of the ILO Group team

Job Type

We are currently seeking individuals who are interested in full-time opportunities.

Location and Travel

We are a virtual organization, and this is a remote position. Travel will be required based on client needs.

About You

The requirements for this position are:

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or 5- 7 years of experience
  • Consulting experience required
  • Outstanding project management skills with an attention to detail
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, dynamic, startup environment with the ability to prioritize items and manage time across projects to meet critical deadlines
  • Comfort presenting ideas and recommendations to senior team members, including participating in two-way feedback
  • Experience analyzing and synthesizing quantitative and qualitative data
  • Willingness to hold oneself personally accountable for results in a rapidly changing context
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion
  • Experience using the Google Suite (e.g., Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Forms)
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel

Compensation

The salary for this position is competitive and depends on prior experience. In addition, a comprehensive benefits package is included.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ILO Group is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Why I do this work

Hear from some of our team on why they do this work as a team with their colleagues at ILO Group.

“I am the product of public school teachers who believed in my potential. As the daughter of immigrants with a humble upbringing, I was supported throughout my K-12 education by teachers and administrators who went the extra mile to ensure that my circumstances would not dictate the quality or rigor of my education. Although I was not statistically likely to persevere, I am my family's first college graduate. Paying that goodwill forward to impact the trajectory of today's students positively is why I do this work.”

“I do this work because I believe all kids deserve an excellent education and it is my mission to support educational leaders in making that belief a reality. Whether it's operationalizing a plan to implement a leader's big bets or creating a strategic plan to drive change, I enjoy partnering with teams from school districts and educational organizations to learn what is working well, to explore what could be better, and to find a path to get there together.”

“I do this work because I am passionate about rethinking our education system to make it work better for students and families. I love working alongside superintendents and their teams to help implement new ideas that make a direct positive impact on their students.”

“When I think of why I do this work, the first thing that comes to mind is something I have always been driven by: helping to support and create a more diverse, impactful and robust education system for students and educational leaders. Everyday, I wake up feeling motivated and energized by the fact that the work we do as a team directly impacts the future of thousands of students in this country, and I have the opportunity to be a part of the change. Seeing projects come to life and transforming the education system in a positive and effective manner is the most rewarding factor of the work.”

Salary: $85,000 – $125,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Employment Type: Independent Contractor | Full-Time & Part-Time Work Arrangement: Fully Remote | Specific working hours will depend on the client's requirements.
jobs.description:
Employment Type: Independent Contractor | Full-Time & Part-Time
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote | Specific working hours will depend on the client's requirements.
Hours: 15–40 hours per week
Time Zones: U.S. Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Bilingual Dental Billing & Accounts Receivable Specialist (English & Spanish) to support a dental practice with end-to-end dental billing, claims management, and accounts receivable activities.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working in a dental office or dental practice and a strong understanding of dental insurance, claims submission, payment posting, denials, outstanding balances, and AR follow-up. Experience with Dentrix Ascend is required, and familiarity with Weave as a VOIP/communications platform is highly preferred.

This role is well suited for someone who understands the unique complexities of dental billing and insurance claims and can independently manage billing and AR workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the dental practice's billing and accounts receivable processes.
  • Submit and follow up on dental insurance claims accurately and timely.
  • Review unpaid, rejected, and denied claims and take appropriate action to resolve outstanding balances.
  • Perform insurance eligibility and benefits verification as needed.
  • Post insurance and patient payments accurately.
  • Review EOBs/ERAs and reconcile payments against submitted claims.
  • Identify billing discrepancies, underpayments, and missing payments.
  • Follow up with insurance carriers regarding outstanding claims and payment status.
  • Manage aging AR and prioritize accounts requiring follow-up.
  • Assist with correcting and resubmitting rejected or denied claims.
  • Review patient accounts for outstanding balances and billing issues.
  • Communicate professionally with insurance companies, patients, and the dental office team.
  • Maintain accurate billing records and documentation within the practice management system.
  • Use Dentrix Ascend to manage patient accounts, claims, payments, and billing activities.
  • Use Weave for practice communications as required.
  • Support other dental administrative and billing functions as needed.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on dental billing, insurance, or accounts receivable experience.
  • Previous experience working directly with a dental office, dental practice, or dental healthcare organization.
  • Hands-on experience with Dentrix Ascend is required.
  • Strong understanding of dental claims and the dental insurance billing process.
  • Experience with claim submission, payment posting, EOB/ERA review, denials, and AR follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of dental insurance terminology, procedures, and billing workflows.
  • Experience working with insurance carriers and resolving claim issues.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify billing discrepancies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English & Spanish.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts and billing priorities.
  • Weave experience is preferred, but not required if the candidate has strong dental practice experience.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following areas are especially encouraged to apply:

  • Dental insurance billing
  • Dental claims and denial management
  • Dental AR and aging reports
  • Insurance follow-up
  • EOB/ERA reconciliation
  • Patient billing and collections
  • Dentrix Ascend
  • Weave
  • Dental practice management

Work Schedule

Both part-time and full-time candidates will be considered. The final schedule will be determined based on the candidate's availability and the client's operational needs.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Field Based Medical

  • Location: Cambridge, MA

About the Job:

The Transplant Medical Science Liaison (MSL) provides comprehensive medical and scientific information in connection with Sanofi products.

The Transplant MSL serves as an advanced field-based scientific professional for US Medical Affairs division of North American Pharmaceutical Operations. The Transplant MSL shares scientific and clinical data exceptionally well, communicating directly with US healthcare providers and clinical researchers via appropriate compliant scientific exchange, clinical research, disease state awareness/education and medical education gaps. Also, the Transplant MSL serves as a field-based scientific professional to facilitate research, education, or other collaborations. The position supports US Medical Affairs mission of generating, translating, and communicating clinical and scientific data to US healthcare providers and decision makers to demonstrate the safe and appropriate use of Sanofi products, technologies, and services in support of optimal patient care.

The responsibility of the Transplant MSL is to establish scientific and professional credibility with customers and other healthcare stakeholders, communicate appropriately and compliantly via scientific exchange on the value of Sanofi products, provide insights to internal teams on key medical education gaps relevant to healthcare decision makers, healthcare providers and identify clinical research sites or educational opportunities when appropriate. Transplant MSLs serve as the principal field-based scientific resource between US Medical Affairs and external health care providers involved in pharmaceutical selection, access and health care decisions. Transplant MSLs engage in scientific exchange by providing clinical data or disease state education in response to clinical, disease state, and evidence-based guideline information requests from health care providers. Transplant MSLs also communicate Medical Materials Review Committee (MMRC)-approved clinical information, in compliance with applicable SOPs. Transpalnt MSLs also identify and communicate customer insights to internal teams to inform the medical research and provide field-based representation to facilitate research, education, and other collaborations, in compliance with applicable SOPs.

Join the team transforming how healthcare is delivered for chronic and specialty conditions worldwide. In General Medicines, you’ll help drive meaningful outcomes in diabetes, transplant, and immunology - with the scale and urgency patients deserve.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Primary responsibilities of this role are to facilitate information, education, and research activities for physicians and ancillary healthcare professionals regarding in-development or commercialized Sanofi products.

Demonstrate Strong Scientific/Technical Expertise in support of Transplant:

  • Understanding of clinical trials methodology, outcomes, and limitations

  • Understanding of connection between healthcare providers and organizations within the MSL designated territory

  • Translation of complex scientific and clinical data to healthcare providers with varying levels of expertise

  • Proficient utilization of clinical data, therapeutic guidelines and other technical tools in the field

  • Drive internal understanding of US Medical Affairs with respect to unmet medical education and research needs

Effectively Manage Regional Responsibilities in support of Transplant:

  • Principal field-based medical point of contact for healthcare providers within the region

  • Communicate and disseminate scientific and clinical data in response to unsolicited requests for information

  • Create and execute medical engagement based on medical education needs within the region

  • Identify and build strong collegial relationships with thought leaders within assigned geographical area

  • Provide meaningful input into clinical research agendas by collecting and communicating customer insights

  • Ability to effectively represent the needs of healthcare providers to US Medical Affairs

Communicate and Disseminate Medical Education and Medical Information in support of Transplant:

  • Establish and maintain credible peer-to-peer scientific interaction with thought leaders

  • Serve as a primary resource for clinical and scientific information to internal and external stakeholders

  • Participate in scientific congresses and professional meetings via podium or poster presentations

  • Connect healthcare providers with appropriate Sanofi medical resources to address their information needs

Collaborate with Field and Home Office Partners:

  • Demonstrate excellent teamwork within US Medical Affairs and with cross-functional partners

  • Contribute to medical or business partner meetings and provide scientific updates

  • Provide input in the development of clinically relevant regional or national medical meetings

  • Serve as a medical resource for ongoing training needs

Communicate Impactful Field Insights in support of Transplant:

  • Identify and regularly communicate field insights and emerging clinical trends to internal stakeholders

  • Communicate field insights to the Medical Core team

Identify Potential Clinical Research Investigators in support of Transplantation:

  • Identify, evaluate, and communicate potential opportunities for qualified clinical investigators

  • Serve as a liaison for the review and submission of Investigator Sponsored Trial proposals

Demonstrate Compliance:

  • Complete all required training and adhere to corporate policies and procedures

  • Complete all activity documentation and administrative responsibilities in a timely manner

About you:

Basic Requirements

  • Advanced degree in a relevant scientific or medical field (MD, PhD, PharmD, NP, PA, or equivalent clinical advanced degree)

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry, managed care, or patient care setting (academic or clinical experience in transplantation or a related field will also be considered)

  • Must reside in territory.

  • Experience in transplantation, Solid Organ Transplant (SOT), kidney, lung, or Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Post-doctoral residency or fellowship in solid organ transplant, bone marrow transplant, or pharmaceutical program

  • Prior MSL or field medical experience

  • Transplant certification or equivalent specialized training

  • Experience in clinical research design and execution

  • Prior pharmaceutical industry experience

  • MBA, MHA, or MPH

MSLs will be held accountable to various departments, corporate and / or product-specific goals as determined and specified by the Director and Director.

MSLs will be expected to demonstrate exceptional levels of technical and strategic expertise, integrity and professionalism and a strong awareness of and adherence to field medical policy and applicable scientific, legal, and regulatory standards. MSLs operate within the field and thus must demonstrate the capability to act independently with limited guidance.

Specific competencies of particular importance to the role include, but are not limited to:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including strong presentation capabilities and the ability to appropriately inform and influence contexts that include decision-making.

  • Strong scientific knowledge with an in-depth understanding of the evolving US healthcare system.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in managing multiple therapeutic areas and strategic initiatives including health outcomes, quality initiatives, consensus standards, evidence-based guidelines, and health care policy.

  • Excellent verbal and written interpersonal skills appropriate for customer environments, and the capability to establish scientific credibility and communicate scientific information clearly and succinctly.

  • Excellent organizational skills, leadership, and the ability to work independently.

  • Demonstrated strategic thinking capability.

  • Profound understanding of compliance standards and practices.

  • Capability to interact successfully with all levels of matrix partners and stakeholders and network with both internal and external colleagues.

  • Demonstrated exceptional proficiency in business planning and time management in settings that require management of multiple, concurrent priorities.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

  • Help shape the future of care for chronic and complex conditions like aT1D, Type 2 diabetes, transplant, and cardiovascular disease.

  • Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.

  • Be part of a simpler, digital- and AI-powered business that’s rethinking how we work and engage with the world.

jobs.description:
Purpose and Charge: The charge of the Commission on Social Witness (CSW) is to oversee the collective social witness process among Unitarian Universalist Association (UUA) member congregations and groups. Social witness is the act of courageously affirming what is just and good through speech and action that demonstrates solidarity with those who are marginalized; collective social witness collaboratively imagines and embodies social witness for collective liberation.

We envision a faith engaging in multigenerational, multicultural, accessible, social witness that is in relationship with what is emerging in social justice movements within and beyond Unitarian Universalism, enabling us to live into discomfort and to adapt into a healing, transformative reality.

Mission: The CSW's mission is to amplify emerging social action, promote connections, and nurture accountable social witness across the Association. We pursue our vision and mission in accountable relationships that seek equitable empowerment with people and groups most impacted by oppression, hate, and violence. Together, we celebrate how seeking justice in news ways of relating brings joy to the process of collective social witness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build relationships beyond the commission especially with marginalized groups: meet, reach out, cold calls, connecting
  • Center marginalized voices in this work (internal/external meetings, plans, processes)
  • Innovate mechanisms for feedback from our congregational leaders
  • Amplify stories of justice in Unitarian Universalism
  • Participate in GA annually (online or in person) to guide social witness process, offer workshops, reports etc.
  • Organize and participate in events (throughout the year beyond GA) and opportunities to amplify social witness action and build connections among UUs in action.

Skills Needed: Desire to learn and grow in an anti-oppressive, multi-cultural, intergenerational faith, receiving constructive feedback and offering it too, as we all seek a new way in the world that is more relational and justice-giving. Engage in online meetings via Zoom and (at such time as travel is prudent), travel up to three times per year (may include travel to General Assembly and/or social witness events). Please note that although we meet on Zoom, calling in and voice only is always an option, and Zoom supports live transcription captions. Phone and/or internet access to meetings are required.

Length of Term: 4 years (maximum of 2 terms with a minimum of 4 years between terms)

Meetings: 12-16 per year (1-3 hours each)

Other Important Information: The Commission is in a process of transformation and growth toward more fully living into our anti-oppressive values. Potential members will need a willingness to explore creative growth, cope with ambiguity, experiment and learn from new ways of doing things, and compassionately share feedback among the commission and beyond. Above all, in order to promote and affirm the inherent dignity of all people we must by definition center historically marginalized voices in this process.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: TL;DR As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll embed with customers and partners to build, deploy, and win the technical trust that lands and grows enterprise deals.
jobs.description:
TL;DR As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll embed with customers and partners to build, deploy, and win the technical trust that lands and grows enterprise deals. Remote, low travel, high ownership. We are looking for someone who can build, understand how enterprises work, and walk into a room and talk to a CIO like a peer. You've spent years in the enterprise space—maybe leading teams, maybe sitting in our buyer's chair—and you're ready to get deeply hands-on again: closer to the code, closer to customers, and using AI tools to move fast. If that sounds like you, read on.

Role Overview

Forward Deployed Engineers are Harper's most trusted people in the field—highly technical, customer-facing engineers who embed in customer environments, drive real adoption and outcomes, and are trusted advisors when it's time to win the business.

This is a role for someone with deep, been-there-done-that enterprise experience and a consulting mindset. You'll build, deploy, and troubleshoot inside real customer environments, and you'll sit across from enterprise buyers and speak their language because you've been in their chair. You'll lean on modern AI tooling every day to move faster, and you'll help customers see how AI fits into their architecture.

We care far more that you can walk into a room with a CIO, architect, or operations lead and talk about their real problems with authenticity than we do about any single development framework or services delivery experience on your resume. We move fast, wear many hats, and value people who flex to get things done. You won't have a playbook for most things; instead you'll help write it.

And unlike most forward-deployed roles: this one is remote and doesn’t require constant travel.

If you're tired of the corporate grind and want to get your hands dirty again—closer to the code, closer to customers, using your experience where it counts—this is your stage.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Technical Delivery

  • Partner closely with customers to understand technical requirements, business objectives, and operational constraints.
  • Build, configure, customize, integrate, and deploy Harper's platform to meet unique customer workflows—directly within customer environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve systems, data, integration, and operational issues during deployment and after go-live.
  • Own customer outcomes end-to-end, working independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments while staying aligned with internal teams and partners.

What success looks like: Customers achieve measurable outcomes from their Harper implementations, with stable production workloads they can own independently.

Customer Calls & Presales Support

  • Get in the room with enterprise buyers—leading technical discussions with developers, architects, and executive sponsors with the authenticity of someone who has sat in their seat.
  • Support the sales cycle: run discovery, shape technical direction, and help prove Harper's value to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Take the lead in conversations and reframe when a proposed approach doesn't fit Harper's platform strategy—leaning into what the platform does and why it's the right call.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the relationship, guiding customers on scalability, reliability, performance, security, and long-term operations.

What success looks like: Harper earns the technical trust that wins and expands enterprise deals, and customers see a credible partner who understands their world.

Solution Engineering & Hands-On Development

  • Write and ship production-quality code, scripts, APIs, and automation to extend Harper's capabilities on behalf of customers.
  • Prototype custom functionality and deliver field-ready solutions that address immediate customer needs, validated in real customer environments.
  • Lean into Harper's opinionated, platform-first model—using what the platform provides rather than rebuilding it from scratch—so customers get up and running fast.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to ensure custom solutions align with long-term platform direction.

What success looks like: Solutions are developed rapidly and map cleanly to a stable path to production, with technical objections resolved swiftly.

Partner Enablement & Co-Delivery

  • Enable and upskill system integrators and technology partners to deliver Harper solutions independently and at scale.
  • Co-deliver strategic engagements alongside partners, providing deep technical guidance and quality assurance.
  • Build reusable delivery assets, reference architectures, and best practices that expand partner-led delivery capacity.

What success looks like: Partners are enabled to deliver Harper's value independently, expanding delivery capacity and Harper's reach.

Product Insight & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the customer's voice inside Harper—gathering field insights, surfacing real-world gaps and customer patterns, and bringing them to Product and Engineering with evidence and a clear point of view.
  • Partner with Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success across the customer lifecycle, and hand off cleanly for a smooth path to production.
  • Participate in post-engagement reviews, capture lessons learned, and mentor peers to raise the delivery bar across the team.

What success looks like: Field insights directly influence product improvements and roadmap decisions, and the whole team delivers better over time.

Incident Support & On-Call

  • Participate in on-call rotations to support platform reliability and availability.
  • Provide engineering expertise during incidents and escalations, troubleshooting platform and infrastructure issues to minimize customer impact.

AI Fluency & Modern Engineering

AI is core to how Harper builds, sells, and delivers—and it's core to this role. Forward Deployed Engineers are expected to be fluent, hands-on users of AI tooling and conversant in the concepts behind it: able to accelerate their own work, demonstrate AI-enabled patterns to customers, and reason credibly about models and workflows in technical conversations.

AI-Assisted Coding & Productivity

  • Use AI coding assistants fluently (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build, deploy, and troubleshoot faster—prompting effectively, reviewing generated code critically, and knowing when to trust versus verify output.
  • Apply agentic and automation workflows to accelerate repetitive engineering, integration, and enablement tasks.

Problem Solving & Applied Reasoning

  • Decompose ambiguous, open-ended technical problems and use AI as a force multiplier for research, design, and debugging—paired with sound engineering judgment.
  • Rapidly get up to speed on unfamiliar systems, codebases, and customer domains by combining AI-assisted exploration with hands-on validation.

Understanding of Models, Concepts & Workflows

  • Hold a solid working understanding of modern AI concepts—LLMs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, context windows, tokens, agents, and tool use—and their practical trade-offs.
  • Reason credibly with customers about model capabilities, limitations, cost/latency trade-offs, and how AI patterns integrate with Harper's data and platform architecture.

What success looks like: You demonstrably move faster with AI, and customers trust Harper's technical authority on how AI fits into their architecture.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Customers achieve measurable outcomes from their Harper implementations and can operate independently.
  • Harper earns the technical trust that wins and expands enterprise deals.
  • Partners are enabled to deliver Harper's value independently, expanding delivery capacity and reach.
  • Deployment timelines accelerate without compromising stability or adoption quality.
  • Technical barriers are resolved swiftly, with solutions that scale beyond individual engagements.
  • Feedback from the field directly influences product improvements and roadmap decisions.

What This Role Is Not

This role is intentionally different from many traditional engineering or delivery positions. To ensure clarity and alignment, it is important to understand what this role is not:

  • Not a heads-down engineering role. We are not hiring an engineer who wants to rebuild everything from scratch. If your instinct is to replace the platform's logging, messaging, or defaults rather than build on them, this isn't the fit—and you don't need prior Node.js experience to succeed here.
  • Not a role removed from customers. This is not a behind-the-scenes position. You work directly with customers and partners, leading technical conversations, navigating real-world constraints and trade-offs, and owning outcomes.
  • Not a repeatable, template-driven delivery role. Each engagement is unique and requires adapting solutions to new technical, operational, and business contexts.
  • Not traditional product engineering. You'll work outside sprint-based development structures, accountable for outcomes rather than feature delivery, with no separate QA team validating your work.
  • Not a narrowly scoped function. The role spans problem framing, solution design, delivery, presales, partner enablement, and customer communication—comfort across technical, commercial, and interpersonal dimensions is required.

Qualifications

Required

  • Deep enterprise experience with a consulting mindset (top priority). 8–10+ years of real-world experience, often including team or senior leadership. You've owned client outcomes, navigated ambiguity, and can speak to enterprise buyers with the authenticity of someone who has been in their chair.
  • Genuinely customer-facing. You want to be on customer calls, lead the conversation, and do presales work—not just build behind the scenes.
  • A hands-on development background (language-agnostic). You can build, script, and validate solutions and get into the terminal. You do not need prior Node.js experience—if you have a solid development foundation and the experience we're after, we'll teach you our stack.
  • Platform-first instincts. You appreciate opinionated platforms and lean into what they do well, rather than reflexively rebuilding from scratch.
  • Fluency with AI coding assistants and a working understanding of modern AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, embeddings, agents, and workflows), with the ability to apply them in real technical work.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You thrive in fast-moving, early-stage environments and hold yourself accountable for outcomes rather than tickets.
  • Excellent communication skills. You can build trust with, and translate between, technical practitioners and business leaders.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations to support platform reliability.

Preferred

  • Prior leadership or senior individual-contributor experience in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience enabling and co-delivering with system integrators, channel, or technology partners.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems, databases, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with Harper or developer-focused / data infrastructure products.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Node.js is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.
  • Familiarity with, or general understanding of, web performance and core web vitals.

Tools We Use

Node.js, GitHub, Docker, Postman, Grafana, Terminal (SSH, Bash), AI Coding Assistants, Google Workspaces, Slack, Zoom, Teams, WebEx, Rocketlane.

Why This Role Matters at Harper

Forward Deployed Engineers are a critical differentiator for Harper's customer outcomes. FDEs accelerate time to value, reduce delivery friction, and ensure Harper's platform is not just adopted technically but operationally embedded within customer organizations. As Harper scales through partnerships, FDEs multiply the company's impact—enabling partners to deliver at scale and turning complex technical challenges into measurable business value and strategic success stories.

Salary: $150,000 – $200,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: You focus on closing.  We’ll focus on filling your calendar.
jobs.description:
You focus on closing. We’ll focus on filling your calendar.

We’re Fuelerate, a growth partner for Shopify brands.
We help eCommerce brands grow through CRO, high-converting
redesigns,and A/B testing. We have a strong offer, proven client results,
and an acquisition engine we’re ready to scale.

Now we’re looking for an E-commerce Sales Closer who can turn qualified opportunities into signed deals.

Once ramped up, our goal is to put 6–8 qualified calls per day on your calendar. Your job is to understand the prospect, find the real problem, position the right solution, and close.If you’re obsessed with sales, want serious call volume, and get excited about closing $6k–$15k deals, keep reading.

What We Value

At Fuelerate, we move fast and care about results.We value ownership, speed, accountability, and high standards.That means owning your numbers. Following up when others stop. Learning from lost deals. Getting better every week. And never waiting for someone else to push an opportunity forward.You’ll have support, training, and a calendar of opportunities. But what happens on those calls is yours to own.

If you’re competitive, coachable, and want to become exceptional at sales, you’ll thrive here.If you need to be pushed, avoid accountability, or are comfortable being average, this won’t be the right environment.

What You’ll Do

Your main job is simple: close qualified eCommerce brands.

You’ll:

  • run sales calls with eCommerce founders and decision-makers
  • understand their business, problems, goals, and growth opportunities
  • sell CRO redesigns and ongoing A/B testing services
  • manage deals from discovery through proposal and close
  • follow up consistently and keep opportunities moving
  • maintain a clean, accurate pipeline
  • learn our offers, case studies, and sales process deeply
  • work with our CRO team when deeper strategy is needed
  • review your calls and continuously improve your close rate
  • help us improve our sales process as we scale

This is not primarily a prospecting role.We’re building the acquisition engine to keep our closers busy. You may help with other sales activities while ramping, but your main responsibility is closing.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of B2B sales experience
  • proven experience closing deals, not just setting appointments
  • agency sales experience OR experience selling an eCommerce-focused B2B offer
  • experience selling to founders and senior decision-makers
  • strong discovery, objection handling, follow-up, and closing skills
  • excellent spoken and written English
  • strong understanding of eCommerce and DTC businesses
  • confidence discussing revenue, conversion rates, marketing, and growth
  • a track record of hitting sales targets
  • strong ownership over your pipeline and results

Bonus points for:

  • experience selling CRO, Shopify development, web design, paid media, or other agency services
  • experience selling $5k–$15k+ offers
  • experience selling recurring retainers
  • deep Shopify / DTC knowledge
  • experience selling to US-based brands

Why Fuelerate

Qualified Call VolumeOur bottleneck is sales capacity, not acquisition. Once ramped, our goal is to give you 6–8 qualified calls per day.

A Strong ProductYou’ll sell CRO services that create measurable value for our clients, backed by real results and case studies.

Serious Earning PotentialOur average deals are around $6k–$15k, with strong commissions and uncapped upside.

Real OwnershipYou own your calls, pipeline, follow-ups, and results. We give you room to perform.

Leadership OpportunityWe’re building a team of 2–3 closers. Top performers will have opportunities to grow into sales leadership as Fuelerate scales.

Challenges (Honest Bit)

This is not a passive sales job. You’ll be expected to:

  • handle multiple calls per day
  • stay sharp even after hearing 'no'
  • follow up relentlessly
  • own your numbers
  • learn from lost deals
  • understand the business behind what you’re selling
  • continuously improve your sales skills

You won't need to spend your whole day hunting for someone to sell to. But when we put an opportunity on your calendar, we expect you to make the most of it.

Details

Type: Full-time
Location: Remote
Target Market: US / North American eCommerce brands
Average Deal Size: $6k–$15k
Target Call Volume: 6–8 qualified calls/day once fully ramped
Target Close Rate: 25%+
Compensation / OTE: Performance-based commission with $10k–$20k+ monthly earning potential for strong performers. Uncapped upside.
Reports to: CEO

Ready to Close?

If you’re a proven closer who understands eCommerce and wants a calendar full of real opportunities, we want to hear from you.

Astanza is seeking motivated, relationship-driven independent sales representatives to support the launch and growth of Dermalosophy in the U.S. market. Dermalosophy is a professional skincare line designed for aesthetic practices, medical spas, dermatology offices, plastic surgery practices, and other skincare-focused providers.

This is a 1099 independent contractor opportunity ideal for experienced aesthetic, skincare, medical device, or beauty industry sales professionals who already have relationships within the professional aesthetics market and are looking to expand their portfolio with a differentiated skincare brand.

About the Opportunity

As an Independent Skincare Sales Representative, you will help introduce Dermalosophy to qualified professional accounts across your territory. You will be responsible for identifying prospective accounts, building relationships, presenting the brand, supporting account onboarding, and driving product sales through a professional, consultative approach.

This role is best suited for someone who is self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable working independently while representing a brand with professionalism, integrity, and enthusiasm.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities may include:

  • Identify and develop new Dermalosophy account opportunities within medical spas, dermatology practices, plastic surgery offices, wellness clinics, entrepreneurial esthetician businesses and aesthetic practices.
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers, providers, estheticians, practice managers, and business owners.
  • Present Dermalosophy’s brand story, product positioning, and professional skincare opportunity in a clear and compelling way.
  • Support account onboarding and help practices understand how Dermalosophy can fit into their retail, treatment, and patient-care offerings.
  • Maintain consistent communication with prospects and active accounts.
  • Track lead activity, follow-ups, and sales progress.
  • Collaborate with Astanza’s internal team when additional clinical, educational, or operational support is needed.
  • Represent Astanza and Dermalosophy with professionalism at all times.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for independent representatives who have:

  • Experience selling into the professional aesthetics, skincare, dermatology, plastic surgery, med spa, or wellness market.
  • Existing relationships with aesthetic practices or skincare professionals.
  • A strong understanding of consultative sales and relationship-based account development.
  • Excellent communication and follow-up skills.
  • The ability to work independently and manage your own schedule.
  • Confidence presenting products and business opportunities to professional accounts.
  • A polished, professional presence.
  • A passion for aesthetics, skincare, education, and helping practices grow.
  • Previous experience with professional skincare, aesthetic devices, injectables, practice development, or medical spa sales is strongly preferred.

Why Represent Dermalosophy?

Dermalosophy gives independent representatives the opportunity to bring a professional, skin-health-focused skincare brand to the growing U.S. aesthetics market.

Designed to support the skin before, during, and after aesthetic treatments, Dermalosophy helps practices build comprehensive skincare routines that support barrier function, hydration, radiance, and long-term patient satisfaction.

For medical spas, dermatology practices, plastic surgery offices, and aesthetic providers, Dermalosophy offers more than skincare. It provides a professional solution that helps practices enhance the patient experience, strengthen treatment plans, and create meaningful retail growth opportunities.

Astanza is a leading aesthetic technology company committed to helping providers succeed through innovative devices, hands-on education, responsive service, and long-term business support.

At Astanza, our culture is built on teamwork, integrity, education, and doing what is right for our customers. We believe in building lasting relationships, supporting our clients beyond the initial sale, and creating an environment where people are encouraged to grow, contribute, and make an impact.

Our team is passionate about aesthetics, training, customer success, and helping practices build stronger businesses. As we expand into professional skincare with Dermalosophy, we are looking for independent representatives who share our values and want to be part of a growth-focused opportunity.

This is an independent contractor opportunity. Representatives are not employees of Astanza and are responsible for managing their own schedule, business activities, expenses, and applicable taxes. Final terms, expectations, and compensation structure will be outlined in a written independent contractor agreement.

MuseHub is where millions of creators get their music tools: Muse Sounds, plugins, sample libraries and apps like MuseScore and Audacity, all in one desktop app and web storefront. We relaunched it this fall with ambitious goals, and now we’re looking for someone to own its backend.

  • Migrated a live product from one stack or cloud to another without downtime
  • Database work: profiling, indexes, query plans, caching, queues and background jobs (MySQL)
  • Production operations: logging, monitoring, debugging in prod, safe migrations, zero-downtime deploys
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Unit and integration tests, Git, code review, CI/CD
  • Basics of PCI and PII compliance for payments and accounts
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

Job Summary:

You will build the foundations the whole team stands on - cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability - and establish the reliability practice that lets us ship safely. Our customers run 24/7 mission-critical operations, so reliability is a feature, not an afterthought.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Production-first. Reliability is the product for customers who rely on us 24/7. You will ship safe, repeatable delivery, not experiments.
  • Platform and product. You will build the foundations that the whole team and portfolio stand on. One solid platform multiplies everyone's velocity.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. You will learn the domain well enough to know what "reliable" means to customers running mission-critical operations.
  • A founding role. As an early hire, you will establish the delivery and on-call culture and help raise the bar as we grow.
  • Pragmatic build or buy. You will make pragmatic build or buy decisions on infrastructure and tooling, without gold-plating.

What You'll Do

Foundations and Delivery

  • Build and own cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code and the Kubernetes foundations the team builds on.
  • Own CI/CD as a product: fast, safe, repeatable delivery.
  • Automate away toil, and codify operational knowledge into tooling and runbooks.

Reliability and Observability

  • Establish observability (metrics, logs and traces), SLOs and alerting, so the platform is measurable and debuggable.
  • Set up and mature on-call and incident response, and drive reliability improvements from postmortems.

Deployment and Cost

  • Support deployment into both cloud and customer-managed environments, and manage version and configuration drift.
  • Optimise cost and capacity, including for AI workloads.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by establishing on-call and reliability culture, and mentor as we grow.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production infrastructure: You have built and run production cloud infrastructure and owned its reliability.
  • Operations as engineering: You treat operations as engineering, not ticket-driven ops.
  • On-call maturity: You have carried real on-call for what you built.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Kubernetes and IaC: Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Azure depth: Landing zones, networking and identity on Azure.
  • Customer-managed environments: Shipping software into environments the vendor does not fully control.
  • Regulated delivery: Delivery into regulated or restricted environments.
  • Compute cost: Cost optimisation for GPUs or other expensive compute.
  • Languages: Comfortable in Python, C#/.NET or Go for tooling and automation.
  • Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software, and its reliability, security and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.
