About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is an innovative organization that is disrupting the global professional services and talent market. In response to our clients’ overwhelming demand for exceptional talent in new areas, we are expanding the breadth and depth of our Technology Services offerings, including Hybrid Cloud and DevOps, to fuel the next phase of growth. As a Practice Director for Toptal’s Cloud Services practice, you will lead and develop the team of solution architects who design, sell, and deliver hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions for our clients.

You will set the technical vision and standards for the team, shape the solutions it takes to market, and be empowered to work across organizational lines to build a world-class architecture practice. This leader will be a proven expert in hybrid cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices, and a proven people leader who has built and managed teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants. The right candidate will understand target buyers, their priorities, and the trends impacting them. Their knowledge will inform which solutions the team builds out, how we scope and package what we do, and how we create a competitive value proposition now and in the future to meet changing market needs.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for leading Toptal’s Cloud Services Team. This includes:

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of solution architects. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Hiring Talent: Recruit, onboard, and retain top solution architects, and ensure the team has the right skills in the right capacities (e.g., hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, SRE, security) to meet market demand.
  • Architecture Standards: Define reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions, and review the team’s solution designs for quality, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Pre-Sales Leadership: Partner with Sales to assess client needs, define solution approaches, and shape proposals and technical presentations. Ensure architects are matched to the right opportunities, and lead key client conversations yourself.
  • Solution Development: Work with practice and delivery leadership to turn repeatable solutions into scalable offerings, such as hybrid cloud architecture and migration, landing zones, container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD and DevSecOps, SRE and observability, and FinOps.
  • Delivery: Partner with Delivery to ensure designs are implemented successfully. Guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions, and step in directly on critical engagements.
  • Capacity and Performance: Plan team capacity, manage workload and utilization across opportunities and engagements, and track key team metrics such as pipeline support, win rate, and client satisfaction.
  • Partnerships: Build relationships with key technology and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat, HashiCorp) and keep the team’s certifications and partner alignment current.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay current on hybrid cloud, platform engineering, and DevOps trends; contribute to marketing content that builds the team’s reputation with clients and in the market.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Remain hands-on by owning architecture for strategic accounts and building proofs of concept, modeling the standard you expect from the team.

This role is highly collaborative and will work extremely closely with our Marketing, Sales, Delivery, and Talent Operations teams to fulfill the above responsibilities.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal; meet your colleagues and the Solution Architects on your team.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of our industry, Toptal’s operating model, and the core messages important to Toptal.
  • Shadow critical teams throughout the organization to learn Toptal’s core operations and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Begin developing relationships with key leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Dive deeper into the operations of key teams (e.g., Sales, Talent Operations) across the company.
  • Conduct a comprehensive review of current demand in your practice area, talent that already exists in the network, active engagements, and any work we may already be doing or have done.
  • Assess the skills, strengths, and development needs of your Solution Architects.
  • Articulate a hypothesis about how to grow the team’s impact (priorities, structure, and standards) and design experiments and execution approaches to get there.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Sales (Enterprise/SMB), Marketing, and Talent Operations.
  • Be in front of clients on a regular basis to hear from them firsthand.
  • Define the team’s operating model, architecture standards, and pre-sales engagement process.
  • Build your team and begin positively impacting revenue growth.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have moved from purely planning to execution.
  • See an impact from your involvement in early initiatives, including repeatable solutions in market and a growing pipeline supported by your team.
  • Establish key partner relationships and a clear hiring and talent plan for the team.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Feel like you made the best decision of your career.
  • Increase the growth rate of Toptal materially.
  • Have a high-performing, fully staffed Solution Architect team recognized for Hybrid Cloud and DevOps expertise.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA is preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering and architecture, with at least 5+ years leading teams of solution architects or senior engineers within cloud or technology services.
  • 3+ years managing a business or team, preferably with P&L or budget responsibility, and a proven track record of overseeing financial performance, identifying areas for improvement, and driving profitability and growth.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants.
  • Proven ability to build and scale hybrid cloud and DevOps service offerings in a consulting, managed services, technology services, or enterprise environment.
  • Deep expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including connectivity, identity, governance, and workload placement across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with data center and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) and hybrid cloud technologies (e.g., Azure Arc, AWS Outposts, Google Distributed Cloud).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker), serverless computing, and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and automation frameworks (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Argo CD).
  • Expertise in DevOps and platform engineering practices, including DevSecOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), observability, and the use of delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to drive improvement.
  • Experience with cloud migration and application modernization strategies, disaster recovery, and business continuity in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks and practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS), including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization, and of emerging trends such as AI-enabled infrastructure and operations, and edge computing.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP Architect; CKA/CKAD; Terraform Associate) are a plus.

  • Comfortable with rolling up your sleeves to do the work, demonstrating traction, and building a team over time.
  • Demonstrated success in making data-driven decisions and defining key metrics to measure progress.
  • Ability to walk in the shoes of your audience in order to understand their challenges, develop and execute an approach to solve them, and articulate the solution in a clear and compelling way.
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Refined relationship development and leadership skills with a track record of building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Confidence in your analytical abilities, with proven success in delivering results in ambiguous and sophisticated project efforts.
  • Skilled in the art of communicating (written and verbal) with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

We’re seeking remote, US or Mexico-based hacking professionals focused on red teaming to join our team – and help us build a more secure world. 

Who You Are and What You’ll Do

You are a born red teamer; you see problems and solutions in everything. You instinctively know your way around source code. You’ve plundered apps and pillaged networks (legally, of course). You have a passion for hacking that goes beyond a career – it’s a way of life for you. At this point, you may have accumulated a few disclosures, written blog posts, and given some industry talks. 

With Bishop Fox you’ll be running red teaming engagements, starting with research and including profiling organizations, defining attack objectives and crafting attack tree graphs and other key planning efforts. You will then perform operations based on planning to achieve the attack objectives through a variety of potential attack paths, including network, web applications, physical, social engineering, and others. You will help our customers understand their attack surface by communicating, ability to respond to incidents, report on steps taken, and issues discovered. Additionally, you’ll provide thoughtful, tailored, and actionable recommendations. 

As a senior-level consultant, you’ll solve challenging technical problems and build creative solutions in a client-facing role. As a trusted advisor, you’ll provide your expert opinion to help our clients navigate difficult business decisions including how to prioritize critical findings. And as a senior penetration tester, you’ll lead small teams on one-of-a-kind engagements, mentor co-workers, and contribute significantly to the advancement of our consulting practice. 

Requirements 

  • 5+ years of offensive security experience supporting a variety of adversary emulation engagements (red teaming and purple teaming) with clients from a variety of industries.
  • Working knowledge of all common operating systems such as Windows, MacOS, Linux, ChromeOS
  • Expertise in Windows Active Directory exploitation and lateral movement
  • Working knowledge of “cloud” platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP and O365/Google Workspace) and container technologies (Kubernetes/Docker)
  • Hands-on experience with c2 frameworks like Sliver, Nighthawk, Mythic, and others

  • Experience researching and developing EDR evasion techniques.
  • Proficiency in multiple programming languages (preferably Python, Golang, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, C/C++, PowerShell, and/or Bash)
  • Network and web-related protocol knowledge (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTPS, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience with social engineering, conducting reconnaissance, development, and delivery of phishing/vishing pretexts as well as an understanding of email security technologies and other related countermeasures
  • Experience assessing the security of AI systems, with a focus on tool misuse, authorization and trust boundaries, and sensitive data exposure.
  • Experience developing and using AI-enabled capabilities, including autonomous agents and multi-agent systems, to support reconnaissance, attack planning, and execution during Red Team engagements.

Nice to have:

  • OSCP/E, CRTL/CRTO, GPEN, or GXPN certifications can be helpful, but are not a necessity 

Why Bishop Fox 

At Bishop Fox, we're driven by a simple mission: deliver exceptional quality to our clients, foster a vibrant and fulfilling environment for our team, and champion excellence within our industry. Our core values, which we live by every day, are:

jobs.title: Principal AI & ML Architect
jobs.excerpt: OverviewNational Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Principal AI & ML Architect to design and build the AI and machine learning systems that power our Data Science and Applied AI teams.
jobs.description:
Overview

National Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Principal AI & ML Architect to design and build the AI and machine learning systems that power our Data Science and Applied AI teams. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Data and AI, this senior individual contributor serves both teams equally, helping shape shared architecture standards while staying hands-on in code. A core focus of this role is helping design NDR’s agentic architecture: the frameworks, patterns, and platforms that allow AI agents to reason, use tools, and act reliably across both predictive ML and Generative AI use cases. You will partner closely with the Directors of Data Science and Applied AI, as well as Data Engineering and Analytics Platforms, to move solutions from prototype to secure, scalable production. This is a unique opportunity for a technically deep, pragmatic architect who enjoys both whiteboard design and production delivery to shape how AI is built across a mission-driven company. This is a highly collaborative role, and strong teamwork and interpersonal skills are required.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Partner with Data Science and Applied AI team members to design NDR’s agentic architecture, including:
    • Agent orchestration patterns (single-agent, multi-agent, and human-in-the-loop workflows)
    • Tool and API integration standards, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and function calling
    • Memory, context management, and retrieval (RAG) layers
    • Guardrails, evaluation, observability, and cost controls for agents in production
  • Collaborate with both teams on reference architectures and reusable components so they can build AI and ML solutions on a common foundation.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, write production-quality code, and work alongside engineers and data scientists to deliver high-priority solutions.
  • Contribute to the design of end-to-end ML systems, from feature pipelines and model training through deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Help determine where agents and LLMs should call predictive ML models (and vice versa), combining both into cohesive solutions.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Analytics Platforms to help ensure data, infrastructure, and platform choices support AI and ML workloads at scale.
  • Contribute to build vs. buy evaluations for AI platforms, frameworks, and vendors, prioritizing scalable, secure, and cost-effective options.
  • Help mature MLOps and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD for models and agents, versioning, testing, and production monitoring.
  • Champion robust governance, security, privacy, and compliance for AI systems operating in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Participate in architecture and code reviews, and help document shared standards and best practices.
  • Share expertise with peers across the Data and AI organization, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and roadmaps clearly to technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Stay abreast of evolving AI and ML tools, models, and agent frameworks, and bring forward recommendations on when to adopt them.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is strongly preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in ML engineering, data science, AI engineering, or software architecture roles.
  • 3+ years in a senior, staff, principal, or architect-level role setting technical direction across multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying production-grade ML models and Generative AI applications at scale.
  • Hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic AI systems (LLM agents, tool use, multi-step workflows) to production.
  • Preferred Experience
    • Experience in financial services or a related regulated industry.
    • Familiarity with Salesforce integrations and data workflows.
    • Experience with Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, or similar enterprise AI/ML platforms.
    • Experience with voice AI or conversational AI for telephony platforms.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Expert Python skills and a track record of writing production-quality, well-tested code.
  • Strong SQL proficiency (Snowflake preferred) for data preparation and model enablement workflows.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or similar).
  • Strong grounding in classical ML, including supervised and unsupervised learning, time series, anomaly detection, and NLP.
  • Experience with MLOps and LLMOps tooling, including model registries, experiment tracking, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring.
  • Experience deploying models and services via APIs using tools such as FastAPI and Docker, with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to influence without authority and build consensus across teams with different priorities.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architecture to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience applying an AI-first approach to development, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Preferred Skills
    • Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.
    • Exposure to collaborative tools such as JIRA and Miro.

National Debt Relief Role Qualifications:

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.
  • Attain and maintain high performance expectations on a monthly basis.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Remain calm and professional during difficult discussions.
  • Take constructive feedback.
  • Available for full-time position.

Compensation Information

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This good faith pay range is provided in compliance with NYC law and the laws of other jurisdictions that may require a salary range in job postings. The salary for this position is $180,000 to $207,000 annually.

About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Want to learn more about who we are? Connect with us on social!

Benefits

National Debt Relief is a team-oriented environment full of rewards and growth opportunities for our employees. We are dedicated to our employee's success and growth within the company, through our employee mentorship and leadership programs.

Our extensive benefits package includes:

  • Generous Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Paid Holidays, Volunteer Time Off, Sick Days, and Vacation
  • 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Pre-tax Transit Benefits
  • No-Cost Life Insurance Benefits
  • Voluntary Benefits Options
  • ASPCA Pet Health Insurance Discount
  • Wellness Incentive Program

National Debt Relief is a certified Great Place to Work®!

jobs.description:
Poznaj Onwelo

Onwelo jest partnerem technologicznym, który dostarcza kompleksowe usługi, od strategii i architektury, przez wdrożenia, po utrzymanie, w obszarach transformacji cyfrowej, danych i automatyzacji. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 400 specjalistów z silnymi kompetencjami seniorskim, a na koncie mamy 300+ zrealizowanych projektów dla dużych organizacji w Polsce, Europie i USA. Działamy z kilku polskich miast oraz z biur w Niemczech, Szwajcarii i USA, łącząc lokalną obecność z globalnym zasięgiem.

O projekcie

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy specjalisty/specjalistki AI z doświadczeniem w pracy z dużymi modelami językowymi (LLM), który będzie współtworzył i budował platformę wdrożeniową dla klienta z branży healthcare.

Twoje zadania

  • Projektowanie, rozwijanie i wdrażanie rozwiązań opartych na modelach LLM

  • Tworzenie workflowów i promptów dla modeli generatywnych oraz ich ewaluacja i optymalizacja

  • Budowanie pipeline’ów przetwarzania dużych wolumenów danych

  • Integracja modeli LLM z systemami wyszukiwania informacji i bazami wiedzy (RAG) przy użyciu takich narzędzi jak LangChain, LlamaIndex, Elasticsearch, Pinecone lub innych rozwiązań wektorowych

  • Zapewnianie wysokiej jakości odpowiedzi modeli, ciągła ewaluacja wyników oraz współpraca z ekspertami merytorycznymi.

  • Monitorowanie wydajności, stabilności i kosztów wdrażanych rozwiązań AI

  • Praca zgodna z najlepszymi praktykami w zakresie bezpieczeństwa danych

  • Współpraca z zespołami biznesowymi i technicznymi na każdym etapie realizacji projektów AI

Kogo szukamy

  • Masz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z modelami LLM (np. GPT‑4, Llama, Claude, Gemini lub modele open‑source)

  • Znasz Python, HuggingFace, LangChain lub LlamaIndex, REST API i rozwiązania chmurowe (Azure, AWS lub GCP)

  • Pracujesz z dokumentami – potrafisz je czyścić, klasyfikować, wyciągać z nich kluczowe dane oraz automatyzować ich przetwarzanie

  • Masz wiedzą z zakresu prompt engineeringu, tuningu modeli oraz oceny ich jakości

  • Znasz Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) i potrafisz integrować LLM z wektorowymi bazami wiedzy (Pinecone, Elasticsearch, FAISS, Milvus, Qdrant)

  • Potrafisz przekładać potrzeby biznesowe na konkretne rozwiązania AI oraz efektywnie współpracować z różnymi działami

Co oferujemy

  • Elastyczne godzinyoraz możliwość pracy zdalnej

  • Udział w ciekawych projektach dla globalnych klientów

  • Aż 80% awansów w naszej firmie odbywa się wewnętrznie

  • 90% kadry zarządzającej ma wykształcenie techniczne

  • Dostęp do szkoleń wewnętrznych i ścieżek rozwojowych

  • Udział w wydarzeniach zespołowych, firmowych spotkaniach i Town Hallach

  • Wsparcie w budowaniu profesjonalnego wizerunku (personal branding)

  • Dostęp do ubezpieczenia na życie oraz prywatnej opieki medycznej dla siebie i rodziny

Title: Senior Software Engineer, Business Map

Location: Remote, US

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Business Map is a new team in Toast's growing Enterprise engineering org. We own how Toast models a business: its locations, the organization that owns them, and how they're grouped. More of our customers run many locations, operate as franchises, or have locations that aren't restaurants, and the platform needs to grow with them. We build the foundation other teams use to serve those customers, and we own the core services it runs on.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build that foundation. You'll own features end to end on a small team, from location creation and copy to the new Organization APIs and the internal tools that manage them, working day to day with the team's Staff and Principal engineers. The work ships into services much of Toast depends on, so you'll learn the core of the platform quickly and see your changes used across the company.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and ship features in Business Map's backend services, from a written design through production rollout
  • Own a feature area end to end, including its tests, monitoring, and staged rollout behind feature flags
  • Work with engineers on partner teams as they adopt new location and organization data
  • Join the team's on-call rotation, and fix the root causes of what you find there
  • Write designs for your features and give thoughtful code reviews
  • Help newer engineers on the team through pairing and code review

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years building backend services in Java, Kotlin, or another object-oriented language
  • Proficient with relational databases and SQL (we use Postgres)
  • Experience owning and operating production systems, including on-call and debugging live issues
  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven messaging, or microservices
  • A track record of taking ambiguous projects from design to production
  • Clear written and verbal communication with engineers and product partners
  • Experience or strong interest in using coding agents and AI-assisted development day to day

What will help you stand out

  • Experience making changes in a large, long-lived codebase while it serves production traffic
  • Experience with multi-tenant data models, account hierarchies, or multi-location systems

The opportunity

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive

  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Developer to support the migration of an enterprise digital platform from Sitecore to Contentful.

The role involves both content migration and the migration of existing applications, React/Typescript development, API integrations and modern headless architectures.

We are also looking for someone with an AI-first mindset who embraces AI-assisted and spec-driven development to improve delivery speed, quality and consistency, while retaining ownership of technical judgement and code quality.

Key Responsibilities

Application and Content Migration

  • Migrate and modernise existing Sitecore-backed applications to work with Contentful.
  • Develop, refactor and enhance frontend applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Replace Sitecore-specific dependencies, components and integrations with Contentful-compatible solutions.
  • Develop content migration tooling, scripts and automated transformation processes.
  • Implement Contentful content models, API integrations and content delivery patterns.
  • Ensure migrated applications maintain functionality, performance, accessibility and quality.

AI-Native Engineering

  • Adopt an AI-first mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to accelerate development, migration and problem-solving using AI.
  • Apply spec-driven development, using clear technical specifications, acceptance criteria and tests to guide AI-assisted implementation.
  • Leverage AI to support Sitecore analysis, schema mapping, migration script generation, application refactoring and validation.
  • Use AI coding assistants effectively while reviewing, testing and taking accountability for generated outputs.
  • Share AI-enabled development practices and contribute to improving team productivity.

Engineering Quality and Collaboration

  • Independently own complex development tasks and significant migration components.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with Lead Developers, architects, QA and content teams.
  • Support less experienced developers through mentoring, code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Strong commercial software engineering experience, particularly with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience migrating, modernising or refactoring existing frontend applications.
  • Practical experience with headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful, and an understanding of Sitecore.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns and content modelling.
  • Experience with backend development, migration scripting or data transformation.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of spec-driven development approaches.
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
  • Ability to work independently, solve complex problems and influence technical implementation decisions.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with Next.js, Sitecore JSS or CMS/DXP replatforming.
  • Experience applying AI to content analysis, migration automation, code transformation or test generation.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

jobs.excerpt: • Employment Type: Full-Time • FLSA Status: Exempt • Pay Type: Salary, Exempt.
jobs.description:
• Employment Type: Full-Time
  • FLSA Status: Exempt
  • Pay Type: Salary, Exempt. $115,000 - $140,000 annual base salary, depending on experience
  • Work Location: Remote. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. This position is open only to candidates currently residing in the United States.
  • Travel Requirement: Occasional travel for all-team meetings and client workshops

AI Technical Lead

Purpose of this Position

The AI Technical Lead is a seasoned AI practitioner and trusted client consultant who serves as the senior technical voice of VeilSun’s AI Practice. This role is consultant first. Before a model is selected or an integration is built, the Technical Lead has done the harder and more important work. They have learned the client’s business, their data, and their goals, and achieved Radical Alignment on what AI should accomplish and why. Radical Alignment is genuine, documented agreement with the client on what is being built, why it is being built, and what success looks like before development begins.

This role combines hands-on AI engineering depth with the consultative presence to guide enterprise AI roadmaps and AI service package engagements. Their expertise goes well beyond third-party AI tools. It includes models, APIs, MCP servers, and the work of connecting AI securely to client data and schemas.

The AI Technical Lead also carries an internal mandate. They redesign how VeilSun delivers, prove on real projects that AI can compress weeks of technical work into days, and build AI capability across the delivery organization. Low code moves the work. AI makes it intelligent. This role makes that promise real for our clients and keeps VeilSun’s low-code practices competitive and growing.

Business Outcomes

Success in this role means AI engagements deliver measurable client value, VeilSun delivers faster with leaner teams, and AI capability is spreading across the delivery organization. You will be measured on:

  • Engagement quality. AI roadmaps and service package engagements are technically sound, right-sized, and tied to client business outcomes.
  • Client satisfaction. Clients feel heard, informed, and confident. Risks around data, security, and model behavior are surfaced early and worked through together.
  • Acceleration results. Complex work such as data mapping and code generation moves from weeks or months to days. Results are measured, documented, and repeatable.
  • Team enablement. Delivery team members, including PMs and leadership, show measurable growth in AI skills and day-to-day adoption.
  • Knowledge distribution. AI expertise is held by multiple team members, not one person.
  • Commercial discipline. Meets the billable utilization target agreed with AI Practice leadership. Estimates are accurate and margin is protected.

Core Responsibilities

Enterprise AI Roadmapping & Client Consulting

  • Serve as the technical expert on enterprise AI roadmap and AI service package engagements, partnering with the AI Services Lead and the project lead.
  • Lead discovery with discipline. Learn the client’s business, data landscape, and systems before recommending an AI approach.
  • Achieve Radical Alignment on AI use cases, success measures, and boundaries before any build begins.
  • Translate AI possibilities into practical, phased roadmaps that deliver value in small, high-value increments.
  • Advise clients candidly on what AI can and cannot do today. Redirect them away from poorly fit use cases, unsafe data practices, or oversized investments.
  • Educate client stakeholders on tradeoffs among cost, accuracy, security, and speed so they can make informed decisions.
  • Partner with the Solution Engineer during the handoff from sales so technical design and estimates carry into delivery intact.

AI Engineering & Architecture

  • Design and build AI solutions that go beyond off-the-shelf tools, including model selection, API integration, prompt and agent design, and MCP server development.
  • Connect AI to client data and schemas securely, with attention to data quality, access controls, and governance.
  • Integrate AI capabilities with the Quickbase, Mendix, and custom web applications delivered by VeilSun’s other practices.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority on assigned AI engagements. Make and defend architecture decisions with confidence.
  • Establish and document AI development standards, reusable patterns, and evaluation practices for the practice.
  • Validate AI output quality through testing and evaluation. Keep a human in the loop where the risk calls for it.

Delivery Model Modernization

  • Redesign VeilSun’s delivery methods so engagements of $400K to $500K can be run by a project lead and one developer, with QA added when needed.
  • Identify where AI can compress effort across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements, data mapping, code generation, testing, and documentation.
  • Prove new approaches on real client projects. Measure the results and turn what works into repeatable practice.
  • Partner with the PMO and Delivery Team Managers to update estimating, staffing, and quality practices to fit the new model.

AI-Accelerated Development

  • Show the team, on live engagements, how AI cuts complex technical work like data mapping and code generation from weeks or months to days.
  • Build and share the tools, prompts, workflows, and templates that let other developers repeat those results.
  • Protect quality while moving faster. AI-generated work is reviewed, tested, and maintainable before it reaches a client.

Internal Initiatives & Platform Depth

  • Help build and accelerate VeilSun’s internal MCP integration between Claude and Quickbase.
  • Work with the related work group as testers. Gather feedback, prioritize fixes, and move the integration toward production use.
  • Learn and build VeilSun’s depth on RapidMiner AI Studio and AI Graph with existing team members so the expertise does not sit with one person.
  • Apply AI to keep VeilSun’s Quickbase practice competitive and growing through new offerings, faster delivery, and stronger client outcomes.

Team Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Lead workshops, coaching, and hands-on sessions that build AI skills across delivery, including Developers, PMs, and leadership.
  • Drive the change toward AI-first thinking about what is technically possible and how long it should take.
  • Meet people where they are. Tailor enablement to each role and build real confidence, not just awareness.
  • Mentor Developers through pairing, reviews, and direct coaching on AI-assisted development.
  • Contribute to the practice’s knowledge base. Document solutions, patterns, and lessons learned in a form others can use.

Risk Identification & Commercial Discipline

  • Scan engagements continuously for technical, data, security, scope, and client relationship risks. Raise them with enough lead time for the team to act, not react.
  • Escalate architectural and delivery risks to AI Practice leadership before they become delivery problems.
  • Balance billable delivery with enablement and internal initiative work deliberately. Meet the utilization target agreed with AI Practice leadership.
  • Size AI workstreams with practiced accuracy. Recognize when scope expansion warrants a change order and coordinate rather than absorbing it silently.

Business Development Support

  • Identify new AI use cases and account growth within assigned clients. Coordinate with the Account Manager on growth opportunities.
  • Support pre-sales efforts including technical discovery, AI readiness assessments, and proof-of-concept development when needed.

Decision Authority

You have authority to:

  • Make architecture, model, and integration design decisions on assigned AI engagements.
  • Hold or redirect scope on active engagements, in coordination with the project lead or AI Practice leadership.
  • Require rework when AI solutions do not meet quality, security, or architectural standards.
  • Pilot new AI-accelerated delivery methods on assigned engagements, in agreement with the project lead.
  • Recommend AI tools, platforms, and models for delivery and internal use, within VeilSun’s AI governance policies.
  • Escalate technical risks, data concerns, scope issues, or client issues to AI Practice leadership.

Desired Behaviors & Attributes

  • Consultant First. Approaches every engagement as a business consultant who happens to be a deep AI practitioner. Starts with the client’s problem, not the technology.
  • Radical Alignment. Does not build until alignment is real. Re-validates use cases, data assumptions, and success measures throughout the engagement.
  • Deep Technical Fluency. Understands how models, APIs, and data actually work, not just how tools present them. Stays current without being prompted.
  • Proves It. Shows what is possible with working results on real projects, not slides. Measures outcomes and shares them openly.
  • Change Leadership. Moves people toward AI-first thinking with patience and conviction. Challenges assumptions about what is possible and how long it should take.
  • Teacher at Heart. Builds capability in others rather than becoming the bottleneck. Knows the difference between doing the work and building someone’s capacity to do it.
  • Boldness and Directness. Says what needs to be said to clients, teammates, and leadership. Pushes back on unrealistic AI expectations while keeping the relationship intact.
  • Responsible Judgment. Treats client data, security, and AI governance as non-negotiable. Knows when a human must stay in the loop.
  • Composure Under Pressure. Steady when experiments fail, timelines compress, or clients are frustrated. Sets the tone for the team and does not pass stress downward.

Failure Patterns We Avoid

  • Building before Radical Alignment. Starting an AI build before use cases, data, and success measures are agreed is a fundamental failure of this role.
  • Leading with the technology. AI is a means, not the goal. Solutions must tie back to the client’s business outcomes.
  • Overpromising. Unrealistic claims about what AI can do damage client trust and VeilSun’s credibility.
  • Staying at the surface. Relying only on third-party tools when the engagement calls for deeper engineering.
  • Demonstrating without delivering. Proofs of concept that never become repeatable practice do not change how VeilSun works.
  • Hoarding expertise. Knowledge that sits with one person is a business risk, not job security.
  • Trading quality for speed. Faster delivery never excuses unreviewed, untested, or unmaintainable AI-generated work.
  • Ignoring data security and governance. Connecting AI to client data without proper controls is unacceptable.
  • Leaving people behind. Enablement that builds awareness but not skill and confidence does not change behavior.
  • Letting scope drift without surfacing it. Scope integrity is a core responsibility of this role, not the project lead’s alone.

Preferred Capabilities

  • 5+ years of software development or technical consulting experience, including 1+ years of hands-on AI solution delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or Google, including prompt design, tool use, and agent patterns.
  • Experience building or integrating MCP servers and connecting AI to enterprise data sources, APIs, and database schemas.
  • Proficiency in at least one language commonly used for AI integration, such as Python or TypeScript.
  • Experience with data science, analytics, or AI modeling platforms. VeilSun currently uses RapidMiner AI Studio and AI Graph, but experience with similar tools is acceptable, along with the willingness to build depth on ours.
  • Experience with low-code platforms, especially Quickbase or Mendix, is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated experience leading client engagements from discovery through delivery in a consulting environment.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical training, workshops, or enablement programs.
  • Working knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, and security practices.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is $115,000–$140,000, depending on experience.

VeilSun offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and supplemental insurance, short- and long-term disability, eligibility to participate in company stock or equity programs, 401(k), paid vacation, and sick time.

jobs.excerpt: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand.
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is an innovative organization that is disrupting the global professional services and talent market. In response to our clients’ overwhelming demand for exceptional talent in new areas, we are expanding the breadth and depth of our Technology Services offerings, including Hybrid Cloud and DevOps, to fuel the next phase of growth. As a Practice Director for Toptal’s Cloud Services practice, you will lead and develop the team of solution architects who design, sell, and deliver hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions for our clients.

You will set the technical vision and standards for the team, shape the solutions it takes to market, and be empowered to work across organizational lines to build a world-class architecture practice. This leader will be a proven expert in hybrid cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices, and a proven people leader who has built and managed teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants. The right candidate will understand target buyers, their priorities, and the trends impacting them. Their knowledge will inform which solutions the team builds out, how we scope and package what we do, and how we create a competitive value proposition now and in the future to meet changing market needs.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for leading Toptal’s Cloud Services Team. This includes:

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of solution architects. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Hiring Talent: Recruit, onboard, and retain top solution architects, and ensure the team has the right skills in the right capacities (e.g., hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, SRE, security) to meet market demand.
  • Architecture Standards: Define reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions, and review the team’s solution designs for quality, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Pre-Sales Leadership: Partner with Sales to assess client needs, define solution approaches, and shape proposals and technical presentations. Ensure architects are matched to the right opportunities, and lead key client conversations yourself.
  • Solution Development: Work with practice and delivery leadership to turn repeatable solutions into scalable offerings, such as hybrid cloud architecture and migration, landing zones, container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD and DevSecOps, SRE and observability, and FinOps.
  • Delivery: Partner with Delivery to ensure designs are implemented successfully. Guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions, and step in directly on critical engagements.
  • Capacity and Performance: Plan team capacity, manage workload and utilization across opportunities and engagements, and track key team metrics such as pipeline support, win rate, and client satisfaction.
  • Partnerships: Build relationships with key technology and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat, HashiCorp) and keep the team’s certifications and partner alignment current.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay current on hybrid cloud, platform engineering, and DevOps trends; contribute to marketing content that builds the team’s reputation with clients and in the market.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Remain hands-on by owning architecture for strategic accounts and building proofs of concept, modeling the standard you expect from the team.

This role is highly collaborative and will work extremely closely with our Marketing, Sales, Delivery, and Talent Operations teams to fulfill the above responsibilities.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal; meet your colleagues and the Solution Architects on your team.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of our industry, Toptal’s operating model, and the core messages important to Toptal.
  • Shadow critical teams throughout the organization to learn Toptal’s core operations and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Begin developing relationships with key leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Dive deeper into the operations of key teams (e.g., Sales, Talent Operations) across the company.
  • Conduct a comprehensive review of current demand in your practice area, talent that already exists in the network, active engagements, and any work we may already be doing or have done.
  • Assess the skills, strengths, and development needs of your Solution Architects.
  • Articulate a hypothesis about how to grow the team’s impact (priorities, structure, and standards) and design experiments and execution approaches to get there.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Sales (Enterprise/SMB), Marketing, and Talent Operations.
  • Be in front of clients on a regular basis to hear from them firsthand.
  • Define the team’s operating model, architecture standards, and pre-sales engagement process.
  • Build your team and begin positively impacting revenue growth.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have moved from purely planning to execution.
  • See an impact from your involvement in early initiatives, including repeatable solutions in market and a growing pipeline supported by your team.
  • Establish key partner relationships and a clear hiring and talent plan for the team.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Feel like you made the best decision of your career.
  • Increase the growth rate of Toptal materially.
  • Have a high-performing, fully staffed Solution Architect team recognized for Hybrid Cloud and DevOps expertise.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA is preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering and architecture, with at least 5+ years leading teams of solution architects or senior engineers within cloud or technology services.
  • 3+ years managing a business or team, preferably with P&L or budget responsibility, and a proven track record of overseeing financial performance, identifying areas for improvement, and driving profitability and growth.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants.
  • Proven ability to build and scale hybrid cloud and DevOps service offerings in a consulting, managed services, technology services, or enterprise environment.
  • Deep expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including connectivity, identity, governance, and workload placement across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with data center and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) and hybrid cloud technologies (e.g., Azure Arc, AWS Outposts, Google Distributed Cloud).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker), serverless computing, and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and automation frameworks (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Argo CD).
  • Expertise in DevOps and platform engineering practices, including DevSecOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), observability, and the use of delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to drive improvement.
  • Experience with cloud migration and application modernization strategies, disaster recovery, and business continuity in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks and practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS), including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization, and of emerging trends such as AI-enabled infrastructure and operations, and edge computing.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP Architect; CKA/CKAD; Terraform Associate) are a plus.
  • Ability to develop strong relationships with enterprise clients and executives to drive hybrid cloud and DevOps consulting engagements.
  • Proven ability to lead collaboratively and operate in a high-growth environment.
  • Skilled in articulating a strategy with a strong, agile execution plan.
  • Comfortable with rolling up your sleeves to do the work, demonstrating traction, and building a team over time.
  • Demonstrated success in making data-driven decisions and defining key metrics to measure progress.
  • Ability to walk in the shoes of your audience in order to understand their challenges, develop and execute an approach to solve them, and articulate the solution in a clear and compelling way.
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Refined relationship development and leadership skills with a track record of building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Confidence in your analytical abilities, with proven success in delivering results in ambiguous and sophisticated project efforts.
  • Skilled in the art of communicating (written and verbal) with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.excerpt: Project – the aim you’ll haveWe are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes) to join the team running managed Kubernetes services for a Dutch managed services provider.
jobs.description:
Project – the aim you’ll have

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes) to join the team running managed Kubernetes services for a Dutch managed services provider.

The clusters run on the provider's own infrastructure, on-premises and at scale, and they are production for the provider's customers, who deploy and run their own workloads on them. One team both builds and operates the platform - there is no separate ops team, so what you automate is what you are on call for.

The workload is growing faster than the current capacity can handle, which is why two senior engineers are joining. That shapes the first months: the priority is learning the environment quickly enough to take real work off the team, rather than spending a quarter reading documentation.

Your first milestone is operational independence - handling production incidents on the clusters on your own, and taking your place in the on-call rotation once onboarding is complete. From there the work moves into cluster lifecycle, automation and direct work with the customers running on the platform.

Role – how you’ll contribute

  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production Kubernetes clusters, on-premises and at scale - this is the core, day-to-day work of the role
  • Deploy, upgrade and maintain the lifecycle of the clusters
  • Work directly with the customers running on the platform: helping them deploy their workloads, and diagnosing problems with them when something breaks
  • Improve the platform through automation and GitOps
  • Write and maintain runbooks, so operational knowledge sits with the team rather than with individuals
  • Join the on-call rotation after an onboarding period

Expectations – the experience you need

  • 5+ years of hands-on Kubernetes experience, including running and debugging production clusters - diagnosing what fails under load, during upgrades, and at the networking and storage layers
  • Strong Linux fundamentals and systematic troubleshooting
  • GitOps in practice, preferably ArgoCD
  • Helm - writing and maintaining charts, not only installing them
  • Kubernetes networking at CNI level: Cilium, ingress, load balancing, DNS
  • Kubernetes storage: CSI, persistent volumes, stateful workloads
  • Working directly with customers: explaining a technical problem and its consequences to someone outside your team
  • English at C1 level - the working language with the client's engineers and with the customers running on the platform

How you work with others:

  • Takes ownership: picks up a problem, decides how to approach it, and carries it through without needing to be chased for progress
  • Spots problems before they become incidents: notices what is degrading in the environment and raises or fixes it rather than waiting for a ticket
  • Gets productive fast in an unfamiliar estate: learns by working in it and asking the right questions, rather than waiting for complete documentation

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • CKA, CKAD or CKS, CKA preferred - a current certification confirms the fundamentals are covered before you start
  • Cluster lifecycle tooling - Cluster API, kubeadm, or Rancher/RKE2 - cluster deployment and upgrades are part of the day-to-day, so experience here shortens the ramp-up
  • Python scripting and automation - most platform improvement work on this team is automation work
  • Public track record: open-source contributions, talks, blog posts or further certifications such as Kubestronaut

What we offer:

  • Flexible and remote cooperation options
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • Travels related to international projects
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Access* to language classes
  • Access* to knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Access* to private healthcare and life insurance
  • Access* to multisport card

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines employment with enjoyment.
